tr.khattab: Their messengers asked ˹them˺, “Is there any doubt about Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth? He is inviting you in order to forgive your sins, and delay your end until your appointed term.” They argued, “You are no more than humans like us! You ˹only˺ wish to turn us away from what our forefathers worshipped. So bring us some compelling proof.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَتْ لَهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ إِن نَّحْنُ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَنَآ أَن نَّأْتِيَكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Their messengers said to them, "We are only men like you, but Allah confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of Allah. And upon Allah let the believers rely.
tr.pickthall: Their messengers said unto them: We are but mortals like you, but Allah giveth grace unto whom He will of His slaves. It is not ours to bring you a warrant unless by the permission of Allah. In Allah let believers put their trust!
tr.yusufali: Their messengers said to them: "True, we are human like yourselves, but Allah doth grant His grace to such of his servants as He pleases. It is not for us to bring you an authority except as Allah permits. And on Allah let all men of faith put their trust.
tr.khattab: Their messengers said to them, “We are ˹indeed˺ only humans like you, but Allah favours whoever He chooses of His servants. It is not for us to bring you any proof without Allah’s permission. And in Allah let the believers put their trust

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لَنَآ أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَقَدْ هَدَىٰنَا سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَلَنَصْبِرَنَّ عَلَىٰ مَآ ءَاذَيْتُمُونَا ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

tr.sahih: And why should we not rely upon Allah while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon Allah let those who would rely [indeed] rely."
tr.pickthall: How should we not put our trust in Allah when He hath shown us our ways? We surely will endure the hurt ye do us. In Allah let the trusting put their trust.
tr.yusufali: "No reason have we why we should not put our trust on Allah. Indeed He Has guided us to the Ways we (follow). We shall certainly bear with patience all the hurt you may cause us. For those who put their trust should put their trust on Allah."
tr.khattab: Why should we not put our trust in Allah, when He has truly guided us to ˹the very best of˺ ways? Indeed, we will patiently endure whatever harm you may cause us. And in Allah let the faithful put their trust.”

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِرُسُلِهِمْ لَنُخْرِجَنَّكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِنَآ أَوْ لَتَعُودُنَّ فِى مِلَّتِنَا ۖ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ لَنُهْلِكَنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.
tr.pickthall: And those who disbelieved said unto their messengers: Verily we will drive you out from our land, unless ye return to our religion. Then their Lord inspired them, (saying): Verily we shall destroy the wrong-doers,
tr.yusufali: And the Unbelievers said to their messengers: "Be sure we shall drive you out of our land, or ye shall return to our religion." But their Lord inspired (this Message) to them: "Verily We shall cause the wrong-doers to perish!
tr.khattab: The disbelievers then threatened their messengers, “We will certainly expel you from our land, unless you return to our faith.” So their Lord revealed to them, “We will surely destroy the wrongdoers

ayahs.ar: وَلَنُسْكِنَنَّكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامِى وَخَافَ وَعِيدِ

tr.sahih: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position and fears My threat."
tr.pickthall: And verily We shall make you to dwell in the land after them. This is for him who feareth My Majesty and feareth My threats.
tr.yusufali: "And verily We shall cause you to abide in the land, and succeed them. This for such as fear the Time when they shall stand before My tribunal,- such as fear the punishment denounced."
tr.khattab: and make you reside in the land after them. This is for whoever is in awe of standing before Me and fears My warning.”

ayahs.ar: وَٱسْتَفْتَحُوا۟ وَخَابَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ

tr.sahih: And they requested victory from Allah, and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.
tr.pickthall: And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught;
tr.yusufali: But they sought victory and decision (there and then), and frustration was the lot of every powerful obstinate transgressor.
tr.khattab: And both sides called for judgment, so every stubborn tyrant was doomed

ayahs.ar: مِّن وَرَآئِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسْقَىٰ مِن مَّآءٍۢ صَدِيدٍۢ

tr.sahih: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.
tr.pickthall: Hell is before him, and he is made to drink a festering water,
tr.yusufali: In front of such a one is Hell, and he is given, for drink, boiling fetid water.
tr.khattab: Awaiting them is Hell, and they will be left to drink oozing pus

ayahs.ar: يَتَجَرَّعُهُۥ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُسِيغُهُۥ وَيَأْتِيهِ ٱلْمَوْتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍۢ وَمَا هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍۢ ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِۦ عَذَابٌ غَلِيظٌۭ

tr.sahih: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment.
tr.pickthall: Which he sippeth but can hardly swallow, and death cometh unto him from every side while yet he cannot die, and before him is a harsh doom.
tr.yusufali: In gulps will he sip it, but never will he be near swallowing it down his throat: death will come to him from every quarter, yet will he not die: and in front of him will be a chastisement unrelenting.
tr.khattab: which they will sip with difficulty, and can hardly swallow. Death will overwhelm them from every side, yet they will not ˹be able to˺ die. Awaiting them still is harsher torment

ayahs.ar: مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ ۖ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ كَرَمَادٍ ٱشْتَدَّتْ بِهِ ٱلرِّيحُ فِى يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ مِمَّا كَسَبُوا۟ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلضَّلَٰلُ ٱلْبَعِيدُ

tr.sahih: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error.
tr.pickthall: A similitude of those who disbelieve in their Lord: Their works are as ashes which the wind bloweth hard upon a stormy day. They have no control of aught that they have earned. That is the extreme failure.
tr.yusufali: The parable of those who reject their Lord is that their works are as ashes, on which the wind blows furiously on a tempestuous day: No power have they over aught that they have earned: that is the straying far, far (from the goal).
tr.khattab: The parable of the deeds of those who disbelieve in their Lord is that of ashes fiercely blown away by wind on a stormy day. They will gain nothing from what they have earned. That is ˹truly˺ the farthest one can stray

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ

tr.sahih: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation.
tr.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth? If He will, He can remove you and bring (in) some new creation;
tr.yusufali: Seest thou not that Allah created the heavens and the earth in Truth? If He so will, He can remove you and put (in your place) a new creation?
tr.khattab: Have you not seen that Allah created the heavens and the earth for a reason? If He wills, He can eliminate you and produce a new creation

ayahs.ar: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍۢ

tr.sahih: And that is not difficult for Allah.
tr.pickthall: And that is no great matter for Allah.
tr.yusufali: Nor is that for Allah any great matter.
tr.khattab: And that is not difficult for Allah ˹at all˺

ayahs.ar: وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعًۭا فَقَالَ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًۭا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ هَدَىٰنَا ٱللَّهُ لَهَدَيْنَٰكُمْ ۖ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَجَزِعْنَآ أَمْ صَبَرْنَا مَا لَنَا مِن مَّحِيصٍۢ

tr.sahih: And they will come out [for judgement] before Allah all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allah?" They will say, "If Allah had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape."
tr.pickthall: They all come forth unto their Lord. Then those who were despised say unto those who were scornful: We were unto you a following, can ye then avert from us aught of Allah's doom? They say: Had Allah guided us, we should have guided you. Whether we rage or patiently endure is (now) all one for us; we have no place of refuge.
tr.yusufali: They will all be marshalled before Allah together: then will the weak say to those who were arrogant, "For us, we but followed you; can ye then avail us to all against the wrath of Allah?" They will reply, "If we had received the Guidance of Allah, we should have given it to you: to us it makes no difference (now) whether we rage, or bear (these torments) with patience: for ourselves there is no way of escape."
tr.khattab: They will all appear before Allah, and the lowly ˹followers˺ will appeal to the arrogant ˹leaders˺, “We were your ˹dedicated˺ followers, so will you ˹then˺ protect us from Allah’s torment in any way?” They will reply, “Had Allah guided us, we would have guided you. ˹Now˺ it is all the same for us whether we suffer patiently or impatiently, there is no escape for us.”

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لَمَّا قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍ إِلَّآ أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى ۖ فَلَا تَلُومُونِى وَلُومُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُم ۖ مَّآ أَنَا۠ بِمُصْرِخِكُمْ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُصْرِخِىَّ ۖ إِنِّى كَفَرْتُ بِمَآ أَشْرَكْتُمُونِ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allah had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allah] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."
tr.pickthall: And Satan saith, when the matter hath been decided: Lo! Allah promised you a promise of truth; and I promised you, then failed you. And I had no power over you save that I called unto you and ye obeyed me. So blame not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can ye help me, Lo! I disbelieved in that which ye before ascribed to me. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful doom.
tr.yusufali: And Satan will say when the matter is decided: "It was Allah Who gave you a promise of Truth: I too promised, but I failed in my promise to you. I had no authority over you except to call you but ye listened to me: then reproach not me, but reproach your own souls. I cannot listen to your cries, nor can ye listen to mine. I reject your former act in associating me with Allah. For wrong-doers there must be a grievous penalty."
tr.khattab: And Satan will say ˹to his followers˺ after the judgment has been passed, “Indeed, Allah has made you a true promise. I too made you a promise, but I failed you. I did not have any authority over you. I only called you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; blame yourselves. I cannot save you, nor can you save me. Indeed, I denounce your previous association of me with Allah ˹in loyalty˺. Surely the wrongdoers will suffer a painful punishment.”

ayahs.ar: وَأُدْخِلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ تَحِيَّتُهُمْ فِيهَا سَلَٰمٌ

tr.sahih: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace!"
tr.pickthall: And those who believed and did good works are made to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein abiding by permission of their Lord, their greeting therein: Peace!
tr.yusufali: But those who believe and work righteousness will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow,- to dwell therein for aye with the leave of their Lord. Their greeting therein will be: "Peace!"
tr.khattab: Those who believe and do good will be admitted into Gardens, under which rivers flow—to stay there forever by the Will of their Lord—where they will be greeted with “Peace!”

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا كَلِمَةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ كَشَجَرَةٍۢ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌۭ وَفَرْعُهَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ

tr.sahih: Have you not considered how Allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?
tr.pickthall: Seest thou not how Allah coineth a similitude: A goodly saying, as a goodly tree, its root set firm, its branches reaching into heaven,
tr.yusufali: Seest thou not how Allah sets forth a parable? - A goodly word like a goodly tree, whose root is firmly fixed, and its branches (reach) to the heavens,- of its Lord. So Allah sets forth parables for men, in order that they may receive admonition.
tr.khattab: Do you not see how Allah compares a good word to a good tree? Its root is firm and its branches reach the sky

ayahs.ar: تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا ۗ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allah presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.
tr.pickthall: Giving its fruit at every season by permission of its Lord? Allah coineth the similitudes for mankind in order that they may reflect.
tr.yusufali: It brings forth its fruit at all times, by the leave of its Lord. So Allah sets forth parables for men, in order that they may receive admonition.
tr.khattab: ˹always˺ yielding its fruit in every season by the Will of its Lord. This is how Allah sets forth parables for the people, so perhaps they will be mindful

ayahs.ar: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍۢ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبِيثَةٍ ٱجْتُثَّتْ مِن فَوْقِ ٱلْأَرْضِ مَا لَهَا مِن قَرَارٍۢ

tr.sahih: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.
tr.pickthall: And the similitude of a bad saying is as a bad tree, uprooted from upon the earth, possessing no stability.
tr.yusufali: And the parable of an evil Word is that of an evil tree: It is torn up by the root from the surface of the earth: it has no stability.
tr.khattab: And the parable of an evil word is that of an evil tree, uprooted from the earth, having no stability

ayahs.ar: يُثَبِّتُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱلْقَوْلِ ٱلثَّابِتِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۖ وَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ۚ وَيَفْعَلُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ

tr.sahih: Allah keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allah sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allah does what He wills.
tr.pickthall: Allah confirmeth those who believe by a firm saying in the life of the world and in the Hereafter, and Allah sendeth wrong-doers astray. And Allah doeth what He will.
tr.yusufali: Allah will establish in strength those who believe, with the word that stands firm, in this world and in the Hereafter; but Allah will leave, to stray, those who do wrong: Allah doeth what He willeth.
tr.khattab: Allah makes the believers steadfast with the firm Word ˹of faith˺ in this worldly life and the Hereafter. And Allah leaves the wrongdoers to stray. For Allah does what He wills

ayahs.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ كُفْرًۭا وَأَحَلُّوا۟ قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ ٱلْبَوَارِ

tr.sahih: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?
tr.pickthall: Hast thou not seen those who gave the grace of Allah in exchange for thanklessness and led their people down to the Abode of Loss,
tr.yusufali: Hast thou not turned thy vision to those who have changed the favour of Allah. Into blasphemy and caused their people to descend to the House of Perdition?-
tr.khattab: Have you not seen those ˹disbelievers˺ who meet Allah’s favours with ingratitude and lead their own people to their doom

ayahs.ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ

tr.sahih: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.
tr.pickthall: (Even to) hell? They are exposed thereto. A hapless end!
tr.yusufali: Into Hell? They will burn therein,- an evil place to stay in!
tr.khattab: In Hell they will burn. What an evil place for settlement

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَإِنَّ مَصِيرَكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: And they have attributed to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."
tr.pickthall: And they set up rivals to Allah that they may mislead (men) from His way. Say: Enjoy life (while ye may) for lo! your journey's end will be the Fire.
tr.yusufali: And they set up (idols) as equal to Allah, to mislead (men) from the Path! Say: "Enjoy (your brief power)! But verily ye are making straightway for Hell!"
tr.khattab: They set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy yourselves! Surely your destination is the Fire.”

ayahs.ar: قُل لِّعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌۭ لَّا بَيْعٌۭ فِيهِ وَلَا خِلَٰلٌ

tr.sahih: [O Muhammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange, nor any friendships.
tr.pickthall: Tell My bondmen who believe to establish worship and spend of that which We have given them, secretly and publicly, before a day cometh wherein there will be neither traffick nor befriending.
tr.yusufali: Speak to my servants who have believed, that they may establish regular prayers, and spend (in charity) out of the sustenance we have given them, secretly and openly, before the coming of a Day in which there will be neither mutual bargaining nor befriending.
tr.khattab: Tell My believing servants to establish prayer and donate from what We have provided for them—openly and secretly—before the arrival of a Day in which there will be no ransom or friendly connections

ayahs.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ لِتَجْرِىَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ

tr.sahih: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.
tr.pickthall: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth, and causeth water to descend from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you, and maketh the ships to be of service unto you, that they may run upon the sea at His command, and hath made of service unto you the rivers;
tr.yusufali: It is Allah Who hath created the heavens and the earth and sendeth down rain from the skies, and with it bringeth out fruits wherewith to feed you; it is He Who hath made the ships subject to you, that they may sail through the sea by His command; and the rivers (also) hath He made subject to you.
tr.khattab: It is Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and sends down rain from the sky, causing fruits to grow as a provision for you. He has subjected the ships for your service, sailing through the sea by His command, and has subjected the rivers for you

ayahs.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ

tr.sahih: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.
tr.pickthall: And maketh the sun and the moon, constant in their courses, to be of service unto you, and hath made of service unto you the night and the day.
tr.yusufali: And He hath made subject to you the sun and the moon, both diligently pursuing their courses; and the night and the day hath he (also) made subject to you.
tr.khattab: He has ˹also˺ subjected for you the sun and the moon, both constantly orbiting, and has subjected the day and night for you

ayahs.ar: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ

tr.sahih: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.
tr.pickthall: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.
tr.yusufali: And He giveth you of all that ye ask for. But if ye count the favours of Allah, never will ye be able to number them. Verily, man is given up to injustice and ingratitude.
tr.khattab: And He has granted you all that you asked Him for. If you tried to count Allah’s blessings, you would never be able to number them. Indeed humankind is truly unfair, ˹totally˺ ungrateful

ayahs.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدَ ءَامِنًۭا وَٱجْنُبْنِى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ ٱلْأَصْنَامَ

tr.sahih: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
tr.pickthall: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.
tr.yusufali: Remember Abraham said: "O my Lord! make this city one of peace and security: and preserve me and my sons from worshipping idols.
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when Abraham prayed, “My Lord! Make this city ˹of Mecca˺ secure, and keep me and my children away from the worship of idols

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.
tr.pickthall: My Lord! Lo! they have led many of mankind astray. But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeyeth me - Still Thou art Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: "O my Lord! they have indeed led astray many among mankind; He then who follows my (ways) is of me, and he that disobeys me,- but Thou art indeed Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: My Lord! They have caused many people to go astray. So whoever follows me is with me, and whoever disobeys me—then surely You are ˹still˺ All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: رَّبَّنَآ إِنِّىٓ أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِى بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ ٱلْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱجْعَلْ أَفْـِٔدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ تَهْوِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ وَٱرْزُقْهُم مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ

tr.sahih: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.
tr.pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful.
tr.yusufali: "O our Lord! I have made some of my offspring to dwell in a valley without cultivation, by Thy Sacred House; in order, O our Lord, that they may establish regular Prayer: so fill the hearts of some among men with love towards them, and feed them with fruits: so that they may give thanks.
tr.khattab: Our Lord! I have settled some of my offspring in a barren valley, near Your Sacred House, our Lord, so that they may establish prayer. So make the hearts of ˹believing˺ people incline towards them and provide them with fruits, so perhaps they will be thankful

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِى وَمَا نُعْلِنُ ۗ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ

tr.sahih: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven.
tr.pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah.
tr.yusufali: "O our Lord! truly Thou dost know what we conceal and what we reveal: for nothing whatever is hidden from Allah, whether on earth or in heaven.
tr.khattab: Our Lord! You certainly know what we conceal and what we reveal. Nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden from Allah

ayahs.ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ

tr.sahih: Praise to Allah, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.
tr.pickthall: Praise be to Allah Who hath given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of Prayer.
tr.yusufali: "Praise be to Allah, Who hath granted unto me in old age Isma'il and Isaac: for truly my Lord is He, the Hearer of Prayer!
tr.khattab: All praise is for Allah who has blessed me with Ishmael and Isaac in my old age. My Lord is indeed the Hearer of ˹all˺ prayers

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ

tr.sahih: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
tr.pickthall: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer.
tr.yusufali: O my Lord! make me one who establishes regular Prayer, and also (raise such) among my offspring O our Lord! and accept Thou my Prayer.
tr.khattab: My Lord! Make me and those ˹believers˺ of my descendants keep up prayer. Our Lord! Accept my prayers

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ

tr.sahih: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."
tr.pickthall: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast.
tr.yusufali: "O our Lord! cover (us) with Thy Forgiveness - me, my parents, and (all) Believers, on the Day that the Reckoning will be established!
tr.khattab: Our Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day when the judgment will come to pass.”

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَٰفِلًا عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍۢ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ

tr.sahih: And never think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].
tr.pickthall: Deem not that Allah is unaware of what the wicked do. He but giveth them a respite till a day when eyes will stare (in terror),
tr.yusufali: Think not that Allah doth not heed the deeds of those who do wrong. He but giveth them respite against a Day when the eyes will fixedly stare in horror,-
tr.khattab: Do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them until a Day when ˹their˺ eyes will stare in horror—

ayahs.ar: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِى رُءُوسِهِمْ لَا يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۖ وَأَفْـِٔدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌۭ

tr.sahih: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.
tr.pickthall: As they come hurrying on in fear, their heads upraised, their gaze returning not to them, and their hearts as air.
tr.yusufali: They running forward with necks outstretched, their heads uplifted, their gaze returning not towards them, and their hearts a (gaping) void!
tr.khattab: rushing forth, heads raised, never blinking, hearts void

ayahs.ar: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ ۗ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوٓا۟ أَقْسَمْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُم مِّن زَوَالٍۢ

tr.sahih: And, [O Muhammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, "Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers." [But it will be said], "Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?
tr.pickthall: And warn mankind of a day when the doom will come upon them, and those who did wrong will say: Our Lord! Reprieve us for a little while. We will obey Thy call and will follow the messengers. (It will be answered): Did ye not swear before that there would be no end for you?
tr.yusufali: So warn mankind of the Day when the Wrath will reach them: then will the wrong-doers say: "Our Lord! respite us (if only) for a short term: we will answer Thy call, and follow the messengers!" "What! were ye not wont to swear aforetime that ye should suffer no decline?
tr.khattab: And warn the people of the Day when the punishment will overtake ˹the wicked among˺ them, and the wrongdoers will cry, “Our Lord! Delay us for a little while. We will respond to Your call and follow the messengers!” ˹It will be said,˺ “Did you not swear before that you would never be removed ˹to the next life˺?”

ayahs.ar: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِى مَسَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ

tr.sahih: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples."
tr.pickthall: And (have ye not) dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves (of old) and (hath it not) become plain to you how We dealt with them and made examples for you?
tr.yusufali: "And ye dwelt in the dwellings of men who wronged their own souls; ye were clearly shown how We dealt with them; and We put forth (many) parables in your behoof!"
tr.khattab: You passed by the ruins of those ˹destroyed peoples˺ who had wronged themselves. It was made clear to you how We dealt with them, and We gave you ˹many˺ examples

ayahs.ar: وَقَدْ مَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ

tr.sahih: And they had planned their plan, but with Allah is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.
tr.pickthall: Verily they have plotted their plot, and their plot is with Allah, though their plot were one whereby the mountains should be moved.
tr.yusufali: Mighty indeed were the plots which they made, but their plots were (well) within the sight of Allah, even though they were such as to shake the hills!
tr.khattab: They devised every plot, which was fully known to Allah, but their plotting was not enough to ˹even˺ overpower mountains ˹let alone Allah˺

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِۦ رُسُلَهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌۭ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍۢ

tr.sahih: So never think that Allah will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.
tr.pickthall: So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).
tr.yusufali: Never think that Allah would fail his messengers in His promise: for Allah is Exalted in power, - the Lord of Retribution.
tr.khattab: So do not think ˹O Prophet˺ that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Allah is indeed Almighty, capable of punishment

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ۖ وَبَرَزُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ

tr.sahih: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and all creatures will come out before Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
tr.pickthall: On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty,
tr.yusufali: One day the earth will be changed to a different earth, and so will be the heavens, and (men) will be marshalled forth, before Allah, the One, the Irresistible;
tr.khattab: ˹Watch for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the earth will be changed into a different earth and the heavens as well, and all will appear before Allah—the One, the Supreme

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ

tr.sahih: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in shackles,
tr.pickthall: Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains,
tr.yusufali: And thou wilt see the sinners that day bound together in fetters;-
tr.khattab: On that Day you will see the wicked bound together in chains

ayahs.ar: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍۢ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ

tr.sahih: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire.
tr.pickthall: Their raiment of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces,
tr.yusufali: Their garments of liquid pitch, and their faces covered with Fire;
tr.khattab: with garments of tar, and their faces covered with flames

ayahs.ar: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّا كَسَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ

tr.sahih: So that Allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.
tr.pickthall: That Allah may repay each soul what it hath earned. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.
tr.yusufali: That Allah may requite each soul according to its deserts; and verily Allah is swift in calling to account.
tr.khattab: As such, Allah will reward every soul for what it has committed. Surely Allah is swift in reckoning

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

tr.sahih: This [Qur'an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.
tr.pickthall: This is a clear message for mankind in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is only One Allah, and that men of understanding may take heed.
tr.yusufali: Here is a Message for mankind: Let them take warning therefrom, and let them know that He is (no other than) One Allah: let men of understanding take heed.
tr.khattab: This ˹Quran˺ is a ˹sufficient˺ message for humanity so that they may take it as a warning and know that there is only One God, and so that people of reason may be mindful

ayahs.ar: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.
tr.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.
tr.yusufali: A. L. R. These are the Ayats of Revelation,- of a Qur'an that makes things clear.
tr.khattab: Alif-Lãm-Ra. These are the verses of the Book; the clear Quran

ayahs.ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
tr.pickthall: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.
tr.yusufali: Again and again will those who disbelieve, wish that they had bowed (to Allah's will) in Islam.
tr.khattab: ˹The day will come when˺ the disbelievers will certainly wish they had submitted ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
tr.pickthall: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!
tr.yusufali: Leave them alone, to enjoy (the good things of this life) and to please themselves: let (false) hope amuse them: soon will knowledge (undeceive them).
tr.khattab: ˹So˺ let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by ˹false˺ hope, for they will soon know

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

tr.sahih: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
tr.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.
tr.yusufali: Never did We destroy a population that had not a term decreed and assigned beforehand.
tr.khattab: We have never destroyed a society without a destined term

ayahs.ar: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

tr.sahih: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
tr.pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.
tr.yusufali: Neither can a people anticipate its term, nor delay it.
tr.khattab: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ

tr.sahih: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
tr.pickthall: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!
tr.yusufali: They say: "O thou to whom the Message is being revealed! truly thou art mad (or possessed)!
tr.khattab: They say, “O you to whom the Reminder is revealed! You must be insane

ayahs.ar: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
tr.pickthall: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful?
tr.yusufali: "Why bringest thou not angels to us if it be that thou hast the Truth?"
tr.khattab: Why do you not bring us the angels, if what you say is true?”

ayahs.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ

tr.sahih: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.
tr.pickthall: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.
tr.yusufali: We send not the angels down except for just cause: if they came (to the ungodly), behold! no respite would they have!
tr.khattab: We do not send the angels down except for a just cause, and then ˹the end of˺ the disbelievers will not be delayed

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.
tr.yusufali: We have, without doubt, sent down the Message; and We will assuredly guard it (from corruption).
tr.khattab: It is certainly We Who have revealed the Reminder, and it is certainly We Who will preserve it

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
tr.pickthall: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.
tr.yusufali: We did send messengers before thee amongst the religious sects of old:
tr.khattab: Indeed, We sent messengers before you ˹O Prophet˺ among the groups of early peoples

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

tr.sahih: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
tr.pickthall: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.
tr.yusufali: But never came a messenger to them but they mocked him.
tr.khattab: but no messenger ever came to them without being mocked

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.
tr.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:
tr.yusufali: Even so do we let it creep into the hearts of the sinners -
tr.khattab: This is how We allow disbelief ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked

ayahs.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
tr.pickthall: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.
tr.yusufali: That they should not believe in the (Message); but the ways of the ancients have passed away.
tr.khattab: They would not believe in this ˹Quran˺ despite the ˹many˺ examples of those ˹destroyed˺ before

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ

tr.sahih: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
tr.pickthall: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,
tr.yusufali: Even if We opened out to them a gate from heaven, and they were to continue (all day) ascending therein,
tr.khattab: And even if We opened for them a gate to heaven, through which they continued to ascend

ayahs.ar: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ

tr.sahih: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
tr.pickthall: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.
tr.yusufali: They would only say: "Our eyes have been intoxicated: Nay, we have been bewitched by sorcery."
tr.khattab: still they would say, “Our eyes have truly been dazzled! In fact, we must have been bewitched.”

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
tr.pickthall: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.
tr.yusufali: It is We Who have set out the zodiacal signs in the heavens, and made them fair-seeming to (all) beholders;
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have placed constellations in the sky, and adorned it for all to see

ayahs.ar: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]
tr.pickthall: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,
tr.yusufali: And (moreover) We have guarded them from every cursed devil:
tr.khattab: And We protected it from every accursed devil

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
tr.pickthall: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.
tr.yusufali: But any that gains a hearing by stealth, is pursued by a flaming fire, bright (to see).
tr.khattab: except the one eavesdropping, who is then pursued by a visible flare

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
tr.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.
tr.yusufali: And the earth We have spread out (like a carpet); set thereon mountains firm and immovable; and produced therein all kinds of things in due balance.
tr.khattab: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and caused everything to grow there in perfect balance

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
tr.pickthall: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.
tr.yusufali: And We have provided therein means of subsistence,- for you and for those for whose sustenance ye are not responsible.
tr.khattab: And We made in it means of sustenance for you and others, who you do not provide for

ayahs.ar: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ

tr.sahih: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.
tr.pickthall: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.
tr.yusufali: And there is not a thing but its (sources and) treasures (inexhaustible) are with Us; but We only send down thereof in due and ascertainable measures.
tr.khattab: There is not any means ˹of sustenance˺ whose reserves We do not hold, only bringing it forth in precise measure

ayahs.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
tr.pickthall: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.
tr.yusufali: And We send the fecundating winds, then cause the rain to descend from the sky, therewith providing you with water (in abundance), though ye are not the guardians of its stores.
tr.khattab: We send fertilizing winds, and bring down rain from the sky for you to drink. It is not you who hold its reserves

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
tr.pickthall: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.
tr.yusufali: And verily, it is We Who give life, and Who give death: it is We Who remain inheritors (after all else passes away).
tr.khattab: Surely it is We Who give life and cause death. And We are the ˹Eternal˺ Successor

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
tr.pickthall: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.
tr.yusufali: To Us are known those of you who hasten forward, and those who lag behind.
tr.khattab: We certainly know those who have gone before you and those who will come after ˹you˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.
tr.yusufali: Assuredly it is thy Lord Who will gather them together: for He is perfect in Wisdom and Knowledge.
tr.khattab: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ will gather them together ˹for judgment˺. He is truly All-Wise, All-Knowing

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
tr.pickthall: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,
tr.yusufali: We created man from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape;
tr.khattab: Indeed, We created man from sounding clay moulded from black mud

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ

tr.sahih: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
tr.pickthall: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.
tr.yusufali: And the Jinn race, We had created before, from the fire of a scorching wind.
tr.khattab: As for the jinn, We created them earlier from smokeless fire

ayahs.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
tr.pickthall: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,
tr.yusufali: Behold! thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man, from sounding clay from mud moulded into shape;
tr.khattab: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from sounding clay moulded from black mud

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
tr.pickthall: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.
tr.yusufali: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
tr.khattab: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”

ayahs.ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

tr.sahih: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
tr.pickthall: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together
tr.yusufali: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
tr.khattab: So the angels prostrated all together—

ayahs.ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.
tr.pickthall: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.
tr.yusufali: Not so Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
tr.khattab: but not Iblîs, who refused to prostrate with the others

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
tr.pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate?
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! what is your reason for not being among those who prostrated themselves?"
tr.khattab: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What is the matter with you that you did not join others in prostration?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
tr.pickthall: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered!
tr.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "I am not one to prostrate myself to man, whom Thou didst create from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape."
tr.khattab: He replied, “It is not for me to prostrate to a human You created from sounding clay moulded from black mud.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.
tr.pickthall: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here; for thou art rejected, accursed.
tr.khattab: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
tr.pickthall: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.
tr.yusufali: "And the curse shall be on thee till the day of Judgment."
tr.khattab: And surely upon you is condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
tr.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
tr.khattab: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
tr.pickthall: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Respite is granted thee
tr.khattab: Allah said, “You will be delayed

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

tr.sahih: Until the Day of the time well-known."
tr.pickthall: Till the Day of appointed time.
tr.yusufali: "Till the Day of the Time appointed."
tr.khattab: until the appointed Day.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,
tr.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! because Thou hast put me in the wrong, I will make (wrong) fair-seeming to them on the earth, and I will put them all in the wrong,-
tr.khattab: Satan responded, “My Lord! For allowing me to stray I will surely tempt them on earth and mislead them all together

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

tr.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
tr.pickthall: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves.
tr.yusufali: "Except Thy servants among them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
tr.khattab: except Your chosen servants among them.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
tr.pickthall: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me:
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "This (way of My sincere servants) is indeed a way that leads straight to Me.
tr.khattab: Allah said, “This is the Way, binding on Me

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
tr.pickthall: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee,
tr.yusufali: "For over My servants no authority shalt thou have, except such as put themselves in the wrong and follow thee."
tr.khattab: you will certainly have no authority over My servants, except the deviant who follow you

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
tr.pickthall: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place.
tr.yusufali: And verily, Hell is the promised abode for them all!
tr.khattab: and surely Hell is their destined place, all together

ayahs.ar: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ

tr.sahih: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."
tr.pickthall: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion.
tr.yusufali: To it are seven gates: for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned.
tr.khattab: It has seven gates, to each a group of them is designated.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings.
tr.yusufali: The righteous (will be) amid gardens and fountains (of clear-flowing water).
tr.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs

ayahs.ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

tr.sahih: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
tr.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.
tr.yusufali: (Their greeting will be): "Enter ye here in peace and security."
tr.khattab: ˹It will be said to them,˺ “Enter in peace and security.”

ayahs.ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

tr.sahih: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
tr.pickthall: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.
tr.yusufali: And We shall remove from their hearts any lurking sense of injury: (they will be) brothers (joyfully) facing each other on thrones (of dignity).
tr.khattab: We will remove whatever bitterness they had in their hearts. In a friendly manner, they will be on thrones, facing one another

ayahs.ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ

tr.sahih: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
tr.pickthall: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.
tr.yusufali: There no sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave.
tr.khattab: No fatigue will touch them there, nor will they ever be asked to leave

ayahs.ar: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tr.sahih: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
tr.yusufali: Tell My servants that I am indeed the Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful;
tr.khattab: Inform My servants ˹O Prophet˺ that I am truly the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
tr.pickthall: And that My doom is the dolorous doom.
tr.yusufali: And that My Penalty will be indeed the most grievous Penalty.
tr.khattab: and that My torment is indeed the most painful

ayahs.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

tr.sahih: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
tr.pickthall: And tell them of Abraham's guests,
tr.yusufali: Tell them about the guests of Abraham.
tr.khattab: And inform them ˹O Prophet˺ about Abraham’s guests

ayahs.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ

tr.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."
tr.pickthall: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.
tr.yusufali: When they entered his presence and said, "Peace!" He said, "We feel afraid of you!"
tr.khattab: who entered upon him and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He ˹later˺ said, “Surely we are afraid of you.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
tr.pickthall: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.
tr.yusufali: They said: "Fear not! We give thee glad tidings of a son endowed with wisdom."
tr.khattab: They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid! Surely we give you good news of a knowledgeable son.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
tr.pickthall: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings?
tr.yusufali: He said: "Do ye give me glad tidings that old age has seized me? Of what, then, is your good news?"
tr.khattab: He wondered, “Do you give me good news despite my old age? What unlikely news!”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
tr.pickthall: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing.
tr.yusufali: They said: "We give thee glad tidings in truth: be not then in despair!"
tr.khattab: They responded, “We give you good news in all truth, so do not be one of those who despair.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
tr.pickthall: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray?
tr.yusufali: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, but such as go astray?"
tr.khattab: He exclaimed, “Who would despair of the mercy of their Lord except the misguided?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
tr.pickthall: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)?
tr.yusufali: Abraham said: "What then is the business on which ye (have come), O ye messengers (of Allah)?"
tr.khattab: He ˹then˺ added, “What is your mission, O messenger-angels?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
tr.pickthall: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,
tr.yusufali: They said: "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin,
tr.khattab: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people

ayahs.ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
tr.pickthall: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,
tr.yusufali: "Excepting the adherents of Lut: them we are certainly (charged) to save (from harm),- All -
tr.khattab: As for the family of Lot, we will certainly deliver them all

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
tr.pickthall: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind.
tr.yusufali: "Except his wife, who, We have ascertained, will be among those who will lag behind."
tr.khattab: except his wife. We have determined that she will be one of the doomed.”

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
tr.pickthall: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,
tr.yusufali: At length when the messengers arrived among the adherents of Lut,
tr.khattab: So when the messengers came to the family of Lot

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
tr.pickthall: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me).
tr.yusufali: He said: "Ye appear to be uncommon folk."
tr.khattab: he said, “You are surely an unfamiliar people!”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

tr.sahih: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
tr.pickthall: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,
tr.yusufali: They said: "Yea, we have come to thee to accomplish that of which they doubt.
tr.khattab: They responded, “We have come to you with that ˹torment˺ which they have doubted

ayahs.ar: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ

tr.sahih: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
tr.pickthall: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers.
tr.yusufali: "We have brought to thee that which is inevitably due, and assuredly we tell the truth.
tr.khattab: We come to you with the truth, and we are certainly truthful

ayahs.ar: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ

tr.sahih: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
tr.pickthall: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.
tr.yusufali: "Then travel by night with thy household, when a portion of the night (yet remains), and do thou bring up the rear: let no one amongst you look back, but pass on whither ye are ordered."
tr.khattab: So travel with your family in the dark of night, and follow ˹closely˺ behind them. Do not let any of you look back, and go where you are commanded.”

ayahs.ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ

tr.sahih: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
tr.pickthall: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn.
tr.yusufali: And We made known this decree to him, that the last remnants of those (sinners) should be cut off by the morning.
tr.khattab: We revealed to him this decree: “Those ˹sinners˺ will be uprooted in the morning.”

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
tr.pickthall: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals).
tr.yusufali: The inhabitants of the city came in (mad) joy (at news of the young men).
tr.khattab: And there came the men of the city, rejoicing

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

tr.sahih: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
tr.pickthall: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!
tr.yusufali: Lut said: "These are my guests: disgrace me not:
tr.khattab: Lot pleaded, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not embarrass me

ayahs.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ

tr.sahih: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."
tr.pickthall: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!
tr.yusufali: "But fear Allah, and shame me not."
tr.khattab: Fear Allah and do not humiliate me.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
tr.pickthall: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone?
tr.yusufali: They said: "Did we not forbid thee (to speak) for all and sundry?"
tr.khattab: They responded, “Have we not forbidden you from protecting anyone?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ

tr.sahih: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
tr.pickthall: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so).
tr.yusufali: He said: "There are my daughters (to marry), if ye must act (so)."
tr.khattab: He said, “O my people! Here are my daughters ˹so marry them˺ if you wish to do so.”

ayahs.ar: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

tr.sahih: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
tr.pickthall: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death.
tr.yusufali: Verily, by thy life (O Prophet), in their wild intoxication, they wander in distraction, to and fro.
tr.khattab: By your life ˹O Prophet˺, they certainly wandered blindly, intoxicated ˹by lust˺

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ

tr.sahih: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
tr.pickthall: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.
tr.yusufali: But the (mighty) Blast overtook them before morning,
tr.khattab: So the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them at sunrise

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

tr.sahih: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
tr.pickthall: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.
tr.yusufali: And We turned (the cities) upside down, and rained down on them brimstones hard as baked clay.
tr.khattab: And We turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down and rained upon them stones of baked clay

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
tr.pickthall: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs.
tr.yusufali: Behold! in this are Signs for those who by tokens do understand.
tr.khattab: Surely in this are signs for those who contemplate

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced.
tr.yusufali: And the (cities were) right on the high-road.
tr.khattab: Their ruins still lie along a known route

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.
tr.yusufali: Behold! in this is a sign for those who believed.
tr.khattab: Surely in this is a sign for those who believe

ayahs.ar: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.
tr.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers.
tr.yusufali: And the Companions of the Wood were also wrong-doers;
tr.khattab: And the residents of the Forest were truly wrongdoers

ayahs.ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
tr.pickthall: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.
tr.yusufali: So We exacted retribution from them. They were both on an open highway, plain to see.
tr.khattab: so We inflicted punishment upon them. The ruins of both nations still lie on a well-known road

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.
tr.pickthall: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.
tr.yusufali: The Companions of the Rocky Tract also rejected the messengers:
tr.khattab: Indeed, the residents of the Stone Valley also denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

tr.sahih: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
tr.pickthall: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.
tr.yusufali: We sent them Our Signs, but they persisted in turning away from them.
tr.khattab: We gave them Our signs, but they turned away from them

ayahs.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
tr.pickthall: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.
tr.yusufali: Out of the mountains did they hew (their) edifices, (feeling themselves) secure.
tr.khattab: They carved their homes in the mountains, feeling secure

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ

tr.sahih: But the shriek seized them at early morning.
tr.pickthall: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,
tr.yusufali: But the (mighty) Blast seized them of a morning,
tr.khattab: But the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them in the morning

ayahs.ar: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

tr.sahih: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
tr.pickthall: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.
tr.yusufali: And of no avail to them was all that they did (with such art and care)!
tr.khattab: and all they achieved was of no help to them

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ

tr.sahih: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
tr.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.
tr.yusufali: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, but for just ends. And the Hour is surely coming (when this will be manifest). So overlook (any human faults) with gracious forgiveness.
tr.khattab: We have not created the heavens and the earth and everything in between except for a purpose. And the Hour is certain to come, so forgive graciously

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
tr.pickthall: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.
tr.yusufali: For verily it is thy Lord who is the Master-Creator, knowing all things.
tr.khattab: Surely your Lord is the Master Creator, All-Knowing

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.
tr.pickthall: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.
tr.yusufali: And We have bestowed upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Grand Qur'an.
tr.khattab: We have certainly granted you the seven often-repeated verses and the great Quran

ayahs.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers
tr.pickthall: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.
tr.yusufali: Strain not thine eyes. (Wistfully) at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them, nor grieve over them: but lower thy wing (in gentleness) to the believers.
tr.khattab: Do not let your eyes crave the ˹fleeting˺ pleasures We have provided for some of the disbelievers, nor grieve for them. And be gracious to the believers

ayahs.ar: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

tr.sahih: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
tr.pickthall: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,
tr.yusufali: And say: "I am indeed he that warneth openly and without ambiguity,"-
tr.khattab: And say, “I am truly sent with a clear warning”—

ayahs.ar: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
tr.pickthall: Such as We send down for those who make division,
tr.yusufali: (Of just such wrath) as We sent down on those who divided (Scripture into arbitrary parts),-
tr.khattab: ˹a warning˺ similar to what We sent to those who divided ˹the Scriptures˺

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ

tr.sahih: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.
tr.pickthall: Those who break the Qur'an into parts.
tr.yusufali: (So also on such) as have made Qur'an into shreds (as they please).
tr.khattab: who ˹now˺ accept parts of the Quran, rejecting others

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
tr.pickthall: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,
tr.yusufali: Therefore, by the Lord, We will, of a surety, call them to account,
tr.khattab: So by your Lord! We will certainly question them all

ayahs.ar: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: About what they used to do.
tr.pickthall: Of what they used to do.
tr.yusufali: For all their deeds.
tr.khattab: about what they used to do

ayahs.ar: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

tr.sahih: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
tr.pickthall: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.
tr.yusufali: Therefore expound openly what thou art commanded, and turn away from those who join false gods with Allah.
tr.khattab: So proclaim what you have been commanded, and turn away from the polytheists

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
tr.pickthall: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,
tr.yusufali: For sufficient are We unto thee against those who scoff,-
tr.khattab: Surely We will be sufficient for you against the mockers

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.
tr.pickthall: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.
tr.yusufali: Those who adopt, with Allah, another god: but soon will they come to know.
tr.khattab: who set up ˹other˺ gods with Allah. They will soon come to know

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

tr.sahih: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
tr.pickthall: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,
tr.yusufali: We do indeed know how thy heart is distressed at what they say.
tr.khattab: We certainly know that your heart is truly distressed by what they say

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
tr.pickthall: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).
tr.yusufali: But celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves in adoration.
tr.khattab: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be one of those who ˹always˺ pray

ayahs.ar: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ

tr.sahih: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
tr.pickthall: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.
tr.yusufali: And serve thy Lord until there come unto thee the Hour that is Certain.
tr.khattab: and worship your Lord until the inevitable comes your way

ayahs.ar: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

tr.sahih: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
tr.pickthall: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).
tr.yusufali: (Inevitable) cometh (to pass) the Command of Allah: seek ye not then to hasten it: Glory to Him, and far is He above having the partners they ascribe unto Him!
tr.khattab: The command of Allah is at hand, so do not hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him in worship˺

ayahs.ar: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ

tr.sahih: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
