ayahs.ar: وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ فَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَٰوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةًۭ وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّآ أَحْصَىٰهَا ۚ وَوَجَدُوا۟ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ حَاضِرًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one.
tr.pickthall: And the Book is placed, and thou seest the guilty fearful of that which is therein, and they say: What kind of a Book is this that leaveth not a small thing nor a great thing but hath counted it! And they find all that they did confronting them, and thy Lord wrongeth no-one.
tr.yusufali: And the Book (of Deeds) will be placed (before you); and thou wilt see the sinful in great terror because of what is (recorded) therein; they will say, "Ah! woe to us! what a Book is this! It leaves out nothing small or great, but takes account thereof!" They will find all that they did, placed before them: And not one will thy Lord treat with injustice.
tr.khattab: And the record ˹of deeds˺ will be laid ˹open˺, and you will see the wicked in fear of what is ˹written˺ in it. They will cry, “Woe to us! What kind of record is this that does not leave any sin, small or large, unlisted?” They will find whatever they did present ˹before them˺. And your Lord will never wrong anyone

ayahs.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۗ أَفَتَتَّخِذُونَهُۥ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِى وَهُمْ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۢ ۚ بِئْسَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَدَلًۭا

tr.sahih: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange.
tr.pickthall: And (remember) when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, and they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He was of the jinn, so he rebelled against his Lord's command. Will ye choose him and his seed for your protecting friends instead of Me, when they are an enemy unto you? Calamitous is the exchange for evil-doers.
tr.yusufali: Behold! We said to the angels, "Bow down to Adam": They bowed down except Iblis. He was one of the Jinns, and he broke the Command of his Lord. Will ye then take him and his progeny as protectors rather than Me? And they are enemies to you! Evil would be the exchange for the wrong-doers!
tr.khattab: And ˹remember˺ when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” so they all did—but not Iblîs, who was one of the jinn, but he rebelled against the command of his Lord. Would you then take him and his descendants as patrons instead of Me, although they are your enemy? What an evil alternative for the wrongdoers ˹to choose˺

ayahs.ar: ۞ مَّآ أَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ ٱلْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًۭا

tr.sahih: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.
tr.pickthall: I made them not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor their own creation; nor choose I misleaders for (My) helpers.
tr.yusufali: I called them not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor (even) their own creation: nor is it for helpers such as Me to take as lead (men) astray!
tr.khattab: I never called them to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth or ˹even˺ their own creation, nor would I take the misleaders as helpers

ayahs.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَقُولُ نَادُوا۟ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لَهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّوْبِقًۭا

tr.sahih: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, "Call 'My partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction.
tr.pickthall: And (be mindful of) the Day when He will say: Call those partners of Mine whom ye pretended. Then they will cry unto them, but they will not hear their prayer, and We shall set a gulf of doom between them.
tr.yusufali: One Day He will say, "Call on those whom ye thought to be My partners," and they will call on them, but they will not listen to them; and We shall make for them a place of common perdition.
tr.khattab: And ˹beware of˺ the Day He will say, “Call upon those you claimed were My associate-gods.” So they will call them, but will receive no response. And We will make them ˹all˺ share in the same doom

ayahs.ar: وَرَءَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ٱلنَّارَ فَظَنُّوٓا۟ أَنَّهُم مُّوَاقِعُوهَا وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًۭا

tr.sahih: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.
tr.pickthall: And the guilty behold the Fire and know that they are about to fall therein, and they find no way of escape thence.
tr.yusufali: And the Sinful shall see the fire and apprehend that they have to fall therein: no means will they find to turn away therefrom.
tr.khattab: The wicked will see the Fire and realize that they are bound to fall into it, and will find no way to avoid it

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِلنَّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَكْثَرَ شَىْءٍۢ جَدَلًۭا

tr.sahih: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur'an for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.
tr.pickthall: And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all manner of similitudes, but man is more than anything contentious.
tr.yusufali: We have explained in detail in this Qur'an, for the benefit of mankind, every kind of similitude: but man is, in most things, contentious.
tr.khattab: We have surely set forth in this Quran every ˹kind of˺ lesson for people, but humankind is the most argumentative of all beings

ayahs.ar: وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ قُبُلًۭا

tr.sahih: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.
tr.pickthall: And naught hindereth mankind from believing when the guidance cometh unto them, and from asking forgiveness of their Lord unless (it be that they wish) that the judgment of the men of old should come upon them or (that) they should be confronted with the Doom.
tr.yusufali: And what is there to keep back men from believing, now that Guidance has come to them, nor from praying for forgiveness from their Lord, but that (they ask that) the ways of the ancients be repeated with them, or the Wrath be brought to them face to face?
tr.khattab: And nothing prevents people from believing when guidance comes to them and from seeking their Lord’s forgiveness except ˹their demand˺ to meet the same fate of earlier deniers or that the torment would confront them face to face

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نُرْسِلُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَ ۚ وَيُجَٰدِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَمَآ أُنذِرُوا۟ هُزُوًۭا

tr.sahih: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule.
tr.pickthall: We send not the messengers save as bearers of good news and warners. Those who disbelieve contend with falsehood in order to refute the Truth thereby. And they take Our revelations and that wherewith they are threatened as a jest.
tr.yusufali: We only send the messengers to give Glad Tidings and to give warnings: But the unbelievers dispute with vain argument, in order therewith to weaken the truth, and they treat My Signs as a jest, as also the fact that they are warned!
tr.khattab: We do not send the messengers except as deliverers of good news and warners. But the disbelievers argue in falsehood, ˹hoping˺ to discredit the truth with it, and make a mockery of My revelations and warnings

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ ۚ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۖ وَإِن تَدْعُهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ فَلَن يَهْتَدُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.
tr.pickthall: And who doth greater wrong than he who hath been reminded of the revelations of his Lord, yet turneth away from them and forgetteth what his hands send forward (to the Judgment)? Lo! on their hearts We have placed coverings so that they understand not, and in their ears a deafness. And though thou call them to the guidance, in that case they can never be led aright.
tr.yusufali: And who doth more wrong than one who is reminded of the Signs of his Lord, but turns away from them, forgetting the (deeds) which his hands have sent forth? Verily We have set veils over their hearts lest they should understand this, and over their ears, deafness, if thou callest them to guidance, even then will they never accept guidance.
tr.khattab: And who does more wrong than those who, when reminded of their Lord’s revelations, turn away from them and forget what their own hands have done? We have certainly cast veils over their hearts—leaving them unable to comprehend this ˹Quran˺—and deafness in their ears. And if you ˹O Prophet˺ invite them to ˹true˺ guidance, they will never be ˹rightly˺ guided

ayahs.ar: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ۖ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌۭ لَّن يَجِدُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوْئِلًۭا

tr.sahih: And your Lord is the Forgiving, full of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.
tr.pickthall: Thy Lord is the Forgiver, Full of Mercy. If He took them to task (now) for what they earn, He would hasten on the doom for them; but theirs is an appointed term from which they will find no escape.
tr.yusufali: But your Lord is Most forgiving, full of Mercy. If He were to call them (at once) to account for what they have earned, then surely He would have hastened their punishment: but they have their appointed time, beyond which they will find no refuge.
tr.khattab: Your Lord is the All-Forgiving, Full of Mercy. If He were to seize them ˹immediately˺ for what they commit, He would have certainly hastened their punishment. But they have an appointed time, from which they will find no refuge

ayahs.ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰٓ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا۟ وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًۭا

tr.sahih: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.
tr.pickthall: And (all) those townships! We destroyed them when they did wrong, and We appointed a fixed time for their destruction.
tr.yusufali: Such were the populations we destroyed when they committed iniquities; but we fixed an appointed time for their destruction.
tr.khattab: Those ˹are the˺ societies We destroyed when they persisted in wrong, and We had set a time for their destruction

ayahs.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَىٰهُ لَآ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِىَ حُقُبًۭا

tr.sahih: And [mention] when Moses said to his servant, "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period."
tr.pickthall: And when Moses said unto his servant: I will not give up until I reach the point where the two rivers meet, though I march on for ages.
tr.yusufali: Behold, Moses said to his attendant, "I will not give up until I reach the junction of the two seas or (until) I spend years and years in travel."
tr.khattab: And ˹remember˺ when Moses said to his young assistant, “I will never give up until I reach the junction of the two seas, even if I travel for ages.”

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوتَهُمَا فَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ سَرَبًۭا

tr.sahih: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.
tr.pickthall: And when they reached the point where the two met, they forgot their fish, and it took its way into the waters, being free.
tr.yusufali: But when they reached the Junction, they forgot (about) their Fish, which took its course through the sea (straight) as in a tunnel.
tr.khattab: But when they ˹finally˺ reached the point where the seas met, they forgot their ˹salted˺ fish, and it made its way into the sea, slipping away ˹wondrously˺

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتَىٰهُ ءَاتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدْ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا نَصَبًۭا

tr.sahih: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."
tr.pickthall: And when they had gone further, he said unto his servant: Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey.
tr.yusufali: When they had passed on (some distance), Moses said to his attendant: "Bring us our early meal; truly we have suffered much fatigue at this (stage of) our journey."
tr.khattab: When they had passed further, he said to his assistant, “Bring us our meal! We have certainly been exhausted by today’s journey.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَآ إِلَى ٱلصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّى نَسِيتُ ٱلْحُوتَ وَمَآ أَنسَىٰنِيهُ إِلَّا ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُۥ ۚ وَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِيلَهُۥ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ عَجَبًۭا

tr.sahih: He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly".
tr.pickthall: He said: Didst thou see, when we took refuge on the rock, and I forgot the fish - and none but Satan caused me to forget to mention it - it took its way into the waters by a marvel.
tr.yusufali: He replied: "Sawest thou (what happened) when we betook ourselves to the rock? I did indeed forget (about) the Fish: none but Satan made me forget to tell (you) about it: it took its course through the sea in a marvellous way!"
tr.khattab: He replied, “Do you remember when we rested by the rock? ˹That is when˺ I forgot the fish. None made me forget to mention this except Satan. And the fish made its way into the sea miraculously.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ فَٱرْتَدَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًۭا

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.
tr.pickthall: He said: This is that which we have been seeking. So they retraced their steps again.
tr.yusufali: Moses said: "That was what we were seeking after:" So they went back on their footsteps, following (the path they had come).
tr.khattab: Moses responded, “That is ˹exactly˺ what we were looking for.” So they returned, retracing their footsteps

ayahs.ar: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا

tr.sahih: And they found a servant from among Our servants to whom we had given mercy from us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.
tr.pickthall: Then found they one of Our slaves, unto whom We had given mercy from Us, and had taught him knowledge from Our presence.
tr.yusufali: So they found one of Our servants, on whom We had bestowed Mercy from Ourselves and whom We had taught knowledge from Our own Presence.
tr.khattab: There they found a servant of Ours, to whom We had granted mercy from Us and enlightened with knowledge of Our Own

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ هَلْ أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمْتَ رُشْدًۭا

tr.sahih: Moses said to him, "May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?"
tr.pickthall: Moses said unto him: May I follow thee, to the end that thou mayst teach me right conduct of that which thou hast been taught?
tr.yusufali: Moses said to him: "May I follow thee, on the footing that thou teach me something of the (Higher) Truth which thou hast been taught?"
tr.khattab: Moses said to him, “May I follow you, provided that you teach me some of the right guidance you have been taught?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا

tr.sahih: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.
tr.pickthall: He said: Lo! thou canst not bear with me.
tr.yusufali: (The other) said: "Verily thou wilt not be able to have patience with me!"
tr.khattab: He said, “You certainly cannot be patient ˹enough˺ with me

ayahs.ar: وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ خُبْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"
tr.pickthall: How canst thou bear with that whereof thou canst not compass any knowledge?
tr.yusufali: "And how canst thou have patience about things about which thy understanding is not complete?"
tr.khattab: And how can you be patient with what is beyond your ˹realm of˺ knowledge?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرًۭا وَلَآ أَعْصِى لَكَ أَمْرًۭا

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."
tr.pickthall: He said: Allah willing, thou shalt find me patient and I shall not in aught gainsay thee.
tr.yusufali: Moses said: "Thou wilt find me, if Allah so will, (truly) patient: nor shall I disobey thee in aught."
tr.khattab: Moses assured ˹him˺, “You will find me patient, Allah willing, and I will not disobey any of your orders.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَإِنِ ٱتَّبَعْتَنِى فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِى عَن شَىْءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ أُحْدِثَ لَكَ مِنْهُ ذِكْرًۭا

tr.sahih: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention."
tr.pickthall: He said: Well, if thou go with me, ask me not concerning aught till I myself make mention of it unto thee.
tr.yusufali: The other said: "If then thou wouldst follow me, ask me no questions about anything until I myself speak to thee concerning it."
tr.khattab: He responded, “Then if you follow me, do not question me about anything until I ˹myself˺ clarify it for you.”

ayahs.ar: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا إِمْرًۭا

tr.sahih: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, al-Khidh r tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."
tr.pickthall: So they twain set out till, when they were in the ship, he made a hole therein. (Moses) said: Hast thou made a hole therein to drown the folk thereof? Thou verily hast done a dreadful thing.
tr.yusufali: So they both proceeded: until, when they were in the boat, he scuttled it. Said Moses: "Hast thou scuttled it in order to drown those in it? Truly a strange thing hast thou done!"
tr.khattab: So they set out, but after they had boarded a ship, the man made a hole in it. Moses protested, “Have you done this to drown its people? You have certainly done a terrible thing!”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا

tr.sahih: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
tr.pickthall: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?
tr.yusufali: He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me?"
tr.khattab: He replied, “Did I not say that you cannot have patience with me?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ أَمْرِى عُسْرًۭا

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not cover me in my matter with difficulty."
tr.pickthall: (Moses) said: Be not wroth with me that I forgot, and be not hard upon me for my fault.
tr.yusufali: Moses said: "Rebuke me not for forgetting, nor grieve me by raising difficulties in my case."
tr.khattab: Moses pleaded, “Excuse me for forgetting, and do not be hard on me.”

ayahs.ar: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَٰمًۭا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا زَكِيَّةًۢ بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍۢ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًۭٔا نُّكْرًۭا

tr.sahih: So they set out, until when they met a boy, al-Khidh r killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."
tr.pickthall: So they twain journeyed on till, when they met a lad, he slew him. (Moses) said: What! Hast thou slain an innocent soul who hath slain no man? Verily thou hast done a horrid thing.
tr.yusufali: Then they proceeded: until, when they met a young man, he slew him. Moses said: "Hast thou slain an innocent person who had slain none? Truly a foul (unheard of) thing hast thou done!"
tr.khattab: So they proceeded until they came across a boy, and the man killed him. Moses protested, “Have you killed an innocent soul, who killed no one? You have certainly done a horrible thing.”

ayahs.ar: ۞ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا

tr.sahih: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
tr.pickthall: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?
tr.yusufali: He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me?"
tr.khattab: He answered, “Did I not tell you that you cannot have patience with me?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍۭ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبْنِى ۖ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًۭا

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."
tr.pickthall: (Moses) said: If I ask thee after this concerning aught, keep not company with me. Thou hast received an excuse from me.
tr.yusufali: (Moses) said: "If ever I ask thee about anything after this, keep me not in thy company: then wouldst thou have received (full) excuse from my side."
tr.khattab: Moses replied, “If I ever question you about anything after this, then do not keep me in your company, for by then I would have given you enough of an excuse.”

ayahs.ar: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ ٱسْتَطْعَمَآ أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا۟ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًۭا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًۭا

tr.sahih: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
tr.pickthall: So they twain journeyed on till, when they came unto the folk of a certain township, they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests. And they found therein a wall upon the point of falling into ruin, and he repaired it. (Moses) said: If thou hadst wished, thou couldst have taken payment for it.
tr.yusufali: Then they proceeded: until, when they came to the inhabitants of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused them hospitality. They found there a wall on the point of falling down, but he set it up straight. (Moses) said: "If thou hadst wished, surely thou couldst have exacted some recompense for it!"
tr.khattab: So they moved on until they came to the people of a town. They asked them for food, but the people refused to give them hospitality. There they found a wall ready to collapse, so the man set it right. Moses protested, “If you wanted, you could have demanded a fee for this.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا

tr.sahih: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
tr.pickthall: He said: This is the parting between thee and me! I will announce unto thee the interpretation of that thou couldst not bear with patience.
tr.yusufali: He answered: "This is the parting between me and thee: now will I tell thee the interpretation of (those things) over which thou wast unable to hold patience.
tr.khattab: He replied, “This is the parting of our ways. I will explain to you what you could not bear patiently

ayahs.ar: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌۭ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًۭا

tr.sahih: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
tr.pickthall: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working on the river, and I wished to mar it, for there was a king behind them who is taking every ship by force.
tr.yusufali: "As for the boat, it belonged to certain men in dire want: they plied on the water: I but wished to render it unserviceable, for there was after them a certain king who seized on every boat by force.
tr.khattab: “As for the ship, it belonged to some poor people, working at sea. So I intended to damage it, for there was a ˹tyrant˺ king ahead of them who seizes every ˹good˺ ship by force

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
tr.pickthall: And as for the lad, his parents were believers and we feared lest he should oppress them by rebellion and disbelief.
tr.yusufali: "As for the youth, his parents were people of Faith, and we feared that he would grieve them by obstinate rebellion and ingratitude (to Allah and man).
tr.khattab: “And as for the boy, his parents were ˹true˺ believers, and we feared that he would pressure them into defiance and disbelief

ayahs.ar: فَأَرَدْنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُ زَكَوٰةًۭ وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًۭا

tr.sahih: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
tr.pickthall: And we intended that their Lord should change him for them for one better in purity and nearer to mercy.
tr.yusufali: "So we desired that their Lord would give them in exchange (a son) better in purity (of conduct) and closer in affection.
tr.khattab: So we hoped that their Lord would give them another, more virtuous and caring in his place

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَٰمَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُۥ كَنزٌۭ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُۥ عَنْ أَمْرِى ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
tr.pickthall: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father had been righteous, and thy Lord intended that they should come to their full strength and should bring forth their treasure as a mercy from their Lord; and I did it not upon my own command. Such is the interpretation of that wherewith thou couldst not bear.
tr.yusufali: "As for the wall, it belonged to two youths, orphans, in the Town; there was, beneath it, a buried treasure, to which they were entitled: their father had been a righteous man: So thy Lord desired that they should attain their age of full strength and get out their treasure - a mercy (and favour) from thy Lord. I did it not of my own accord. Such is the interpretation of (those things) over which thou wast unable to hold patience."
tr.khattab: “And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and under the wall was a treasure that belonged to them, and their father had been a righteous man. So your Lord willed that these children should come of age and retrieve their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do it ˹all˺ on my own. This is the explanation of what you could not bear patiently.”

ayahs.ar: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ ۖ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا

tr.sahih: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."
tr.pickthall: They will ask thee of Dhu'l-Qarneyn. Say: I shall recite unto you a remembrance of him.
tr.yusufali: They ask thee concerning Zul-qarnain. Say, "I will rehearse to you something of his story."
tr.khattab: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ about Ⱬul-Qarnain. Say, “I will relate to you something of his narrative.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ سَبَبًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We made him strong in the land and gave him unto every thing a road.
tr.yusufali: Verily We established his power on earth, and We gave him the ways and the means to all ends.
tr.khattab: Surely We established him in the land, and gave him the means to all things

ayahs.ar: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

tr.sahih: So he followed a way
tr.pickthall: And he followed a road
tr.yusufali: One (such) way he followed,
tr.khattab: So he travelled a course

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِى عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍۢ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًۭا ۗ قُلْنَا يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًۭا

tr.sahih: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. Allah said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."
tr.pickthall: Till, when he reached the setting-place of the sun, he found it setting in a muddy spring, and found a people thereabout. We said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Either punish or show them kindness.
tr.yusufali: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it set in a spring of murky water: Near it he found a People: We said: "O Zul-qarnain! (thou hast authority,) either to punish them, or to treat them with kindness."
tr.khattab: until he reached the setting ˹point˺ of the sun, which appeared to him to be setting in a spring of murky water, where he found some people. We said, “O Ⱬul-Qarnain! Either punish them or treat them kindly.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا

tr.sahih: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment.
tr.pickthall: He said: As for him who doeth wrong, we shall punish him, and then he will be brought back unto his Lord, Who will punish him with awful punishment!
tr.yusufali: He said: "Whoever doth wrong, him shall we punish; then shall he be sent back to his Lord; and He will punish him with a punishment unheard-of (before).
tr.khattab: He responded, “Whoever does wrong will be punished by us, then will be returned to their Lord, Who will punish them with a horrible torment

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًۭا

tr.sahih: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease."
tr.pickthall: But as for him who believeth and doeth right, good will be his reward, and We shall speak unto him a mild command.
tr.yusufali: "But whoever believes, and works righteousness,- he shall have a goodly reward, and easy will be his task as We order it by our Command."
tr.khattab: As for those who believe and do good, they will have the finest reward, and we will assign them easy commands.”

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

tr.sahih: Then he followed a way
tr.pickthall: Then he followed a road
tr.yusufali: Then followed he (another) way,
tr.khattab: Then he travelled a ˹different˺ course

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًۭا

tr.sahih: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
tr.pickthall: Till, when he reached the rising-place of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had appointed no shelter therefrom.
tr.yusufali: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no covering protection against the sun.
tr.khattab: until he reached the rising ˹point˺ of the sun. He found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no shelter from it

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًۭا

tr.sahih: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
tr.pickthall: So (it was). And We knew all concerning him.
tr.yusufali: (He left them) as they were: We completely understood what was before him.
tr.khattab: So it was. And We truly had full knowledge of him

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا

tr.sahih: Then he followed a way
tr.pickthall: Then he followed a road
tr.yusufali: Then followed he (another) way,
tr.khattab: Then he travelled a ˹third˺ course

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًۭا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًۭا

tr.sahih: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
tr.pickthall: Till, when he came between the two mountains, he found upon their hither side a folk that scarce could understand a saying.
tr.yusufali: Until, when he reached (a tract) between two mountains, he found, beneath them, a people who scarcely understood a word.
tr.khattab: until he reached ˹a pass˺ between two mountains. He found in front of them a people who could hardly understand ˹his˺ language

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا

tr.sahih: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
tr.pickthall: They said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Lo! Gog and Magog are spoiling the land. So may we pay thee tribute on condition that thou set a barrier between us and them?
tr.yusufali: They said: "O Zul-qarnain! the Gog and Magog (People) do great mischief on earth: shall we then render thee tribute in order that thou mightest erect a barrier between us and them?
tr.khattab: They pleaded, “O Ⱬul-Qarnain! Surely Gog and Magog are spreading corruption throughout the land. Should we pay you tribute, provided that you build a wall between us and them?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا

tr.sahih: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam.
tr.pickthall: He said: That wherein my Lord hath established me is better (than your tribute). Do but help me with strength (of men), I will set between you and them a bank.
tr.yusufali: He said: "(The power) in which my Lord has established me is better (than tribute): Help me therefore with strength (and labour): I will erect a strong barrier between you and them:
tr.khattab: He responded, “What my Lord has provided for me is far better. But assist me with resources, and I will build a barrier between you and them

ayahs.ar: ءَاتُونِى زُبَرَ ٱلْحَدِيدِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُوا۟ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارًۭا قَالَ ءَاتُونِىٓ أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًۭا

tr.sahih: Bring me sheets of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
tr.pickthall: Give me pieces of iron - till, when he had levelled up (the gap) between the cliffs, he said: Blow! - till, when he had made it a fire, he said: Bring me molten copper to pour thereon.
tr.yusufali: "Bring me blocks of iron." At length, when he had filled up the space between the two steep mountain-sides, He said, "Blow (with your bellows)" Then, when he had made it (red) as fire, he said: "Bring me, that I may pour over it, molten lead."
tr.khattab: Bring me blocks of iron!” Then, when he had filled up ˹the gap˺ between the two mountains, he ordered, “Blow!” When the iron became red hot, he said, “Bring me molten copper to pour over it.”

ayahs.ar: فَمَا ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟ أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًۭا

tr.sahih: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
tr.pickthall: And (Gog and Magog) were not able to surmount, nor could they pierce (it).
tr.yusufali: Thus were they made powerless to scale it or to dig through it.
tr.khattab: And so the enemies could neither scale nor tunnel through it

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَ ۖ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى حَقًّۭا

tr.sahih: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
tr.pickthall: He said: This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord cometh to pass, He will lay it low, for the promise of my Lord is true.
tr.yusufali: He said: "This is a mercy from my Lord: But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass, He will make it into dust; and the promise of my Lord is true."
tr.khattab: He declared, “This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass, He will level it to the ground. And my Lord’s promise is ever true.”

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَٰهُمْ جَمْعًۭا

tr.sahih: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
tr.pickthall: And on that day we shall let some of them surge against others, and the Trumpet will be blown. Then We shall gather them together in one gathering.
tr.yusufali: On that day We shall leave them to surge like waves on one another: the trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them all together.
tr.khattab: On that Day, We will let them surge ˹like waves˺ over one another. Later, the Trumpet will be blown, and We will gather all ˹people˺ together

ayahs.ar: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَرْضًا

tr.sahih: And We will present Hell that Day to the Disbelievers, on display -
tr.pickthall: On that day we shall present hell to the disbelievers, plain to view,
tr.yusufali: And We shall present Hell that day for Unbelievers to see, all spread out,-
tr.khattab: On that Day We will display Hell clearly for the disbelievers

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا

tr.sahih: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
tr.pickthall: Those whose eyes were hoodwinked from My reminder, and who could not bear to hear.
tr.yusufali: (Unbelievers) whose eyes had been under a veil from remembrance of Me, and who had been unable even to hear.
tr.khattab: those who turned a blind eye to My Reminder and could not stand listening ˹to it˺

ayahs.ar: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًۭا

tr.sahih: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
tr.pickthall: Do the disbelievers reckon that they can choose My bondmen as protecting friends beside Me? Lo! We have prepared hell as a welcome for the disbelievers.
tr.yusufali: Do the Unbelievers think that they can take My servants as protectors besides Me? Verily We have prepared Hell for the Unbelievers for (their) entertainment.
tr.khattab: Do the disbelievers think they can ˹simply˺ take My servants as lords instead of Me? We have surely prepared Hell as an accommodation for the disbelievers

ayahs.ar: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَٰلًا

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
tr.pickthall: Say: Shall We inform you who will be the greatest losers by their works?
tr.yusufali: Say: "Shall we tell you of those who lose most in respect of their deeds?-
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Shall we inform you of who will lose the most deeds

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا

tr.sahih: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
tr.pickthall: Those whose effort goeth astray in the life of the world, and yet they reckon that they do good work.
tr.yusufali: "Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life, while they thought that they were acquiring good by their works?"
tr.khattab: ˹They are˺ those whose efforts are in vain in this worldly life, while they think they are doing good!”

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَزْنًۭا

tr.sahih: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.
tr.pickthall: Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him. Therefor their works are vain, and on the Day of Resurrection We assign no weight to them.
tr.yusufali: They are those who deny the Signs of their Lord and the fact of their having to meet Him (in the Hereafter): vain will be their works, nor shall We, on the Day of Judgment, give them any weight.
tr.khattab: It is they who reject the signs of their Lord and their meeting with Him, rendering their deeds void, so We will not give their deeds any weight on Judgment Day

ayahs.ar: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا

tr.sahih: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
tr.pickthall: That is their reward: hell, because they disbelieved, and made a jest of Our revelations and Our messengers.
tr.yusufali: That is their reward, Hell, because they rejected Faith, and took My Signs and My Messengers by way of jest.
tr.khattab: That is their reward: Hell, for their disbelief and mockery of My signs and messengers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs are the Gardens of Paradise for welcome,
tr.yusufali: As to those who believe and work righteous deeds, they have, for their entertainment, the Gardens of Paradise,
tr.khattab: Indeed, those who believe and do good will have the Gardens of Paradise as an accommodation

ayahs.ar: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًۭا

tr.sahih: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
tr.pickthall: Wherein they will abide, with no desire to be removed from thence.
tr.yusufali: Wherein they shall dwell (for aye): no change will they wish for from them.
tr.khattab: where they will be forever, never desiring anywhere else

ayahs.ar: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًۭا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًۭا

tr.sahih: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."
tr.pickthall: Say: Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord, verily the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even though We brought the like thereof to help.
tr.yusufali: Say: "If the ocean were ink (wherewith to write out) the words of my Lord, sooner would the ocean be exhausted than would the words of my Lord, even if we added another ocean like it, for its aid."
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the ocean were ink for ˹writing˺ the Words of my Lord, it would certainly run out before the Words of my Lord were finished, even if We refilled it with its equal.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا

tr.sahih: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
tr.pickthall: Say: I am only a mortal like you. My Lord inspireth in me that your Allah is only One Allah. And whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work, and make none sharer of the worship due unto his Lord.
tr.yusufali: Say: "I am but a man like yourselves, (but) the inspiration has come to me, that your Allah is one Allah: whoever expects to meet his Lord, let him work righteousness, and, in the worship of his Lord, admit no one as partner.
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a man like you, ˹but˺ it has been revealed to me that your God is only One God. So whoever hopes for the meeting with their Lord, let them do good deeds and associate none in the worship of their Lord.”

ayahs.ar: كٓهيعٓصٓ

tr.sahih: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.
tr.pickthall: Kaf. Ha. Ya. A'in. Sad.
tr.yusufali: Kaf. Ha. Ya. 'Ain. Sad.
tr.khattab: Kãf-Ha-Ya-’Aĩn- Ṣãd

ayahs.ar: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ

tr.sahih: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
tr.pickthall: A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah.
tr.yusufali: (This is) a recital of the Mercy of thy Lord to His servant Zakariya.
tr.khattab: ˹This is˺ a reminder of your Lord’s mercy to His servant Zachariah

ayahs.ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.
tr.pickthall: When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret,
tr.yusufali: Behold! he cried to his Lord in secret,
tr.khattab: when he cried out to his Lord privately

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.
tr.pickthall: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.
tr.yusufali: Praying: "O my Lord! infirm indeed are my bones, and the hair of my head doth glisten with grey: but never am I unblest, O my Lord, in my prayer to Thee!
tr.khattab: saying, “My Lord! Surely my bones have become brittle, and grey hair has spread across my head, but I have never been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord

ayahs.ar: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
tr.pickthall: Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor
tr.yusufali: "Now I fear (what) my relatives (and colleagues) (will do) after me: but my wife is barren: so give me an heir as from Thyself,-
tr.khattab: And I am concerned about ˹the faith of˺ my relatives after me, since my wife is barren. So grant me, by Your grace, an heir

ayahs.ar: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
tr.pickthall: Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee).
tr.yusufali: "(One that) will (truly) represent me, and represent the posterity of Jacob; and make him, O my Lord! one with whom Thou art well-pleased!"
tr.khattab: who will inherit ˹prophethood˺ from me and the family of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, pleasing ˹to You˺!”

ayahs.ar: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
tr.pickthall: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him).
tr.yusufali: (His prayer was answered): "O Zakariya! We give thee good news of a son: His name shall be Yahya: on none by that name have We conferred distinction before."
tr.khattab: ˹The angels announced,˺ “O Zachariah! Indeed, We give you the good news of ˹the birth of˺ a son, whose name will be John—a name We have not given to anyone before.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?
tr.yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren and I have grown quite decrepit from old age?"
tr.khattab: He wondered, “My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have become extremely old?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا

tr.sahih: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "
tr.pickthall: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.
tr.yusufali: He said: "So (it will be) thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: I did indeed create thee before, when thou hadst been nothing!'"
tr.khattab: An angel replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me, just as I created you before, when you were nothing!’”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights.
tr.yusufali: (Zakariya) said: "O my Lord! give me a Sign." "Thy Sign," was the answer, "Shall be that thou shalt speak to no man for three nights, although thou art not dumb."
tr.khattab: Zachariah said, “My Lord! Grant me a sign.” He responded, “Your sign is that you will not ˹be able to˺ speak to people for three nights, despite being healthy.”

ayahs.ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.
tr.pickthall: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.
tr.yusufali: So Zakariya came out to his people from him chamber: He told them by signs to celebrate Allah's praises in the morning and in the evening.
tr.khattab: So he came out to his people from the sanctuary, signalling to them to glorify ˹Allah˺ morning and evening

ayahs.ar: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
tr.pickthall: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,
tr.yusufali: (To his son came the command): "O Yahya! take hold of the Book with might": and We gave him Wisdom even as a youth,
tr.khattab: ˹It was later said,˺ “O John! Hold firmly to the Scriptures.” And We granted him wisdom while ˹he was still˺ a child

ayahs.ar: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
tr.pickthall: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,
tr.yusufali: And piety (for all creatures) as from Us, and purity: He was devout,
tr.khattab: as well as purity and compassion from Us. And he was God-fearing

ayahs.ar: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
tr.pickthall: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious.
tr.yusufali: And kind to his parents, and he was not overbearing or rebellious.
tr.khattab: and kind to his parents. He was neither arrogant nor disobedient

ayahs.ar: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
tr.pickthall: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!
tr.yusufali: So Peace on him the day he was born, the day that he dies, and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)!
tr.khattab: Peace be upon him the day he was born, and the day of his death, and the day he will be raised back to life

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
tr.pickthall: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East,
tr.yusufali: Relate in the Book (the story of) Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place in the East.
tr.khattab: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place in the east

ayahs.ar: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
tr.pickthall: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man.
tr.yusufali: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent her our angel, and he appeared before her as a man in all respects.
tr.khattab: screening herself off from them. Then We sent to her Our angel, ˹Gabriel,˺ appearing before her as a man, perfectly formed

ayahs.ar: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."
tr.pickthall: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.
tr.yusufali: She said: "I seek refuge from thee to (Allah) Most Gracious: (come not near) if thou dost fear Allah."
tr.khattab: She appealed, “I truly seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you! ˹So leave me alone˺ if you are God-fearing.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."
tr.pickthall: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.
tr.yusufali: He said: "Nay, I am only a messenger from thy Lord, (to announce) to thee the gift of a holy son.
tr.khattab: He responded, “I am only a messenger from your Lord, ˹sent˺ to bless you with a pure son.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
tr.pickthall: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?
tr.yusufali: She said: "How shall I have a son, seeing that no man has touched me, and I am not unchaste?"
tr.khattab: She wondered, “How can I have a son when no man has ever touched me, nor am I unchaste?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "
tr.pickthall: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.
tr.yusufali: He said: "So (it will be): Thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: and (We wish) to appoint him as a Sign unto men and a Mercy from Us': It is a matter (so) decreed."
tr.khattab: He replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me. And so will We make him a sign for humanity and a mercy from Us.’ It is a matter ˹already˺ decreed.”

ayahs.ar: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
tr.pickthall: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place.
tr.yusufali: So she conceived him, and she retired with him to a remote place.
tr.khattab: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a remote place

ayahs.ar: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
tr.pickthall: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!
tr.yusufali: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree: She cried (in her anguish): "Ah! would that I had died before this! would that I had been a thing forgotten and out of sight!"
tr.khattab: Then the pains of labour drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She cried, “Alas! I wish I had died before this, and was a thing long forgotten!”

ayahs.ar: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
tr.pickthall: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,
tr.yusufali: But (a voice) cried to her from beneath the (palm-tree): "Grieve not! for thy Lord hath provided a rivulet beneath thee;
tr.khattab: So a voice reassured her from below her, “Do not grieve! Your Lord has provided a stream at your feet

ayahs.ar: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
tr.pickthall: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee.
tr.yusufali: "And shake towards thyself the trunk of the palm-tree: It will let fall fresh ripe dates upon thee.
tr.khattab: And shake the trunk of this palm tree towards you, it will drop fresh, ripe dates upon you

ayahs.ar: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "
tr.pickthall: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.
tr.yusufali: "So eat and drink and cool (thine) eye. And if thou dost see any man, say, 'I have vowed a fast to (Allah) Most Gracious, and this day will I enter into not talk with any human being'"
tr.khattab: So eat and drink, and put your heart at ease. But if you see any of the people, say, ‘I have vowed silence to the Most Compassionate, so I am not talking to anyone today.’”

ayahs.ar: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
tr.pickthall: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing.
tr.yusufali: At length she brought the (babe) to her people, carrying him (in her arms). They said: "O Mary! truly an amazing thing hast thou brought!
tr.khattab: Then she returned to her people, carrying him. They said ˹in shock˺, “O Mary! You have certainly done a horrible thing

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
tr.pickthall: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot.
tr.yusufali: "O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a man of evil, nor thy mother a woman unchaste!"
tr.khattab: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not an indecent man, nor was your mother unchaste.”

ayahs.ar: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
tr.pickthall: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?
tr.yusufali: But she pointed to the babe. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?"
tr.khattab: So she pointed to the baby. They exclaimed, “How can we talk to someone who is an infant in the cradle?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
tr.pickthall: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet,
tr.yusufali: He said: "I am indeed a servant of Allah: He hath given me revelation and made me a prophet;
tr.khattab: ˹Jesus˺ declared, “I am truly a servant of Allah. He has destined me to be given the Scripture and to be a prophet

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
tr.pickthall: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive,
tr.yusufali: "And He hath made me blessed wheresoever I be, and hath enjoined on me Prayer and Charity as long as I live;
tr.khattab: He has made me a blessing wherever I go, and bid me to establish prayer and give alms-tax as long as I live

ayahs.ar: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
tr.pickthall: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.
tr.yusufali: "(He) hath made me kind to my mother, and not overbearing or miserable;
tr.khattab: and to be kind to my mother. He has not made me arrogant or defiant

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
tr.pickthall: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!
tr.yusufali: "So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)"!
tr.khattab: Peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I will be raised back to life!”

ayahs.ar: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

tr.sahih: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
tr.pickthall: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.
tr.yusufali: Such (was) Jesus the son of Mary: (it is) a statement of truth, about which they (vainly) dispute.
tr.khattab: That is Jesus, son of Mary. ˹And this is˺ a word of truth, about which they dispute

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

tr.sahih: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
tr.pickthall: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
tr.yusufali: It is not befitting to (the majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son. Glory be to Him! when He determines a matter, He only says to it, "Be", and it is.
tr.khattab: It is not for Allah to take a son! Glory be to Him. When He decrees a matter, He simply tells it, “Be!” And it is

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
tr.pickthall: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path.
tr.yusufali: Verily Allah is my Lord and your Lord: Him therefore serve ye: this is a Way that is straight.
tr.khattab: ˹Jesus also declared,˺ “Surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”

ayahs.ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
tr.pickthall: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day.
tr.yusufali: But the sects differ among themselves: and woe to the unbelievers because of the (coming) Judgment of a Momentous Day!
tr.khattab: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the disbelievers when they face a tremendous Day

ayahs.ar: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
tr.pickthall: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.
tr.yusufali: How plainly will they see and hear, the Day that they will appear before Us! but the unjust today are in error manifest!
tr.khattab: How clearly will they hear and see on the Day they will come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly astray

ayahs.ar: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
tr.pickthall: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.
tr.yusufali: But warn them of the Day of Distress, when the matter will be determined: for (behold,) they are negligent and they do not believe!
tr.khattab: And warn them ˹O Prophet˺ of the Day of Regret, when all matters will be settled, while they are ˹engrossed˺ in heedlessness and disbelief

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned.
tr.yusufali: It is We Who will inherit the earth, and all beings thereon: to Us will they all be returned.
tr.khattab: Indeed, it is We Who will succeed the earth and whoever is on it. And to Us they will ˹all˺ be returned

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا

tr.sahih: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
tr.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet.
tr.yusufali: (Also mention in the Book (the story of) Abraham: He was a man of Truth, a prophet.
tr.khattab: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Abraham. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا

tr.sahih: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
tr.pickthall: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?
tr.yusufali: Behold, he said to his father: "O my father! why worship that which heareth not and seeth not, and can profit thee nothing?
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his father, “O dear father! Why do you worship what can neither hear nor see, nor benefit you at all

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
tr.pickthall: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.
tr.yusufali: "O my father! to me hath come knowledge which hath not reached thee: so follow me: I will guide thee to a way that is even and straight.
tr.khattab: O dear father! I have certainly received some knowledge which you have not received, so follow me and I will guide you to the Straight Path

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
tr.pickthall: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent.
tr.yusufali: "O my father! serve not Satan: for Satan is a rebel against (Allah) Most Gracious.
tr.khattab: O dear father! Do not worship Satan. Surely Satan is ever rebellious against the Most Compassionate

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
tr.pickthall: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil.
tr.yusufali: "O my father! I fear lest a Penalty afflict thee from (Allah) Most Gracious, so that thou become to Satan a friend."
tr.khattab: O dear father! I truly fear that you will be touched by a torment from the Most Compassionate, and become Satan’s companion ˹in Hell˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
tr.pickthall: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!
tr.yusufali: (The father) replied: "Dost thou hate my gods, O Abraham? If thou forbear not, I will indeed stone thee: Now get away from me for a good long while!"
tr.khattab: He threatened, “How dare you reject my idols, O Abraham! If you do not desist, I will certainly stone you ˹to death˺. So be gone from me for a long time!”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
tr.pickthall: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.
tr.yusufali: Abraham said: "Peace be on thee: I will pray to my Lord for thy forgiveness: for He is to me Most Gracious.
tr.khattab: Abraham responded, “Peace be upon you! I will pray to my Lord for your forgiveness. He has truly been Most Gracious to me

ayahs.ar: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."
tr.pickthall: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.
tr.yusufali: "And I will turn away from you (all) and from those whom ye invoke besides Allah: I will call on my Lord: perhaps, by my prayer to my Lord, I shall be not unblest."
tr.khattab: As I distance myself from ˹all of˺ you and from whatever you invoke besides Allah, I will ˹continue to˺ call upon my Lord ˹alone˺, trusting that I will never be disappointed in invoking my Lord.”

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
tr.pickthall: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.
tr.yusufali: When he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each one of them We made a prophet.
tr.khattab: So after he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and made each of them a prophet

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.
tr.pickthall: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.
tr.yusufali: And We bestowed of Our Mercy on them, and We granted them lofty honour on the tongue of truth.
tr.khattab: We showered them with Our mercy, and blessed them with honourable mention

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
tr.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
tr.yusufali: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Moses: for he was specially chosen, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
tr.khattab: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Moses. He was truly a chosen man, and was a messenger and a prophet

ayahs.ar: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
tr.pickthall: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.
tr.yusufali: And we called him from the right side of Mount (Sinai), and made him draw near to Us, for mystic (converse).
tr.khattab: We called him from the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and drew him near, speaking ˹with him˺ directly

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
tr.pickthall: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).
tr.yusufali: And, out of Our Mercy, We gave him his brother Aaron, (also) a prophet.
tr.khattab: And We appointed for him—out of Our grace—his brother, Aaron, as a prophet

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
tr.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
tr.yusufali: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Isma'il: He was (strictly) true to what he promised, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
tr.khattab: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Ishmael. He was truly a man of his word, and was a messenger and a prophet

ayahs.ar: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.
tr.pickthall: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
tr.yusufali: He used to enjoin on his people Prayer and Charity, and he was most acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
tr.khattab: He used to urge his people to pray and give alms-tax. And his Lord was well pleased with him

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
