tr.sahih: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
tr.pickthall: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;
tr.yusufali: Also mention in the Book the case of Idris: He was a man of truth (and sincerity), (and) a prophet:
tr.khattab: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Enoch. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet

ayahs.ar: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا

tr.sahih: And We raised him to a high station.
tr.pickthall: And We raised him to high station.
tr.yusufali: And We raised him to a lofty station.
tr.khattab: And We elevated him to an honourable status

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩

tr.sahih: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
tr.pickthall: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.
tr.yusufali: Those were some of the prophets on whom Allah did bestow His Grace,- of the posterity of Adam, and of those who We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel of those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the Signs of (Allah) Most Gracious were rehearsed to them, they would fall down in prostrate adoration and in tears.
tr.khattab: Those were ˹some of˺ the prophets who Allah has blessed from among the descendants of Adam, and of those We carried with Noah ˹in the Ark˺, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those We ˹rightly˺ guided and chose. Whenever the revelations of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down, prostrating and weeping

ayahs.ar: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا

tr.sahih: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
tr.pickthall: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.
tr.yusufali: But after them there followed a posterity who missed prayers and followed after lusts soon, then, will they face Destruction,-
tr.khattab: But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and followed their lusts and so will soon face the evil consequences

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا

tr.sahih: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
tr.pickthall: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -
tr.yusufali: Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness: for these will enter the Garden and will not be wronged in the least,-
tr.khattab: As for those who repent, believe, and do good, it is they who will be admitted into Paradise, never being denied any reward

ayahs.ar: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.
tr.pickthall: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -
tr.yusufali: Gardens of Eternity, those which (Allah) Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the Unseen: for His promise must (necessarily) come to pass.
tr.khattab: ˹They will be in˺ the Gardens of Eternity, promised in trust by the Most Compassionate to His servants. Surely His promise will be fulfilled

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
tr.pickthall: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.
tr.yusufali: They will not there hear any vain discourse, but only salutations of Peace: And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and evening.
tr.khattab: There they will never hear any idle talk—only ˹greetings of˺ peace. And there they will have their provisions morning and evening

ayahs.ar: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.
tr.pickthall: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.
tr.yusufali: Such is the Garden which We give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who guard against Evil.
tr.khattab: That is Paradise, which We will grant to whoever is devout among Our servants

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
tr.pickthall: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -
tr.yusufali: (The angels say:) "We descend not but by command of thy Lord: to Him belongeth what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between: and thy Lord never doth forget,-
tr.khattab: “We only descend by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us, and whatever is behind us, and everything in between. And your Lord is never forgetful

ayahs.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
tr.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?
tr.yusufali: "Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that is between them; so worship Him, and be constant and patient in His worship: knowest thou of any who is worthy of the same Name as He?"
tr.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens, and the earth, and everything in between. So worship Him ˹alone˺, and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know of anyone equal to Him ˹in His attributes˺?”

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا

tr.sahih: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
tr.pickthall: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?
tr.yusufali: Man says: "What! When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"
tr.khattab: Yet ˹some˺ people ask ˹mockingly˺, “After I die, will I really be raised to life again?”

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا

tr.sahih: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
tr.pickthall: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?
tr.yusufali: But does not man call to mind that We created him before out of nothing?
tr.khattab: Do ˹such˺ people not remember that We created them before, when they were nothing

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
tr.pickthall: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.
tr.yusufali: So, by thy Lord, without doubt, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Evil Ones (with them); then shall We bring them forth on their knees round about Hell;
tr.khattab: By your Lord ˹O Prophet˺! We will surely gather them along with the devils, and then set them around Hell on their knees

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
tr.pickthall: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.
tr.yusufali: Then shall We certainly drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against (Allah) Most Gracious.
tr.khattab: Then We will certainly begin by dragging out of every group the ones most defiant to the Most Compassionate

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
tr.pickthall: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.
tr.yusufali: And certainly We know best those who are most worthy of being burned therein.
tr.khattab: And We truly know best who is most deserving of burning in it

ayahs.ar: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
tr.pickthall: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.
tr.yusufali: Not one of you but will pass over it: this is, with thy Lord, a Decree which must be accomplished.
tr.khattab: There is none of you who will not pass over it. ˹This is˺ a decree your Lord must fulfil

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
tr.pickthall: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.
tr.yusufali: But We shall save those who guarded against evil, and We shall leave the wrong-doers therein, (humbled) to their knees.
tr.khattab: Then We will deliver those who were devout, leaving the wrongdoers there on their knees

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا

tr.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
tr.pickthall: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?
tr.yusufali: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say to those who believe, "Which of the two sides is best in point of position? Which makes the best show in council?"
tr.khattab: When Our clear revelations are recited to them, the disbelievers ask the believers ˹mockingly˺, “Which of the two of us is better in status and superior in assembly?”

ayahs.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا

tr.sahih: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
tr.pickthall: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!
tr.yusufali: But how many (countless) generations before them have we destroyed, who were even better in equipment and in glitter to the eye?
tr.khattab: ˹Imagine, O Prophet˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them, who were far better in luxury and splendour

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا

tr.sahih: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
tr.pickthall: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.
tr.yusufali: Say: "If any men go astray, (Allah) Most Gracious extends (the rope) to them, until, when they see the warning of Allah (being fulfilled) - either in punishment or in (the approach of) the Hour,- they will at length realise who is worst in position, and (who) weakest in forces!
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Whoever is ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, the Most Compassionate will allow them plenty of time, until—behold!—they face what they are threatened with: either the torment or the Hour. Only then will they realize who is worse in position and inferior in manpower.”

ayahs.ar: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا

tr.sahih: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
tr.pickthall: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.
tr.yusufali: "And Allah doth advance in guidance those who seek guidance: and the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best in respect of (their) eventual return."
tr.khattab: And Allah increases in guidance those who are ˹rightly˺ guided. And the everlasting good deeds are far better with your Lord in reward and in outcome

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا

tr.sahih: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"
tr.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?
tr.yusufali: Hast thou then seen the (sort of) man who rejects Our Signs, yet says: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children?"
tr.khattab: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ the one who rejects Our revelations yet boasts, “I will definitely be granted ˹plenty of˺ wealth and children ˹if there is an afterlife˺.”

ayahs.ar: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا

tr.sahih: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
tr.pickthall: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?
tr.yusufali: Has he penetrated to the Unseen, or has he taken a contract with (Allah) Most Gracious?
tr.khattab: Has he looked into the unseen or taken a pledge from the Most Compassionate

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا

tr.sahih: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.
tr.yusufali: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall add and add to his punishment.
tr.khattab: Not at all! We certainly record whatever he claims and will increase his punishment extensively

ayahs.ar: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا

tr.sahih: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
tr.pickthall: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).
tr.yusufali: To Us shall return all that he talks of and he shall appear before Us bare and alone.
tr.khattab: And We will inherit what he boasts of, and he will come before Us all by himself

ayahs.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا

tr.sahih: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
tr.pickthall: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.
tr.yusufali: And they have taken (for worship) gods other than Allah, to give them power and glory!
tr.khattab: They have taken other gods, instead of Allah, seeking strength ˹and protection˺ through them

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا

tr.sahih: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
tr.pickthall: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.
tr.yusufali: Instead, they shall reject their worship, and become adversaries against them.
tr.khattab: But no! Those ˹gods˺ will deny their worship and turn against them

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا

tr.sahih: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?
tr.pickthall: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?
tr.yusufali: Seest thou not that We have set the Evil Ones on against the unbelievers, to incite them with fury?
tr.khattab: Do you ˹O Prophet˺ not see that We have sent the devils against the disbelievers, constantly inciting them

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا

tr.sahih: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.
tr.pickthall: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).
tr.yusufali: So make no haste against them, for We but count out to them a (limited) number (of days).
tr.khattab: So do not be in haste against them, for indeed We are ˹closely˺ counting down their days

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًۭا

tr.sahih: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
tr.pickthall: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.
tr.yusufali: The day We shall gather the righteous to (Allah) Most Gracious, like a band presented before a king for honours,
tr.khattab: ˹Watch for˺ the Day We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as an honoured delegation

ayahs.ar: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا

tr.sahih: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
tr.pickthall: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,
tr.yusufali: And We shall drive the sinners to Hell, like thirsty cattle driven down to water,-
tr.khattab: and drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا

tr.sahih: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
tr.pickthall: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord.
tr.yusufali: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from (Allah) Most Gracious.
tr.khattab: None will have the right to intercede, except those who have taken a covenant from the Most Compassionate

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
tr.pickthall: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son.
tr.yusufali: They say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
tr.khattab: They say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring.”

ayahs.ar: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا

tr.sahih: You have done an atrocious thing.
tr.pickthall: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing
tr.yusufali: Indeed ye have put forth a thing most monstrous!
tr.khattab: You have certainly made an outrageous claim

ayahs.ar: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا

tr.sahih: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
tr.pickthall: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,
tr.yusufali: At it the skies are ready to burst, the earth to split asunder, and the mountains to fall down in utter ruin,
tr.khattab: by which the heavens are about to burst, the earth to split apart, and the mountains to crumble to pieces

ayahs.ar: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًۭا

tr.sahih: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
tr.pickthall: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son,
tr.yusufali: That they should invoke a son for (Allah) Most Gracious.
tr.khattab: in protest of attributing children to the Most Compassionate

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا

tr.sahih: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
tr.pickthall: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.
tr.yusufali: For it is not consonant with the majesty of (Allah) Most Gracious that He should beget a son.
tr.khattab: It does not befit ˹the majesty of˺ the Most Compassionate to have children

ayahs.ar: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًۭا

tr.sahih: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
tr.pickthall: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.
tr.yusufali: Not one of the beings in the heavens and the earth but must come to (Allah) Most Gracious as a servant.
tr.khattab: There is none in the heavens or the earth who will not return to the Most Compassionate in full submission

ayahs.ar: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا

tr.sahih: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
tr.pickthall: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.
tr.yusufali: He does take an account of them (all), and hath numbered them (all) exactly.
tr.khattab: Indeed, He fully knows them and has counted them precisely

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا

tr.sahih: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
tr.pickthall: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.
tr.yusufali: And everyone of them will come to Him singly on the Day of Judgment.
tr.khattab: And each of them will return to Him on the Day of Judgment all alone

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.
tr.yusufali: On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.
tr.khattab: As for those who believe and do good, the Most Compassionate will ˹certainly˺ bless them with ˹genuine˺ love

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا

tr.sahih: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
tr.pickthall: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.
tr.yusufali: So have We made the (Qur'an) easy in thine own tongue, that with it thou mayest give Glad Tidings to the righteous, and warnings to people given to contention.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so with it you may give good news to the righteous and warn those who are contentious

ayahs.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا

tr.sahih: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
tr.pickthall: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound?
tr.yusufali: But how many (countless) generations before them have We destroyed? Canst thou find a single one of them (now) or hear (so much as) a whisper of them?
tr.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them! Do you ˹still˺ see any of them, or ˹even˺ hear from them the slightest sound

ayahs.ar: طه

tr.sahih: Ta, Ha.
tr.pickthall: Ta. Ha.
tr.yusufali: Ta-Ha.
tr.khattab: Ṭâ-Hâ

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
tr.pickthall: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,
tr.yusufali: We have not sent down the Qur'an to thee to be (an occasion) for thy distress,
tr.khattab: We have not revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ to cause you distress

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ

tr.sahih: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -
tr.pickthall: But as a reminder unto him who feareth,
tr.yusufali: But only as an admonition to those who fear (Allah),-
tr.khattab: but as a reminder to those in awe ˹of Allah˺

ayahs.ar: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى

tr.sahih: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
tr.pickthall: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens,
tr.yusufali: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the heavens on high.
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens—

ayahs.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ

tr.sahih: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
tr.pickthall: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne.
tr.yusufali: (Allah) Most Gracious is firmly established on the throne (of authority).
tr.khattab: the Most Compassionate, ˹Who is˺ established on the Throne

ayahs.ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ

tr.sahih: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
tr.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod.
tr.yusufali: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and on earth, and all between them, and all beneath the soil.
tr.khattab: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth and whatever is in between and whatever is underground

ayahs.ar: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى

tr.sahih: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
tr.pickthall: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.
tr.yusufali: If thou pronounce the word aloud, (it is no matter): for verily He knoweth what is secret and what is yet more hidden.
tr.khattab: Whether you speak openly ˹or not˺, He certainly knows what is secret and what is even more hidden

ayahs.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
tr.pickthall: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names.
tr.yusufali: Allah! there is no god but He! To Him belong the most Beautiful Names.
tr.khattab: Allah—there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He has the Most Beautiful Names

ayahs.ar: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
tr.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?
tr.yusufali: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
tr.khattab: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.ar: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى

tr.sahih: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
tr.pickthall: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire.
tr.yusufali: Behold, he saw a fire: So he said to his family, "Tarry ye; I perceive a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire."
tr.khattab: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Wait here, ˹for˺ I have spotted a fire. Perhaps I can bring you a torch from it, or find some guidance at the fire.”

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
tr.pickthall: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses!
tr.yusufali: But when he came to the fire, a voice was heard: "O Moses!
tr.khattab: But when he approached it, he was called, “O Moses

ayahs.ar: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى

tr.sahih: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
tr.pickthall: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa.
tr.yusufali: "Verily I am thy Lord! therefore (in My presence) put off thy shoes: thou art in the sacred valley Tuwa.
tr.khattab: It is truly I. I am your Lord! So take off your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
tr.pickthall: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.
tr.yusufali: "I have chosen thee: listen, then, to the inspiration (sent to thee).
tr.khattab: I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed

ayahs.ar: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ

tr.sahih: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
tr.pickthall: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance.
tr.yusufali: "Verily, I am Allah: There is no god but I: So serve thou Me (only), and establish regular prayer for celebrating My praise.
tr.khattab: ‘It is truly I. I am Allah! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me. So worship Me ˹alone˺, and establish prayer for My remembrance

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
tr.pickthall: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve).
tr.yusufali: "Verily the Hour is coming - My design is to keep it hidden - for every soul to receive its reward by the measure of its Endeavour.
tr.khattab: The Hour is sure to come. My Will is to keep it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded according to their efforts

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ

tr.sahih: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
tr.pickthall: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.
tr.yusufali: "Therefore let not such as believe not therein but follow their own lusts, divert thee therefrom, lest thou perish!"..
tr.khattab: So do not let those who disbelieve in it and follow their desires distract you from it, or you will be doomed.’”

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
tr.pickthall: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?
tr.yusufali: "And what is that in the right hand, O Moses?"
tr.khattab: ˹Allah added,˺ “And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
tr.pickthall: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses.
tr.yusufali: He said, "It is my rod: on it I lean; with it I beat down fodder for my flocks; and in it I find other uses."
tr.khattab: He replied, “It is my staff! I lean on it, and with it I beat down ˹branches˺ for my sheep, and have other uses for it.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
tr.pickthall: He said: Cast it down, O Moses!
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said, "Throw it, O Moses!"
tr.khattab: Allah said, “Throw it down, O Moses!”

ayahs.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ

tr.sahih: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
tr.pickthall: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding.
tr.yusufali: He threw it, and behold! It was a snake, active in motion.
tr.khattab: So he did, then—behold!—it became a serpent, slithering

ayahs.ar: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
tr.pickthall: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state.
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said, "Seize it, and fear not: We shall return it at once to its former condition"..
tr.khattab: Allah said, “Take it, and have no fear. We will return it to its former state

ayahs.ar: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
tr.pickthall: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token.
tr.yusufali: "Now draw thy hand close to thy side: It shall come forth white (and shining), without harm (or stain),- as another Sign,-
tr.khattab: And put your hand under your armpit, it will come out ˹shining˺ white, unblemished, as another sign

ayahs.ar: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى

tr.sahih: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
tr.pickthall: That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents,
tr.yusufali: "In order that We may show thee (two) of our Greater Signs.
tr.khattab: so that We may show you some of Our greatest signs

ayahs.ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

tr.sahih: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."
tr.pickthall: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
tr.yusufali: "Go thou to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds."
tr.khattab: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
tr.pickthall: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind
tr.yusufali: (Moses) said: "O my Lord! expand me my breast;
tr.khattab: Moses prayed, “My Lord! Uplift my heart for me

ayahs.ar: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى

tr.sahih: And ease for me my task
tr.pickthall: And ease my task for me;
tr.yusufali: "Ease my task for me;
tr.khattab: and make my task easy

ayahs.ar: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى

tr.sahih: And untie the knot from my tongue
tr.pickthall: And loose a knot from my tongue,
tr.yusufali: "And remove the impediment from my speech,
tr.khattab: and remove the impediment from my tongue

ayahs.ar: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى

tr.sahih: That they may understand my speech.
tr.pickthall: That they may understand my saying.
tr.yusufali: "So they may understand what I say:
tr.khattab: so people may understand my speech

ayahs.ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِى

tr.sahih: And appoint for me a minister from my family -
tr.pickthall: Appoint for me a henchman from my folk,
tr.yusufali: "And give me a Minister from my family,
tr.khattab: and grant me a helper from my family

ayahs.ar: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى

tr.sahih: Aaron, my brother.
tr.pickthall: Aaron, my brother.
tr.yusufali: "Aaron, my brother;
tr.khattab: Aaron, my brother

ayahs.ar: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى

tr.sahih: Increase through him my strength
tr.pickthall: Confirm my strength with him
tr.yusufali: "Add to my strength through him,
tr.khattab: Strengthen me through him

ayahs.ar: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى

tr.sahih: And let him share my task
tr.pickthall: And let him share my task,
tr.yusufali: "And make him share my task:
tr.khattab: and let him share my task

ayahs.ar: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: That we may exalt You much
tr.pickthall: That we may glorify Thee much
tr.yusufali: "That we may celebrate Thy praise without stint,
tr.khattab: so that we may glorify You much

ayahs.ar: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا

tr.sahih: And remember You much.
tr.pickthall: And much remember Thee.
tr.yusufali: "And remember Thee without stint:
tr.khattab: and remember You much

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
tr.pickthall: Lo! Thou art ever Seeing us.
tr.yusufali: "For Thou art He that (ever) regardeth us."
tr.khattab: for truly You have ˹always˺ been overseeing us.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
tr.pickthall: He said: Thou art granted thy request, O Moses.
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Granted is thy prayer, O Moses!"
tr.khattab: Allah responded, “All that you requested has been granted, O Moses

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
tr.pickthall: And indeed, another time, already We have shown thee favour,
tr.yusufali: "And indeed We conferred a favour on thee another time (before).
tr.khattab: And surely We had shown You favour before

ayahs.ar: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
tr.pickthall: When we inspired in thy mother that which is inspired,
tr.yusufali: "Behold! We sent to thy mother, by inspiration, the message:
tr.khattab: when We inspired your mother with this

ayahs.ar: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ

tr.sahih: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.
tr.pickthall: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,
tr.yusufali: "'Throw (the child) into the chest, and throw (the chest) into the river: the river will cast him up on the bank, and he will be taken up by one who is an enemy to Me and an enemy to him': But I cast (the garment of) love over thee from Me: and (this) in order that thou mayest be reared under Mine eye.
tr.khattab: ‘Put him into a chest, then put it into the river. The river will wash it ashore, and he will be taken by ˹Pharaoh,˺ an enemy of Mine and his.’ And I blessed you with lovability from Me ˹O Moses˺ so that you would be brought up under My ˹watchful˺ Eye

ayahs.ar: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
tr.pickthall: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,
tr.yusufali: "Behold! thy sister goeth forth and saith, 'shall I show you one who will nurse and rear the (child)?' So We brought thee back to thy mother, that her eye might be cooled and she should not grieve. Then thou didst slay a man, but We saved thee from trouble, and We tried thee in various ways. Then didst thou tarry a number of years with the people of Midian. Then didst thou come hither as ordained, O Moses!
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when your sister came along and proposed, ‘Shall I direct you to someone who will nurse him?’ So We reunited you with your mother so that her heart would be put at ease, and she would not grieve. ˹Later˺ you killed a man ˹by mistake˺, but We saved you from sorrow, as well as other tests We put you through. Then you stayed for a number of years among the people of Midian. Then you came here as pre-destined, O Moses

ayahs.ar: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى

tr.sahih: And I produced you for Myself.
tr.pickthall: And I have attached thee to Myself.
tr.yusufali: "And I have prepared thee for Myself (for service)"..
tr.khattab: And I have selected you for My service

ayahs.ar: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى

tr.sahih: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
tr.pickthall: Go, thou and thy brother, with My tokens, and be not faint in remembrance of Me.
tr.yusufali: "Go, thou and thy brother, with My Signs, and slacken not, either of you, in keeping Me in remembrance.
tr.khattab: Go forth, you and your brother, with My signs and never falter in remembering Me

ayahs.ar: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

tr.sahih: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
tr.pickthall: Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
tr.yusufali: "Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds;
tr.khattab: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺

ayahs.ar: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ

tr.sahih: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."
tr.pickthall: And speak unto him a gentle word, that peradventure he may heed or fear.
tr.yusufali: "But speak to him mildly; perchance he may take warning or fear (Allah)."
tr.khattab: Speak to him gently, so perhaps he may be mindful ˹of Me˺ or fearful ˹of My punishment˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ

tr.sahih: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
tr.pickthall: They said: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us or that he may play the tyrant.
tr.yusufali: They (Moses and Aaron) said: "Our Lord! We fear lest he hasten with insolence against us, or lest he transgress all bounds."
tr.khattab: They both pleaded, “Our Lord! We fear that he may be quick to harm us or act tyrannically.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
tr.pickthall: He said: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing.
tr.yusufali: He said: "Fear not: for I am with you: I hear and see (everything).
tr.khattab: Allah reassured ˹them˺, “Have no fear! I am with you, hearing and seeing

ayahs.ar: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
tr.pickthall: So go ye unto him and say: Lo! we are two messengers of thy Lord. So let the children of Israel go with us, and torment them not. We bring thee a token from thy Lord. And peace will be for him who followeth right guidance.
tr.yusufali: "So go ye both to him, and say, 'Verily we are messengers sent by thy Lord: Send forth, therefore, the Children of Israel with us, and afflict them not: with a Sign, indeed, have we come from thy Lord! and peace to all who follow guidance!
tr.khattab: So go to him and say, ‘Indeed we are both messengers from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And salvation will be for whoever follows the ˹right˺ guidance

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "
tr.pickthall: Lo! it hath been revealed unto us that the doom will be for him who denieth and turneth away.
tr.yusufali: "'Verily it has been revealed to us that the Penalty (awaits) those who reject and turn away.'"
tr.khattab: It has indeed been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies ˹the truth˺ and turns away.’”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Who then is the Lord of you twain, O Moses?
tr.yusufali: (When this message was delivered), (Pharaoh) said: "Who, then, O Moses, is the Lord of you two?"
tr.khattab: Pharaoh asked, “Who then is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ

tr.sahih: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
tr.pickthall: He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright.
tr.yusufali: He said: "Our Lord is He Who gave to each (created) thing its form and nature, and further, gave (it) guidance."
tr.khattab: He answered, “Our Lord is the One Who has given everything its ˹distinctive˺ form, then guided ˹it˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
tr.pickthall: He said: What then is the state of the generations of old?
tr.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said: "What then is the condition of previous generations?"
tr.khattab: Pharaoh asked, “And what about previous peoples?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
tr.pickthall: He said: The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither erreth nor forgetteth,
tr.yusufali: He replied: "The knowledge of that is with my Lord, duly recorded: my Lord never errs, nor forgets,-
tr.khattab: He replied, “That knowledge is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither falters nor forgets ˹anything˺.”

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ

tr.sahih: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
tr.pickthall: Who hath appointed the earth as a bed and hath threaded roads for you therein and hath sent down water from the sky and thereby We have brought forth divers kinds of vegetation,
tr.yusufali: "He Who has, made for you the earth like a carpet spread out; has enabled you to go about therein by roads (and channels); and has sent down water from the sky." With it have We produced diverse pairs of plants each separate from the others.
tr.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for ˹all of˺ you, and set in it pathways for you, and sends down rain from the sky, causing various types of plants to grow

ayahs.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ

tr.sahih: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.
tr.pickthall: (Saying): Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought.
tr.yusufali: Eat (for yourselves) and pasture your cattle: verily, in this are Signs for men endued with understanding.
tr.khattab: ˹so˺ eat and graze your cattle. Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment

ayahs.ar: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
tr.pickthall: Thereof We created you, and thereunto We return you, and thence We bring you forth a second time.
tr.yusufali: From the (earth) did We create you, and into it shall We return you, and from it shall We bring you out once again.
tr.khattab: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will bring you back again

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ

tr.sahih: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
tr.pickthall: And We verily did show him all Our tokens, but he denied them and refused.
tr.yusufali: And We showed Pharaoh all Our Signs, but he did reject and refuse.
tr.khattab: And We certainly showed Pharaoh all of Our signs, but he denied them and refused ˹to believe˺

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
tr.pickthall: He said: Hast come to drive us out from our land by thy magic, O Moses?
tr.yusufali: He said: "Hast thou come to drive us out of our land with thy magic, O Moses?
tr.khattab: He said, “Have you come to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses

ayahs.ar: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى

tr.sahih: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."
tr.pickthall: But we surely can produce for thee magic the like thereof; so appoint a tryst between us and you, which neither we nor thou shall fail to keep, at a place convenient (to us both).
tr.yusufali: "But we can surely produce magic to match thine! So make a tryst between us and thee, which we shall not fail to keep - neither we nor thou - in a place where both shall have even chances."
tr.khattab: We can surely meet you with similar magic. So set for us an appointment that neither of us will fail to keep, in a central place.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًۭى

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."
tr.pickthall: (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high.
tr.yusufali: Moses said: "Your tryst is the Day of the Festival, and let the people be assembled when the sun is well up."
tr.khattab: Moses said, “Your appointment is on the Day of the Festival, and let the people be gathered mid-morning.”

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ

tr.sahih: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
tr.pickthall: Then Pharaoh went and gathered his strength, then came (to the appointed tryst).
tr.yusufali: So Pharaoh withdrew: He concerted his plan, and then came (back).
tr.khattab: Pharaoh then withdrew, orchestrated his scheme, then returned

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ

tr.sahih: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."
tr.pickthall: Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably.
tr.yusufali: Moses said to him: Woe to you! Forge not ye a lie against Allah, lest He destroy you (at once) utterly by chastisement: the forger must suffer frustration!"
tr.khattab: Moses warned the magicians, “Woe to you! Do not fabricate a lie against Allah, or He will wipe you out with a torment. Whoever fabricates ˹lies˺ is bound to fail.”

ayahs.ar: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ

tr.sahih: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
tr.pickthall: Then they debated one with another what they must do, and they kept their counsel secret.
tr.yusufali: So they disputed, one with another, over their affair, but they kept their talk secret.
tr.khattab: So the magicians disputed the matter among themselves, conversing privately

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ

tr.sahih: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.
tr.pickthall: They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions;
tr.yusufali: They said: "These two are certainly (expert) magicians: their object is to drive you out from your land with their magic, and to do away with your most cherished institutions.
tr.khattab: They concluded, “These two are only magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic, and do away with your most cherished traditions

ayahs.ar: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّۭا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ

tr.sahih: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
tr.pickthall: So arrange your plan, and come in battle line. Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful.
tr.yusufali: "Therefore concert your plan, and then assemble in (serried) ranks: He wins (all along) today who gains the upper hand."
tr.khattab: So orchestrate your plan, then come forward in ˹perfect˺ ranks. And whoever prevails today will certainly be successful.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ

tr.sahih: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
tr.pickthall: They said: O Moses! Either throw first, or let us be the first to throw?
tr.yusufali: They said: "O Moses! whether wilt thou that thou throw (first) or that we be the first to throw?"
tr.khattab: They said, “O Moses! Either you cast, or let us be the first to cast.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ

tr.sahih: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
tr.pickthall: He said: Nay, do ye throw! Then lo! their cords and their staves, by their magic, appeared to him as though they ran.
tr.yusufali: He said, "Nay, throw ye first!" Then behold their ropes and their rods-so it seemed to him on account of their magic - began to be in lively motion!
tr.khattab: Moses responded, “No, you go first.” And suddenly their ropes and staffs appeared to him—by their magic—to be slithering

ayahs.ar: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةًۭ مُّوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
tr.pickthall: And Moses conceived a fear in his mind.
tr.yusufali: So Moses conceived in his mind a (sort of) fear.
tr.khattab: So Moses concealed fear within himself

ayahs.ar: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

tr.sahih: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
tr.pickthall: We said: Fear not! Lo! thou art the higher.
tr.yusufali: We said: "Fear not! for thou hast indeed the upper hand:
tr.khattab: We reassured ˹him˺, “Do not fear! It is certainly you who will prevail

ayahs.ar: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ

tr.sahih: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
tr.pickthall: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.
tr.yusufali: "Throw that which is in thy right hand: Quickly will it swallow up that which they have faked what they have faked is but a magician's trick: and the magician thrives not, (no matter) where he goes."
tr.khattab: Cast what is in your right hand, and it will swallow up what they have made, for what they have made is no more than a magic trick. And magicians can never succeed wherever they go.”

ayahs.ar: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
tr.pickthall: Then the wizards were (all) flung down prostrate, crying: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.
tr.yusufali: So the magicians were thrown down to prostration: they said, "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses".
tr.khattab: So the magicians fell down in prostration, declaring, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًۭا وَأَبْقَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he is your chief who taught you magic. Now surely I shall cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and I shall crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and ye shall know for certain which of us hath sterner and more lasting punishment.
tr.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said: "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? Surely this must be your leader, who has taught you magic! be sure I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will have you crucified on trunks of palm-trees: so shall ye know for certain, which of us can give the more severe and the more lasting punishment!"
tr.khattab: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. You will really see whose punishment is more severe and more lasting.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ

tr.sahih: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
tr.pickthall: They said: We choose thee not above the clear proofs that have come unto us, and above Him Who created us. So decree what thou wilt decree. Thou wilt end for us only this life of the world.
tr.yusufali: They said: "Never shall we regard thee as more than the Clear Signs that have come to us, or than Him Who created us! so decree whatever thou desirest to decree: for thou canst only decree (touching) the life of this world.
tr.khattab: They responded, “By the One Who created us! We will never prefer you over the clear proofs that have come to us. So do whatever you want! Your authority only covers the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."
tr.pickthall: Lo! we believe in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins and the magic unto which thou didst force us. Allah is better and more lasting.
tr.yusufali: "For us, we have believed in our Lord: may He forgive us our faults, and the magic to which thou didst compel us: for Allah is Best and Most Abiding."
tr.khattab: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord so He may forgive our sins and that magic you have forced us to practice. And Allah is far superior ˹in reward˺ and more lasting ˹in punishment˺.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًۭا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

tr.sahih: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
tr.pickthall: Lo! whoso cometh guilty unto his Lord, verily for him is hell. There he will neither die nor live.
tr.yusufali: Verily he who comes to his Lord as a sinner (at Judgment),- for him is Hell: therein shall he neither die nor live.
tr.khattab: Whoever comes to their Lord as an evildoer will certainly have Hell, where they can neither live nor die

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًۭا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ

tr.sahih: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
tr.pickthall: But whoso cometh unto Him a believer, having done good works, for such are the high stations;
tr.yusufali: But such as come to Him as Believers who have worked righteous deeds,- for them are ranks exalted,-
tr.khattab: But whoever comes to Him as a believer, having done good, they will have the highest ranks

ayahs.ar: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

tr.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
tr.pickthall: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of him who groweth.
tr.yusufali: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which flow rivers: they will dwell therein for aye: such is the reward of those who purify themselves (from evil).
tr.khattab: the Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, where they will stay forever. That is the reward of those who purify themselves

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ

tr.sahih: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
tr.pickthall: And verily We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night and strike for them a dry path in the sea, fearing not to be overtaken, neither being afraid (of the sea).
tr.yusufali: We sent an inspiration to Moses: "Travel by night with My servants, and strike a dry path for them through the sea, without fear of being overtaken (by Pharaoh) and without (any other) fear."
tr.khattab: And We surely inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants ˹at night˺ and strike a dry passage for them across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken, nor be concerned ˹of drowning˺.”

ayahs.ar: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ

tr.sahih: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
tr.pickthall: Then Pharaoh followed them with his hosts and there covered them that which did cover them of the sea.
tr.yusufali: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his forces, but the waters completely overwhelmed them and covered them up.
tr.khattab: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers—but how overwhelming were the waters that submerged them

ayahs.ar: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ

tr.sahih: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
tr.pickthall: And Pharaoh led his folk astray, he did not guide them.
tr.yusufali: Pharaoh led his people astray instead of leading them aright.
tr.khattab: And ˹so˺ Pharaoh led his people astray, and did not guide ˹them rightly˺

ayahs.ar: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ

tr.sahih: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
tr.pickthall: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and we made a covenant with you on the holy mountain's side, and sent down on you the manna and the quails,
tr.yusufali: O ye Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and We made a Covenant with you on the right side of Mount (Sinai), and We sent down to you Manna and quails:
tr.khattab: O Children of Israel! We saved you from your enemy, and made an appointment with you on the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and sent down to you manna and quails

ayahs.ar: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."
tr.pickthall: (Saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and transgress not in respect thereof lest My wrath come upon you: and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost indeed.
tr.yusufali: (Saying): "Eat of the good things We have provided for your sustenance, but commit no excess therein, lest My Wrath should justly descend on you: and those on whom descends My Wrath do perish indeed!
tr.khattab: ˹saying,˺ “Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not transgress in them, or My wrath will befall you. And whoever My wrath befalls is certainly doomed

ayahs.ar: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌۭ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ

tr.sahih: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
tr.pickthall: And lo! verily I am Forgiving toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright.
tr.yusufali: "But, without doubt, I am (also) He that forgives again and again, to those who repent, believe, and do right, who,- in fine, are ready to receive true guidance."
tr.khattab: But I am truly Most Forgiving to whoever repents, believes, and does good, then persists on ˹true˺ guidance.”

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
tr.pickthall: And (it was said): What hath made thee hasten from thy folk, O Moses?
tr.yusufali: (When Moses was up on the Mount, Allah said:) "What made thee hasten in advance of thy people, O Moses?"
tr.khattab: ˹Allah asked,˺ “Why have you come with such haste ahead of your people, O Moses?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ

tr.sahih: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
tr.pickthall: He said: They are close upon my track. I hastened unto Thee, my Lord, that Thou mightest be well pleased.
tr.yusufali: He replied: "Behold, they are close on my footsteps: I hastened to thee, O my Lord, to please thee."
tr.khattab: He replied, “They are close on my tracks. And I have hastened to You, my Lord, so You will be pleased.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."
tr.pickthall: He said: Lo! We have tried thy folk in thine absence, and As-Samiri hath misled them.
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "We have tested thy people in thy absence: the Samiri has led them astray."
tr.khattab: Allah responded, “We have indeed tested your people in your absence, and the Sâmiri has led them astray.”

ayahs.ar: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَٰنَ أَسِفًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى

tr.sahih: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
tr.pickthall: Then Moses went back unto his folk, angry and sad. He said: O my people! Hath not your Lord promised you a fair promise? Did the time appointed then appear too long for you, or did ye wish that wrath from your Lord should come upon you, that ye broke tryst with me?
tr.yusufali: So Moses returned to his people in a state of indignation and sorrow. He said: "O my people! did not your Lord make a handsome promise to you? Did then the promise seem to you long (in coming)? Or did ye desire that Wrath should descend from your Lord on you, and so ye broke your promise to me?"
tr.khattab: So Moses returned to his people, furious and sorrowful. He said, “O my people! Had your Lord not made you a good promise? Has my absence been too long for you? Or have you wished for wrath from your Lord to befall you, so you broke your promise to me?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًۭا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ

tr.sahih: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."
tr.pickthall: They said: We broke not tryst with thee of our own will, but we were laden with burdens of ornaments of the folk, then cast them (in the fire), for thus As-Samiri proposed.
tr.yusufali: They said: "We broke not the promise to thee, as far as lay in our power: but we were made to carry the weight of the ornaments of the (whole) people, and we threw them (into the fire), and that was what the Samiri suggested.
tr.khattab: They argued, “We did not break our promise to you of our own free will, but we were made to carry the burden of the people’s ˹golden˺ jewellery, then we threw it ˹into the fire˺, and so did the Sâmiri.”

ayahs.ar: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًۭا جَسَدًۭا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌۭ فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ

tr.sahih: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."
tr.pickthall: Then he produced for them a calf, of saffron hue, which gave forth a lowing sound. And they cried: This is your god and the god of Moses, but he hath forgotten.
tr.yusufali: "Then he brought out (of the fire) before the (people) the image of a calf: It seemed to low: so they said: This is your god, and the god of Moses, but (Moses) has forgotten!"
tr.khattab: Then he moulded for them an idol of a calf that made a lowing sound. They said, “This is your god and the god of Moses, but Moses forgot ˹where it was˺!”

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا

tr.sahih: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
tr.pickthall: See they not, then, that it returneth no saying unto them and possesseth for them neither hurt nor use?
tr.yusufali: Could they not see that it could not return them a word (for answer), and that it had no power either to harm them or to do them good?
tr.khattab: Did they not see that it did not respond to them, nor could it protect or benefit them

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى

tr.sahih: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."
tr.pickthall: And Aaron indeed had told them beforehand: O my people! Ye are but being seduced therewith, for lo! your Lord is the Beneficent, so follow me and obey my order.
tr.yusufali: Aaron had already, before this said to them: "O my people! ye are being tested in this: for verily your Lord is (Allah) Most Gracious; so follow me and obey my command."
tr.khattab: Aaron had already warned them beforehand, “O my people! You are only being tested by this, for indeed your ˹one true˺ Lord is the Most Compassionate. So follow me and obey my orders.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."
tr.pickthall: They said: We shall by no means cease to be its votaries till Moses return unto us.
tr.yusufali: They had said: "We will not abandon this cult, but we will devote ourselves to it until Moses returns to us."
tr.khattab: They replied, “We will not cease to worship it until Moses returns to us.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
tr.pickthall: He (Moses) said: O Aaron! What held thee back when thou didst see them gone astray,
tr.yusufali: (Moses) said: "O Aaron! what kept thee back, when thou sawest them going wrong,
tr.khattab: Moses scolded ˹his brother˺, “O Aaron! What prevented you, when you saw them going astray

ayahs.ar: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى

tr.sahih: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
tr.pickthall: That thou followedst me not? Hast thou then disobeyed my order?
tr.yusufali: "From following me? Didst thou then disobey my order?"
tr.khattab: from following after me? How could you disobey my orders?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى

tr.sahih: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "
tr.pickthall: He said: O son of my mother! Clutch not my beard nor my head! I feared lest thou shouldst say: Thou hast caused division among the Children of Israel, and hast not waited for my word.
tr.yusufali: (Aaron) replied: "O son of my mother! Seize (me) not by my beard nor by (the hair of) my head! Truly I feared lest thou shouldst say, 'Thou has caused a division among the children of Israel, and thou didst not respect my word!'"
tr.khattab: Aaron pleaded, “O son of my mother! Do not seize me by my beard or ˹the hair of˺ my head. I really feared that you would say, ‘You have caused division among the Children of Israel, and did not observe my word.’”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِىُّ

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"
tr.pickthall: (Moses) said: And what hast thou to say, O Samiri?
tr.yusufali: (Moses) said: "What then is thy case, O Samiri?"
tr.khattab: Moses then asked, “What did you think you were doing, O Sâmiri?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةًۭ مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى

tr.sahih: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."
tr.pickthall: He said: I perceived what they perceive not, so I seized a handful from the footsteps of the messenger, and then threw it in. Thus my soul commended to me.
tr.yusufali: He replied: "I saw what they saw not: so I took a handful (of dust) from the footprint of the Messenger, and threw it (into the calf): thus did my soul suggest to me."
tr.khattab: He said, “I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful ˹of dust˺ from the hoof-prints of ˹the horse of˺ the messenger-angel ˹Gabriel˺ then cast it ˹on the moulded calf˺. This is what my lower-self tempted me into.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.
tr.pickthall: (Moses) said: Then go! and lo! in this life it is for thee to say: Touch me not! and lo! there is for thee a tryst thou canst not break. Now look upon thy god of which thou hast remained a votary. Verily we will burn it and will scatter its dust over the sea.
