tr.yusufali: (Moses) said: "Get thee gone! but thy (punishment) in this life will be that thou wilt say, 'touch me not'; and moreover (for a future penalty) thou hast a promise that will not fail: Now look at thy god, of whom thou hast become a devoted worshipper: We will certainly (melt) it in a blazing fire and scatter it broadcast in the sea!"
tr.khattab: Moses said, “Go away then! And for ˹the rest of your˺ life you will surely be crying, ‘Do not touch ˹me˺!’ Then you will certainly have a fate that you cannot escape. Now look at your god to which you have been devoted: we will burn it up, then scatter it in the sea completely.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۭا

tr.sahih: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."
tr.pickthall: Your Allah is only Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah. He embraceth all things in His knowledge.
tr.yusufali: But the god of you all is the One Allah: there is no god but He: all things He comprehends in His knowledge.
tr.khattab: ˹Then Moses addressed his people,˺ “Your only god is Allah, there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He encompasses everything in ˹His˺ knowledge.”

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًۭا

tr.sahih: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.
tr.pickthall: Thus relate We unto thee (Muhammad) some tidings of that which happened of old, and We have given thee from Our presence a reminder.
tr.yusufali: Thus do We relate to thee some stories of what happened before: for We have sent thee a Message from Our own Presence.
tr.khattab: This is how We relate to you ˹O Prophet˺ some of the stories of the past. And We have certainly granted you a Reminder from Us

ayahs.ar: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وِزْرًا

tr.sahih: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,
tr.pickthall: Whoso turneth away from it, he verily will bear a burden on the Day of Resurrection,
tr.yusufali: If any do turn away therefrom, verily they will bear a burden on the Day of judgment;
tr.khattab: Whoever turns away from it will surely bear the burden ˹of sin˺ on the Day of Judgment

ayahs.ar: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ حِمْلًۭا

tr.sahih: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
tr.pickthall: Abiding under it - an evil burden for them on the Day of Resurrection,
tr.yusufali: They will abide in this (state): and grievous will the burden be to them on that Day,-
tr.khattab: suffering its consequences forever. What an evil burden they will carry on Judgment Day

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ زُرْقًۭا

tr.sahih: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
tr.pickthall: The day when the Trumpet is blown. On that day we assemble the guilty white-eyed (with terror),
tr.yusufali: The Day when the Trumpet will be sounded: that Day, We shall gather the sinful, blear-eyed (with terror).
tr.khattab: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and We will gather the wicked on that Day blue-faced ˹from horror and thirst˺

ayahs.ar: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًۭا

tr.sahih: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
tr.pickthall: Murmuring among themselves: Ye have tarried but ten (days).
tr.yusufali: In whispers will they consult each other: "Yet tarried not longer than ten (Days);
tr.khattab: They will whisper among themselves, “You stayed no more than ten days ˹on the earth˺.”

ayahs.ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًۭا

tr.sahih: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."
tr.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they utter when their best in conduct say: Ye have tarried but a day.
tr.yusufali: We know best what they will say, when their leader most eminent in conduct will say: "Ye tarried not longer than a day!"
tr.khattab: We know best what they will say—the most reasonable of them will say, “You stayed no more than a day.”

ayahs.ar: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًۭا

tr.sahih: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
tr.pickthall: They will ask thee of the mountains (on that day). Say: My Lord will break them into scattered dust.
tr.yusufali: They ask thee concerning the Mountains: say, "My Lord will uproot them and scatter them as dust;
tr.khattab: And ˹if˺ they ask you ˹O Prophet˺ about the mountains, ˹then˺ say, “My Lord will wipe them out completely

ayahs.ar: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًۭا صَفْصَفًۭا

tr.sahih: And He will leave the earth a level plain;
tr.pickthall: And leave it as an empty plain,
tr.yusufali: "He will leave them as plains smooth and level;
tr.khattab: leaving the earth level and bare

ayahs.ar: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًۭا وَلَآ أَمْتًۭا

tr.sahih: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
tr.pickthall: Wherein thou seest neither curve nor ruggedness.
tr.yusufali: "Nothing crooked or curved wilt thou see in their place."
tr.khattab: with neither depressions nor elevations to be seen.”

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًۭا

tr.sahih: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
tr.pickthall: On that day they follow the summoner who deceiveth not, and voices are hushed for the Beneficent, and thou hearest but a faint murmur.
tr.yusufali: On that Day will they follow the Caller (straight): no crookedness (can they show) him: all sounds shall humble themselves in the Presence of (Allah) Most Gracious: nothing shalt thou hear but the tramp of their feet (as they march).
tr.khattab: On that Day all will follow the caller ˹for assembly˺, ˹and˺ none will dare to deviate. All voices will be hushed before the Most Compassionate. Only whispers will be heard

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا

tr.sahih: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.
tr.pickthall: On that day no intercession availeth save (that of) him unto whom the Beneficent hath given leave and whose word He accepteth.
tr.yusufali: On that Day shall no intercession avail except for those for whom permission has been granted by (Allah) Most Gracious and whose word is acceptable to Him.
tr.khattab: On that Day no intercession will be of any benefit, except by those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are agreeable to Him

ayahs.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًۭا

tr.sahih: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge.
tr.pickthall: He knoweth (all) that is before them and (all) that is behind them, while they cannot compass it in knowledge.
tr.yusufali: He knows what (appears to His creatures as) before or after or behind them: but they shall not compass it with their knowledge.
tr.khattab: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them, but they cannot encompass Him in ˹their˺ knowledge

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًۭا

tr.sahih: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.
tr.pickthall: And faces humble themselves before the Living, the Eternal. And he who beareth (a burden of) wrongdoing is indeed a failure (on that day).
tr.yusufali: (All) faces shall be humbled before (Him) - the Living, the Self-Subsisting, Eternal: hopeless indeed will be the man that carries iniquity (on his back).
tr.khattab: And all faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, All-Sustaining. And those burdened with wrongdoing will be in loss

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًۭا وَلَا هَضْمًۭا

tr.sahih: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
tr.pickthall: And he who hath done some good works, being a believer, he feareth not injustice nor begrudging (of his wage).
tr.yusufali: But he who works deeds of righteousness, and has faith, will have no fear of harm nor of any curtailment (of what is his due).
tr.khattab: But whoever does good and is a believer will have no fear of being wronged or denied ˹their reward˺

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
tr.pickthall: Thus we have revealed it as a Lecture in Arabic, and have displayed therein certain threats, that peradventure they may keep from evil or that it may cause them to take heed.
tr.yusufali: Thus have We sent this down - an arabic Qur'an - and explained therein in detail some of the warnings, in order that they may fear Allah, or that it may cause their remembrance (of Him).
tr.khattab: And so We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran and varied the warnings in it, so perhaps they will shun evil or it may cause them to be mindful

ayahs.ar: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا

tr.sahih: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
tr.pickthall: Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.
tr.yusufali: High above all is Allah, the King, the Truth! Be not in haste with the Qur'an before its revelation to thee is completed, but say, "O my Lord! advance me in knowledge."
tr.khattab: Exalted is Allah, the True King! Do not rush to recite ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran ˹O Prophet˺ before it is ˹properly˺ conveyed to you, and pray, “My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.”

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًۭا

tr.sahih: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
tr.pickthall: And verily We made a covenant of old with Adam, but he forgot, and We found no constancy in him.
tr.yusufali: We had already, beforehand, taken the covenant of Adam, but he forgot: and We found on his part no firm resolve.
tr.khattab: And indeed, We once made a covenant with Adam, but he forgot, and ˹so˺ We did not find determination in him

ayahs.ar: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ

tr.sahih: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
tr.pickthall: And when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, they fell prostrate (all) save Iblis; he refused.
tr.yusufali: When We said to the angels, "Prostrate yourselves to Adam", they prostrated themselves, but not Iblis: he refused.
tr.khattab: And ˹remember˺ when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” so they all did—but not Iblîs, who refused ˹arrogantly˺

ayahs.ar: فَقُلْنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوٌّۭ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
tr.pickthall: Therefor we said: O Adam! This is an enemy unto thee and unto thy wife, so let him not drive you both out of the Garden so that thou come to toil.
tr.yusufali: Then We said: "O Adam! verily, this is an enemy to thee and thy wife: so let him not get you both out of the Garden, so that thou art landed in misery.
tr.khattab: So We cautioned, “O Adam! This is surely an enemy to you and to your wife. So do not let him drive you both out of Paradise, for you ˹O Adam˺ would then suffer ˹hardship˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.
tr.pickthall: It is (vouchsafed) unto thee that thou hungerest not therein nor art naked,
tr.yusufali: "There is therein (enough provision) for thee not to go hungry nor to go naked,
tr.khattab: Here it is guaranteed that you will never go hungry or unclothed

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ

tr.sahih: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."
tr.pickthall: And that thou thirstest not therein nor art exposed to the sun's heat.
tr.yusufali: "Nor to suffer from thirst, nor from the sun's heat."
tr.khattab: nor will you ˹ever˺ suffer from thirst or ˹the sun’s˺ heat.”

ayahs.ar: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍۢ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ

tr.sahih: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"
tr.pickthall: But the devil whispered to him, saying: O Adam! Shall I show thee the tree of immortality and power that wasteth not away?
tr.yusufali: But Satan whispered evil to him: he said, "O Adam! shall I lead thee to the Tree of Eternity and to a kingdom that never decays?"
tr.khattab: But Satan whispered to him, saying, “O Adam! Shall I show you the Tree of Immortality and a kingdom that does not fade away?”

ayahs.ar: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ

tr.sahih: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
tr.pickthall: Then they twain ate thereof, so that their shame became apparent unto them, and they began to hide by heaping on themselves some of the leaves of the Garden. And Adam disobeyed his Lord, so went astray.
tr.yusufali: In the result, they both ate of the tree, and so their nakedness appeared to them: they began to sew together, for their covering, leaves from the Garden: thus did Adam disobey his Lord, and allow himself to be seduced.
tr.khattab: So they both ate from the tree and then their nakedness was exposed to them, prompting them to cover themselves with leaves from Paradise. So Adam disobeyed his Lord, and ˹so˺ lost his way

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ

tr.sahih: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].
tr.pickthall: Then his Lord chose him, and relented toward him, and guided him.
tr.yusufali: But his Lord chose him (for His Grace): He turned to him, and gave him Guidance.
tr.khattab: Then his Lord chose him ˹for His grace˺, accepted his repentance, and guided him ˹rightly˺

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۭ ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًۭى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
tr.pickthall: He said: Go down hence, both of you, one of you a foe unto the other. But when there come unto you from Me a guidance, then whoso followeth My guidance, he will not go astray nor come to grief.
tr.yusufali: He said: "Get ye down, both of you,- all together, from the Garden, with enmity one to another: but if, as is sure, there comes to you Guidance from Me, whosoever follows My Guidance, will not lose his way, nor fall into misery.
tr.khattab: Allah said, “Descend, both of you, from here together ˹with Satan˺ as enemies to each other. Then when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray ˹in this life˺ nor suffer ˹in the next˺

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةًۭ ضَنكًۭا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ

tr.sahih: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
tr.pickthall: But he who turneth away from remembrance of Me, his will be a narrow life, and I shall bring him blind to the assembly on the Day of Resurrection.
tr.yusufali: "But whosoever turns away from My Message, verily for him is a life narrowed down, and We shall raise him up blind on the Day of Judgment."
tr.khattab: But whoever turns away from My Reminder will certainly have a miserable life, then We will raise them up blind on the Day of Judgment.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
tr.pickthall: He will say: My Lord! Wherefor hast Thou gathered me (hither) blind, when I was wont to see?
tr.yusufali: He will say: "O my Lord! why hast Thou raised me up blind, while I had sight (before)?"
tr.khattab: They will cry, “My Lord! Why have you raised me up blind, although I used to see?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ

tr.sahih: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
tr.pickthall: He will say: So (it must be). Our revelations came unto thee but thou didst forget them. In like manner thou art forgotten this Day.
tr.yusufali: (Allah) will say: "Thus didst Thou, when Our Signs came unto thee, disregard them: so wilt thou, this day, be disregarded."
tr.khattab: Allah will respond, “It is so, just as Our revelations came to you and you neglected them, so Today you are neglected.”

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
tr.pickthall: Thus do We reward him who is prodigal and believeth not the revelations of his Lord; and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be sterner and more lasting.
tr.yusufali: And thus do We recompense him who transgresses beyond bounds and believes not in the Signs of his Lord: and the Penalty of the Hereafter is far more grievous and more enduring.
tr.khattab: This is how We reward whoever transgresses and does not believe in the revelations of their Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is far more severe and more lasting

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ

tr.sahih: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
tr.pickthall: Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many a generation We destroyed before them, amid whose dwellings they walk? Lo! therein verily are signs for men of thought.
tr.yusufali: Is it not a warning to such men (to call to mind) how many generations before them We destroyed, in whose haunts they (now) move? Verily, in this are Signs for men endued with understanding.
tr.khattab: Is it not yet clear to them how many peoples We destroyed before them, whose ruins they still pass by? Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًۭا وَأَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّۭى

tr.sahih: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
tr.pickthall: And but for a decree that had already gone forth from thy Lord, and a term already fixed, the judgment would have been inevitable (in this world).
tr.yusufali: Had it not been for a Word that went forth before from thy Lord, (their punishment) must necessarily have come; but there is a Term appointed (for respite).
tr.khattab: Had it not been for a prior decree from your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ and a term already set, their ˹instant˺ doom would have been inevitable

ayahs.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ

tr.sahih: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
tr.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), bear with what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere the going down thereof. And glorify Him some hours of the night and at the two ends of the day, that thou mayst find acceptance.
tr.yusufali: Therefore be patient with what they say, and celebrate (constantly) the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun, and before its setting; yea, celebrate them for part of the hours of the night, and at the sides of the day: that thou mayest have (spiritual) joy.
tr.khattab: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset, and glorify Him in the hours of the night and at both ends of the day, so that you may be pleased ˹with the reward˺

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰ

tr.sahih: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.
tr.pickthall: And strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoy, the flower of the life of the world, that We may try them thereby. The provision of thy Lord is better and more lasting.
tr.yusufali: Nor strain thine eyes in longing for the things We have given for enjoyment to parties of them, the splendour of the life of this world, through which We test them: but the provision of thy Lord is better and more enduring.
tr.khattab: Do not let your eyes crave what We have allowed some of the disbelievers to enjoy; the ˹fleeting˺ splendour of this worldly life, which We test them with. But your Lord’s provision ˹in the Hereafter˺ is far better and more lasting

ayahs.ar: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًۭا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَٱلْعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ

tr.sahih: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
tr.pickthall: And enjoin upon thy people worship, and be constant therein. We ask not of thee a provision: We provided for thee. And the sequel is for righteousness.
tr.yusufali: Enjoin prayer on thy people, and be constant therein. We ask thee not to provide sustenance: We provide it for thee. But the (fruit of) the Hereafter is for righteousness.
tr.khattab: Bid your people to pray, and be diligent in ˹observing˺ it. We do not ask you to provide. It is We Who provide for you. And the ultimate outcome is ˹only˺ for ˹the people of˺ righteousness

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

tr.sahih: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
tr.pickthall: And they say: If only he would bring us a miracle from his Lord! Hath there not come unto them the proof of what is in the former scriptures?
tr.yusufali: They say: "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has not a Clear Sign come to them of all that was in the former Books of revelation?
tr.khattab: They demand, “If only he could bring us a sign from his Lord!” Have they not ˹already˺ received a confirmation of what is in earlier Scriptures

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًۭا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ

tr.sahih: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
tr.pickthall: And if we had destroyed them with some punishment before it, they would assuredly have said: Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent unto us a messenger, so that we might have followed Thy revelations before we were (thus) humbled and disgraced!
tr.yusufali: And if We had inflicted on them a penalty before this, they would have said: "Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent us a messenger, we should certainly have followed Thy Signs before we were humbled and put to shame."
tr.khattab: Had We destroyed them with a torment before this ˹Prophet came˺, they would have surely argued, “Our Lord! If only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your revelations before being humiliated and put to shame.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ كُلٌّۭ مُّتَرَبِّصٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ

tr.sahih: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
tr.pickthall: Say: Each is awaiting; so await ye! Ye will come to know who are the owners of the path of equity, and who is right.
tr.yusufali: Say: "Each one (of us) is waiting: wait ye, therefore, and soon shall ye know who it is that is on the straight and even way, and who it is that has received Guidance."
tr.khattab: Say ˹to them, O Prophet˺, “Each ˹of us˺ is waiting, so keep waiting! You will soon know who is on the Straight Path and is ˹rightly˺ guided.”

ayahs.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مُّعْرِضُونَ

tr.sahih: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
tr.pickthall: Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness.
tr.yusufali: Closer and closer to mankind comes their Reckoning: yet they heed not and they turn away.
tr.khattab: ˹The time of˺ people’s judgment has drawn near, yet they are heedlessly turning away

ayahs.ar: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ

tr.sahih: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
tr.pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play,
tr.yusufali: Never comes (aught) to them of a renewed Message from their Lord, but they listen to it as in jest,-
tr.khattab: Whatever new reminder comes to them from their Lord, they only listen to it jokingly

ayahs.ar: لَاهِيَةًۭ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
tr.pickthall: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?
tr.yusufali: Their hearts toying as with trifles. The wrong-doers conceal their private counsels, (saying), "Is this (one) more than a man like yourselves? Will ye go to witchcraft with your eyes open?"
tr.khattab: with their hearts ˹totally˺ distracted. The evildoers would converse secretly, ˹saying,˺ “Is this ˹one˺ not human like yourselves? Would you fall for ˹this˺ witchcraft, even though you can ˹clearly˺ see?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
tr.pickthall: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
tr.yusufali: Say: "My Lord knoweth (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth: He is the One that heareth and knoweth (all things)."
tr.khattab: The Prophet responded, “My Lord ˹fully˺ knows every word spoken in the heavens and the earth. For He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.”

ayahs.ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۭ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

tr.sahih: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
tr.pickthall: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).
tr.yusufali: "Nay," they say, "(these are) medleys of dream! - Nay, He forged it! - Nay, He is (but) a poet! Let him then bring us a Sign like the ones that were sent to (Prophets) of old!"
tr.khattab: Yet they say, “This ˹Quran˺ is a set of confused dreams! No, he has fabricated it! No, he must be a poet! So let him bring us a ˹tangible˺ sign like those ˹prophets˺ sent before.”

ayahs.ar: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
tr.pickthall: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe?
tr.yusufali: (As to those) before them, not one of the populations which We destroyed believed: will these believe?
tr.khattab: Not a ˹single˺ society We destroyed before them ever believed ˹after receiving the signs˺. Will these ˹pagans˺ then believe

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.
tr.pickthall: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not?
tr.yusufali: Before thee, also, the messengers We sent were but men, to whom We granted inspiration: If ye realise this not, ask of those who possess the Message.
tr.khattab: We did not send ˹messengers˺ before you ˹O Prophet˺ except mere men inspired by Us. If you ˹polytheists˺ do not know ˹this already˺, then ask those who have knowledge ˹of the Scriptures˺

ayahs.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًۭا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
tr.pickthall: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals.
tr.yusufali: Nor did We give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they exempt from death.
tr.khattab: We did not give those messengers ˹supernatural˺ bodies that did not need food, nor were they immortal

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

tr.sahih: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
tr.pickthall: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals.
tr.yusufali: In the end We fulfilled to them Our Promise, and We saved them and those whom We pleased, but We destroyed those who transgressed beyond bounds.
tr.khattab: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, saving them along with whoever We willed and destroying the transgressors

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
tr.pickthall: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense?
tr.yusufali: We have revealed for you (O men!) a book in which is a Message for you: will ye not then understand?
tr.khattab: We have surely revealed to you a Book, in which there is glory for you. Will you not then understand

ayahs.ar: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۢ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةًۭ وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

tr.sahih: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
tr.pickthall: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk!
tr.yusufali: How many were the populations We utterly destroyed because of their iniquities, setting up in their places other peoples?
tr.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many societies of wrongdoers We have destroyed, raising up other people after them

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ

tr.sahih: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
tr.pickthall: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it!
tr.yusufali: Yet, when they felt Our Punishment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.
tr.khattab: When the wrongdoers sensed ˹the arrival of˺ Our torment, they started to run away from their cities

ayahs.ar: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
tr.pickthall: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned.
tr.yusufali: Flee not, but return to the good things of this life which were given you, and to your homes in order that ye may be called to account.
tr.khattab: ˹They were told,˺ “Do not run away! Return to your luxuries and your homes, so you may be questioned ˹about your fate˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
tr.pickthall: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers.
tr.yusufali: They said: "Ah! woe to us! We were indeed wrong-doers!"
tr.khattab: They cried, “Woe to us! We have surely been wrongdoers.”

ayahs.ar: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
tr.pickthall: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct.
tr.yusufali: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is mown, as ashes silent and quenched.
tr.khattab: They kept repeating their cry until We mowed them down, ˹leaving them˺ lifeless

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

tr.sahih: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
tr.pickthall: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play.
tr.yusufali: Not for (idle) sport did We create the heavens and the earth and all that is between!
tr.khattab: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport

ayahs.ar: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًۭا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

tr.sahih: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
tr.pickthall: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did.
tr.yusufali: If it had been Our wish to take (just) a pastime, We should surely have taken it from the things nearest to Us, if We would do (such a thing)!
tr.khattab: Had We intended to take ˹some˺ amusement, We could have found it in Our presence, if that had been Our Will

ayahs.ar: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌۭ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

tr.sahih: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
tr.yusufali: Nay, We hurl the Truth against falsehood, and it knocks out its brain, and behold, falsehood doth perish! Ah! woe be to you for the (false) things ye ascribe (to Us).
tr.khattab: In fact, We hurl the truth against falsehood, leaving it crushed, and it quickly vanishes. And woe be to you for what you claim

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ

tr.sahih: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
tr.pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary;
tr.yusufali: To Him belong all (creatures) in the heavens and on earth: Even those who are in His (very) Presence are not too proud to serve Him, nor are they (ever) weary (of His service):
tr.khattab: To Him belong all those in the heavens and the earth. And those nearest to Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they tire

ayahs.ar: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ

tr.sahih: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
tr.pickthall: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not.
tr.yusufali: They celebrate His praises night and day, nor do they ever flag or intermit.
tr.khattab: They glorify ˹Him˺ day and night, never wavering

ayahs.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
tr.pickthall: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead?
tr.yusufali: Or have they taken (for worship) gods from the earth who can raise (the dead)?
tr.khattab: Or have they taken gods from the earth, who can raise the dead

ayahs.ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

tr.sahih: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
tr.pickthall: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him).
tr.yusufali: If there were, in the heavens and the earth, other gods besides Allah, there would have been confusion in both! but glory to Allah, the Lord of the Throne: (High is He) above what they attribute to Him!
tr.khattab: Had there been other gods besides Allah in the heavens or the earth, both ˹realms˺ would have surely been corrupted. So Glorified is Allah, Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim

ayahs.ar: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ

tr.sahih: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
tr.pickthall: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned.
tr.yusufali: He cannot be questioned for His acts, but they will be questioned (for theirs).
tr.khattab: He cannot be questioned about what He does, but they will ˹all˺ be questioned

ayahs.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
tr.pickthall: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse.
tr.yusufali: Or have they taken for worship (other) gods besides him? Say, "Bring your convincing proof: this is the Message of those with me and the Message of those before me." But most of them know not the Truth, and so turn away.
tr.khattab: Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Show ˹me˺ your proof. Here is ˹the Quran,˺ the Reminder for those with me; along with ˹earlier Scriptures,˺ the Reminder for those before me.” But most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ

tr.sahih: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
tr.pickthall: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me.
tr.yusufali: Not a messenger did We send before thee without this inspiration sent by Us to him: that there is no god but I; therefore worship and serve Me.
tr.khattab: We never sent a messenger before you ˹O Prophet˺ without revealing to him: “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me, so worship Me ˹alone˺.”

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌۭ مُّكْرَمُونَ

tr.sahih: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
tr.pickthall: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves;
tr.yusufali: And they say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten offspring." Glory to Him! they are (but) servants raised to honour.
tr.khattab: And they say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring!” Glory be to Him! In fact, those ˹angels˺ are only ˹His˺ honoured servants

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
tr.pickthall: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command.
tr.yusufali: They speak not before He speaks, and they act (in all things) by His Command.
tr.khattab: who do not speak until He has spoken, ˹only˺ acting at His command

ayahs.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ

tr.sahih: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
tr.pickthall: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him.
tr.yusufali: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they offer no intercession except for those who are acceptable, and they stand in awe and reverence of His (Glory).
tr.khattab: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them. They do not intercede except for whom He approves, and they tremble in awe of Him

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَٰهٌۭ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
tr.pickthall: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers.
tr.yusufali: If any of them should say, "I am a god besides Him", such a one We should reward with Hell: thus do We reward those who do wrong.
tr.khattab: Whoever of them were to say, “I am a god besides Him,” they would be rewarded with Hell by Us. This is how We reward the wrongdoers

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
tr.pickthall: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?
tr.yusufali: Do not the Unbelievers see that the heavens and the earth were joined together (as one unit of creation), before we clove them asunder? We made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
tr.khattab: Do the disbelievers not realize that the heavens and earth were ˹once˺ one mass then We split them apart? And We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًۭا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

tr.sahih: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
tr.pickthall: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way.
tr.yusufali: And We have set on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein broad highways (between mountains) for them to pass through: that they may receive Guidance.
tr.khattab: And We have placed firm mountains upon the earth so it does not shake with them, and made in it broad pathways so they may find their way

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًۭا مَّحْفُوظًۭا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ

tr.sahih: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
tr.pickthall: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents.
tr.yusufali: And We have made the heavens as a canopy well guarded: yet do they turn away from the Signs which these things (point to)!
tr.khattab: And We have made the sky a well-protected canopy, still they turn away from its signs

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ

tr.sahih: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
tr.pickthall: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit.
tr.yusufali: It is He Who created the Night and the Day, and the sun and the moon: all (the celestial bodies) swim along, each in its rounded course.
tr.khattab: And He is the One Who created the day and the night, the sun and the moon—each travelling in an orbit

ayahs.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِدُونَ

tr.sahih: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
tr.pickthall: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal!
tr.yusufali: We granted not to any man before thee permanent life (here): if then thou shouldst die, would they live permanently?
tr.khattab: We have not granted immortality to any human before you ˹O Prophet˺: so if you die, will they live forever

ayahs.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةًۭ ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ

tr.sahih: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
tr.pickthall: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.
tr.yusufali: Every soul shall have a taste of death: and We test you by evil and by good by way of trial. to Us must ye return.
tr.khattab: Every soul will taste death. And We test you ˹O humanity˺ with good and evil as a trial, then to Us you will ˹all˺ be returned

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
tr.pickthall: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent.
tr.yusufali: When the Unbelievers see thee, they treat thee not except with ridicule. "Is this," (they say), "the one who talks of your gods?" and they blaspheme at the mention of (Allah) Most Gracious!
tr.khattab: When the disbelievers see you ˹O Prophet˺, they only make fun of you, ˹saying,˺ “Is this the one who speaks ˹ill˺ of your gods?” while they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Compassionate

ayahs.ar: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍۢ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

tr.sahih: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me.
tr.pickthall: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten.
tr.yusufali: Man is a creature of haste: soon (enough) will I show you My Signs; then ye will not ask Me to hasten them!
tr.khattab: Humankind is made of haste. I will soon show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
tr.pickthall: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
tr.yusufali: They say: "When will this promise come to pass, if ye are telling the truth?"
tr.khattab: They ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass if what you say is true?”

ayahs.ar: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

tr.sahih: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
tr.pickthall: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped!
tr.yusufali: If only the Unbelievers knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the fire from their faces, nor yet from their backs, and (when) no help can reach them!
tr.khattab: If only the disbelievers knew that a time will come when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces or backs, nor will they be helped

ayahs.ar: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةًۭ فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

tr.sahih: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved.
tr.yusufali: Nay, it may come to them all of a sudden and confound them: no power will they have then to avert it, nor will they (then) get respite.
tr.khattab: In fact, the Hour will take them by surprise, leaving them stunned. So they will not be able to avert it, nor will it be delayed from them

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

tr.sahih: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr.pickthall: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.
tr.yusufali: Mocked were (many) messenger before thee; But their scoffers were hemmed in by the thing that they mocked.
tr.khattab: ˹Other˺ messengers had already been ridiculed before you ˹O Prophet˺, but those who mocked them were overtaken by what they used to ridicule

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

tr.sahih: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
tr.pickthall: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!
tr.yusufali: Say: "Who can keep you safe by night and by day from (the Wrath of) (Allah) Most Gracious?" Yet they turn away from the mention of their Lord.
tr.khattab: Ask ˹them, O Prophet,˺ “Who can defend you by day or by night against the Most Compassionate?” Still they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌۭ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
tr.pickthall: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us.
tr.yusufali: Or have they gods that can guard them from Us? They have no power to aid themselves, nor can they be defended from Us.
tr.khattab: Or do they have gods—other than Us—that can protect them? They cannot ˹even˺ protect themselves, nor will they be aided against Us

ayahs.ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ

tr.sahih: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
tr.pickthall: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors?
tr.yusufali: Nay, We gave the good things of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them; See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will win?
tr.khattab: In fact, We have allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers for such a long time ˹that they took it for granted˺. Do they not see that We gradually reduce ˹their˺ land from its borders? Is it they who will then prevail

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ

tr.sahih: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned.
tr.yusufali: Say, "I do but warn you according to revelation": But the deaf will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned!
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I warn you only by revelation.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are warned

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌۭ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
tr.pickthall: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.
tr.yusufali: If but a breath of the Wrath of thy Lord do touch them, they will then say, "Woe to us! we did wrong indeed!"
tr.khattab: If they were touched by even a breath of your Lord’s torment, they would certainly cry, “Woe to us! We have really been wrongdoers.”

ayahs.ar: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍۢ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ

tr.sahih: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
tr.pickthall: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.
tr.yusufali: We shall set up scales of justice for the Day of Judgment, so that not a soul will be dealt with unjustly in the least, and if there be (no more than) the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it (to account): and enough are We to take account.
tr.khattab: We will set up the scales of justice on the Day of Judgment, so no soul will be wronged in the least. And ˹even˺ if a deed is the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as a ˹vigilant˺ Reckoner

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءًۭ وَذِكْرًۭا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

tr.sahih: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
tr.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,
tr.yusufali: In the past We granted to Moses and Aaron the criterion (for judgment), and a Light and a Message for those who would do right,-
tr.khattab: Indeed, We granted Moses and Aaron the standard ˹to distinguish between right and wrong˺—a light and a reminder for the righteous

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
tr.pickthall: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom).
tr.yusufali: Those who fear their Lord in their most secret thoughts, and who hold the Hour (of Judgment) in awe.
tr.khattab: who are in awe of their Lord without seeing Him, and are fearful of the Hour

ayahs.ar: وَهَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
tr.pickthall: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?
tr.yusufali: And this is a blessed Message which We have sent down: will ye then reject it?
tr.khattab: And this ˹Quran˺ is a blessed reminder which We have revealed. Will you ˹pagans˺ then deny it

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
tr.pickthall: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,
tr.yusufali: We bestowed aforetime on Abraham his rectitude of conduct, and well were We acquainted with him.
tr.khattab: And indeed, We had granted Abraham sound judgment early on, for We knew him well ˹to be worthy of it˺

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَ

tr.sahih: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
tr.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?
tr.yusufali: Behold! he said to his father and his people, "What are these images, to which ye are (so assiduously) devoted?"
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when he questioned his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are so devoted?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَٰبِدِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
tr.pickthall: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them.
tr.yusufali: They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them."
tr.khattab: They replied, “We found our forefathers worshipping them.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
tr.pickthall: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.
tr.yusufali: He said, "Indeed ye have been in manifest error - ye and your fathers."
tr.khattab: He responded, “Indeed, you and your forefathers have been clearly astray.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّٰعِبِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
tr.pickthall: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester?
tr.yusufali: They said, "Have you brought us the Truth, or are you one of those who jest?"
tr.khattab: They asked, “Have you come to us with the truth, or is this a joke?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ

tr.sahih: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
tr.pickthall: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.
tr.yusufali: He said, "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He Who created them (from nothing): and I am a witness to this (Truth).
tr.khattab: He replied, “In fact, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them ˹both˺. And to that I bear witness.”

ayahs.ar: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And [I swear] by Allah, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
tr.pickthall: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.
tr.yusufali: "And by Allah, I have a plan for your idols - after ye go away and turn your backs"..
tr.khattab: ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “By Allah! I will surely plot against your idols after you have turned your backs and gone away.”

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًۭا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ

tr.sahih: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
tr.pickthall: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it.
tr.yusufali: So he broke them to pieces, (all) but the biggest of them, that they might turn (and address themselves) to it.
tr.khattab: So he smashed them into pieces, except the biggest of them, so they might turn to it ˹for answers˺

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
tr.pickthall: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer.
tr.yusufali: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? He must indeed be some man of impiety!"
tr.khattab: They protested, “Who dared do this to our gods? It must be an evildoer!”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًۭى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ

tr.sahih: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
tr.pickthall: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham.
tr.yusufali: They said, "We heard a youth talk of them: He is called Abraham."
tr.khattab: Some said, “We heard a young man, called Abraham, speaking ˹ill˺ of them.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
tr.pickthall: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify.
tr.yusufali: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may bear witness."
tr.khattab: They demanded, “Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness ˹his trial˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ

tr.sahih: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
tr.pickthall: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?
tr.yusufali: They said, "Art thou the one that did this with our gods, O Abraham?"
tr.khattab: They asked, “Was it you who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
tr.pickthall: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.
tr.yusufali: He said: "Nay, this was done by - this is their biggest one! ask them, if they can speak intelligently!"
tr.khattab: He replied ˹sarcastically˺, “No, this one—the biggest of them—did it! So ask them, if they can talk!”

ayahs.ar: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

tr.sahih: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
tr.pickthall: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers.
tr.yusufali: So they turned to themselves and said, "Surely ye are the ones in the wrong!"
tr.khattab: So they came back to their senses, saying ˹to one another˺, “You yourselves are truly the wrongdoers!”

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
tr.pickthall: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.
tr.yusufali: Then were they confounded with shame: (they said), "Thou knowest full well that these (idols) do not speak!"
tr.khattab: Then they ˹quickly˺ regressed to their ˹original˺ mind-set, ˹arguing,˺ “You already know that those ˹idols˺ cannot talk.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ

tr.sahih: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
tr.pickthall: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you?
tr.yusufali: (Abraham) said, "Do ye then worship, besides Allah, things that can neither be of any good to you nor do you harm?
tr.khattab: He rebuked ˹them˺, “Do you then worship—instead of Allah—what can neither benefit nor harm you in any way

ayahs.ar: أُفٍّۢ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah. Then will you not use reason?"
tr.pickthall: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?
tr.yusufali: "Fie upon you, and upon the things that ye worship besides Allah! Have ye no sense?"..
tr.khattab: Shame on you and whatever you worship instead of Allah! Do you not have any sense?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
tr.pickthall: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing.
tr.yusufali: They said, "Burn him and protect your gods, If ye do (anything at all)!"
tr.khattab: They concluded, “Burn him up to avenge your gods, if you must act.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

tr.sahih: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
tr.pickthall: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,
tr.yusufali: We said, "O Fire! be thou cool, and (a means of) safety for Abraham!"
tr.khattab: We ordered, “O fire! Be cool and safe for Abraham!”

ayahs.ar: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ

tr.sahih: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.
tr.pickthall: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.
tr.yusufali: Then they sought a stratagem against him: but We made them the ones that lost most!
tr.khattab: They had sought to harm him, but We made them the worst losers

ayahs.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.
tr.yusufali: But We delivered him and (his nephew) Lut (and directed them) to the land which We have blessed for the nations.
tr.khattab: Then We delivered him, along with Lot, to the land We had showered with blessings for all people

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةًۭ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا صَٰلِحِينَ

tr.sahih: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
tr.pickthall: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous.
tr.yusufali: And We bestowed on him Isaac and, as an additional gift, (a grandson), Jacob, and We made righteous men of every one (of them).
tr.khattab: And We blessed him with Isaac ˹as a son˺ and Jacob ˹as a grandson˺, as an additional favour—making all of them righteous

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةًۭ يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us.
tr.pickthall: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone).
tr.yusufali: And We made them leaders, guiding (men) by Our Command, and We sent them inspiration to do good deeds, to establish regular prayers, and to practise regular charity; and they constantly served Us (and Us only).
tr.khattab: We ˹also˺ made them leaders, guiding by Our command, and inspired them to do good deeds, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. And they were devoted to Our worship

ayahs.ar: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَٰسِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
tr.pickthall: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd.
tr.yusufali: And to Lut, too, We gave Judgment and Knowledge, and We saved him from the town which practised abominations: truly they were a people given to Evil, a rebellious people.
tr.khattab: And to Lot We gave wisdom and knowledge, and delivered him from the society engrossed in shameful practices. They were certainly an evil, rebellious people

ayahs.ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

tr.sahih: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
tr.pickthall: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous.
tr.yusufali: And We admitted him to Our Mercy: for he was one of the Righteous.
tr.khattab: And We admitted him into Our mercy, ˹for˺ he was truly one of the righteous

ayahs.ar: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood.
tr.pickthall: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.
tr.yusufali: (Remember) Noah, when he cried (to Us) aforetime: We listened to his (prayer) and delivered him and his family from great distress.
tr.khattab: And ˹remember˺ when Noah had cried out to Us earlier, so We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great distress

ayahs.ar: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍۢ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
tr.pickthall: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.
tr.yusufali: We helped him against people who rejected Our Signs: truly they were a people given to Evil: so We drowned them (in the Flood) all together.
tr.khattab: And We made him prevail over those who had rejected Our signs. They were truly an evil people, so We drowned them all

ayahs.ar: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَٰهِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.
tr.pickthall: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.
tr.yusufali: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the matter of the field into which the sheep of certain people had strayed by night: We did witness their judgment.
tr.khattab: And ˹remember˺ when David and Solomon passed judgment regarding the crops ruined ˹at night˺ by someone’s sheep, and We were witness to their judgments

ayahs.ar: فَفَهَّمْنَٰهَا سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ

tr.sahih: And We gave understanding of the case to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].
tr.pickthall: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof).
tr.yusufali: To Solomon We inspired the (right) understanding of the matter: to each (of them) We gave Judgment and Knowledge; it was Our power that made the hills and the birds celebrate Our praises, with David: it was We Who did (all these things).
tr.khattab: We guided ˹young˺ Solomon to a fairer settlement, and granted each of them wisdom and knowledge. We subjected the mountains as well as the birds to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with David. It is We Who did ˹it all˺

ayahs.ar: وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍۢ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَٰكِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
tr.pickthall: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful?
tr.yusufali: It was We Who taught him the making of coats of mail for your benefit, to guard you from each other's violence: will ye then be grateful?
tr.khattab: We taught him the art of making body armour to protect you in battle. Will you then be grateful

ayahs.ar: وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
tr.pickthall: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware.
tr.yusufali: (It was Our power that made) the violent (unruly) wind flow (tamely) for Solomon, to his order, to the land which We had blessed: for We do know all things.
tr.khattab: And to Solomon We subjected the raging winds, blowing by his command to the land We had showered with blessings. It is We Who know everything

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَٰفِظِينَ

tr.sahih: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
tr.pickthall: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them.
tr.yusufali: And of the evil ones, were some who dived for him, and did other work besides; and it was We Who guarded them.
tr.khattab: And ˹We subjected˺ some jinn that dived for him, and performed other duties. It is We Who kept them in check

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."
tr.pickthall: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
tr.yusufali: And (remember) Job, when He cried to his Lord, "Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful."
tr.khattab: And ˹remember˺ when Job cried out to his Lord, “I have been touched with adversity, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”

ayahs.ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَٰبِدِينَ

tr.sahih: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah].
tr.pickthall: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers;
tr.yusufali: So We listened to him: We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his people to him, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who serve Us.
