tr.sahih: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
tr.pickthall: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein ye used to differ.
tr.yusufali: "Allah will judge between you on the Day of Judgment concerning the matters in which ye differ."
tr.khattab: Allah will judge between you ˹all˺ on Judgment Day regarding your differences

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

tr.sahih: Do you not know that Allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allah, is easy.
tr.pickthall: Hast thou not known that Allah knoweth all that is in the heaven and the earth? Lo! it is in a record. Lo! that is easy for Allah.
tr.yusufali: Knowest thou not that Allah knows all that is in heaven and on earth? Indeed it is all in a Record, and that is easy for Allah.
tr.khattab: Do you not know that Allah ˹fully˺ knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth? Surely it is all ˹written˺ in a Record. That is certainly easy for Allah

ayahs.ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًۭا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍۢ

tr.sahih: And they worship besides Allah that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
tr.pickthall: And they worship instead of Allah that for which He hath sent down no warrant, and that whereof they have no knowledge. For evil-doers there is no helper.
tr.yusufali: Yet they worship, besides Allah, things for which no authority has been sent down to them, and of which they have (really) no knowledge: for those that do wrong there is no helper.
tr.khattab: Yet they worship besides Allah that for which He has sent down no authority, and of which they have no knowledge. The wrongdoers will have no helper

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ۗ قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ۗ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

tr.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."
tr.pickthall: And when Our revelations are recited unto them, thou knowest the denial in the faces of those who disbelieve; they all but attack those who recite Our revelations unto them. Say: Shall I proclaim unto you worse than that? The Fire! Allah hath promised it for those who disbelieve. A hapless journey's end!
tr.yusufali: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, thou wilt notice a denial on the faces of the Unbelievers! they nearly attack with violence those who rehearse Our Signs to them. Say, "Shall I tell you of something (far) worse than these Signs? It is the Fire (of Hell)! Allah has promised it to the Unbelievers! and evil is that destination!"
tr.khattab: Whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, you ˹O Prophet˺ recognize rage on the faces of the disbelievers, as if they are going to snap at those who recite Our revelations to them. Say, “Shall I inform you of something far more enraging than that? ˹It is˺ the Fire with which Allah has threatened those who disbelieve. What an evil destination!”

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌۭ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًۭا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًۭٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ

tr.sahih: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for that purpose. And if the fly should steal away from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.
tr.pickthall: O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought!
tr.yusufali: O men! Here is a parable set forth! listen to it! Those on whom, besides Allah, ye call, cannot create (even) a fly, if they all met together for the purpose! and if the fly should snatch away anything from them, they would have no power to release it from the fly. Feeble are those who petition and those whom they petition!
tr.khattab: O humanity! A lesson is set forth, so listen to it ˹carefully˺: those ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah can never create ˹so much as˺ a fly, even if they ˹all˺ were to come together for that. And if a fly were to snatch anything away from them, they cannot ˹even˺ retrieve it from the fly. How powerless are those who invoke and those invoked

ayahs.ar: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ

tr.sahih: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
tr.pickthall: They measure not Allah His rightful measure. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
tr.yusufali: No just estimate have they made of Allah: for Allah is He Who is strong and able to Carry out His Will.
tr.khattab: They have not shown Allah the reverence He deserves. Surely Allah is All-Powerful, Almighty

ayahs.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ

tr.sahih: Allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.
tr.pickthall: Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer.
tr.yusufali: Allah chooses messengers from angels and from men for Allah is He Who hears and sees (all things).
tr.khattab: Allah selects messengers from both angels and people, for Allah is truly All-Hearing, All-Seeing

ayahs.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ

tr.sahih: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allah will be returned [all] matters.
tr.pickthall: He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned. $$A
tr.yusufali: He knows what is before them and what is behind them: and to Allah go back all questions (for decision).
tr.khattab: He knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them. And to Allah ˹all˺ matters will be returned ˹for judgment˺

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۩

tr.sahih: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.
tr.pickthall: O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper.
tr.yusufali: O ye who believe! bow down, prostrate yourselves, and adore your Lord; and do good; that ye may prosper.
tr.khattab: O believers! Bow down, prostrate yourselves, worship your Lord, and do ˹what is˺ good so that you may be successful

ayahs.ar: وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ ۚ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍۢ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ

tr.sahih: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. Allah named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
tr.pickthall: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!
tr.yusufali: And strive in His cause as ye ought to strive, (with sincerity and under discipline). He has chosen you, and has imposed no difficulties on you in religion; it is the cult of your father Abraham. It is He Who has named you Muslims, both before and in this (Revelation); that the Messenger may be a witness for you, and ye be witnesses for mankind! So establish regular Prayer, give regular Charity, and hold fast to Allah! He is your Protector - the Best to protect and the Best to help!
tr.khattab: Strive for ˹the cause of˺ Allah in the way He deserves, for ˹it is˺ He ˹Who˺ has chosen you, and laid upon you no hardship in the religion—the way of your forefather Abraham. ˹It is Allah˺ Who named you ‘the ones who submit’ ˹in the˺ earlier ˹Scriptures˺ and in this ˹Quran˺, so that the Messenger may be a witness over you, and that you may be witnesses over humanity. So establish prayer, pay alms-tax, and hold fast to Allah. He ˹alone˺ is your Guardian. What an excellent Guardian, and what an excellent Helper

ayahs.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
tr.pickthall: Successful indeed are the believers
tr.yusufali: The believers must (eventually) win through,-
tr.khattab: Successful indeed are the believers

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ

tr.sahih: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
tr.pickthall: Who are humble in their prayers,
tr.yusufali: Those who humble themselves in their prayers;
tr.khattab: those who humble themselves in prayer

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ

tr.sahih: And they who turn away from ill speech
tr.pickthall: And who shun vain conversation,
tr.yusufali: Who avoid vain talk;
tr.khattab: those who avoid idle talk

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ

tr.sahih: And they who are observant of zakah
tr.pickthall: And who are payers of the poor-due;
tr.yusufali: Who are active in deeds of charity;
tr.khattab: those who pay alms-tax

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ

tr.sahih: And they who guard their private parts
tr.pickthall: And who guard their modesty -
tr.yusufali: Who abstain from sex,
tr.khattab: those who guard their chastity

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

tr.sahih: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
tr.pickthall: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy,
tr.yusufali: Except with those joined to them in the marriage bond, or (the captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (in their case) they are free from blame,
tr.khattab: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame

ayahs.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ

tr.sahih: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
tr.pickthall: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors -
tr.yusufali: But those whose desires exceed those limits are transgressors;-
tr.khattab: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ

tr.sahih: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
tr.pickthall: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,
tr.yusufali: Those who faithfully observe their trusts and their covenants;
tr.khattab: ˹the believers are also˺ those who are true to their trusts and covenants

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

tr.sahih: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
tr.pickthall: And who pay heed to their prayers.
tr.yusufali: And who (strictly) guard their prayers;-
tr.khattab: and those who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

tr.sahih: Those are the inheritors
tr.pickthall: These are the heirs
tr.yusufali: These will be the heirs,
tr.khattab: These are the ones who will be awarded

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

tr.sahih: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
tr.pickthall: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.
tr.yusufali: Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever).
tr.khattab: Paradise as their own. They will be there forever

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
tr.pickthall: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;
tr.yusufali: Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay);
tr.khattab: And indeed, We created humankind from an extract of clay

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.
tr.pickthall: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging;
tr.yusufali: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed;
tr.khattab: then placed each ˹human˺ as a sperm-drop in a secure place

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
tr.pickthall: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!
tr.yusufali: Then We made the sperm into a clot of congealed blood; then of that clot We made a (foetus) lump; then we made out of that lump bones and clothed the bones with flesh; then we developed out of it another creature. So blessed be Allah, the best to create!
tr.khattab: then We developed the drop into a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then developed the clot into a lump ˹of flesh˺, then developed the lump into bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, then We brought it into being as a new creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ

tr.sahih: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
tr.pickthall: Then lo! after that ye surely die.
tr.yusufali: After that, at length ye will die
tr.khattab: After that you will surely die

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ

tr.sahih: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
tr.pickthall: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).
tr.yusufali: Again, on the Day of Judgment, will ye be raised up.
tr.khattab: then on the Day of Judgment you will be resurrected

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ

tr.sahih: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
tr.pickthall: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.
tr.yusufali: And We have made, above you, seven tracts; and We are never unmindful of (our) Creation.
tr.khattab: And indeed, We created above you seven levels ˹of heaven˺. We are never unmindful of ˹Our˺ creation

ayahs.ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
tr.pickthall: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.
tr.yusufali: And We send down water from the sky according to (due) measure, and We cause it to soak in the soil; and We certainly are able to drain it off (with ease).
tr.khattab: We send down rain from the sky in perfect measure, causing it to soak into the earth. And We are surely able to take it away

ayahs.ar: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

tr.sahih: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
tr.pickthall: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;
tr.yusufali: With it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and vines: in them have ye abundant fruits: and of them ye eat (and have enjoyment),-
tr.khattab: With it We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are abundant fruits, and from which you may eat

ayahs.ar: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ

tr.sahih: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.
tr.pickthall: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.
tr.yusufali: Also a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, which produces oil, and relish for those who use it for food.
tr.khattab: as well as ˹olive˺ trees which grow at Mount Sinai, providing oil and a condiment to eat

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
tr.pickthall: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;
tr.yusufali: And in cattle (too) ye have an instructive example: from within their bodies We produce (milk) for you to drink; there are, in them, (besides), numerous (other) benefits for you; and of their (meat) ye eat;
tr.khattab: And there is certainly a lesson for you in cattle, from whose bellies We give you ˹milk˺ to drink, and in them are many other benefits for you, and from them you may eat

ayahs.ar: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
tr.pickthall: And on them and on the ship ye are carried.
tr.yusufali: And on them, as well as in ships, ye ride.
tr.khattab: And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
tr.pickthall: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.yusufali: (Further, We sent a long line of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people: He said, "O my people! worship Allah! Ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
tr.khattab: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people. He declared, “O my people! Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
tr.pickthall: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.
tr.yusufali: The chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: his wish is to assert his superiority over you: if Allah had wished (to send messengers), He could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing (as he says), among our ancestors of old."
tr.khattab: But the disbelieving chiefs of his people said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you, who wants to be superior to you. Had Allah willed, He could have easily sent down angels ˹instead˺. We have never heard of this in ˹the history of˺ our forefathers

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
tr.pickthall: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.
tr.yusufali: (And some said): "He is only a man possessed: wait (and have patience) with him for a time."
tr.khattab: He is simply insane, so bear with him for a while.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

tr.sahih: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
tr.yusufali: (Noah) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood!"
tr.khattab: Noah prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”

ayahs.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ

tr.sahih: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
tr.pickthall: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.
tr.yusufali: So We inspired him (with this message): "Construct the Ark within Our sight and under Our guidance: then when comes Our Command, and the fountains of the earth gush forth, take thou on board pairs of every species, male and female, and thy family- except those of them against whom the Word has already gone forth: And address Me not in favour of the wrong-doers; for they shall be drowned (in the Flood).
tr.khattab: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes and directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts ˹with water˺, take on board a pair from every species along with your family—except those against whom the decree ˹to drown˺ has already been passed. And do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
tr.pickthall: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!
tr.yusufali: And when thou hast embarked on the Ark - thou and those with thee,- say: "Praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who do wrong."
tr.khattab: Then when you and those with you have settled in the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”

ayahs.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ

tr.sahih: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "
tr.pickthall: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
tr.yusufali: And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark."
tr.khattab: And pray, “My Lord! Allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best accommodator.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
tr.pickthall: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.
tr.yusufali: Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand); (thus) do We try (men).
tr.khattab: Surely in this are lessons. And We ˹always˺ put ˹people˺ to the test

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ

tr.sahih: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
tr.pickthall: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;
tr.yusufali: Then We raised after them another generation.
tr.khattab: Then We raised another generation after them

ayahs.ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
tr.pickthall: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.yusufali: And We sent to them a messenger from among themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah! ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
tr.khattab: and sent to them a messenger from among themselves, ˹declaring,˺ “Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ

tr.sahih: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
tr.pickthall: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.
tr.yusufali: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things of this life, said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: he eats of that of which ye eat, and drinks of what ye drink.
tr.khattab: But the chiefs of his people—who disbelieved, denied the meeting ˹with Allah˺ in the Hereafter, and were spoiled by the worldly luxuries We had provided for them—said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you. He eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
tr.pickthall: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.
tr.yusufali: "If ye obey a man like yourselves, behold, it is certain ye will be lost.
tr.khattab: And if you ˹ever˺ obey a human like yourselves, then you would certainly be losers

ayahs.ar: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ

tr.sahih: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
tr.pickthall: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth?
tr.yusufali: "Does he promise that when ye die and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth (again)?
tr.khattab: Does he promise you that once you are dead and reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth ˹alive˺

ayahs.ar: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
tr.pickthall: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!
tr.yusufali: "Far, very far is that which ye are promised!
tr.khattab: Impossible, simply impossible is what you are promised

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ

tr.sahih: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
tr.pickthall: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).
tr.yusufali: "There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again!
tr.khattab: There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die, others are born, and none will be resurrected

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."
tr.pickthall: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.
tr.yusufali: "He is only a man who invents a lie against Allah, but we are not the ones to believe in him!"
tr.khattab: He is no more than a man who has fabricated a lie about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
tr.yusufali: (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood."
tr.khattab: The messenger prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
tr.pickthall: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "In but a little while, they are sure to be sorry!"
tr.khattab: Allah responded, “Soon they will be truly regretful.”

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
tr.pickthall: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!
tr.yusufali: Then the Blast overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead leaves (floating on the stream of Time)! So away with the people who do wrong!
tr.khattab: Then the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them with justice, and We reduced them to rubble. So away with the wrongdoing people

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ

tr.sahih: Then We produced after them other generations.
tr.pickthall: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
tr.yusufali: Then We raised after them other generations.
tr.khattab: Then We raised other generations after them

ayahs.ar: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

tr.sahih: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
tr.pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.
tr.yusufali: No people can hasten their term, nor can they delay (it).
tr.khattab: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
tr.pickthall: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!
tr.yusufali: Then sent We our messengers in succession: every time there came to a people their messenger, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other (in punishment): We made them as a tale (that is told): So away with a people that will not believe!
tr.khattab: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to his people, they denied him. So We destroyed them, one after the other, reducing them to ˹cautionary˺ tales. So away with the people who refuse to believe

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
tr.pickthall: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant
tr.yusufali: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest,
tr.khattab: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and compelling proof

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ

tr.sahih: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
tr.pickthall: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.
tr.yusufali: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people.
tr.khattab: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a tyrannical people

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
tr.pickthall: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?
tr.yusufali: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us!"
tr.khattab: They argued, “Will we believe in two humans, like ourselves, whose people are slaves to us?”

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ

tr.sahih: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
tr.pickthall: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.
tr.yusufali: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed.
tr.khattab: So they rejected them both, and ˹so˺ were among those destroyed

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

tr.sahih: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
tr.pickthall: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.
tr.yusufali: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance.
tr.khattab: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so perhaps his people would be ˹rightly˺ guided

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
tr.pickthall: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.
tr.yusufali: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs.
tr.khattab: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them refuge on high ground—a ˹suitable˺ place for rest with flowing water

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.
tr.pickthall: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.
tr.yusufali: O ye messengers! enjoy (all) things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with (all) that ye do.
tr.khattab: O messengers! Eat from what is good and lawful, and act righteously. Indeed, I fully know what you do

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ

tr.sahih: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
tr.pickthall: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.
tr.yusufali: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me (and no other).
tr.khattab: Surely this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so fear Me ˹alone˺

ayahs.ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

tr.sahih: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
tr.pickthall: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.
tr.yusufali: But people have cut off their affair (of unity), between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself.
tr.khattab: Yet the people have divided it into different sects, each rejoicing in what they have

ayahs.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

tr.sahih: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
tr.pickthall: So leave them in their error till a time.
tr.yusufali: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time.
tr.khattab: So leave them ˹O Prophet˺ in their heedlessness for a while

ayahs.ar: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ

tr.sahih: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
tr.pickthall: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them
tr.yusufali: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons,
tr.khattab: Do they think, since We provide them with wealth and children

ayahs.ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ

tr.sahih: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
tr.pickthall: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not.
tr.yusufali: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand.
tr.khattab: that We hasten to ˹honour˺ them ˹with˺ all kinds of good? No! They are not aware

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.
tr.yusufali: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
tr.khattab: Surely those who tremble in awe of their Lord

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
tr.pickthall: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
tr.yusufali: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord;
tr.khattab: and who believe in the revelations of their Lord

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ

tr.sahih: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
tr.pickthall: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,
tr.yusufali: Those who join not (in worship) partners with their Lord;
tr.khattab: and who associate none with their Lord

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ

tr.sahih: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
tr.pickthall: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,
tr.yusufali: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord;-
tr.khattab: and who do whatever ˹good˺ they do with their hearts fearful, ˹knowing˺ that they will return to their Lord—

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ

tr.sahih: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
tr.pickthall: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.
tr.yusufali: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them.
tr.khattab: it is they who race to do good deeds, always taking the lead

ayahs.ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
tr.pickthall: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.
tr.yusufali: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged.
tr.khattab: We never require of any soul more than what it can afford. And with Us is a record which speaks the truth. None will be wronged

ayahs.ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ

tr.sahih: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,
tr.pickthall: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;
tr.yusufali: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will (continue) to do,-
tr.khattab: But the hearts of those ˹who disbelieve˺ are oblivious to ˹all of˺ this, and they have other ˹evil˺ deeds, opposite to this, in which they are engrossed

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ

tr.sahih: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.
tr.pickthall: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.
tr.yusufali: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication!
tr.khattab: But as soon as We seize their elite with torment, they start to cry for help

ayahs.ar: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ

tr.sahih: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
tr.pickthall: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.
tr.yusufali: (It will be said): "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us.
tr.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry for help today. Surely you will never be saved from Us

ayahs.ar: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ

tr.sahih: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
tr.pickthall: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,
tr.yusufali: "My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels-
tr.khattab: Indeed, My revelations were recited to you, but you used to back away ˹in disgust˺

ayahs.ar: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًۭا تَهْجُرُونَ

tr.sahih: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
tr.pickthall: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.
tr.yusufali: "In arrogance: talking nonsense about the (Qur'an), like one telling fables by night."
tr.khattab: boasting of the Sacred House, and babbling ˹nonsense about the Quran˺ by night.”

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
tr.pickthall: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?
tr.yusufali: Do they not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old?
tr.khattab: Is it because they have never contemplated the Word ˹of Allah˺? Or ˹because˺ there has come to them something that did not come to their forefathers

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
tr.pickthall: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him?
tr.yusufali: Or do they not recognise their Messenger, that they deny him?
tr.khattab: Or ˹because˺ they failed to recognize their Messenger, and so they denied him

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
tr.pickthall: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.
tr.yusufali: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth.
tr.khattab: Or ˹because˺ they say, “He is insane?” In fact, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are resentful of the truth

ayahs.ar: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

tr.sahih: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
tr.pickthall: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.
tr.yusufali: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition.
tr.khattab: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens, the earth, and all those in them would have certainly been corrupted. In fact, We have brought them ˹the means to˺ their glory, but they turn away from it

ayahs.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
tr.pickthall: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.
tr.yusufali: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
tr.khattab: Or ˹is it because˺ you ˹O Prophet˺ are asking them for tribute? But the reward of your Lord is best, for He is the Best Provider

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.
tr.yusufali: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way;
tr.khattab: And surely you are calling them to the Straight Path

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ

tr.sahih: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
tr.pickthall: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.
tr.yusufali: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way.
tr.khattab: but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are certainly deviating from that Path

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

tr.sahih: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
tr.pickthall: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.
tr.yusufali: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro.
tr.khattab: ˹Even˺ if We had mercy on them and removed their affliction, they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ

tr.sahih: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
tr.pickthall: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,
tr.yusufali: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat (Him)!-
tr.khattab: And We have already seized them with torment, but they never humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they ˹submissively˺ appeal ˹to Him˺

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

tr.sahih: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
tr.pickthall: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.
tr.yusufali: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein!
tr.khattab: But as soon as We open for them a gate of severe punishment, they will be utterly desperate

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

tr.sahih: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
tr.pickthall: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
tr.yusufali: It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give!
tr.khattab: He is the One Who created for you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

tr.sahih: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
tr.pickthall: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.
tr.yusufali: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back.
tr.khattab: And He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
tr.pickthall: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense?
tr.yusufali: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him (is due) the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand?
tr.khattab: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of the day and night. Will you not then understand

ayahs.ar: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

tr.sahih: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;
tr.yusufali: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said.
tr.khattab: But they ˹just˺ say what their predecessors said

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

tr.sahih: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
tr.pickthall: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?
tr.yusufali: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again?
tr.khattab: They said, “Once we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
tr.pickthall: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.
tr.yusufali: "Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients!"
tr.khattab: We have already been promised this, as well as our forefathers earlier. This is nothing but ancient fables!”

ayahs.ar: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
tr.pickthall: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge?
tr.yusufali: Say: "To whom belong the earth and all beings therein? (say) if ye know!"
tr.khattab: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “To whom belong the earth and all those on it, if you ˹really˺ know?”

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
tr.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember?
tr.yusufali: They will say, "To Allah!" say: "Yet will ye not receive admonition?"
tr.khattab: They will reply, “To Allah!” Say, “Why are you not then mindful?”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
tr.pickthall: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?
tr.yusufali: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme?"
tr.khattab: ˹And˺ ask ˹them˺, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
tr.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)?
tr.yusufali: They will say, "(They belong) to Allah." Say: "Will ye not then be filled with awe?"
tr.khattab: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
tr.pickthall: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge?
tr.yusufali: Say: "Who is it in whose hands is the governance of all things,- who protects (all), but is not protected (of any)? (say) if ye know."
tr.khattab: Ask ˹them also,˺ “In Whose Hands is the authority over all things, protecting ˹all˺ while none can protect against Him, if you ˹really˺ know?”

ayahs.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ

tr.sahih: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
tr.pickthall: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched?
tr.yusufali: They will say, "(It belongs) to Allah." Say: "Then how are ye deluded?"
tr.khattab: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “How are you then so deluded?”

ayahs.ar: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

tr.sahih: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars.
tr.yusufali: We have sent them the Truth: but they indeed practise falsehood!
tr.khattab: In fact, We have brought them the truth, and they are certainly liars

ayahs.ar: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ ۚ إِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

tr.sahih: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].
tr.pickthall: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.
tr.yusufali: No son did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him: (if there were many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the (sort of) things they attribute to Him!
tr.khattab: Allah has never had ˹any˺ offspring, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he created, and they would have tried to dominate one another. Glorified is Allah above what they claim

ayahs.ar: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

tr.sahih: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
tr.pickthall: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)!
tr.yusufali: He knows what is hidden and what is open: too high is He for the partners they attribute to Him!
tr.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen. Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺

ayahs.ar: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
tr.pickthall: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.
tr.yusufali: Say: "O my Lord! if Thou wilt show me (in my lifetime) that which they are warned against,-
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Should You show me what they are threatened with

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
tr.pickthall: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk.
tr.yusufali: "Then, O my Lord! put me not amongst the people who do wrong!"
tr.khattab: then, my Lord, do not count me among the wrongdoing people.”

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.
tr.pickthall: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them.
tr.yusufali: And We are certainly able to show thee (in fulfilment) that against which they are warned.
tr.khattab: We are indeed able to show you what We have threatened them with

ayahs.ar: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ

tr.sahih: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
tr.pickthall: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege.
tr.yusufali: Repel evil with that which is best: We are well acquainted with the things they say.
tr.khattab: Respond to evil with what is best. We know well what they claim

ayahs.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ

tr.sahih: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
tr.pickthall: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,
tr.yusufali: And say "O my Lord! I seek refuge with Thee from the suggestions of the Evil Ones.
tr.khattab: And say, “My Lord! I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils

ayahs.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ

tr.sahih: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
tr.pickthall: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me,
tr.yusufali: "And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord! lest they should come near me."
tr.khattab: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, that they ˹even˺ come near me.”

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ

tr.sahih: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
tr.pickthall: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,
tr.yusufali: (In Falsehood will they be) Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "O my Lord! send me back (to life),-
tr.khattab: When death approaches any of them, they cry, “My Lord! Let me go back

ayahs.ar: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

tr.sahih: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
tr.pickthall: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised.
tr.yusufali: "In order that I may work righteousness in the things I neglected." - "By no means! It is but a word he says."- Before them is a Partition till the Day they are raised up.
tr.khattab: so I may do good in what I left behind.” Never! It is only a ˹useless˺ appeal they make. And there is a barrier behind them until the Day they are resurrected

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

tr.sahih: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
tr.pickthall: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.
tr.yusufali: Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no more relationships between them that Day, nor will one ask after another!
tr.khattab: Then, when the Trumpet will be blown, there will be no kinship between them on that Day, nor will they ˹even care to˺ ask about one another

ayahs.ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

tr.sahih: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
tr.pickthall: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.
tr.yusufali: Then those whose balance (of good deeds) is heavy,- they will attain salvation:
tr.khattab: As for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, it is they who will be successful

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ

tr.sahih: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
tr.pickthall: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.
tr.yusufali: But those whose balance is light, will be those who have lost their souls, in Hell will they abide.
tr.khattab: But those whose scale is light, they will have doomed themselves, staying in Hell forever

ayahs.ar: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ

tr.sahih: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
tr.pickthall: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein.
tr.yusufali: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will therein grin, with their lips displaced.
tr.khattab: The Fire will burn their faces, leaving them deformed

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

tr.sahih: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
tr.pickthall: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them?
tr.yusufali: "Were not My Signs rehearsed to you, and ye did but treat them as falsehood?"
tr.khattab: ˹It will be said,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, but you used to deny them?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ

tr.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
tr.pickthall: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.
tr.yusufali: They will say: "our Lord! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we became a people astray!
tr.khattab: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ

tr.sahih: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
tr.pickthall: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers.
tr.yusufali: "Our Lord! bring us out of this: if ever we return (to Evil), then shall we be wrong-doers indeed!"
tr.khattab: Our Lord! Take us out of this ˹Fire˺. Then if we ever return ˹to denial˺, we will truly be wrongdoers.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ

tr.sahih: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
tr.pickthall: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.
tr.yusufali: He will say: "Be ye driven into it (with ignominy)! And speak ye not to Me!
tr.khattab: Allah will respond, “Be despised in there! Do not ˹ever˺ plead with Me ˹again˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
tr.pickthall: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;
tr.yusufali: "A part of My servants there was, who used to pray 'our Lord! we believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us: For Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
tr.khattab: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to pray, ‘Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy,’

ayahs.ar: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ

tr.sahih: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
tr.pickthall: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.
tr.yusufali: "But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that (ridicule of) them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them!
tr.khattab: but you were ˹so busy˺ making fun of them that it made you forget My remembrance. And you used to laugh at them

ayahs.ar: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
tr.pickthall: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant.
tr.yusufali: "I have rewarded them this Day for their patience and constancy: they are indeed the ones that have achieved Bliss..."
tr.khattab: Today I have indeed rewarded them for their perseverance: they are certainly the triumphant.”

ayahs.ar: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
tr.pickthall: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years?
tr.yusufali: He will say: "What number of years did ye stay on earth?"
tr.khattab: He will ask ˹them˺, “How many years did you remain on earth?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ

tr.sahih: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
tr.pickthall: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!
tr.yusufali: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day: but ask those who keep account."
tr.khattab: They will reply, “We remained ˹only˺ a day or part of a day. But ask those who kept count.”

ayahs.ar: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
tr.pickthall: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.
tr.yusufali: He will say: "Ye stayed not but a little,- if ye had only known!
tr.khattab: He will say, “You only remained for a little while, if only you knew

ayahs.ar: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ

tr.sahih: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
tr.pickthall: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us?
tr.yusufali: "Did ye then think that We had created you in jest, and that ye would not be brought back to Us (for account)?"
tr.khattab: Did you then think that We had created you without purpose, and that you would never be returned to Us?”

ayahs.ar: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ

tr.sahih: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
tr.pickthall: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace.
tr.yusufali: Therefore exalted be Allah, the King, the Reality: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Throne of Honour!
tr.khattab: Exalted is Allah, the True King! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Honourable Throne

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
tr.pickthall: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful.
tr.yusufali: If anyone invokes, besides Allah, Any other god, he has no authority therefor; and his reckoning will be only with his Lord! and verily the Unbelievers will fail to win through!
tr.khattab: Whoever invokes, besides Allah, another god—for which they can have no proof—they will surely find their penalty with their Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed

ayahs.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
tr.pickthall: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.
tr.yusufali: So say: "O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”

ayahs.ar: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: [This is] a surah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
tr.pickthall: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed.
tr.yusufali: A sura which We have sent down and which We have ordained in it have We sent down Clear Signs, in order that ye may receive admonition.
tr.khattab: ˹This is˺ a sûrah which We have revealed and made ˹its rulings˺ obligatory, and revealed in it clear commandments so that you may be mindful

ayahs.ar: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍۢ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌۭ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion of Allah, if you should believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.
tr.pickthall: The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment.
tr.yusufali: The woman and the man guilty of adultery or fornication,- flog each of them with a hundred stripes: Let not compassion move you in their case, in a matter prescribed by Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day: and let a party of the Believers witness their punishment.
tr.khattab: As for female and male fornicators, give each of them one hundred lashes, and do not let pity for them make you lenient in ˹enforcing˺ the law of Allah, if you ˹truly˺ believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a number of believers witness their punishment

ayahs.ar: ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةًۭ وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌۭ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that has been made unlawful to the believers.
tr.pickthall: The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers.
tr.yusufali: Let no man guilty of adultery or fornication marry and but a woman similarly guilty, or an Unbeliever: nor let any but such a man or an Unbeliever marry such a woman: to the Believers such a thing is forbidden.
tr.khattab: A male fornicator would only marry a female fornicator or idolatress. And a female fornicator would only be married to a fornicator or idolater. This is ˹all˺ forbidden to the believers

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلْدَةًۭ وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدًۭا ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ

tr.sahih: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,
tr.pickthall: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -
tr.yusufali: And those who launch a charge against chaste women, and produce not four witnesses (to support their allegations),- flog them with eighty stripes; and reject their evidence ever after: for such men are wicked transgressors;-
tr.khattab: Those who accuse chaste women ˹of adultery˺ and fail to produce four witnesses, give them eighty lashes ˹each˺. And do not ever accept any testimony from them—for they are indeed the rebellious—

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr.pickthall: Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: Unless they repent thereafter and mend (their conduct); for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: except those who repent afterwards and mend their ways, then surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the truthful.
tr.pickthall: As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth;
tr.yusufali: And for those who launch a charge against their spouses, and have (in support) no evidence but their own,- their solitary evidence (can be received) if they bear witness four times (with an oath) by Allah that they are solemnly telling the truth;
tr.khattab: And those who accuse their wives ˹of adultery˺ but have no witness except themselves, the accuser must testify, swearing four times by Allah that he is telling the truth

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ

tr.sahih: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allah be upon him if he should be among the liars.
tr.pickthall: And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie.
tr.yusufali: And the fifth (oath) (should be) that they solemnly invoke the curse of Allah on themselves if they tell a lie.
tr.khattab: and a fifth oath that Allah may condemn him if he is lying

ayahs.ar: وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ

tr.sahih: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the liars.
tr.pickthall: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false,
tr.yusufali: But it would avert the punishment from the wife, if she bears witness four times (with an oath) By Allah, that (her husband) is telling a lie;
tr.khattab: For her to be spared the punishment, she must swear four times by Allah that he is telling a lie

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he was of the truthful.
