ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
tr.pickthall: We never sent before thee any messengers but lo! they verily ate food and walked in the markets. And We have appointed some of you a test for others: Will ye be steadfast? And thy Lord is ever Seer.
tr.yusufali: And the messengers whom We sent before thee were all (men) who ate food and walked through the streets: We have made some of you as a trial for others: will ye have patience? for Allah is One Who sees (all things).
tr.khattab: We never sent any messenger before you ˹O Prophet˺, who did not eat food and go about in market-places. We have made some of you a trial for others. Will you ˹not then˺ be patient? And your Lord is All-Seeing

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
tr.pickthall: And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride.
tr.yusufali: Such as fear not the meeting with Us (for Judgment) say: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or (why) do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they have an arrogant conceit of themselves, and mighty is the insolence of their impiety!
tr.khattab: Those who do not expect to meet Us say, “If only the angels were sent down to us, or we could see our Lord!” They have certainly been carried away by their arrogance and have entirely exceeded all limits

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا

tr.sahih: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
tr.pickthall: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban!
tr.yusufali: The Day they see the angels,- no joy will there be to the sinners that Day: The (angels) will say: "There is a barrier forbidden (to you) altogether!"
tr.khattab: ˹But˺ on the Day they will see the angels, there will be no good news for the wicked, who will cry, “Keep away! Away ˹from us˺!”

ayahs.ar: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍۢ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هَبَآءًۭ مَّنثُورًا

tr.sahih: And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
tr.pickthall: And We shall turn unto the work they did and make it scattered motes.
tr.yusufali: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they did (in this life), and We shall make such deeds as floating dust scattered about.
tr.khattab: Then We will turn to whatever ˹good˺ deeds they did, reducing them to scattered dust

ayahs.ar: أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌۭ مُّسْتَقَرًّۭا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
tr.pickthall: Those who have earned the Garden on that day will be better in their home and happier in their place of noonday rest;
tr.yusufali: The Companions of the Garden will be well, that Day, in their abode, and have the fairest of places for repose.
tr.khattab: ˹But˺ on that Day the residents of Paradise will have the best settlement and the finest place to rest

ayahs.ar: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا

tr.sahih: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
tr.pickthall: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent.
tr.yusufali: The Day the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and angels shall be sent down, descending (in ranks),-
tr.khattab: ˹Watch for˺ the Day the heavens will burst with clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive ranks

ayahs.ar: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
tr.pickthall: The Sovereignty on that day will be the True (Sovereignty) belonging to the Beneficent One, and it will be a hard day for disbelievers.
tr.yusufali: That Day, the dominion as of right and truth, shall be (wholly) for (Allah) Most Merciful: it will be a Day of dire difficulty for the misbelievers.
tr.khattab: True authority on that Day will belong ˹only˺ to the Most Compassionate. And it will be a hard day for the disbelievers

ayahs.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
tr.pickthall: On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)!
tr.yusufali: The Day that the wrong-doer will bite at his hands, he will say, "Oh! would that I had taken a (straight) path with the Messenger!
tr.khattab: And ˹beware of˺ the Day the wrongdoer will bite his nails ˹in regret˺ and say, “Oh! I wish I had followed the Way along with the Messenger

ayahs.ar: يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
tr.pickthall: Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend!
tr.yusufali: "Ah! woe is me! Would that I had never taken such a one for a friend!
tr.khattab: Woe to me! I wish I had never taken so-and-so as a close friend

ayahs.ar: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولًۭا

tr.sahih: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
tr.pickthall: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need.
tr.yusufali: "He did lead me astray from the Message (of Allah) after it had come to me! Ah! the Evil One is but a traitor to man!"
tr.khattab: It was he who truly made me stray from the Reminder after it had reached me.” And Satan has always betrayed humanity

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًۭا

tr.sahih: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."
tr.pickthall: And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account.
tr.yusufali: Then the Messenger will say: "O my Lord! Truly my people took this Qur'an for just foolish nonsense."
tr.khattab: The Messenger has cried, “O my Lord! My people have indeed received this Quran with neglect.”

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًۭا وَنَصِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
tr.pickthall: Even so have We appointed unto every prophet an opponent from among the guilty; but Allah sufficeth for a Guide and Helper.
tr.yusufali: Thus have We made for every prophet an enemy among the sinners: but enough is thy Lord to guide and to help.
tr.khattab: Similarly, We made enemies for every prophet from among the wicked, but sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and Helper

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَٰهُ تَرْتِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
tr.pickthall: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order.
tr.yusufali: Those who reject Faith say: "Why is not the Qur'an revealed to him all at once? Thus (is it revealed), that We may strengthen thy heart thereby, and We have rehearsed it to thee in slow, well-arranged stages, gradually.
tr.khattab: The disbelievers say, “If only the Quran had been sent down to him all at once!” ˹We have sent it˺ as such ˹in stages˺ so We may reassure your heart with it. And We have revealed it at a deliberate pace

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا

tr.sahih: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
tr.pickthall: And they bring thee no similitude but We bring thee the Truth (as against it), and better (than their similitude) as argument.
tr.yusufali: And no question do they bring to thee but We reveal to thee the truth and the best explanation (thereof).
tr.khattab: Whenever they bring you an argument, We come to you with the right refutation and the best explanation

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
tr.pickthall: Those who will be gathered on their faces unto hell: such are worse in plight and further from the right road.
tr.yusufali: Those who will be gathered to Hell (prone) on their faces,- they will be in an evil plight, and, as to Path, most astray.
tr.khattab: Those who will be dragged into Hell on their faces will be in the worst place, and are ˹now˺ farthest from the ˹Right˺ Way

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
tr.pickthall: We verily gave Moses the Scripture and placed with him his brother Aaron as henchman.
tr.yusufali: (Before this,) We sent Moses The Book, and appointed his brother Aaron with him as minister;
tr.khattab: We certainly gave Moses the Book and appointed his brother Aaron as his helper

ayahs.ar: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
tr.pickthall: Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction.
tr.yusufali: And We command: "Go ye both, to the people who have rejected our Signs:" And those (people) We destroyed with utter destruction.
tr.khattab: We had ordered ˹them˺, “Go to the people who would deny Our signs.” Then We annihilated the deniers entirely

ayahs.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا

tr.sahih: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
tr.pickthall: And Noah's folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers.
tr.yusufali: And the people of Noah,- when they rejected the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them as a Sign for mankind; and We have prepared for (all) wrong-doers a grievous Penalty;-
tr.khattab: And when the people of Noah rejected the messengers, We drowned them, making them an example to humanity. And We have prepared a painful punishment for the wrongdoers

ayahs.ar: وَعَادًۭا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
tr.pickthall: And (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, and the dwellers in Ar-Rass, and many generations in between.
tr.yusufali: As also 'Ad and Thamud, and the Companions of the Rass, and many a generation between them.
tr.khattab: Also ˹We destroyed˺ ’Ȃd, Thamûd, and the people of the Water-pit, as well as many peoples in between

ayahs.ar: وَكُلًّۭا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
tr.pickthall: Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin.
tr.yusufali: To each one We set forth Parables and examples; and each one We broke to utter annihilation (for their sins).
tr.khattab: For each We set forth ˹various˺ lessons, and We ultimately destroyed each

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًۭا

tr.sahih: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
tr.pickthall: And indeed they have passed by the township whereon was rained the fatal rain. Can it be that they have not seen it? Nay, but they hope for no resurrection.
tr.yusufali: And the (Unbelievers) must indeed have passed by the town on which was rained a shower of evil: did they not then see it (with their own eyes)? But they fear not the Resurrection.
tr.khattab: They have certainly passed by the city ˹of Sodom˺, which had been showered with a dreadful rain ˹of stones˺. Have they not seen its ruins? But they do not expect to be resurrected

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا

tr.sahih: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
tr.pickthall: And when they see thee (O Muhammad) they treat thee only as a jest (saying): Is this he whom Allah sendeth as a messenger?
tr.yusufali: When they see thee, they treat thee no otherwise than in mockery: "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?"
tr.khattab: When they see you ˹O Prophet˺, they only make fun of you, ˹saying,˺ “Is this the one that Allah has sent as a messenger

ayahs.ar: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

tr.sahih: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
tr.pickthall: He would have led us far away from our gods if we had not been staunch to them. They will know, when they behold the doom, who is more astray as to the road.
tr.yusufali: "He indeed would well-nigh have misled us from our gods, had it not been that we were constant to them!" - Soon will they know, when they see the Penalty, who it is that is most misled in Path!
tr.khattab: He would have almost tricked us away from our gods, had we not been so devoted to them.” ˹But˺ soon they will know, when they face the punishment, who is far astray from the ˹Right˺ Way

ayahs.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا

tr.sahih: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
tr.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who chooseth for his god his own lust? Wouldst thou then be guardian over him?
tr.yusufali: Seest thou such a one as taketh for his god his own passion (or impulse)? Couldst thou be a disposer of affairs for him?
tr.khattab: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ the one who has taken their own desires as their god? Will you then be a keeper over them

ayahs.ar: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

tr.sahih: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
tr.pickthall: Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand? They are but as the cattle - nay, but they are farther astray?
tr.yusufali: Or thinkest thou that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle;- nay, they are worse astray in Path.
tr.khattab: Or do you think that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle—no, more than that, they are astray from the ˹Right˺ Way

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًۭا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
tr.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade - And if He willed He could have made it still - then We have made the sun its pilot;
tr.yusufali: Hast thou not turned thy vision to thy Lord?- How He doth prolong the shadow! If He willed, He could make it stationary! then do We make the sun its guide;
tr.khattab: Have you not seen how your Lord extends the shade—He could have simply made it ˹remain˺ still if He so willed—then We make the sun its guide

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًۭا يَسِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.
tr.pickthall: Then We withdraw it unto Us, a gradual withdrawal?
tr.yusufali: Then We draw it in towards Ourselves,- a contraction by easy stages.
tr.khattab: causing the shade to retreat gradually

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًۭا

tr.sahih: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
tr.pickthall: And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection.
tr.yusufali: And He it is Who makes the Night as a Robe for you, and Sleep as Repose, and makes the Day (as it were) a Resurrection.
tr.khattab: He is the One Who has made the night for you as a cover, and ˹made˺ sleep for resting, and the day for rising

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ طَهُورًۭا

tr.sahih: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water
tr.pickthall: And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy, and We send down purifying water from the sky,
tr.yusufali: And He it is Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy, and We send down pure water from the sky,-
tr.khattab: And He is the One Who sends the winds ushering in His mercy, and We send down pure rain from the sky

ayahs.ar: لِّنُحْۦِىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
tr.pickthall: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof.
tr.yusufali: That with it We may give life to a dead land, and slake the thirst of things We have created,- cattle and men in great numbers.
tr.khattab: giving life to a lifeless land, and providing water for countless animals and humans of Our Own creation

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا

tr.sahih: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
tr.pickthall: And verily We have repeated it among them that they may remember, but most of mankind begrudge aught save ingratitude.
tr.yusufali: And We have distributed the (water) amongst them, in order that they may celebrate (our) praises, but most men are averse (to aught) but (rank) ingratitude.
tr.khattab: We certainly disperse it among them so they may be mindful, but most people persist in ungratefulness

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍۢ نَّذِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
tr.pickthall: If We willed, We could raise up a warner in every village.
tr.yusufali: Had it been Our Will, We could have sent a warner to every centre of population.
tr.khattab: Had We willed, We could have easily sent a warner to every society

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًۭا كَبِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.
tr.pickthall: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them herewith with a great endeavour.
tr.yusufali: Therefore listen not to the Unbelievers, but strive against them with the utmost strenuousness, with the (Qur'an).
tr.khattab: So do not yield to the disbelievers, but strive diligently against them with this ˹Quran˺

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًۭا وَحِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا

tr.sahih: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
tr.pickthall: And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them.
tr.yusufali: It is He Who has let free the two bodies of flowing water: One palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter; yet has He made a barrier between them, a partition that is forbidden to be passed.
tr.khattab: And He is the One Who merges the two bodies of water: one fresh and palatable and the other salty and bitter, placing between them a barrier they cannot cross

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًۭا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًۭا وَصِهْرًۭا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
tr.pickthall: And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful.
tr.yusufali: It is He Who has created man from water: then has He established relationships of lineage and marriage: for thy Lord has power (over all things).
tr.khattab: And He is the One Who creates human beings from a ˹humble˺ liquid, then establishes for them bonds of kinship and marriage. For your Lord is Most Capable

ayahs.ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
tr.pickthall: Yet they worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them nor hurt them. The disbeliever was ever a partisan against his Lord.
tr.yusufali: Yet do they worship, besides Allah, things that can neither profit them nor harm them: and the Misbeliever is a helper (of Evil), against his own Lord!
tr.khattab: Yet they worship besides Allah what can neither benefit nor harm them. And the disbeliever always collaborates against their Lord

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
tr.pickthall: And We have sent thee (O Muhammad) only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
tr.yusufali: But thee We only sent to give glad tidings and admonition.
tr.khattab: And We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a deliverer of good news and a warner

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
tr.pickthall: Say: I ask of you no reward for this, save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord.
tr.yusufali: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for it but this: that each one who will may take a (straight) Path to his Lord."
tr.khattab: Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺, but whoever wishes, let them pursue the Way to their Lord.”

ayahs.ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا

tr.sahih: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -
tr.pickthall: And trust thou in the Living One Who dieth not, and hymn His praise. He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen's sins,
tr.yusufali: And put thy trust in Him Who lives and dies not; and celebrate his praise; and enough is He to be acquainted with the faults of His servants;-
tr.khattab: Put your trust in the Ever-Living, Who never dies, and glorify His praises. Sufficient is He as All-Aware of the sins of His servants

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.
tr.pickthall: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days, then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask anyone informed concerning Him!
tr.yusufali: He Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between, in six days, and is firmly established on the Throne (of Authority): Allah Most Gracious: ask thou, then, about Him of any acquainted (with such things).
tr.khattab: ˹He is˺ the One Who created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. ˹He is˺ the Most Compassionate! Ask ˹none other than˺ the All-Knowledgeable about Himself

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًۭا ۩

tr.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
tr.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Prostrate to the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent? Are we to prostrate to whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us? And it increaseth aversion in them.
tr.yusufali: When it is said to them, "Prostrate to (Allah) Most Gracious!", they say, "And what is (Allah) Most Gracious? Shall we prostrate to that which thou commandest us?" And it increases their flight (from the Truth).
tr.khattab: When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they ask ˹in disgust˺, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate’? Will we prostrate to whatever you order us to?” And it only drives them farther away

ayahs.ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًۭا وَقَمَرًۭا مُّنِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
tr.pickthall: Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light!
tr.yusufali: Blessed is He Who made constellations in the skies, and placed therein a Lamp and a Moon giving light;
tr.khattab: Blessed is the One Who has placed constellations in the sky, as well as a ˹radiant˺ lamp and a luminous moon

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةًۭ لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًۭا

tr.sahih: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
tr.pickthall: And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness.
tr.yusufali: And it is He Who made the Night and the Day to follow each other: for such as have the will to celebrate His praises or to show their gratitude.
tr.khattab: And He is the One Who causes the day and the night to alternate, ˹as a sign˺ for whoever desires to be mindful or to be grateful

ayahs.ar: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًۭا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا

tr.sahih: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
tr.pickthall: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;
tr.yusufali: And the servants of (Allah) Most Gracious are those who walk on the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, "Peace!";
tr.khattab: The ˹true˺ servants of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the foolish address them ˹improperly˺, they only respond with peace

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًۭا وَقِيَٰمًۭا

tr.sahih: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
tr.pickthall: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing,
tr.yusufali: Those who spend the night in adoration of their Lord prostrate and standing;
tr.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who spend ˹a good portion of˺ the night, prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

tr.sahih: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
tr.pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;
tr.yusufali: Those who say, "Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous,-
tr.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Keep the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is indeed unrelenting

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;
tr.yusufali: "Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in";
tr.khattab: It is certainly an evil place to settle and reside.”

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا

tr.sahih: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
tr.pickthall: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;
tr.yusufali: Those who, when they spend, are not extravagant and not niggardly, but hold a just (balance) between those (extremes);
tr.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who spend neither wastefully nor stingily, but moderately in between

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًۭا

tr.sahih: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
tr.pickthall: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;
tr.yusufali: Those who invoke not, with Allah, any other god, nor slay such life as Allah has made sacred except for just cause, nor commit fornication; - and any that does this (not only) meets punishment.
tr.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who do not invoke any other god besides Allah, nor take a ˹human˺ life—made sacred by Allah—except with ˹legal˺ right, nor commit fornication. And whoever does ˹any of˺ this will face the penalty

ayahs.ar: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا

tr.sahih: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
tr.pickthall: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;
tr.yusufali: (But) the Penalty on the Day of Judgment will be doubled to him, and he will dwell therein in ignominy,-
tr.khattab: Their punishment will be multiplied on the Day of Judgment, and they will remain in it forever, in disgrace

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا

tr.sahih: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
tr.pickthall: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: Unless he repents, believes, and works righteous deeds, for Allah will change the evil of such persons into good, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful,
tr.khattab: As for those who repent, believe, and do good deeds, they are the ones whose evil deeds Allah will change into good deeds. For Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا

tr.sahih: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
tr.pickthall: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -
tr.yusufali: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah with an (acceptable) conversion;-
tr.khattab: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah properly

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًۭا

tr.sahih: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
tr.pickthall: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.
tr.yusufali: Those who witness no falsehood, and, if they pass by futility, they pass by it with honourable (avoidance);
tr.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who do not bear false witness, and when they come across falsehood, they pass ˹it˺ by with dignity

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا

tr.sahih: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
tr.pickthall: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
tr.yusufali: Those who, when they are admonished with the Signs of their Lord, droop not down at them as if they were deaf or blind;
tr.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who, when reminded of the revelation of their Lord, do not turn a blind eye or a deaf ear to it

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

tr.sahih: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
tr.pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).
tr.yusufali: And those who pray, "Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous."
tr.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Bless us with ˹pious˺ spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our hearts, and make us models for the righteous.”

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَٰمًا

tr.sahih: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
tr.pickthall: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,
tr.yusufali: Those are the ones who will be rewarded with the highest place in heaven, because of their patient constancy: therein shall they be met with salutations and peace,
tr.khattab: It is they who will be rewarded with ˹elevated˺ mansions ˹in Paradise˺ for their perseverance, and will be received with salutations and ˹greetings of˺ peace

ayahs.ar: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا

tr.sahih: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
tr.pickthall: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!
tr.yusufali: Dwelling therein;- how beautiful an abode and place of rest!
tr.khattab: staying there forever. What an excellent place to settle and reside

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا

tr.sahih: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.
tr.yusufali: Say (to the Rejecters): "My Lord is not uneasy because of you if ye call not on Him: But ye have indeed rejected (Him), and soon will come the inevitable (punishment)!"
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You ˹all˺ would not ˹even˺ matter to my Lord were it not for your faith ˹in Him˺. But now you ˹disbelievers˺ have denied ˹the truth˺, so the torment is bound to come.”

ayahs.ar: طسٓمٓ

tr.sahih: Ta, Seen, Meem.
tr.pickthall: Ta. Sin. Mim.
tr.yusufali: Ta. Sin. Mim.
tr.khattab: Ṭâ-Sĩn-Mĩm

ayahs.ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

tr.sahih: These are the verses of the clear Book.
tr.pickthall: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
tr.yusufali: These are verses of the Book that makes (things) clear.
tr.khattab: These are the verses of the clear Book

ayahs.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
tr.pickthall: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.
tr.yusufali: It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers.
tr.khattab: Perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their disbelief

ayahs.ar: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ

tr.sahih: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
tr.pickthall: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
tr.yusufali: If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them from the sky a Sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
tr.khattab: If We willed, We could send down upon them a ˹compelling˺ sign from the heavens, leaving their necks bent in ˹utter˺ submission to it

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ

tr.sahih: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
tr.pickthall: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.
tr.yusufali: But there comes not to them a newly-revealed Message from (Allah) Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom.
tr.khattab: Whatever new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate, they always turn away from it

ayahs.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

tr.sahih: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
tr.pickthall: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.
tr.yusufali: They have indeed rejected (the Message): so they will know soon (enough) the truth of what they mocked at!
tr.khattab: They have certainly denied ˹the truth˺, so they will soon face the consequences of their ridicule

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
tr.pickthall: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?
tr.yusufali: Do they not look at the earth,- how many noble things of all kinds We have produced therein?
tr.khattab: Have they failed to look at the earth, ˹to see˺ how many types of fine plants We have caused to grow in it

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
tr.yusufali: Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
tr.khattab: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.yusufali: And verily, thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
tr.pickthall: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,
tr.yusufali: Behold, thy Lord called Moses: "Go to the people of iniquity,-
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people—

ayahs.ar: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
tr.pickthall: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?
tr.yusufali: "The people of the Pharaoh: will they not fear Allah?"
tr.khattab: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear ˹Allah˺?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
tr.yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! I do fear that they will charge me with falsehood:
tr.khattab: He replied, “My Lord! I fear that they will reject me

ayahs.ar: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ

tr.sahih: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
tr.pickthall: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).
tr.yusufali: "My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (smoothly): so send unto Aaron.
tr.khattab: And ˹so˺ my heart will be broken and my tongue will be tied. So send Aaron along ˹as a messenger˺

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

tr.sahih: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
tr.pickthall: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.
tr.yusufali: "And (further), they have a charge of crime against me; and I fear they may slay me."
tr.khattab: Also, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
tr.pickthall: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.
tr.yusufali: Allah said: "By no means! proceed then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you, and will listen (to your call).
tr.khattab: Allah responded, “Certainly not! So go, both of you, with Our signs. We will be with you, listening

ayahs.ar: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
tr.pickthall: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,
tr.yusufali: "So go forth, both of you, to Pharaoh, and say: 'We have been sent by the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds;
tr.khattab: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are messengers from the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

tr.sahih: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
tr.pickthall: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.
tr.yusufali: "'Send thou with us the Children of Israel.'"
tr.khattab: ˹commanded to say:˺ ‘Let the Children of Israel go with us.’’”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,
tr.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said: "Did we not cherish thee as a child among us, and didst thou not stay in our midst many years of thy life?
tr.khattab: Pharaoh protested, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed several years of your life in our care

ayahs.ar: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
tr.pickthall: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.
tr.yusufali: "And thou didst a deed of thine which (thou knowest) thou didst, and thou art an ungrateful (wretch)!"
tr.khattab: Then you did what you did, being ˹utterly˺ ungrateful!”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
tr.pickthall: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.
tr.yusufali: Moses said: "I did it then, when I was in error.
tr.khattab: Moses replied, “I did it then, lacking guidance

ayahs.ar: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
tr.pickthall: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).
tr.yusufali: "So I fled from you (all) when I feared you; but my Lord has (since) invested me with judgment (and wisdom) and appointed me as one of the messengers.
tr.khattab: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me one of the messengers

ayahs.ar: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

tr.sahih: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
tr.pickthall: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.
tr.yusufali: "And this is the favour with which thou dost reproach me,- that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel!"
tr.khattab: How can that be a ‘favour,’ of which you remind me, when ˹it was only because˺ you ˹have˺ enslaved the Children of Israel?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
tr.pickthall: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?
tr.yusufali: Pharaoh said: "And what is the 'Lord and Cherisher of the worlds'?"
tr.khattab: Pharaoh asked, “And what is ‘the Lord of all worlds’?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
tr.pickthall: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.
tr.yusufali: (Moses) said: "The Lord and Cherisher of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- if ye want to be quite sure."
tr.khattab: Moses replied, “˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ

tr.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
tr.pickthall: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?
tr.yusufali: (Pharaoh) said to those around: "Did ye not listen (to what he says)?"
tr.khattab: Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear ˹what he said˺?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
tr.pickthall: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.
tr.yusufali: (Moses) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers from the beginning!"

tr.yusufali: The Companions of the Wood rejected the messengers.
tr.khattab: The residents of the Forest rejected the messengers

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
tr.pickthall: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.yusufali: Behold, Shu'aib said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
tr.khattab: when Shu’aib said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

ayahs.ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
tr.pickthall: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
tr.yusufali: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
tr.khattab: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

ayahs.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

tr.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
tr.pickthall: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
tr.yusufali: "So fear Allah and obey me.
tr.khattab: So fear Allah, and obey me

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.yusufali: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.khattab: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
tr.pickthall: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).
tr.yusufali: "Give just measure, and cause no loss (to others by fraud).
tr.khattab: Give full measure, and cause no loss ˹to others˺

ayahs.ar: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ

tr.sahih: And weigh with an even balance.
tr.pickthall: And weigh with the true balance.
tr.yusufali: "And weigh with scales true and upright.
tr.khattab: Weigh with an even balance

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
tr.pickthall: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.
tr.yusufali: "And withhold not things justly due to men, nor do evil in the land, working mischief.
tr.khattab: and do not defraud people of their property. Nor go about spreading corruption in the land

ayahs.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
tr.pickthall: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.
tr.yusufali: "And fear Him Who created you and (who created) the generations before (you)"
tr.khattab: And fear the One Who created you and ˹all˺ earlier peoples.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
tr.pickthall: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
tr.yusufali: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!
tr.khattab: They replied, “You are simply bewitched

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ

tr.sahih: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
tr.pickthall: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.
tr.yusufali: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us, and indeed we think thou art a liar!
tr.khattab: Also, you are only a human being like us, and we think you are indeed a liar

ayahs.ar: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
tr.pickthall: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.
tr.yusufali: "Now cause a piece of the sky to fall on us, if thou art truthful!"
tr.khattab: So cause ˹deadly˺ pieces of the sky to fall upon us, if what you say is true.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.
tr.yusufali: He said: "My Lord knows best what ye do."
tr.khattab: Shu’aib responded, “My Lord knows best whatever you do.”

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
tr.pickthall: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.
tr.yusufali: But they rejected him. Then the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom seized them, and that was the Penalty of a Great Day.
tr.khattab: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ were overtaken by the torment of the day of the ˹deadly˺ cloud. That was really a torment of a tremendous day

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
tr.yusufali: Verily in that is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
tr.khattab: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tr.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.yusufali: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,
tr.yusufali: Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds:
tr.khattab: This is certainly a revelation from the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ

tr.sahih: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
tr.pickthall: Which the True Spirit hath brought down
tr.yusufali: With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth-
tr.khattab: which the trustworthy spirit ˹Gabriel˺ brought down

ayahs.ar: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
tr.pickthall: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,
tr.yusufali: To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish.
tr.khattab: into your heart ˹O Prophet˺—so that you may be one of the warners—

ayahs.ar: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: In a clear Arabic language.
tr.pickthall: In plain Arabic speech.
tr.yusufali: In the perspicuous Arabic tongue.
tr.khattab: in a clear Arabic tongue

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.
tr.yusufali: Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples.
tr.khattab: And it has indeed been ˹foretold˺ in the Scriptures of those before

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

tr.sahih: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
tr.pickthall: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?
tr.yusufali: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
tr.khattab: Was it not sufficient proof for the deniers that it has been recognized by the knowledgeable among the Children of Israel

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
tr.pickthall: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,
tr.yusufali: Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs,
tr.khattab: Had We revealed it to a non-Arab

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
tr.pickthall: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
tr.yusufali: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
tr.khattab: who would then recite it to the deniers ˹in fluent Arabic˺, still they would not have believed in it

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
tr.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
tr.yusufali: Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners.
tr.khattab: This is how We allow denial ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked

ayahs.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

tr.sahih: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
tr.pickthall: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,
tr.yusufali: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty;
tr.khattab: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment

ayahs.ar: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

tr.sahih: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
tr.pickthall: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.
tr.yusufali: But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
tr.khattab: which will take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺

ayahs.ar: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ

tr.sahih: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
tr.pickthall: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?
tr.yusufali: Then they will say: "Shall we be respited?"
tr.khattab: Then they will cry, “Can we be allowed more time?”

ayahs.ar: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

tr.sahih: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
tr.pickthall: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?
tr.yusufali: Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on?
tr.khattab: Do they ˹really˺ seek to hasten Our torment

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُمْ سِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
tr.pickthall: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,
tr.yusufali: Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years,
tr.khattab: Imagine ˹O Prophet˺ if We allowed them enjoyment for years

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
tr.pickthall: And then cometh that which they were promised,
tr.yusufali: Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised!
tr.khattab: then there came to them what they had been threatened with

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ

tr.sahih: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
tr.pickthall: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?
tr.yusufali: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)!
tr.khattab: would that enjoyment be of any benefit to them ˹at all˺

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
tr.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
tr.yusufali: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners -
tr.khattab: We have never destroyed a society without warners

ayahs.ar: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
tr.pickthall: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.
tr.yusufali: By way of reminder; and We never are unjust.
tr.khattab: to remind ˹them˺, for We would never wrong ˹anyone˺

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ

tr.sahih: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
tr.pickthall: The devils did not bring it down.
tr.yusufali: No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation):
tr.khattab: It was not the devils who brought this ˹Quran˺ down

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

tr.sahih: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
tr.pickthall: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,
tr.yusufali: It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it).
tr.khattab: it is not for them ˹to do so˺, nor can they

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
tr.pickthall: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.
tr.yusufali: Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it.
tr.khattab: for they are strictly barred from ˹even˺ overhearing ˹it˺

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ

tr.sahih: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
tr.pickthall: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.
tr.yusufali: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty.
tr.khattab: So do not ever call upon any other god besides Allah, or you will be one of the punished

ayahs.ar: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ

tr.sahih: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
tr.pickthall: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,
tr.yusufali: And admonish thy nearest kinsmen,
tr.khattab: And warn ˹all, starting with˺ your closest relatives

ayahs.ar: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
tr.pickthall: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.
tr.yusufali: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee.
tr.khattab: and be gracious to the believers who follow you

ayahs.ar: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
tr.pickthall: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
tr.yusufali: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do!"
tr.khattab: But if they disobey you, say, “I am certainly free of what you do.”

ayahs.ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

tr.sahih: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
tr.pickthall: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.yusufali: And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,-
tr.khattab: Put your trust in the Almighty, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

tr.sahih: Who sees you when you arise
tr.pickthall: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
tr.yusufali: Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer),
tr.khattab: Who sees you when you rise ˹for prayer at night˺

ayahs.ar: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And your movement among those who prostrate.
tr.pickthall: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).
tr.yusufali: And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves,
tr.khattab: as well as your movements ˹in prayer˺ along with ˹fellow˺ worshippers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr.pickthall: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.
tr.yusufali: For it is He Who heareth and knoweth all things.
tr.khattab: He ˹alone˺ is indeed the All-Hearing, All-Knowing

ayahs.ar: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ

tr.sahih: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
tr.pickthall: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
tr.yusufali: Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend?
tr.khattab: Shall I inform you of whom the devils ˹actually˺ descend upon

ayahs.ar: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: They descend upon every sinful liar.
tr.pickthall: They descend on every sinful, false one.
tr.yusufali: They descend on every lying, wicked person,
tr.khattab: They descend upon every sinful liar

ayahs.ar: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَٰذِبُونَ

tr.sahih: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
tr.pickthall: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.
tr.yusufali: (Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars.
tr.khattab: who gives an ˹attentive˺ ear ˹to half-truths˺, mostly passing on sheer lies

ayahs.ar: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ

tr.sahih: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
tr.pickthall: As for poets, the erring follow them.
tr.yusufali: And the Poets,- It is those straying in Evil, who follow them:
tr.khattab: As for poets, they are followed ˹merely˺ by deviants

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ

tr.sahih: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
tr.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,
tr.yusufali: Seest thou not that they wander distracted in every valley?-
tr.khattab: Do you not see how they rant in every field

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And that they say what they do not do? -
tr.pickthall: And how they say that which they do not?
tr.yusufali: And that they say what they practise not?-
tr.khattab: only saying what they never do

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ

tr.sahih: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
tr.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!
tr.yusufali: Except those who believe, work righteousness, engage much in the remembrance of Allah, and defend themselves only after they are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust assailants know what vicissitudes their affairs will take!
tr.khattab: Except those who believe, do good, remember Allah often, and ˹poetically˺ avenge ˹the believers˺ after being wrongfully slandered. The wrongdoers will come to know what ˹evil˺ end they will meet

ayahs.ar: طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book
tr.pickthall: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain;
tr.yusufali: These are verses of the Qur'an,-a book that makes (things) clear;
tr.khattab: Ṭâ-Sĩn. These are the verses of the Quran; the clear Book

ayahs.ar: هُدًۭى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
tr.pickthall: A guidance and good tidings for believers
tr.yusufali: A guide: and glad tidings for the believers,-
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ a guide and good news for the believers

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
tr.pickthall: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter.
tr.yusufali: Those who establish regular prayers and give in regular charity, and also have (full) assurance of the hereafter.
tr.khattab: ˹those˺ who establish prayer, pay alms-tax, and have sure faith in the Hereafter

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
tr.pickthall: Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray.
tr.yusufali: As to those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds pleasing in their eyes; and so they wander about in distraction.
tr.khattab: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have certainly made their ˹evil˺ deeds appealing to them, so they wander blindly

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ

tr.sahih: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
tr.pickthall: Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.
tr.yusufali: Such are they for whom a grievous Penalty is (waiting); and in the Hereafter theirs will be the greatest loss.
tr.khattab: It is they who will suffer a dreadful torment, and in the Hereafter they will ˹truly˺ be the greatest losers

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing.
tr.pickthall: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware.
tr.yusufali: As to thee, the Qur'an is bestowed upon thee from the presence of one who is wise and all-knowing.
tr.khattab: And indeed, you ˹O Prophet˺ are receiving the Quran from the One ˹Who is˺ All-Wise, All-Knowing

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍۢ قَبَسٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
tr.pickthall: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.
tr.yusufali: Behold! Moses said to his family: "I perceive a fire; soon will I bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand to light our fuel, that ye may warm yourselves.
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when Moses said to his family, “I have spotted a fire. I will either bring you some directions from there, or a burning torch so you may warm yourselves.”

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
tr.yusufali: But when he came to the (fire), a voice was heard: "Blessed are those in the fire and those around: and glory to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
tr.khattab: But when he came to it, he was called ˹by Allah˺, “Blessed is the one at the fire, and whoever is around it! Glory be to Allah, the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

tr.sahih: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
tr.pickthall: O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.yusufali: "O Moses! verily, I am Allah, the exalted in might, the wise!....
tr.khattab: O Moses! It is truly I. I am Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise

ayahs.ar: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّۭ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًۭا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
tr.pickthall: And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence,
tr.yusufali: "Now do thou throw thy rod!" But when he saw it moving (of its own accord) as if it had been a snake, he turned back in retreat, and retraced not his steps: "O Moses!" (it was said), "Fear not: truly, in My presence, those called as messengers have no fear,-
tr.khattab: Now, throw down your staff!” But when he saw it slithering like a snake, he ran away without looking back. ˹Allah reassured him,˺ “O Moses! Do not be afraid! Messengers should have no fear in My presence

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍۢ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
tr.pickthall: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: "But if any have done wrong and have thereafter substituted good to take the place of evil, truly, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: ˹Fear is˺ only for those who do wrong. But if they later mend ˹their˺ evil ˹ways˺ with good, then I am certainly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍۢ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
tr.pickthall: And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe, it will come forth white but unhurt. (This will be one) among nine tokens unto Pharaoh and his people Lo! they were ever evil-living folk.
tr.yusufali: "Now put thy hand into thy bosom, and it will come forth white without stain (or harm): (these are) among the nine Signs (thou wilt take) to Pharaoh and his people: for they are a people rebellious in transgression."
tr.khattab: Now put your hand through ˹the opening of˺ your collar, it will come out ˹shining˺ white, unblemished. ˹These are two˺ of nine signs for Pharaoh and his people. They have truly been a rebellious people.”

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةًۭ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
tr.pickthall: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,
tr.yusufali: But when Our Signs came to them, that should have opened their eyes, they said: "This is sorcery manifest!"
tr.khattab: But when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, “This is pure magic.”

ayahs.ar: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًۭا وَعُلُوًّۭا ۚ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ

tr.sahih: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
tr.pickthall: And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers!
tr.yusufali: And they rejected those Signs in iniquity and arrogance, though their souls were convinced thereof: so see what was the end of those who acted corruptly!
tr.khattab: And, although their hearts were convinced the signs were true, they still denied them wrongfully and arrogantly. See then what was the end of the corruptors

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًۭا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
tr.pickthall: And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves!
tr.yusufali: We gave (in the past) knowledge to David and Solomon: And they both said: "Praise be to Allah, Who has favoured us above many of his servants who believe!"
tr.khattab: Indeed, We granted knowledge to David and Solomon. And they said ˹in acknowledgment˺, “All praise is for Allah Who has privileged us over many of His faithful servants.”

ayahs.ar: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

tr.sahih: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
tr.pickthall: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour.
tr.yusufali: And Solomon was David's heir. He said: "O ye people! We have been taught the speech of birds, and on us has been bestowed (a little) of all things: this is indeed Grace manifest (from Allah.)"
tr.khattab: And David was succeeded by Solomon, who said, “O people! We have been taught the language of birds, and been given everything ˹we need˺. This is indeed a great privilege.”

ayahs.ar: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

tr.sahih: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.
tr.pickthall: And there were gathered together unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order;
