tr.yusufali: And We have created for them similar (vessels) on which they ride.
tr.khattab: and created for them similar things to ride in

ayahs.ar: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ

tr.sahih: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
tr.pickthall: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;
tr.yusufali: If it were Our Will, We could drown them: then would there be no helper (to hear their cry), nor could they be delivered,
tr.khattab: If We willed, We could drown them: then no one would respond to their cries, nor would they be rescued—

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
tr.pickthall: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.
tr.yusufali: Except by way of Mercy from Us, and by way of (world) convenience (to serve them) for a time.
tr.khattab: except by mercy from Us, allowing them enjoyment for a ˹little˺ while

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

tr.sahih: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
tr.pickthall: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).
tr.yusufali: When they are told, "Fear ye that which is before you and that which will be after you, in order that ye may receive Mercy," (they turn back).
tr.khattab: ˹Still they turn away˺ when it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you ˹in the Hereafter˺ and what is behind you ˹of destroyed nations˺ so you may be shown mercy.”

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

tr.sahih: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
tr.pickthall: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!
tr.yusufali: Not a Sign comes to them from among the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away therefrom.
tr.khattab: Whenever a sign comes to them from their Lord, they turn away from it

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
tr.pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
tr.yusufali: And when they are told, "Spend ye of (the bounties) with which Allah has provided you," the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Shall we then feed those whom, if Allah had so willed, He would have fed, (Himself)?- Ye are in nothing but manifest error."
tr.khattab: And when it is said to them, “Donate from what Allah has provided for you,” the disbelievers say to the believers, “Why should we feed those whom Allah could have fed if He wanted to? You are clearly astray!”

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
tr.pickthall: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?
tr.yusufali: Further, they say, "When will this promise (come to pass), if what ye say is true?"
tr.khattab: And they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”

ayahs.ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ

tr.sahih: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
tr.pickthall: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.
tr.yusufali: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves!
tr.khattab: They must be awaiting a single Blast, which will seize them while they are ˹entrenched˺ in ˹worldly˺ disputes

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

tr.sahih: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
tr.pickthall: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.
tr.yusufali: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people!
tr.khattab: Then they will not be able to make a ˹last˺ will, nor can they return to their own people

ayahs.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ

tr.sahih: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
tr.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,
tr.yusufali: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!
tr.khattab: The Trumpet will be blown ˹a second time˺, then—behold!—they will rush from the graves to their Lord

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

tr.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
tr.pickthall: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
tr.yusufali: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers!"
tr.khattab: They will cry, “Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of rest? This must be what the Most Compassionate warned us of; the messengers told the truth!”

ayahs.ar: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

tr.sahih: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
tr.pickthall: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!
tr.yusufali: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us!
tr.khattab: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will all be brought before Us

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
tr.pickthall: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.
tr.yusufali: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds.
tr.khattab: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be rewarded except for what you used to do

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,
tr.yusufali: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;
tr.khattab: Indeed, on that Day the residents of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves

ayahs.ar: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ

tr.sahih: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
tr.pickthall: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;
tr.yusufali: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity);
tr.khattab: They and their spouses will be in ˹cool˺ shade, reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches

ayahs.ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ

tr.sahih: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
tr.pickthall: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;
tr.yusufali: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for;
tr.khattab: There they will have fruits and whatever they desire

ayahs.ar: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
tr.pickthall: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
tr.yusufali: "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!
tr.khattab: And “Peace!” will be ˹their˺ greeting from the Merciful Lord

ayahs.ar: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

tr.sahih: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
tr.pickthall: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!
tr.yusufali: "And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day!
tr.khattab: ˹Then the disbelievers will be told,˺ “Step away ˹from the believers˺ this Day, O wicked ones

ayahs.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
tr.pickthall: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -
tr.yusufali: "Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed?-
tr.khattab: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, not to follow Satan, for he is truly your sworn enemy

ayahs.ar: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
tr.pickthall: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.
tr.yusufali: "And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way?
tr.khattab: but to worship Me ˹alone˺? This is the Straight Path

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
tr.pickthall: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?
tr.yusufali: "But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand?
tr.khattab: Yet he already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not have any sense

ayahs.ar: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
tr.pickthall: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).
tr.yusufali: "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!
tr.khattab: This is the Hell you were warned of

ayahs.ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

tr.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
tr.pickthall: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
tr.yusufali: "Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)."
tr.khattab: Burn in it Today for your disbelief.”

ayahs.ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

tr.sahih: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
tr.pickthall: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.
tr.yusufali: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.
tr.khattab: On this Day We will seal their mouths, their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to what they used to commit

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
tr.pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?
tr.yusufali: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen?
tr.khattab: Had We willed, We could have easily blinded their eyes, so they would struggle to find their way. How then could they see

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ

tr.sahih: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
tr.pickthall: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.
tr.yusufali: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error).
tr.khattab: And had We willed, We could have transfigured them on the spot, so they could neither progress forward nor turn back

ayahs.ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
tr.pickthall: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?
tr.yusufali: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?
tr.khattab: And whoever We grant a long life, We reverse them in development. Will they not then understand

ayahs.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
tr.pickthall: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
tr.yusufali: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur'an making things clear:
tr.khattab: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This ˹Book˺ is only a Reminder and a clear Quran

ayahs.ar: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

tr.sahih: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
tr.pickthall: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.
tr.yusufali: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth).
tr.khattab: to warn whoever is ˹truly˺ alive and fulfil the decree ˹of torment˺ against the disbelievers

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ

tr.sahih: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
tr.pickthall: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,
tr.yusufali: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion?-
tr.khattab: Do they not see that We singlehandedly created for them, among other things, cattle which are under their control

ayahs.ar: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ

tr.sahih: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
tr.pickthall: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?
tr.yusufali: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat:
tr.khattab: And We have subjected these ˹animals˺ to them, so they may ride some and eat others

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

tr.sahih: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
tr.pickthall: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?
tr.yusufali: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
tr.khattab: And they derive from them other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks

ayahs.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

tr.sahih: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
tr.pickthall: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.
tr.yusufali: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than Allah, (hoping) that they might be helped!
tr.khattab: Still they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping to be helped ˹by them˺

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ

tr.sahih: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
tr.pickthall: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.
tr.yusufali: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned).
tr.khattab: They cannot help the pagans, even though they serve the idols as dedicated guards

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

tr.sahih: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
tr.pickthall: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.
tr.yusufali: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose.
tr.khattab: So do not let their words grieve you ˹O Prophet˺. Indeed, We ˹fully˺ know what they conceal and what they reveal

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
tr.pickthall: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
tr.yusufali: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary!
tr.khattab: Do people not see that We have created them from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Us˺

ayahs.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
tr.pickthall: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?
tr.yusufali: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)?"
tr.khattab: And they argue with Us—forgetting they were created—saying, “Who will give life to decayed bones?”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ

tr.sahih: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
tr.pickthall: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,
tr.yusufali: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation!-
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “They will be revived by the One Who produced them the first time, for He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of every created being

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ

tr.sahih: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
tr.pickthall: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.
tr.yusufali: "The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)!
tr.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who gives you fire from green trees, and—behold!—you kindle ˹fire˺ from them

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
tr.pickthall: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,
tr.yusufali: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)!
tr.khattab: Can the One Who created the heavens and the earth not ˹easily˺ resurrect these ˹deniers˺?” Yes ˹He can˺! For He is the Master Creator, All-Knowing

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

tr.sahih: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
tr.pickthall: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
tr.yusufali: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is!
tr.khattab: All it takes, when He wills something ˹to be˺, is simply to say to it: “Be!” And it is

ayahs.ar: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

tr.sahih: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
tr.pickthall: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.
tr.yusufali: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back.
tr.khattab: So glory be to the One in Whose Hands is the authority over all things, and to Whom ˹alone˺ you will ˹all˺ be returned

ayahs.ar: وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا

tr.sahih: By those [angels] lined up in rows
tr.pickthall: By those who set the ranks in battle order
tr.yusufali: By those who range themselves in ranks,
tr.khattab: By those ˹angels˺ lined up in ranks

ayahs.ar: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And those who drive [the clouds]
tr.pickthall: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
tr.yusufali: And so are strong in repelling (evil),
tr.khattab: and those who diligently drive ˹the clouds˺

ayahs.ar: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا

tr.sahih: And those who recite the message,
tr.pickthall: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
tr.yusufali: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!
tr.khattab: and those who recite the Reminder

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, your God is One,
tr.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;
tr.yusufali: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-
tr.khattab: Surely your God is One

ayahs.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ

tr.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
tr.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.
tr.yusufali: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!
tr.khattab: ˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, and the Lord of all points of sunrise

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;
tr.yusufali: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars for decoration

ayahs.ar: وَحِفْظًۭا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّارِدٍۢ

tr.sahih: And as protection against every rebellious devil
tr.pickthall: With security from every froward devil.
tr.yusufali: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,
tr.khattab: and ˹for˺ protection from every rebellious devil

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ

tr.sahih: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
tr.pickthall: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
tr.yusufali: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
tr.khattab: They cannot listen to the highest assembly ˹of angels˺ for they are pelted from every side

ayahs.ar: دُحُورًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ وَاصِبٌ

tr.sahih: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
tr.pickthall: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
tr.yusufali: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,
tr.khattab: ˹fiercely˺ driven away. And they will suffer an everlasting torment

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ

tr.sahih: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
tr.pickthall: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
tr.yusufali: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.
tr.khattab: But whoever manages to stealthily eavesdrop is ˹instantly˺ pursued by a piercing flare

ayahs.ar: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ

tr.sahih: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
tr.pickthall: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.
tr.yusufali: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!
tr.khattab: So ask them ˹O Prophet˺, which is harder to create: them or other marvels of Our creation? Indeed, We created them from a sticky clay

ayahs.ar: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ

tr.sahih: But you wonder, while they mock,
tr.pickthall: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
tr.yusufali: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,
tr.khattab: In fact, you are astonished ˹by their denial˺, while they ridicule ˹you˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ

tr.sahih: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
tr.pickthall: And heed not when they are reminded,
tr.yusufali: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-
tr.khattab: When they are reminded, they are never mindful

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
tr.pickthall: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.
tr.yusufali: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,
tr.khattab: And whenever they see a sign, they make fun of it

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
tr.pickthall: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
tr.yusufali: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!
tr.khattab: saying, “This is nothing but pure magic

ayahs.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

tr.sahih: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
tr.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?
tr.yusufali: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)
tr.khattab: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected

ayahs.ar: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

tr.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
tr.pickthall: And our forefathers?
tr.yusufali: "And also our fathers of old?"
tr.khattab: And our forefathers as well?”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
tr.yusufali: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."
tr.khattab: Say, “Yes! And you will be fully humbled.”

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

tr.sahih: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
tr.pickthall: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,
tr.yusufali: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!
tr.khattab: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will see ˹it all˺

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
tr.pickthall: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
tr.yusufali: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"
tr.khattab: They will cry, “Oh, woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

tr.sahih: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
tr.pickthall: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
tr.yusufali: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"
tr.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision which you used to deny.”

ayahs.ar: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ

tr.sahih: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
tr.pickthall: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship
tr.yusufali: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-
tr.khattab: ˹Allah will say to the angels,˺ “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers, and whatever they used to worship

ayahs.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
tr.pickthall: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
tr.yusufali: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!
tr.khattab: instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell

ayahs.ar: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ

tr.sahih: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
tr.pickthall: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
tr.yusufali: "But stop them, for they must be asked:
tr.khattab: And detain them, for they must be questioned.”

ayahs.ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ

tr.sahih: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
tr.pickthall: What aileth you that ye help not one another?
tr.yusufali: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"
tr.khattab: ˹Then they will be asked,˺ “What is the matter with you that you can no longer help each other?”

ayahs.ar: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ

tr.sahih: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but this day they make full submission.
tr.yusufali: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);
tr.khattab: In fact, on that Day they will be ˹fully˺ submissive

ayahs.ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
tr.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
tr.yusufali: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
tr.khattab: They will turn on each other, throwing blame

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
tr.pickthall: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
tr.yusufali: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"
tr.khattab: The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
tr.pickthall: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
tr.yusufali: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!
tr.khattab: The misleaders will reply, “No! You disbelieved on your own

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ

tr.sahih: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
tr.pickthall: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.
tr.yusufali: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
tr.khattab: We had no authority over you. In fact, you yourselves were a transgressing people

ayahs.ar: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ

tr.sahih: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
tr.pickthall: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).
tr.yusufali: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).
tr.khattab: The decree of our Lord has come to pass against us ˹all˺: we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺

ayahs.ar: فَأَغْوَيْنَٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ

tr.sahih: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
tr.pickthall: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
tr.yusufali: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."
tr.khattab: We caused you to deviate, for we ourselves were deviant.”

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

tr.sahih: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
tr.pickthall: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
tr.yusufali: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
tr.khattab: Surely on that Day they will ˹all˺ share in the punishment

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
tr.yusufali: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
tr.khattab: That is certainly how We deal with the wicked

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
tr.pickthall: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful
tr.yusufali: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,
tr.khattab: For whenever it was said to them ˹in the world˺, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah,” they acted arrogantly

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ

tr.sahih: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
tr.pickthall: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
tr.yusufali: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
tr.khattab: and argued, “Should we really abandon our gods for a mad poet?”

ayahs.ar: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
tr.yusufali: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).
tr.khattab: In fact, he came with the truth, confirming ˹earlier˺ messengers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
tr.pickthall: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -
tr.yusufali: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-
tr.khattab: You will certainly taste the painful torment

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
tr.pickthall: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -
tr.yusufali: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-
tr.khattab: and will only be rewarded for what you used to do

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

tr.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
tr.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;
tr.yusufali: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-
tr.khattab: But not the chosen servants of Allah

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

tr.sahih: Those will have a provision determined -
tr.pickthall: For them there is a known provision,
tr.yusufali: For them is a Sustenance determined,
tr.khattab: They will have a known provision

ayahs.ar: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Fruits; and they will be honored
tr.pickthall: Fruits. And they will be honoured
tr.yusufali: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,
tr.khattab: fruits ˹of every type˺. And they will be honoured

ayahs.ar: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

tr.sahih: In gardens of pleasure
tr.pickthall: In the Gardens of delight,
tr.yusufali: In Gardens of Felicity,
tr.khattab: in the Gardens of Bliss

ayahs.ar: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

tr.sahih: On thrones facing one another.
tr.pickthall: On couches facing one another;
tr.yusufali: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):
tr.khattab: facing each other on thrones

ayahs.ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ

tr.sahih: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
tr.pickthall: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
tr.yusufali: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,
tr.khattab: A drink ˹of pure wine˺ will be passed around to them from a flowing stream

ayahs.ar: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ

tr.sahih: White and delicious to the drinkers;
tr.pickthall: White, delicious to the drinkers,
tr.yusufali: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),
tr.khattab: crystal-white, delicious to drink

ayahs.ar: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

tr.sahih: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
tr.pickthall: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.
tr.yusufali: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
tr.khattab: It will neither harm ˹them˺, nor will they be intoxicated by it

ayahs.ar: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
tr.pickthall: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,
tr.yusufali: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).
tr.khattab: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and gorgeous eyes

ayahs.ar: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ

tr.sahih: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
tr.pickthall: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).
tr.yusufali: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.
tr.khattab: as if they were pristine pearls

ayahs.ar: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
tr.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
tr.yusufali: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.
tr.khattab: Then they will turn to one another inquisitively

ayahs.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
tr.pickthall: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
tr.yusufali: One of them will start the talk and say: "I had an intimate companion (on the earth),
tr.khattab: One of them will say, “I once had a companion ˹in the world˺

ayahs.ar: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ

tr.sahih: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
tr.pickthall: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?
tr.yusufali: "Who used to say, 'what! art thou amongst those who bear witness to the Truth (of the Message)?
tr.khattab: who used to ask ˹me˺, ‘Do you actually believe ˹in resurrection˺

ayahs.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

tr.sahih: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
tr.pickthall: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?
tr.yusufali: "'When we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed receive rewards and punishments?'"
tr.khattab: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be brought to judgment?’”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ

tr.sahih: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
tr.pickthall: He saith: Will ye look?
tr.yusufali: (A voice) said: "Would ye like to look down?"
tr.khattab: He will ˹then˺ ask, “Would you care to see ˹his fate˺?”

ayahs.ar: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
tr.yusufali: He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
tr.khattab: Then he ˹and the others˺ will look and spot him in the midst of the Hellfire

ayahs.ar: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ

tr.sahih: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.
tr.pickthall: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,
tr.yusufali: He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!
tr.khattab: He will ˹then˺ say, “By Allah! You nearly ruined me

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ

tr.sahih: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
tr.pickthall: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).
tr.yusufali: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been among those brought (there)!
tr.khattab: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I ˹too˺ would have certainly been among those brought ˹to Hell˺.”

ayahs.ar: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ

tr.sahih: Then, are we not to die
tr.pickthall: Are we then not to die
tr.yusufali: "Is it (the case) that we shall not die,
tr.khattab: ˹Then he will ask his fellow believers,˺ “Can you imagine that we will never die

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

tr.sahih: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
tr.pickthall: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?
tr.yusufali: "Except our first death, and that we shall not be punished?"
tr.khattab: except our first death, nor be punished ˹like the others˺?”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
tr.pickthall: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.
tr.yusufali: Verily this is the supreme achievement!
tr.khattab: This is truly the ultimate triumph

ayahs.ar: لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَٰمِلُونَ

tr.sahih: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
tr.pickthall: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.
tr.yusufali: For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.
tr.khattab: For such ˹honour˺ all should strive

ayahs.ar: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

tr.sahih: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
tr.pickthall: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?
tr.yusufali: Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?
tr.khattab: Is this ˹bliss˺ a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqûm

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.
tr.yusufali: For We have truly made it (as) a trial for the wrong-doers.
tr.khattab: We have surely made it a test for the wrongdoers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.
tr.yusufali: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-Fire:
tr.khattab: Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell

ayahs.ar: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ

tr.sahih: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
tr.pickthall: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils
tr.yusufali: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of devils:
tr.khattab: bearing fruit like devils’ heads

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
tr.pickthall: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.
tr.yusufali: Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
tr.khattab: The evildoers will certainly ˹be left to˺ eat from it, filling up their bellies with it

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
tr.pickthall: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
tr.yusufali: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture made of boiling water.
tr.khattab: Then on top of that they will be given a blend of boiling drink

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.
tr.yusufali: Then shall their return be to the (Blazing) Fire.
tr.khattab: Then they will ultimately return to ˹their place in˺ Hell

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
tr.pickthall: They indeed found their fathers astray,
tr.yusufali: Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;
tr.khattab: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray

ayahs.ar: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ

tr.sahih: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
tr.pickthall: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.
tr.yusufali: So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!
tr.khattab: so they rushed in their footsteps

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
tr.pickthall: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,
tr.yusufali: And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-
tr.khattab: And surely most of the earlier generations had strayed before them

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And We had already sent among them warners.
tr.pickthall: And verily We sent among them warners.
tr.yusufali: But We sent aforetime, among them, (messengers) to admonish them;-
tr.khattab: although We had certainly sent warners among them

ayahs.ar: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

tr.sahih: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
tr.pickthall: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,
tr.yusufali: Then see what was the end of those who were admonished (but heeded not),-
tr.khattab: See then what was the end of those who had been warned

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

tr.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
tr.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
tr.yusufali: Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah.
tr.khattab: But not the chosen servants of Allah

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌۭ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ

tr.sahih: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
tr.pickthall: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
tr.yusufali: (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, and We are the best to hear prayer.
tr.khattab: Indeed, Noah cried out to Us, and how excellent are We in responding

ayahs.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
tr.pickthall: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,
tr.yusufali: And We delivered him and his people from the Great Calamity,
tr.khattab: We delivered him and his family from the great distress

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ

tr.sahih: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
tr.pickthall: And made his seed the survivors,
tr.yusufali: And made his progeny to endure (on this earth);
tr.khattab: and made his descendants the sole survivors

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
tr.pickthall: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
tr.yusufali: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations to come in later times:
tr.khattab: And We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

ayahs.ar: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
tr.pickthall: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!
tr.yusufali: "Peace and salutation to Noah among the nations!"
tr.khattab: “Peace be upon Noah among all peoples.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
tr.yusufali: Thus indeed do we reward those who do right.
tr.khattab: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
tr.pickthall: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
tr.yusufali: For he was one of our believing Servants.
tr.khattab: ˹For˺ he was truly one of Our faithful servants

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ

tr.sahih: Then We drowned the disbelievers.
tr.pickthall: Then We did drown the others.
tr.yusufali: Then the rest we overwhelmed in the Flood.
tr.khattab: Then We drowned the others

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
tr.pickthall: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
tr.yusufali: Verily among those who followed his Way was Abraham.
tr.khattab: And indeed, one of those who followed his way was Abraham

ayahs.ar: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍ

tr.sahih: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
tr.pickthall: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;
tr.yusufali: Behold! he approached his Lord with a sound heart.
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when he came to his Lord with a pure heart

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ

tr.sahih: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
tr.pickthall: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?
tr.yusufali: Behold! he said to his father and to his people, "What is that which ye worship?
tr.khattab: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshipping

ayahs.ar: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةًۭ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ

tr.sahih: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
tr.pickthall: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?
tr.yusufali: "Is it a falsehood- gods other than Allah- that ye desire?
tr.khattab: Is it false gods that you desire instead of Allah

ayahs.ar: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
tr.pickthall: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?
tr.yusufali: "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"
tr.khattab: What then do you expect from the Lord of all worlds?”

ayahs.ar: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةًۭ فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ

tr.sahih: And he cast a look at the stars
tr.pickthall: And he glanced a glance at the stars
tr.yusufali: Then did he cast a glance at the Stars.
tr.khattab: He later looked up to the stars ˹in contemplation˺

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
tr.pickthall: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
tr.yusufali: And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"
tr.khattab: then said, “I am really sick.”

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ

tr.sahih: So they turned away from him, departing.
tr.pickthall: And they turned their backs and went away from him.
tr.yusufali: So they turned away from him, and departed.
tr.khattab: So they turned their backs on him and went away

ayahs.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

tr.sahih: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
tr.pickthall: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?
tr.yusufali: Then did he turn to their gods and said, "will ye not eat (of the offerings before you)?...
tr.khattab: Then he ˹stealthily˺ advanced towards their gods, and said ˹mockingly˺, “Will you not eat ˹your offerings˺

ayahs.ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ

tr.sahih: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
tr.pickthall: What aileth you that ye speak not?
tr.yusufali: "What is the matter with you that ye speak not (intelligently)?"
tr.khattab: What is wrong with you that you cannot speak?”

ayahs.ar: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
tr.pickthall: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.
tr.yusufali: Then did he turn upon them, striking (them) with the right hand.
tr.khattab: Then he swiftly turned on them, striking ˹them˺ with his right hand

ayahs.ar: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ

tr.sahih: Then the people came toward him, hastening.
tr.pickthall: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
tr.yusufali: Then came (the worshippers) with hurried steps, and faced (him).
tr.khattab: Later, his people came rushing towards him ˹furiously˺

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
tr.pickthall: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
tr.yusufali: He said: "Worship ye that which ye have (yourselves) carved?
tr.khattab: He argued, “How can you worship what you carve ˹with your own hands˺

ayahs.ar: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: While Allah created you and that which you do?"
tr.pickthall: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?
tr.yusufali: "But Allah has created you and your handwork!"
tr.khattab: when it is Allah Who created you and whatever you do?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
tr.pickthall: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
tr.yusufali: They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"
tr.khattab: They said ˹to one another˺, “Build him a furnace and cast him into the blazing fire.”

ayahs.ar: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ

tr.sahih: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.
tr.pickthall: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.
tr.yusufali: (This failing), they then sought a stratagem against him, but We made them the ones most humiliated!
tr.khattab: And so they sought to harm him, but We made them inferior

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

tr.sahih: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
tr.pickthall: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.
tr.yusufali: He said: "I will go to my Lord! He will surely guide me!
tr.khattab: He later said, “I am leaving ˹in obedience˺ to my Lord. He will guide me

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

tr.sahih: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
tr.pickthall: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.
tr.yusufali: "O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!"
tr.khattab: My Lord! Bless me with righteous offspring.”

ayahs.ar: فَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
tr.pickthall: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.
tr.yusufali: So We gave him the good news of a boy ready to suffer and forbear.
tr.khattab: So We gave him good news of a forbearing son

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
tr.pickthall: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.
tr.yusufali: Then, when (the son) reached (the age of) (serious) work with him, he said: "O my son! I see in vision that I offer thee in sacrifice: Now see what is thy view!" (The son) said: "O my father! Do as thou art commanded: thou will find me, if Allah so wills one practising Patience and Constancy!"
tr.khattab: Then when the boy reached the age to work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son! I have seen in a dream that I ˹must˺ sacrifice you. So tell me what you think.” He replied, “O my dear father! Do as you are commanded. Allah willing, you will find me steadfast.”

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ

tr.sahih: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
tr.pickthall: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,
tr.yusufali: So when they had both submitted their wills (to Allah), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (for sacrifice),
tr.khattab: Then when they submitted ˹to Allah’s Will˺, and Abraham laid him on the side of his forehead ˹for sacrifice˺

ayahs.ar: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ

tr.sahih: We called to him, "O Abraham,
tr.pickthall: We called unto him: O Abraham!
tr.yusufali: We called out to him "O Abraham!
tr.khattab: We called out to him, “O Abraham

ayahs.ar: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

tr.sahih: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.
tr.yusufali: "Thou hast already fulfilled the vision!" - thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
tr.khattab: You have already fulfilled the vision.” Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
tr.pickthall: Lo! that verily was a clear test.
tr.yusufali: For this was obviously a trial-
tr.khattab: That was truly a revealing test

ayahs.ar: وَفَدَيْنَٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
tr.pickthall: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.
tr.yusufali: And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice:
tr.khattab: And We ransomed his son with a great sacrifice

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
tr.pickthall: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
tr.yusufali: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
tr.khattab: and blessed Abraham ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

ayahs.ar: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

tr.sahih: "Peace upon Abraham."
tr.pickthall: Peace be unto Abraham!
tr.yusufali: "Peace and salutation to Abraham!"
tr.khattab: “Peace be upon Abraham.”

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Thus do We reward the good.
tr.yusufali: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
tr.khattab: This is how We reward the good-doers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
tr.pickthall: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
tr.yusufali: For he was one of our believing Servants.
tr.khattab: He was truly one of Our faithful servants

ayahs.ar: وَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِإِسْحَٰقَ نَبِيًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

tr.sahih: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
tr.pickthall: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.
tr.yusufali: And We gave him the good news of Isaac - a prophet,- one of the Righteous.
tr.khattab: We ˹later˺ gave him good news of Isaac—a prophet, and one of the righteous

ayahs.ar: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
tr.pickthall: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.
tr.yusufali: We blessed him and Isaac: but of their progeny are (some) that do right, and (some) that obviously do wrong, to their own souls.
tr.khattab: We blessed him and Isaac as well. Some of their descendants did good, while others clearly wronged themselves

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ

tr.sahih: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
tr.pickthall: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron,
tr.yusufali: Again (of old) We bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron,
tr.khattab: And We certainly showed favour to Moses and Aaron

ayahs.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
tr.pickthall: And saved them and their people from the great distress,
tr.yusufali: And We delivered them and their people from (their) Great Calamity;
tr.khattab: and delivered them and their people from the great distress

ayahs.ar: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ

tr.sahih: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
tr.pickthall: And helped them so that they became the victors.
tr.yusufali: And We helped them, so they overcame (their troubles);
tr.khattab: We helped them so it was they who prevailed

ayahs.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ

tr.sahih: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
tr.pickthall: And We gave them the clear Scripture
tr.yusufali: And We gave them the Book which helps to make things clear;
tr.khattab: We gave them the clear Scripture

ayahs.ar: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ

tr.sahih: And We guided them on the straight path.
tr.pickthall: And showed them the right path.
tr.yusufali: And We guided them to the Straight Way.
tr.khattab: and guided them to the Straight Path

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
tr.pickthall: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):
tr.yusufali: And We left (this blessing) for them among generations (to come) in later times:
tr.khattab: And We blessed them ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

ayahs.ar: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ

tr.sahih: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
tr.pickthall: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!
tr.yusufali: "Peace and salutation to Moses and Aaron!"
tr.khattab: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
tr.yusufali: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
tr.khattab: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
tr.pickthall: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.
tr.yusufali: For they were two of our believing Servants.
tr.khattab: They were truly ˹two˺ of Our faithful servants

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
tr.pickthall: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),
tr.yusufali: So also was Elias among those sent (by Us).
tr.khattab: And Elias was indeed one of the messengers

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?
tr.pickthall: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.yusufali: Behold, he said to his people, "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his people, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

ayahs.ar: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًۭا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
tr.pickthall: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,
tr.yusufali: "Will ye call upon Baal and forsake the Best of Creators,-
tr.khattab: Do you call upon ˹the idol of˺ Ba’l and abandon the Best of Creators—

ayahs.ar: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
tr.pickthall: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?
tr.yusufali: "Allah, your Lord and Cherisher and the Lord and Cherisher of your fathers of old?"
tr.khattab: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

tr.sahih: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
tr.pickthall: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)
tr.yusufali: But they rejected him, and they will certainly be called up (for punishment),-
tr.khattab: But they rejected him, so they will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

tr.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
tr.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
tr.yusufali: Except the sincere and devoted Servants of Allah (among them).
tr.khattab: But not the chosen servants of Allah

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
tr.pickthall: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
tr.yusufali: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
tr.khattab: We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

ayahs.ar: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ

tr.sahih: "Peace upon Elias."
tr.pickthall: Peace be unto Elias!
tr.yusufali: "Peace and salutation to such as Elias!"
tr.khattab: “Peace be upon Elias.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
tr.yusufali: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
tr.khattab: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
tr.pickthall: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.
tr.yusufali: For he was one of our believing Servants.
tr.khattab: He was truly one of Our faithful servants

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لُوطًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
tr.pickthall: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).
tr.yusufali: So also was Lut among those sent (by Us).
tr.khattab: And Lot was indeed one of the messengers

ayahs.ar: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
tr.pickthall: When We saved him and his household, every one,
tr.yusufali: Behold, We delivered him and his adherents, all
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when We delivered him and all of his family

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
tr.pickthall: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;
tr.yusufali: Except an old woman who was among those who lagged behind:
tr.khattab: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ

tr.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.
tr.pickthall: Then We destroyed the others.
tr.yusufali: Then We destroyed the rest.
tr.khattab: Then We ˹utterly˺ destroyed the rest

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
tr.pickthall: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning
tr.yusufali: Verily, ye pass by their (sites), by day-
tr.khattab: You ˹Meccans˺ certainly pass by their ruins day

ayahs.ar: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
tr.pickthall: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?
tr.yusufali: And by night: will ye not understand?
tr.khattab: and night. Will you not then understand

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
tr.pickthall: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)
tr.yusufali: So also was Jonah among those sent (by Us).
tr.khattab: And Jonah was indeed one of the messengers

ayahs.ar: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

tr.sahih: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
tr.pickthall: When he fled unto the laden ship,
tr.yusufali: When he ran away (like a slave from captivity) to the ship (fully) laden,
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when he fled to the overloaded ship

ayahs.ar: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ

tr.sahih: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
tr.pickthall: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;
tr.yusufali: He (agreed to) cast lots, and he was condemned:
tr.khattab: Then ˹to save it from sinking,˺ he drew straws ˹with other passengers˺. He lost ˹and was thrown overboard˺

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
tr.pickthall: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;
tr.yusufali: Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.
tr.khattab: Then the whale engulfed him while he was blameworthy

ayahs.ar: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ

tr.sahih: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,
tr.pickthall: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)
tr.yusufali: Had it not been that he (repented and) glorified Allah,
tr.khattab: Had he not ˹constantly˺ glorified ˹Allah˺

ayahs.ar: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

tr.sahih: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
tr.pickthall: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;
tr.yusufali: He would certainly have remained inside the Fish till the Day of Resurrection.
tr.khattab: he would have certainly remained in its belly until the Day of Resurrection

ayahs.ar: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
tr.pickthall: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;
tr.yusufali: But We cast him forth on the naked shore in a state of sickness,
tr.khattab: But We cast him onto the open ˹shore˺, ˹totally˺ worn out

ayahs.ar: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةًۭ مِّن يَقْطِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
tr.pickthall: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;
tr.yusufali: And We caused to grow, over him, a spreading plant of the gourd kind.
tr.khattab: and caused a squash plant to grow over him

ayahs.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ

tr.sahih: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
tr.pickthall: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more
tr.yusufali: And We sent him (on a mission) to a hundred thousand (men) or more.
tr.khattab: We ˹later˺ sent him ˹back˺ to ˹his city of˺ at least one hundred thousand people

ayahs.ar: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
tr.pickthall: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.
tr.yusufali: And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.
tr.khattab: who then believed ˹in him˺, so We allowed them enjoyment for a while

ayahs.ar: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ

tr.sahih: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
tr.pickthall: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?
tr.yusufali: Now ask them their opinion: Is it that thy Lord has (only) daughters, and they have sons?-
tr.khattab: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ if your Lord has daughters, while the pagans ˹prefer to˺ have sons

ayahs.ar: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ

tr.sahih: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
tr.pickthall: Or created We the angels females while they were present?
tr.yusufali: Or that We created the angels female, and they are witnesses (thereto)?
tr.khattab: Or ˹ask them˺ if We created the angels as females right before their eyes

ayahs.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ

tr.sahih: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:
tr.yusufali: Is it not that they say, from their own invention,
tr.khattab: Indeed, it is one of their ˹outrageous˺ fabrications to say

ayahs.ar: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

tr.sahih: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
tr.pickthall: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.
tr.yusufali: "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!
tr.khattab: “Allah has children.” They are simply liars

ayahs.ar: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ

tr.sahih: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
tr.pickthall: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.
tr.yusufali: Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?
tr.khattab: Has He chosen daughters over sons

ayahs.ar: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

tr.sahih: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
tr.pickthall: What aileth you? How judge ye?
tr.yusufali: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
tr.khattab: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: Then will you not be reminded?
tr.pickthall: Will ye not then reflect?
tr.yusufali: Will ye not then receive admonition?
tr.khattab: Will you not then be mindful

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَٰنٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: Or do you have a clear authority?
tr.pickthall: Or have ye a clear warrant?
tr.yusufali: Or have ye an authority manifest?
tr.khattab: Or do you have ˹any˺ compelling proof

ayahs.ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
tr.pickthall: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.
tr.yusufali: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!
tr.khattab: Then bring ˹us˺ your scripture, if what you say is true

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

tr.sahih: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
tr.pickthall: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).
tr.yusufali: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!
tr.khattab: They have also established a ˹marital˺ relationship between Him and the jinn. Yet the jinn ˹themselves˺ know well that such people will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺

ayahs.ar: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

tr.sahih: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
tr.pickthall: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),
tr.yusufali: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!
tr.khattab: Glorified is Allah far above what they claim

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

tr.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
tr.pickthall: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
tr.yusufali: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.
tr.khattab: But not the chosen servants of Allah

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ

tr.sahih: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
tr.pickthall: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,
tr.yusufali: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-
tr.khattab: Surely you ˹pagans˺ and whatever ˹idols˺ you worship

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ

tr.sahih: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
tr.pickthall: Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.
tr.yusufali: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,
tr.khattab: can never lure ˹anyone˺ away from Him

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: Save him who is to burn in hell.
tr.yusufali: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!
tr.khattab: except those ˹destined˺ to burn in Hell

ayahs.ar: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

tr.sahih: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
tr.pickthall: There is not one of us but hath his known position.
tr.yusufali: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;
tr.khattab: ˹The angels respond,˺ “There is not one of us without an assigned station ˹of worship˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
tr.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,
tr.yusufali: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);
tr.khattab: We are indeed the ones lined up in ranks ˹for Allah˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
tr.pickthall: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
tr.yusufali: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"
tr.khattab: And we are indeed the ones ˹constantly˺ glorifying ˹His praise˺.”

ayahs.ar: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
tr.pickthall: And indeed they used to say:
tr.yusufali: And there were those who said,
tr.khattab: They certainly used to say

ayahs.ar: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
tr.pickthall: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
tr.yusufali: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,
tr.khattab: “If only we had a Reminder like ˹those of˺ earlier peoples

ayahs.ar: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

tr.sahih: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
tr.pickthall: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.
tr.yusufali: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"
tr.khattab: we would have truly been Allah’s devoted servants.”

ayahs.ar: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
tr.pickthall: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.
