tr.yusufali: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!
tr.khattab: But ˹now˺ they reject it, so they will soon know

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
tr.pickthall: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
tr.yusufali: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),
tr.khattab: Our Word has already gone forth to Our servants, the messengers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ

tr.sahih: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
tr.pickthall: That they verily would be helped,
tr.yusufali: That they would certainly be assisted,
tr.khattab: that they would surely be helped

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ

tr.sahih: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
tr.pickthall: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.
tr.yusufali: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.
tr.khattab: and that Our forces will certainly prevail

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
tr.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,
tr.yusufali: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
tr.khattab: So turn away from the deniers for a while ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.ar: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
tr.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
tr.yusufali: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
tr.khattab: You will see ˹what will happen to˺ them, and they too will see

ayahs.ar: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

tr.sahih: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
tr.pickthall: Would they hasten on Our doom?
tr.yusufali: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?
tr.khattab: Do they ˹really˺ wish to hasten Our punishment

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

tr.sahih: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
tr.pickthall: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.
tr.yusufali: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!
tr.khattab: Yet when it descends upon them: how evil will that morning be for those who had been warned

ayahs.ar: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And leave them for a time.
tr.pickthall: Withdraw from them awhile
tr.yusufali: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
tr.khattab: And turn away from them for a while

ayahs.ar: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And see, for they are going to see.
tr.pickthall: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
tr.yusufali: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
tr.khattab: You will see, and they too will see

ayahs.ar: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

tr.sahih: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
tr.pickthall: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
tr.yusufali: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!
tr.khattab: Glorified is your Lord—the Lord of Honour and Power—above what they claim

ayahs.ar: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

tr.sahih: And peace upon the messengers.
tr.pickthall: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
tr.yusufali: And Peace on the messengers!
tr.khattab: Peace be upon the messengers

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
tr.yusufali: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.
tr.khattab: And praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ

tr.sahih: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
tr.pickthall: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,
tr.yusufali: Sad: By the Qur'an, Full of Admonition: (This is the Truth).
tr.khattab: Ṣãd. By the Quran, full of reminders

ayahs.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ

tr.sahih: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.
tr.yusufali: But the Unbelievers (are steeped) in self-glory and Separatism.
tr.khattab: ˹This is the truth,˺ yet the disbelievers are ˹entrenched˺ in arrogance and opposition

ayahs.ar: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ

tr.sahih: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
tr.pickthall: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!
tr.yusufali: How many generations before them did We destroy? In the end they cried (for mercy)- when there was no longer time for being saved!
tr.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late to escape

ayahs.ar: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ

tr.sahih: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
tr.pickthall: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.
tr.yusufali: So they wonder that a Warner has come to them from among themselves! and the Unbelievers say, "This is a sorcerer telling lies!
tr.khattab: Now, the pagans are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a total liar

ayahs.ar: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ

tr.sahih: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
tr.pickthall: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.
tr.yusufali: "Has he made the gods (all) into one Allah? Truly this is a wonderful thing!"
tr.khattab: Has he reduced ˹all˺ the gods to One God? Indeed, this is something totally astonishing.”

ayahs.ar: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ

tr.sahih: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
tr.pickthall: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.
tr.yusufali: And the leader among them go away (impatiently), (saying), "Walk ye away, and remain constant to your gods! For this is truly a thing designed (against you)!
tr.khattab: The chiefs among them went forth saying, “Carry on, and stand firm in devotion to your gods. Certainly this is just a scheme ˹for power˺

ayahs.ar: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ

tr.sahih: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
tr.pickthall: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.
tr.yusufali: "We never heard (the like) of this among the people of these latter days: this is nothing but a made-up tale!"
tr.khattab: We have never heard of this in the previous faith. This is nothing but a fabrication

ayahs.ar: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ

tr.sahih: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
tr.pickthall: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.
tr.yusufali: "What! has the Message been sent to him - (Of all persons) among us?"... but they are in doubt concerning My (Own) Message! Nay, they have not yet tasted My Punishment!
tr.khattab: Has the Reminder been revealed ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us?” In fact, they are ˹only˺ in doubt of My ˹revealed˺ Reminder. In fact, ˹they do so because˺ they have not yet tasted My punishment

ayahs.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ

tr.sahih: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
tr.pickthall: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?
tr.yusufali: Or have they the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord,- the Exalted in Power, the Grantor of Bounties without measure?
tr.khattab: Or ˹is it because˺ they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Almighty, the Giver ˹of all bounties˺

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ

tr.sahih: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
tr.pickthall: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!
tr.yusufali: Or have they the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all between? If so, let them mount up with the ropes and means (to reach that end)!
tr.khattab: Or ˹is it because˺ the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between belongs to them? Let them then climb their way ˹to heaven, if their claim is true˺

ayahs.ar: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ

tr.sahih: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
tr.pickthall: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.
tr.yusufali: But there - will be put to flight even a host of confederates.
tr.khattab: This is just another ˹enemy˺ force bound for defeat out there

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ

tr.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
tr.pickthall: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,
tr.yusufali: Before them (were many who) rejected messengers,- the people of Noah, and 'Ad, and Pharaoh, the Lord of Stakes,
tr.khattab: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ’Âd, Pharaoh of the mighty structures

ayahs.ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ

tr.sahih: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
tr.pickthall: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.
tr.yusufali: And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Companions of the Wood; - such were the Confederates.
tr.khattab: Thamûd, the people of Lot, and the residents of the Forest. These were ˹all˺ enemy forces

ayahs.ar: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ

tr.sahih: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
tr.pickthall: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,
tr.yusufali: Not one (of them) but rejected the messengers, but My punishment came justly and inevitably (on them).
tr.khattab: Each rejected their messenger, so My punishment was justified

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ

tr.sahih: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
tr.pickthall: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.
tr.yusufali: These (today) only wait for a single mighty Blast, which (when it comes) will brook no delay.
tr.khattab: These ˹pagans˺ are awaiting nothing but a single Blast that cannot be stopped

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

tr.sahih: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
tr.pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.
tr.yusufali: They say: "Our Lord! hasten to us our sentence (even) before the Day of Account!"
tr.khattab: They say ˹mockingly˺, “Our Lord! Hasten for us our share ˹of the punishment˺ before the Day of Reckoning.”

ayahs.ar: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

tr.sahih: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].
tr.pickthall: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
tr.yusufali: Have patience at what they say, and remember our servant David, the man of strength: for he ever turned (to Allah).
tr.khattab: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And remember Our servant, David, the man of strength. Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,
tr.yusufali: It was We that made the hills declare, in unison with him, Our Praises, at eventide and at break of day,
tr.khattab: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise

ayahs.ar: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ

tr.sahih: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
tr.pickthall: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.
tr.yusufali: And the birds gathered (in assemblies): all with him did turn (to Allah).
tr.khattab: And ˹We subjected˺ the birds, flocking together. All turned to him ˹echoing his hymns˺

ayahs.ar: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ

tr.sahih: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
tr.pickthall: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
tr.yusufali: We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment in speech and decision.
tr.khattab: We strengthened his kingship, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ

tr.sahih: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
tr.pickthall: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber;
tr.yusufali: Has the Story of the Disputants reached thee? Behold, they climbed over the wall of the private chamber;
tr.khattab: Has the story of the two plaintiffs, who scaled the ˹wall of David’s˺ sanctuary, reached you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ

tr.sahih: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
tr.pickthall: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.
tr.yusufali: When they entered the presence of David, and he was terrified of them, they said: "Fear not: we are two disputants, one of whom has wronged the other: Decide now between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, but guide us to the even Path..
tr.khattab: When they came into David’s presence, he was startled by them. They said, “Have no fear. ˹We are merely˺ two in a dispute: one of us has wronged the other. So judge between us with truth—do not go beyond ˹it˺—and guide us to the right way

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ

tr.sahih: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
tr.pickthall: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.
tr.yusufali: "This man is my brother: He has nine and ninety ewes, and I have (but) one: Yet he says, 'commit her to my care,' and is (moreover) harsh to me in speech."
tr.khattab: This is my brother. He has ninety-nine sheep while I have ˹only˺ one. ˹Still˺ he asked me to give it up to him, overwhelming me with ˹his˺ argument.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩

tr.sahih: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].
tr.pickthall: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.
tr.yusufali: (David) said: "He has undoubtedly wronged thee in demanding thy (single) ewe to be added to his (flock of) ewes: truly many are the partners (in business) who wrong each other: Not so do those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, and how few are they?"... and David gathered that We had tried him: he asked forgiveness of his Lord, fell down, bowing (in prostration), and turned (to Allah in repentance).
tr.khattab: David ˹eventually˺ ruled, “He has definitely wronged you in demanding ˹to add˺ your sheep to his. And certainly many partners wrong each other, except those who believe and do good—but how few are they!” Then David realized that We had tested him so he asked for his Lord’s forgiveness, fell down in prostration, and turned ˹to Him in repentance˺

ayahs.ar: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ

tr.sahih: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
tr.pickthall: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end.
tr.yusufali: So We forgave him this (lapse): he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful place of (Final) Return.
tr.khattab: So We forgave that for him. And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination

ayahs.ar: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ

tr.sahih: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
tr.pickthall: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning.
tr.yusufali: O David! We did indeed make thee a vicegerent on earth: so judge thou between men in truth (and justice): Nor follow thou the lusts (of thy heart), for they will mislead thee from the Path of Allah: for those who wander astray from the Path of Allah, is a Penalty Grievous, for that they forget the Day of Account.
tr.khattab: ˹We instructed him:˺ “O David! We have surely made you an authority in the land, so judge between people with truth. And do not follow ˹your˺ desires or they will lead you astray from Allah’s Way. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s Way will suffer a severe punishment for neglecting the Day of Reckoning.”

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
tr.pickthall: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire!
tr.yusufali: Not without purpose did We create heaven and earth and all between! that were the thought of Unbelievers! but woe to the Unbelievers because of the Fire (of Hell)!
tr.khattab: We have not created the heavens and earth and everything in between without purpose—as the disbelievers think. So woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire

ayahs.ar: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ

tr.sahih: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
tr.pickthall: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked?
tr.yusufali: Shall We treat those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, the same as those who do mischief on earth? Shall We treat those who guard against evil, the same as those who turn aside from the right?
tr.khattab: Or should We treat those who believe and do good like those who make mischief throughout the land? Or should We treat the righteous like the wicked

ayahs.ar: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

tr.sahih: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
tr.pickthall: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.
tr.yusufali: (Here is) a Book which We have sent down unto thee, full of blessings, that they may mediate on its Signs, and that men of understanding may receive admonition.
tr.khattab: ˹This is˺ a blessed Book which We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ so that they may contemplate its verses, and people of reason may be mindful

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

tr.sahih: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
tr.pickthall: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
tr.yusufali: To David We gave Solomon (for a son),- How excellent in Our service! Ever did he turn (to Us)!
tr.khattab: And We blessed David with Solomon—what an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ

tr.sahih: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
tr.pickthall: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers
tr.yusufali: Behold, there were brought before him, at eventide coursers of the highest breeding, and swift of foot;
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when the well-trained, swift horses were paraded before him in the evening

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ

tr.sahih: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
tr.pickthall: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.
tr.yusufali: And he said, "Truly do I love the love of good, with a view to the glory of my Lord,"- until (the sun) was hidden in the veil (of night):
tr.khattab: He then proclaimed, “I am truly in love with ˹these˺ fine things out of remembrance for Allah,” until they went out of sight

ayahs.ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ

tr.sahih: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
tr.pickthall: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.
tr.yusufali: "Bring them back to me." then began he to pass his hand over (their) legs and their necks.
tr.khattab: ˹He ordered,˺ “Bring them back to me!” Then he began to rub down their legs and necks

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ

tr.sahih: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
tr.pickthall: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent.
tr.yusufali: And We did try Solomon: We placed on his throne a body (without life); but he did turn (to Us in true devotion):
tr.khattab: And indeed, We tested Solomon, placing a ˹deformed˺ body on his throne, then he turned ˹to Allah in repentance˺

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.
tr.yusufali: He said, "O my Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom which, (it may be), suits not another after me: for Thou art the Grantor of Bounties (without measure).
tr.khattab: He prayed, “My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me an authority that will never be matched by anyone after me. You are indeed the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.”

ayahs.ar: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ

tr.sahih: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
tr.pickthall: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended.
tr.yusufali: Then We subjected the wind to his power, to flow gently to his order, Whithersoever he willed,-
tr.khattab: So We subjected to him the wind, blowing gently at his command to wherever he pleased

ayahs.ar: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ

tr.sahih: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
tr.pickthall: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient),
tr.yusufali: As also the evil ones, (including) every kind of builder and diver,-
tr.khattab: And ˹We subjected to him˺ every builder and diver of the jinn

ayahs.ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ

tr.sahih: And others bound together in shackles.
tr.pickthall: And others linked together in chains,
tr.yusufali: As also others bound together in fetters.
tr.khattab: and others bound together in chains

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

tr.sahih: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
tr.pickthall: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning.
tr.yusufali: "Such are Our Bounties: whether thou bestow them (on others) or withhold them, no account will be asked."
tr.khattab: ˹Allah said,˺ “This is Our gift, so give or withhold ˹as you wish˺, never to be called to account.”

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ

tr.sahih: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
tr.pickthall: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end.
tr.yusufali: And he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful Place of (Final) Return.
tr.khattab: And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ

tr.sahih: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
tr.pickthall: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment.
tr.yusufali: Commemorate Our Servant Job. Behold he cried to his Lord: "The Evil One has afflicted me with distress and suffering!"
tr.khattab: And remember Our servant Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with distress and suffering.”

ayahs.ar: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ

tr.sahih: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
tr.pickthall: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink.
tr.yusufali: (The command was given:) "Strike with thy foot: here is (water) wherein to wash, cool and refreshing, and (water) to drink."
tr.khattab: ˹We responded,˺ “Stomp your foot: ˹now˺ here is a cool ˹and refreshing˺ spring for washing and drinking.”

ayahs.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

tr.sahih: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
tr.pickthall: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding.
tr.yusufali: And We gave him (back) his people, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who have Understanding.
tr.khattab: And We gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for people of reason

ayahs.ar: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ

tr.sahih: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
tr.pickthall: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord).
tr.yusufali: "And take in thy hand a little grass, and strike therewith: and break not (thy oath)." Truly We found him full of patience and constancy. How excellent in Our service! ever did he turn (to Us)!
tr.khattab: ˹And We said to him,˺ “Take in your hand a bundle of grass, and strike ˹your wife˺ with it, and do not break your oath.” We truly found him patient. What an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ

tr.sahih: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
tr.pickthall: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision.
tr.yusufali: And commemorate Our Servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, possessors of Power and Vision.
tr.khattab: And remember Our servants: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the men of strength and insight

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
tr.pickthall: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter).
tr.yusufali: Verily We did choose them for a special (purpose)- proclaiming the Message of the Hereafter.
tr.khattab: We truly chose them for the honour of proclaiming the Hereafter

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

tr.sahih: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
tr.pickthall: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent.
tr.yusufali: They were, in Our sight, truly, of the company of the Elect and the Good.
tr.khattab: And in Our sight they are truly among the chosen and the finest

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

tr.sahih: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
tr.pickthall: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen.
tr.yusufali: And commemorate Isma'il, Elisha, and Zul-Kifl: Each of them was of the Company of the Good.
tr.khattab: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Ⱬul-Kifl. All are among the best

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ

tr.sahih: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
tr.pickthall: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end,
tr.yusufali: This is a Message (of admonition): and verily, for the righteous, is a beautiful Place of (Final) Return,-
tr.khattab: This is ˹all˺ a reminder. And the righteous will certainly have an honourable destination

ayahs.ar: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ

tr.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
tr.pickthall: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them,
tr.yusufali: Gardens of Eternity, whose doors will (ever) be open to them;
tr.khattab: the Gardens of Eternity, whose gates will be open for them

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ

tr.sahih: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
tr.pickthall: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein.
tr.yusufali: Therein will they recline (at ease): Therein can they call (at pleasure) for fruit in abundance, and (delicious) drink;
tr.khattab: There they will recline, calling for abundant fruit and drink

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ

tr.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
tr.pickthall: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions.
tr.yusufali: And beside them will be chaste women restraining their glances, (companions) of equal age.
tr.khattab: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and equal age

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

tr.sahih: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
tr.pickthall: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning.
tr.yusufali: Such is the Promise made, to you for the Day of Account!
tr.khattab: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
tr.pickthall: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away.
tr.yusufali: Truly such will be Our Bounty (to you); it will never fail;-
tr.khattab: This is indeed Our provision that will never end

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ

tr.sahih: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
tr.pickthall: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end,
tr.yusufali: Yea, such! but - for the wrong-doers will be an evil place of (Final) Return!-
tr.khattab: That is that. And the transgressors will certainly have the worst destination

ayahs.ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ

tr.sahih: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
tr.pickthall: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place.
tr.yusufali: Hell!- they will burn therein, - an evil bed (indeed, to lie on)!-
tr.khattab: Hell, where they will burn. What an evil place to rest

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ

tr.sahih: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
tr.pickthall: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it,
tr.yusufali: Yea, such! - then shall they taste it,- a boiling fluid, and a fluid dark, murky, intensely cold!-
tr.khattab: Let them then taste this: boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus

ayahs.ar: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ

tr.sahih: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
tr.pickthall: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)!
tr.yusufali: And other Penalties of a similar kind, to match them!
tr.khattab: and other torments of the same sort

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
tr.pickthall: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire.
tr.yusufali: Here is a troop rushing headlong with you! No welcome for them! truly, they shall burn in the Fire!
tr.khattab: ˹The misleaders will say to one another,˺ “Here is a crowd ˹of followers˺ being thrown in with us. They are not welcome, ˹for˺ they ˹too˺ will burn in the Fire.”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ

tr.sahih: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
tr.pickthall: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight.
tr.yusufali: (The followers shall cry to the misleaders:) "Nay, ye (too)! No welcome for you! It is ye who have brought this upon us! Now evil is (this) place to stay in!"
tr.khattab: The followers will respond, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this upon us. What an evil place for settlement!”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
tr.pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire!
tr.yusufali: They will say: "Our Lord! whoever brought this upon us,- Add to him a double Penalty in the Fire!"
tr.khattab: Adding, “Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, double their punishment in the Fire.”

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ

tr.sahih: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
tr.pickthall: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?
tr.yusufali: And they will say: "What has happened to us that we see not men whom we used to number among the bad ones?
tr.khattab: The tyrants will ask ˹one another˺, “But why do we not see those we considered to be lowly

ayahs.ar: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ

tr.sahih: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
tr.pickthall: Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them?
tr.yusufali: "Did we treat them (as such) in ridicule, or have (our) eyes failed to perceive them?"
tr.khattab: Were we wrong in mocking them ˹in the world˺? Or do our eyes ˹just˺ fail to see them ˹in the Fire˺?”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
tr.pickthall: Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire.
tr.yusufali: Truly that is just and fitting,- the mutual recriminations of the People of the Fire!
tr.khattab: This dispute between the residents of the Fire will certainly come to pass

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute,
tr.yusufali: Say: "Truly am I a Warner: no god is there but the one Allah, Supreme and Irresistible,-
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a warner. And there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah—the One, the Supreme

ayahs.ar: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ

tr.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
tr.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning.
tr.yusufali: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- Exalted in Might, able to enforce His Will, forgiving again and again."
tr.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between—the Almighty, Most Forgiving.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ

tr.sahih: Say, "It is great news
tr.pickthall: Say: It is tremendous tidings
tr.yusufali: Say: "That is a Message Supreme (above all),-
tr.khattab: Say, “This ˹Quran˺ is momentous news

ayahs.ar: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ

tr.sahih: From which you turn away.
tr.pickthall: Whence ye turn away!
tr.yusufali: "From which ye do turn away!
tr.khattab: from which you ˹pagans˺ are turning away.”

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

tr.sahih: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
tr.pickthall: I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed;
tr.yusufali: "No knowledge have I of the Chiefs on high, when they discuss (matters) among themselves.
tr.khattab: ˹And say,˺ “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly ˹in heaven˺ when they differed ˹concerning Adam˺

ayahs.ar: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
tr.pickthall: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner.
tr.yusufali: 'Only this has been revealed to me: that I am to give warning plainly and publicly."
tr.khattab: What is revealed to me is that I am only sent with a clear warning.”

ayahs.ar: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
tr.pickthall: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire,
tr.yusufali: Behold, thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man from clay:
tr.khattab: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

tr.sahih: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
tr.pickthall: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate,
tr.yusufali: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
tr.khattab: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”

ayahs.ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

tr.sahih: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
tr.pickthall: The angels fell down prostrate, every one,
tr.yusufali: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
tr.khattab: So the angels prostrated all together—

ayahs.ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
tr.pickthall: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers.
tr.yusufali: Not so Iblis: he was haughty, and became one of those who reject Faith.
tr.khattab: but not Iblîs, who acted arrogantly, becoming unfaithful

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
tr.pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted?
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! What prevents thee from prostrating thyself to one whom I have created with my hands? Art thou haughty? Or art thou one of the high (and mighty) ones?"
tr.khattab: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My Own Hands? Did you ˹just˺ become proud? Or have you always been arrogant?”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
tr.pickthall: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay.
tr.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "I am better than he: thou createdst me from fire, and him thou createdst from clay."
tr.khattab: He replied, “I am better than he is: You created me from fire and him from clay.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.
tr.pickthall: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast,
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here: for thou art rejected, accursed.
tr.khattab: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
tr.pickthall: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment.
tr.yusufali: "And My curse shall be on thee till the Day of Judgment."
tr.khattab: And surely upon you is My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
tr.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
tr.khattab: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
tr.pickthall: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Respite then is granted thee-
tr.khattab: Allah said, “You will be delayed

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

tr.sahih: Until the Day of the time well-known."
tr.pickthall: Until the day of the time appointed.
tr.yusufali: "Till the Day of the Time Appointed."
tr.khattab: until the appointed Day.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
tr.pickthall: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,
tr.yusufali: (Iblis) said: "Then, by Thy power, I will put them all in the wrong,-
tr.khattab: Satan said, “By Your Glory! I will certainly mislead them all

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

tr.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
tr.pickthall: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them.
tr.yusufali: "Except Thy Servants amongst them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
tr.khattab: except Your chosen servants among them.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ

tr.sahih: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
tr.pickthall: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak,
tr.yusufali: (Allah) said: "Then it is just and fitting- and I say what is just and fitting-
tr.khattab: Allah concluded, “The truth is—and I ˹only˺ say the truth—

ayahs.ar: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
tr.pickthall: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together.
tr.yusufali: "That I will certainly fill Hell with thee and those that follow thee,- every one."
tr.khattab: I will surely fill up Hell with you and whoever follows you from among them, all together.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating.
tr.yusufali: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor am I a pretender.
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹Quran˺, nor do I pretend to be someone I am not

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples
tr.yusufali: "This is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds.
tr.khattab: It is only a reminder to the whole world

ayahs.ar: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ

tr.sahih: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
tr.pickthall: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof.
tr.yusufali: "And ye shall certainly know the truth of it (all) after a while."
tr.khattab: And you will certainly know its truth before long.”

ayahs.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

tr.sahih: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr.pickthall: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.yusufali: The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Power, full of Wisdom.
tr.khattab: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have revealed the Scripture unto thee (Muhammad) with truth; so worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).
tr.yusufali: Verily it is We Who have revealed the Book to thee in Truth: so serve Allah, offering Him sincere devotion.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have sent down the Book to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth, so worship Allah ˹alone˺, being sincerely devoted to Him

ayahs.ar: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ

tr.sahih: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
tr.pickthall: Surely pure religion is for Allah only. And those who choose protecting friends beside Him (say): We worship them only that they may bring us near unto Allah. Lo! Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Lo! Allah guideth not him who is a liar, an ingrate.
tr.yusufali: Is it not to Allah that sincere devotion is due? But those who take for protectors other than Allah (say): "We only serve them in order that they may bring us nearer to Allah." Truly Allah will judge between them in that wherein they differ. But Allah guides not such as are false and ungrateful.
tr.khattab: Indeed, sincere devotion is due ˹only˺ to Allah. As for those who take other lords besides Him, ˹saying,˺ “We worship them only so they may bring us closer to Allah,” surely Allah will judge between all regarding what they differed about. Allah certainly does not guide whoever persists in lying and disbelief

ayahs.ar: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًۭا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

tr.sahih: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
tr.pickthall: If Allah had willed to choose a son, He could have chosen what He would of that which He hath created. Be He Glorified! He is Allah, the One, the Absolute.
tr.yusufali: Had Allah wished to take to Himself a son, He could have chosen whom He pleased out of those whom He doth create: but Glory be to Him! (He is above such things.) He is Allah, the One, the Irresistible.
tr.khattab: Had it been Allah’s Will to have offspring, He could have chosen whatever He willed of His creation. Glory be to Him! He is Allah—the One, the Supreme

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ

tr.sahih: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
tr.pickthall: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. He maketh night to succeed day, and He maketh day to succeed night, and He constraineth the sun and the moon to give service, each running on for an appointed term. Is not He the Mighty, the Forgiver?
tr.yusufali: He created the heavens and the earth in true (proportions): He makes the Night overlap the Day, and the Day overlap the Night: He has subjected the sun and the moon (to His law): Each one follows a course for a time appointed. Is not He the Exalted in Power - He Who forgives again and again?
tr.khattab: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. He wraps the night around the day, and wraps the day around the night. And He has subjected the sun and the moon, each orbiting for an appointed term. He is truly the Almighty, Most Forgiving

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًۭا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍۢ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍۢ ثَلَٰثٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ

tr.sahih: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
tr.pickthall: He created you from one being, then from that (being) He made its mate; and He hath provided for you of cattle eight kinds. He created you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold gloom. Such is Allah, your Lord. His is the Sovereignty. There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye turned away?
tr.yusufali: He created you (all) from a single person: then created, of like nature, his mate; and he sent down for you eight head of cattle in pairs: He makes you, in the wombs of your mothers, in stages, one after another, in three veils of darkness. such is Allah, your Lord and Cherisher: to Him belongs (all) dominion. There is no god but He: then how are ye turned away (from your true Centre)?
tr.khattab: He created you ˹all˺ from a single soul, then from it He made its mate. And He produced for you four pairs of cattle. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers ˹in stages˺, one development after another, in three layers of darkness. That is Allah—your Lord! All authority belongs to Him. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. How can you then be turned away

ayahs.ar: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

tr.sahih: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr.pickthall: If ye are thankless, yet Allah is Independent of you, though He is not pleased with thanklessness for His bondmen; and if ye are thankful He is pleased therewith for you. No laden soul will bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return; and He will tell you what ye used to do. Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men).
tr.yusufali: If ye reject (Allah), Truly Allah hath no need of you; but He liketh not ingratitude from His servants: if ye are grateful, He is pleased with you. No bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another. In the end, to your Lord is your Return, when He will tell you the truth of all that ye did (in this life). for He knoweth well all that is in (men's) hearts.
tr.khattab: If you disbelieve, then ˹know that˺ Allah is truly not in need of you, nor does He approve of disbelief from His servants. But if you become grateful ˹through faith˺, He will appreciate that from you. No soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you of what you used to do. He certainly knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
tr.pickthall: And when some hurt toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning unto Him (repentant). Then, when He granteth him a boon from Him he forgetteth that for which he cried unto Him before, and setteth up rivals to Allah that he may beguile (men) from his way. Say (O Muhammad, unto such an one): Take pleasure in thy disbelief a while. Lo! thou art of the owners of the Fire.
tr.yusufali: When some trouble toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning to Him in repentance: but when He bestoweth a favour upon him as from Himself, (man) doth forget what he cried and prayed for before, and he doth set up rivals unto Allah, thus misleading others from Allah's Path. Say, "Enjoy thy blasphemy for a little while: verily thou art (one) of the Companions of the Fire!"
tr.khattab: When one is touched with hardship, they cry out to their Lord, turning to Him ˹alone˺. But as soon as He showers them with blessings from Him, they ˹totally˺ forget the One they had cried to earlier, and set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy your disbelief for a little while! You will certainly be one of the inmates of the Fire.”

ayahs.ar: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًۭا وَقَآئِمًۭا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

tr.sahih: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
tr.pickthall: Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed.
tr.yusufali: Is one who worships devoutly during the hour of the night prostrating himself or standing (in adoration), who takes heed of the Hereafter, and who places his hope in the Mercy of his Lord - (like one who does not)? Say: "Are those equal, those who know and those who do not know? It is those who are endued with understanding that receive admonition.
tr.khattab: ˹Are they better˺ or those who worship ˹their Lord˺ devoutly in the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of their Lord? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” None will be mindful ˹of this˺ except people of reason

ayahs.ar: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ

tr.sahih: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."
tr.pickthall: Say: O My bondmen who believe! Observe your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good, and Allah's earth is spacious. Verily the steadfast will be paid their wages without stint.
tr.yusufali: Say: "O ye my servants who believe! Fear your Lord, good is (the reward) for those who do good in this world. Spacious is Allah's earth! those who patiently persevere will truly receive a reward without measure!"
tr.khattab: Say ˹O Prophet, that Allah says˺, “O My servants who believe! Be mindful of your Lord. Those who do good in this world will have a good reward. And Allah’s earth is spacious. Only those who endure patiently will be given their reward without limit.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).
tr.yusufali: Say: "Verily, I am commanded to serve Allah with sincere devotion;
tr.khattab: Say, “I am commanded to worship Allah, being sincerely devoted to Him ˹alone˺

ayahs.ar: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
tr.pickthall: And I am commanded to be the first of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him).
tr.yusufali: "And I am commanded to be the first of those who bow to Allah in Islam."
tr.khattab: And I am commanded to be the first of those who submit ˹to His Will˺.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
tr.pickthall: Say: Lo! if I should disobey my Lord, I fear the doom of a tremendous Day.
tr.yusufali: Say: "I would, if I disobeyed my Lord, indeed have fear of the Penalty of a Mighty Day."
tr.khattab: Say, “I truly fear—if I were to disobey my Lord—the torment of a tremendous Day.”

ayahs.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُۥ دِينِى

tr.sahih: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
tr.pickthall: Say: Allah I worship, making my religion pure for Him (only).
tr.yusufali: Say: "It is Allah I serve, with my sincere (and exclusive) devotion:
tr.khattab: Say, “It is ˹only˺ Allah that I worship, being sincere in my devotion to Him

ayahs.ar: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

tr.sahih: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
tr.pickthall: Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss!
tr.yusufali: "Serve ye what ye will besides him." Say: "Truly, those in loss are those who lose their own souls and their People on the Day of Judgment: Ah! that is indeed the (real and) evident Loss!
tr.khattab: Worship then whatever ˹gods˺ you want instead of Him.” Say, “The ˹true˺ losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on Judgment Day. That is indeed the clearest loss.”

ayahs.ar: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ

tr.sahih: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
tr.pickthall: They have an awning of fire above them and beneath them a dais (of fire). With this doth Allah appal His bondmen. O My bondmen, therefor fear Me!
tr.yusufali: They shall have Layers of Fire above them, and Layers (of Fire) below them: with this doth Allah warn off his servants: "O My Servants! then fear ye Me!"
tr.khattab: They will have layers of fire above and below them. That is what Allah warns His servants with. So fear Me, O My servants

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ

tr.sahih: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
tr.pickthall: And those who put away false gods lest they should worship them and turn to Allah in repentance, for them there are glad tidings. Therefor give good tidings (O Muhammad) to My bondmen
tr.yusufali: Those who eschew Evil,- and fall not into its worship,- and turn to Allah (in repentance),- for them is Good News: so announce the Good News to My Servants,-
tr.khattab: And those who shun the worship of false gods, turning to Allah ˹alone˺, will have good news. So give good news to My servants ˹O Prophet˺—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

tr.sahih: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.
tr.pickthall: Who hear advice and follow the best thereof. Such are those whom Allah guideth, and such are men of understanding.
tr.yusufali: Those who listen to the Word, and follow the best (meaning) in it: those are the ones whom Allah has guided, and those are the ones endued with understanding.
tr.khattab: those who listen to what is said and follow the best of it. These are the ones ˹rightly˺ guided by Allah, and these are ˹truly˺ the people of reason

ayahs.ar: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ

tr.sahih: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
tr.pickthall: Is he on whom the word of doom is fulfilled (to be helped), and canst thou (O Muhammad) rescue him who is in the Fire?
tr.yusufali: Is, then, one against whom the decree of Punishment is justly due (equal to one who eschews Evil)? Wouldst thou, then, deliver one (who is) in the Fire?
tr.khattab: What about those against whom the decree of torment has been justified? Is it you ˹O Prophet˺ who will then save those bound for the Fire

ayahs.ar: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌۭ مَّبْنِيَّةٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ

tr.sahih: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise.
tr.pickthall: But those who keep their duty to their Lord, for them are lofty halls with lofty halls above them, built (for them), beneath which rivers flow. (It is) a promise of Allah. Allah faileth not His promise.
tr.yusufali: But it is for those who fear their Lord. That lofty mansions, one above another, have been built: beneath them flow rivers (of delight): (such is) the Promise of Allah: never doth Allah fail in (His) promise.
tr.khattab: But those mindful of their Lord will have ˹elevated˺ mansions, built one above the other, under which rivers flow. ˹That is˺ the promise of Allah. ˹And˺ Allah never fails in ˹His˺ promise

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًۭا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

tr.sahih: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
tr.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as watersprings, and afterward thereby produceth crops of divers hues; and afterward they wither and thou seest them turn yellow; then He maketh them chaff. Lo! herein verily is a reminder for men of understanding.
tr.yusufali: Seest thou not that Allah sends down rain from the sky, and leads it through springs in the earth? Then He causes to grow, therewith, produce of various colours: then it withers; thou wilt see it grow yellow; then He makes it dry up and crumble away. Truly, in this, is a Message of remembrance to men of understanding.
tr.khattab: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky—channelling it through streams in the earth—then produces with it crops of various colours, then they dry up and you see them wither, and then He reduces them to chaff? Surely in this is a reminder for people of reason

ayahs.ar: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error.
tr.pickthall: Is he whose bosom Allah hath expanded for Al-Islam, so that he followeth a light from his Lord, (as he who disbelieveth)? Then woe unto those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah. Such are in plain error.
tr.yusufali: Is one whose heart Allah has opened to Islam, so that he has received Enlightenment from Allah, (no better than one hard-hearted)? Woe to those whose hearts are hardened against celebrating the praises of Allah! they are manifestly wandering (in error)!
tr.khattab: Can ˹the misguided be like˺ those whose hearts Allah has opened to Islam, so they are enlightened by their Lord? So woe to those whose hearts are hardened at the remembrance of Allah! It is they who are clearly astray

ayahs.ar: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبًۭا مُّتَشَٰبِهًۭا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ

tr.sahih: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
tr.pickthall: Allah hath (now) revealed the fairest of statements, a Scripture consistent, (wherein promises of reward are) paired (with threats of punishment), whereat doth creep the flesh of those who fear their Lord, so that their flesh and their hearts soften to Allah's reminder. Such is Allah's guidance, wherewith He guideth whom He will. And him whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.
tr.yusufali: Allah has revealed (from time to time) the most beautiful Message in the form of a Book, consistent with itself, (yet) repeating (its teaching in various aspects): the skins of those who fear their Lord tremble thereat; then their skins and their hearts do soften to the celebration of Allah's praises. Such is the guidance of Allah: He guides therewith whom He pleases, but such as Allah leaves to stray, can have none to guide.
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ has sent down the best message—a Book of perfect consistency and repeated lessons—which causes the skin ˹and hearts˺ of those who fear their Lord to tremble, then their skin and hearts soften at the mention of ˹the mercy of˺ Allah. That is the guidance of Allah, through which He guides whoever He wills. But whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide

ayahs.ar: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ

tr.sahih: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
tr.pickthall: Is he then, who will strike his face against the awful doom upon the Day of Resurrection (as he who doeth right)? And it will be said unto the wrong-doers: Taste what ye used to earn.
tr.yusufali: Is, then, one who has to fear the brunt of the Penalty on the Day of Judgment (and receive it) on his face, (like one guarded therefrom)? It will be said to the wrong-doers: "Taste ye (the fruits of) what ye earned!"
tr.khattab: Are those who will only have their ˹bare˺ faces to shield themselves from the awful torment on Judgment Day ˹better than those in Paradise˺? It will ˹then˺ be said to the wrongdoers: “Reap what you sowed!”

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

tr.sahih: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
tr.pickthall: Those before them denied, and so the doom came on them whence they knew not.
tr.yusufali: Those before them (also) rejected (revelation), and so the Punishment came to them from directions they did not perceive.
tr.khattab: Those before them ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺, then the torment came upon them from where they least expected

ayahs.ar: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
tr.pickthall: Thus Allah made them taste humiliation in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be greater if they did but know.
tr.yusufali: So Allah gave them a taste of humiliation in the present life, but greater is the punishment of the Hereafter, if they only knew!
tr.khattab: So Allah made them taste humiliation in this worldly life, but far worse is the punishment of the Hereafter, if only they knew

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
tr.pickthall: And verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes, that haply they may reflect;
tr.yusufali: We have put forth for men, in this Qur'an every kind of Parable, in order that they may receive admonition.
tr.khattab: We have certainly set forth every ˹kind of˺ lesson for people in this Quran, so perhaps they will be mindful

ayahs.ar: قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍۢ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

tr.sahih: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
tr.pickthall: A Lecture in Arabic, containing no crookedness, that haply they may ward off (evil).
tr.yusufali: (It is) a Qur'an in Arabic, without any crookedness (therein): in order that they may guard against Evil.
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ a Quran ˹revealed˺ in Arabic without any crookedness, so perhaps they will be conscious ˹of Allah˺

ayahs.ar: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا رَّجُلًۭا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًۭا سَلَمًۭا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know.
tr.pickthall: Allah coineth a similitude: A man in relation to whom are several part-owners, quarrelling, and a man belonging wholly to one man. Are the two equal in similitude? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not.
tr.yusufali: Allah puts forth a Parable a man belonging to many partners at variance with each other, and a man belonging entirely to one master: are those two equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! but most of them have no knowledge.
tr.khattab: Allah sets forth the parable of a slave owned by several quarrelsome masters, and a slave owned by only one master. Are they equal in condition? Praise be to Allah! In fact, most of them do not know

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌۭ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thou wilt die, and lo! they will die;
tr.yusufali: Truly thou wilt die (one day), and truly they (too) will die (one day).
tr.khattab: You ˹O Prophet˺ will certainly die, and they will die too

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ

tr.sahih: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
tr.pickthall: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord ye will dispute.
