tr.khattab: When Jesus came with clear proofs, he declared, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of what you differ about. So fear Allah, and obey me

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
tr.pickthall: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.
tr.yusufali: "For Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord: so worship ye Him: this is a Straight Way."
tr.khattab: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”

ayahs.ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ

tr.sahih: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
tr.pickthall: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.
tr.yusufali: But sects from among themselves fell into disagreement: then woe to the wrong-doers, from the Penalty of a Grievous Day!
tr.khattab: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the wrongdoers when they face the torment of a painful Day

ayahs.ar: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

tr.sahih: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
tr.pickthall: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not?
tr.yusufali: Do they only wait for the Hour - that it should come on them all of a sudden, while they perceive not?
tr.khattab: Are they waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺

ayahs.ar: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

tr.sahih: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
tr.pickthall: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).
tr.yusufali: Friends on that day will be foes, one to another,- except the Righteous.
tr.khattab: Close friends will be enemies to one another on that Day, except the righteous

ayahs.ar: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ

tr.sahih: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
tr.pickthall: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;
tr.yusufali: My devotees! no fear shall be on you that Day, nor shall ye grieve,-
tr.khattab: ˹who will be told,˺ “O My servants! There is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
tr.pickthall: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,
tr.yusufali: (Being) those who have believed in Our Signs and bowed (their wills to Ours) in Islam.
tr.khattab: ˹those˺ who believed in Our signs and ˹fully˺ submitted ˹to Us˺

ayahs.ar: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ

tr.sahih: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
tr.pickthall: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.
tr.yusufali: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing.
tr.khattab: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing.”

ayahs.ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍۢ مِّن ذَهَبٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ

tr.sahih: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
tr.pickthall: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
tr.yusufali: To them will be passed round, dishes and goblets of gold: there will be there all that the souls could desire, all that their eyes could delight in: and ye shall abide therein (for eye).
tr.khattab: Golden trays and cups will be passed around to them. There will be whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in. And you will be there forever

ayahs.ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
tr.pickthall: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.
tr.yusufali: Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life).
tr.khattab: That is the Paradise which you will be awarded for what you used to do

ayahs.ar: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ كَثِيرَةٌۭ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

tr.sahih: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
tr.pickthall: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.
tr.yusufali: Ye shall have therein abundance of fruit, from which ye shall have satisfaction.
tr.khattab: There you will have abundant fruit to eat from

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
tr.pickthall: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.
tr.yusufali: The sinners will be in the Punishment of Hell, to dwell therein (for aye):
tr.khattab: Indeed, the wicked will be in the torment of Hell forever

ayahs.ar: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

tr.sahih: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
tr.pickthall: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.
tr.yusufali: Nowise will the (Punishment) be lightened for them, and in despair will they be there overwhelmed.
tr.khattab: It will never be lightened for them, and there they will be overwhelmed with despair

ayahs.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
tr.pickthall: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.
tr.yusufali: Nowise shall We be unjust to them: but it is they who have been unjust themselves.
tr.khattab: We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers

ayahs.ar: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ

tr.sahih: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
tr.pickthall: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.
tr.yusufali: They will cry: "O Malik! would that thy Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Nay, but ye shall abide!"
tr.khattab: They will cry, “O Mâlik! Let your Lord finish us off.” He will answer, “You are definitely here to stay.”

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ جِئْنَٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ

tr.sahih: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
tr.pickthall: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.
tr.yusufali: Verily We have brought the Truth to you: but most of you have a hatred for Truth.
tr.khattab: We certainly brought the truth to you, but most of you were resentful of the truth

ayahs.ar: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
tr.pickthall: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining.
tr.yusufali: What! have they settled some plan (among themselves)? But it is We Who settle things.
tr.khattab: Or have they mastered some ˹evil˺ plan? Then We ˹too˺ are surely planning

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
tr.pickthall: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.
tr.yusufali: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsels? Indeed (We do), and Our messengers are by them, to record.
tr.khattab: Or do they think that We do not hear their ˹evil˺ thoughts and secret talks? Yes ˹We do˺! And Our messenger-angels are in their presence, recording ˹it all˺

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌۭ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَٰبِدِينَ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).
tr.yusufali: Say: "If (Allah) Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship."
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the Most Compassionate ˹really˺ had offspring, I would be the first worshipper.”

ayahs.ar: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

tr.sahih: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
tr.pickthall: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
tr.yusufali: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)!
tr.khattab: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim

ayahs.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
tr.pickthall: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.
tr.yusufali: So leave them to babble and play (with vanities) until they meet that Day of theirs, which they have been promised.
tr.khattab: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been warned of

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَٰهٌۭ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
tr.pickthall: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.
tr.yusufali: It is He Who is Allah in heaven and Allah on earth; and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge.
tr.khattab: It is He Who is ˹the only˺ God in the heavens and ˹the only˺ God on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing

ayahs.ar: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

tr.sahih: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
tr.pickthall: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.
tr.yusufali: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all between them: with Him is the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment): and to Him shall ye be brought back.
tr.khattab: And Blessed is the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between! With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
tr.pickthall: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.
tr.yusufali: And those whom they invoke besides Allah have no power of intercession;- only he who bears witness to the Truth, and they know (him).
tr.khattab: ˹But˺ those ˹objects of worship˺ they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

tr.sahih: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?
tr.pickthall: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?
tr.yusufali: If thou ask them, who created them, they will certainly say, Allah: How then are they deluded away (from the Truth)?
tr.khattab: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created them, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺

ayahs.ar: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
tr.pickthall: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.
tr.yusufali: (Allah has knowledge) of the (Prophet's) cry, "O my Lord! Truly these are people who will not believe!"
tr.khattab: ˹Allah is Aware of˺ the Prophet’s cry: “O my Lord! Indeed, these are a people who persist in disbelief.”

ayahs.ar: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌۭ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
tr.pickthall: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.
tr.yusufali: But turn away from them, and say "Peace!" But soon shall they know!
tr.khattab: So bear with them and respond with peace. They will soon come to know

ayahs.ar: حمٓ

tr.sahih: Ha, Meem.
tr.pickthall: Ha. Mim.
tr.yusufali: Ha-Mim.
tr.khattab: Ḥâ-Mĩm

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

tr.sahih: By the clear Book,
tr.pickthall: By the Scripture that maketh plain
tr.yusufali: By the Book that makes things clear;-
tr.khattab: By the clear Book

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
tr.pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -
tr.yusufali: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).
tr.khattab: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺

ayahs.ar: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

tr.sahih: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -
tr.pickthall: Whereon every wise command is made clear
tr.yusufali: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,
tr.khattab: On that night every matter of wisdom is ordained

ayahs.ar: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

tr.sahih: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
tr.pickthall: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -
tr.yusufali: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),
tr.khattab: by a command from Us, for We have always sent ˹messengers˺

ayahs.ar: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr.pickthall: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,
tr.yusufali: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);
tr.khattab: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
tr.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.
tr.yusufali: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.
tr.khattab: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith

ayahs.ar: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
tr.pickthall: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
tr.yusufali: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.
tr.khattab: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers

ayahs.ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ

tr.sahih: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but they play in doubt.
tr.yusufali: Yet they play about in doubt.
tr.khattab: In fact, they are in doubt, amusing themselves

ayahs.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
tr.pickthall: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
tr.yusufali: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,
tr.khattab: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible

ayahs.ar: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
tr.pickthall: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.
tr.yusufali: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.
tr.khattab: overwhelming the people. ˹They will cry,˺ “This is a painful torment

ayahs.ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
tr.pickthall: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.
tr.yusufali: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"
tr.khattab: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”

ayahs.ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
tr.pickthall: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,
tr.yusufali: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Messenger explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-
tr.khattab: How can they be reminded when a messenger has already come to them, making things clear

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ

tr.sahih: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
tr.pickthall: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?
tr.yusufali: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"
tr.khattab: then they turned away from him, saying, “A madman, taught by others!”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
tr.pickthall: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).
tr.yusufali: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).
tr.khattab: Indeed, We will remove ˹that˺ torment for a while, and you ˹Meccans˺ will return ˹to disbelief˺

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
tr.pickthall: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.
tr.yusufali: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!
tr.khattab: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ

tr.sahih: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
tr.pickthall: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,
tr.yusufali: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them a messenger most honourable,
tr.khattab: Indeed, before them We tested Pharaoh’s people: a noble messenger came to them

ayahs.ar: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
tr.pickthall: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.
tr.yusufali: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of Allah: I am to you an messenger worthy of all trust;
tr.khattab: ˹proclaiming,˺ “Hand over the servants of Allah to me. I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

ayahs.ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
tr.pickthall: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.
tr.yusufali: "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.
tr.khattab: And do not be arrogant with Allah. I have certainly come to you with a compelling proof

ayahs.ar: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

tr.sahih: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
tr.pickthall: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
tr.yusufali: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.
tr.khattab: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ

tr.sahih: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
tr.pickthall: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.
tr.yusufali: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."
tr.khattab: ˹But˺ if you do not believe me, then let me be.”

ayahs.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ

tr.sahih: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
tr.pickthall: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.
tr.yusufali: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."
tr.khattab: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”

ayahs.ar: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

tr.sahih: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
tr.pickthall: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,
tr.yusufali: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.
tr.khattab: ˹Allah responded,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued

ayahs.ar: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ

tr.sahih: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
tr.pickthall: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.
tr.yusufali: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."
tr.khattab: And leave the sea parted, for they are certainly an army bound to drown.”

ayahs.ar: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
tr.pickthall: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,
tr.yusufali: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,
tr.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many gardens and springs the tyrants left behind

ayahs.ar: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: And crops and noble sites
tr.pickthall: And the cornlands and the goodly sites
tr.yusufali: And corn-fields and noble buildings,
tr.khattab: as well as ˹various˺ crops and splendid residences

ayahs.ar: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ

tr.sahih: And comfort wherein they were amused.
tr.pickthall: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!
tr.yusufali: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!
tr.khattab: and luxuries which they fully enjoyed

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

tr.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
tr.pickthall: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;
tr.yusufali: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!
tr.khattab: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to another people

ayahs.ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ

tr.sahih: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
tr.pickthall: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
tr.yusufali: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).
tr.khattab: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

tr.sahih: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
tr.pickthall: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;
tr.yusufali: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,
tr.khattab: And We certainly delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment

ayahs.ar: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

tr.sahih: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
tr.pickthall: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.
tr.yusufali: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.
tr.khattab: of Pharaoh. He was truly a tyrant, a transgressor

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.
tr.yusufali: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,
tr.khattab: And indeed, We chose the Israelites knowingly above the others

ayahs.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
tr.pickthall: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.
tr.yusufali: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial
tr.khattab: And We showed them signs in which there was a clear test

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
tr.pickthall: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:
tr.yusufali: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:
tr.khattab: Indeed, these ˹Meccans˺ say

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

tr.sahih: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
tr.pickthall: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
tr.yusufali: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
tr.khattab: “There is nothing beyond our first death, and we will never be resurrected

ayahs.ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
tr.pickthall: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!
tr.yusufali: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
tr.khattab: Bring ˹back˺ our forefathers, if what you say is true.”

ayahs.ar: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
tr.pickthall: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.
tr.yusufali: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.
tr.khattab: Are they superior to the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them ˹all˺, ˹for˺ they were truly wicked

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

tr.sahih: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
tr.pickthall: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.
tr.yusufali: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:
tr.khattab: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport

ayahs.ar: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
tr.pickthall: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.
tr.yusufali: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.
tr.khattab: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
tr.pickthall: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,
tr.yusufali: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-
tr.khattab: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
tr.pickthall: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,
tr.yusufali: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,
tr.khattab: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tr.sahih: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr.pickthall: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.yusufali: Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: except those shown mercy by Allah. He is truly the Almighty, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
tr.pickthall: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,
tr.yusufali: Verily the tree of Zaqqum
tr.khattab: Surely ˹the fruit of˺ the tree of Zaqqûm

ayahs.ar: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ

tr.sahih: Is food for the sinful.
tr.pickthall: The food of the sinner!
tr.yusufali: Will be the food of the Sinful,-
tr.khattab: will be the food of the evildoer

ayahs.ar: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

tr.sahih: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
tr.pickthall: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies
tr.yusufali: Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.
tr.khattab: Like molten metal, it will boil in the bellies

ayahs.ar: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

tr.sahih: Like the boiling of scalding water.
tr.pickthall: As the seething of boiling water.
tr.yusufali: Like the boiling of scalding water.
tr.khattab: like the boiling of hot water

ayahs.ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
tr.pickthall: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,
tr.yusufali: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!
tr.khattab: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

tr.sahih: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
tr.pickthall: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.
tr.yusufali: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,
tr.khattab: Then pour over their heads the torment of boiling water.”

ayahs.ar: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ

tr.sahih: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
tr.pickthall: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!
tr.yusufali: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!
tr.khattab: ˹The wicked will be told,˺ “Taste this. You mighty, noble one

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
tr.pickthall: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.
tr.yusufali: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"
tr.khattab: This is truly what you ˹all˺ used to doubt.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.
tr.yusufali: As to the Righteous (they will be) in a position of Security,
tr.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place

ayahs.ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: Within gardens and springs,
tr.pickthall: Amid gardens and watersprings,
tr.yusufali: Among Gardens and Springs;
tr.khattab: amid Gardens and springs

ayahs.ar: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

tr.sahih: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
tr.pickthall: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.
tr.yusufali: Dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, they will face each other;
tr.khattab: dressed in fine silk and rich brocade, facing one another

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
tr.pickthall: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
tr.yusufali: So; and We shall join them to fair women with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes.
tr.khattab: So it will be. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes

ayahs.ar: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

tr.sahih: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
tr.pickthall: They call therein for every fruit in safety.
tr.yusufali: There can they call for every kind of fruit in peace and security;
tr.khattab: There they will call for every fruit in serenity

ayahs.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
tr.pickthall: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,
tr.yusufali: Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-
tr.khattab: There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—

ayahs.ar: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

tr.sahih: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
tr.pickthall: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
tr.yusufali: As a Bounty from thy Lord! that will be the supreme achievement!
tr.khattab: as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.
tr.pickthall: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.
tr.yusufali: Verily, We have made this (Qur'an) easy, in thy tongue, in order that they may give heed.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so perhaps they will be mindful

ayahs.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

tr.sahih: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
tr.pickthall: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
tr.yusufali: So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.
tr.khattab: Wait then! They too are certainly waiting

ayahs.ar: حمٓ

tr.sahih: Ha, Meem.
tr.pickthall: Ha. Mim.
tr.yusufali: Ha-Mim.
tr.khattab: Ḥâ-Mĩm

ayahs.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

tr.sahih: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr.pickthall: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.yusufali: The revelation of the Book is from Allah the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.
tr.khattab: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
tr.pickthall: Lo! in the heavens and the earth are portents for believers.
tr.yusufali: Verily in the heavens and the earth, are Signs for those who believe.
tr.khattab: Surely in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers

ayahs.ar: وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ

tr.sahih: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
tr.pickthall: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.
tr.yusufali: And in the creation of yourselves and the fact that animals are scattered (through the earth), are Signs for those of assured Faith.
tr.khattab: And in your own creation, and whatever living beings He dispersed, are signs for people of sure faith

ayahs.ar: وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍۢ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
tr.pickthall: And the difference of night and day and the provision that Allah sendeth down from the sky and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death, and the ordering of the winds, are portents for a people who have sense.
tr.yusufali: And in the alternation of Night and Day, and the fact that Allah sends down Sustenance from the sky, and revives therewith the earth after its death, and in the change of the winds,- are Signs for those that are wise.
tr.khattab: And ˹in˺ the alternation of the day and the night, the provision sent down from the skies by Allah—reviving the earth after its death—and the shifting of the winds, are signs for people of understanding

ayahs.ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?
tr.pickthall: These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth. Then in what fact, after Allah and His portents, will they believe?
tr.yusufali: Such are the Signs of Allah, which We rehearse to thee in Truth; then in what exposition will they believe after (rejecting) Allah and His Signs?
tr.khattab: These are Allah’s revelations which We recite to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth. So what message will they believe in after ˹denying˺ Allah and His revelations

ayahs.ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: Woe to every sinful liar
tr.pickthall: Woe unto each sinful liar,
tr.yusufali: Woe to each sinful dealer in Falsehoods:
tr.khattab: Woe to every sinful liar

ayahs.ar: يَسْمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
tr.pickthall: Who heareth the revelations of Allah recited unto him, and then continueth in pride as though he heard them not. Give him tidings of a painful doom.
tr.yusufali: He hears the Signs of Allah rehearsed to him, yet is obstinate and lofty, as if he had not heard them: then announce to him a Penalty Grievous!
tr.khattab: They hear Allah’s revelations recited to them, then persist ˹in denial˺ arrogantly as if they did not hear them. So give them good news of a painful punishment

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
tr.pickthall: And when he knoweth aught of Our revelations he maketh it a jest. For such there is a shameful doom.
tr.yusufali: And when he learns something of Our Signs, he takes them in jest: for such there will be a humiliating Penalty.
tr.khattab: And whenever they learn anything of Our revelations, they make a mockery of it. It is they who will suffer a humiliating punishment

ayahs.ar: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

tr.sahih: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
tr.pickthall: Beyond them there is hell, and that which they have earned will naught avail them, nor those whom they have chosen for protecting friends beside Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom.
tr.yusufali: In front of them is Hell: and of no profit to them is anything they may have earned, nor any protectors they may have taken to themselves besides Allah: for them is a tremendous Penalty.
tr.khattab: Awaiting them is Hell. Their ˹worldly˺ gains will not be of any benefit to them whatsoever, nor will those protectors they have taken besides Allah. And they will suffer a tremendous punishment

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا هُدًۭى ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ

tr.sahih: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
tr.pickthall: This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath.
tr.yusufali: This is (true) Guidance and for those who reject the Signs of their Lord, is a grievous Penalty of abomination.
tr.khattab: This ˹Quran˺ is ˹true˺ guidance. And those who deny their Lord’s revelations will suffer the ˹worst˺ torment of agonizing pain

ayahs.ar: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

tr.sahih: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
tr.pickthall: Allah it is Who hath made the sea of service unto you that the ships may run thereon by His command, and that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful;
tr.yusufali: It is Allah Who has subjected the sea to you, that ships may sail through it by His command, that ye may seek of his Bounty, and that ye may be grateful.
tr.khattab: Allah is the One Who has subjected the sea for you so that ships may sail upon it by His command, and that you may seek His bounty, and that perhaps you will be grateful

ayahs.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
tr.pickthall: And hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect.
tr.yusufali: And He has subjected to you, as from Him, all that is in the heavens and on earth: Behold, in that are Signs indeed for those who reflect.
tr.khattab: He ˹also˺ subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth—all by His grace. Surely in this are signs for people who reflect

ayahs.ar: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
tr.pickthall: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn.
tr.yusufali: Tell those who believe, to forgive those who do not look forward to the Days of Allah: It is for Him to recompense (for good or ill) each People according to what they have earned.
tr.khattab: ˹O Prophet!˺ Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days ˹of torment˺, so that He will reward each group for what they used to commit

ayahs.ar: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ

tr.sahih: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
tr.pickthall: Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back.
tr.yusufali: If any one does a righteous deed, it ensures to the benefit of his own soul; if he does evil, it works against (his own soul). In the end will ye (all) be brought back to your Lord.
tr.khattab: Whoever does good, it is to their own benefit. And whoever does evil, it is to their own loss. Then to your Lord you will ˹all˺ be returned

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And verily we gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and the Command and the Prophethood, and provided them with good things and favoured them above (all) peoples;
tr.yusufali: We did aforetime grant to the Children of Israel the Book the Power of Command, and Prophethood; We gave them, for Sustenance, things good and pure; and We favoured them above the nations.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; granted them good, lawful provisions; and favoured them above the others

ayahs.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

tr.sahih: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
tr.pickthall: And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.
tr.yusufali: And We granted them Clear Signs in affairs (of Religion): it was only after knowledge had been granted to them that they fell into schisms, through insolent envy among themselves. Verily thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment as to those matters in which they set up differences.
tr.khattab: We ˹also˺ gave them clear commandments regarding ˹their˺ faith. But it was not until knowledge came to them that they differed out of mutual envy. Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
tr.pickthall: And now have We set thee (O Muhammad) on a clear road of (Our) commandment; so follow it, and follow not the whims of those who know not.
tr.yusufali: Then We put thee on the (right) Way of Religion: so follow thou that (Way), and follow not the desires of those who know not.
tr.khattab: Now We have set you ˹O Prophet˺ on the ˹clear˺ Way of faith. So follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know ˹the truth˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous.
tr.pickthall: Lo! they can avail thee naught against Allah. And lo! as for the wrong-doers, some of them are friends of others; and Allah is the Friend of those who ward off (evil).
tr.yusufali: They will be of no use to thee in the sight of Allah: it is only Wrong-doers (that stand as) protectors, one to another: but Allah is the Protector of the Righteous.
tr.khattab: They certainly can be of no benefit to you against Allah whatsoever. Surely the wrongdoers are patrons of each other, whereas Allah is the Patron of the righteous

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ

tr.sahih: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
tr.pickthall: This is clear indication for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a folk whose faith is sure.
tr.yusufali: These are clear evidences to men and a Guidance and Mercy to those of assured Faith.
tr.khattab: This ˹Quran˺ is an insight for humanity—a guide and mercy for people of sure faith

ayahs.ar: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءًۭ مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.
tr.pickthall: Or do those who commit ill-deeds suppose that We shall make them as those who believe and do good works, the same in life and death? Bad is their judgment!
tr.yusufali: What! Do those who seek after evil ways think that We shall hold them equal with those who believe and do righteous deeds,- that equal will be their life and their death? Ill is the judgment that they make.
tr.khattab: Or do those who commit evil deeds ˹simply˺ think that We will make them equal—in their life and after their death—to those who believe and do good? How wrong is their judgment

ayahs.ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
tr.pickthall: And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged.
tr.yusufali: Allah created the heavens and the earth for just ends, and in order that each soul may find the recompense of what it has earned, and none of them be wronged.
tr.khattab: For Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose, so that every soul may be paid back for what it has committed. And none will be wronged

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۢ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةًۭ فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded?
tr.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed?
tr.yusufali: Then seest thou such a one as takes as his god his own vain desire? Allah has, knowing (him as such), left him astray, and sealed his hearing and his heart (and understanding), and put a cover on his sight. Who, then, will guide him after Allah (has withdrawn Guidance)? Will ye not then receive admonition?
tr.khattab: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ those who have taken their own desires as their god? ˹And so˺ Allah left them to stray knowingly, sealed their hearing and hearts, and placed a cover on their sight. Who then can guide them after Allah? Will you ˹all˺ not then be mindful

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ

tr.sahih: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
tr.pickthall: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess.
tr.yusufali: And they say: "What is there but our life in this world? We shall die and we live, and nothing but time can destroy us." But of that they have no knowledge: they merely conjecture:
tr.khattab: And they argue, “There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die; others are born. And nothing destroys us but ˹the passage of˺ time.” Yet they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They only speculate

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
tr.pickthall: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them their only argument is that they say: Bring (back) our fathers. then, if ye are truthful.
tr.yusufali: And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them their argument is nothing but this: They say, "Bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
tr.khattab: And whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if what you say is true!”

ayahs.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not.
tr.yusufali: Say: "It is Allah Who gives you life, then gives you death; then He will gather you together for the Day of Judgment about which there is no doubt": But most men do not understand.
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ gives you life, then causes you to die, then will gather you ˹all˺ on the Day of Judgment, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.”

ayahs.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ

tr.sahih: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
tr.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost.
tr.yusufali: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and the Day that the Hour of Judgment is established,- that Day will the dealers in Falsehood perish!
tr.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. On the Day the Hour will be established, the people of falsehood will then be in ˹total˺ loss

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍۢ جَاثِيَةًۭ ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۢ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
tr.pickthall: And thou wilt see each nation crouching, each nation summoned to its record. (And it will be said unto them): This day ye are requited what ye used to do.
tr.yusufali: And thou wilt see every sect bowing the knee: Every sect will be called to its Record: "This Day shall ye be recompensed for all that ye did!
tr.khattab: And you will see every faith-community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its record ˹of deeds˺. ˹They all will be told,˺ “This Day you will be rewarded for what you used to do

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
tr.pickthall: This Our Book pronounceth against you with truth. Lo! We have caused (all) that ye did to be recorded.
tr.yusufali: "This Our Record speaks about you with truth: For We were wont to put on Record all that ye did."
tr.khattab: This record of Ours speaks the truth about you. Indeed, We always had your deeds recorded ˹by the angels˺.”

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

tr.sahih: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
tr.pickthall: Then, as for those who believed and did good works, their Lord will bring them in unto His mercy. That is the evident triumph.
tr.yusufali: Then, as to those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them to His Mercy that will be the achievement for all to see.
tr.khattab: As for those who believed and did good, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is ˹truly˺ the absolute triumph

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?
tr.pickthall: And as for those who disbelieved (it will be said unto them): Were not Our revelations recited unto you? But ye were scornful and became a guilty folk.
tr.yusufali: But as to those who rejected Allah, (to them will be said): "Were not Our Signs rehearsed to you? But ye were arrogant, and were a people given to sin!
tr.khattab: And as for those who disbelieved, ˹they will be told,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, yet you acted arrogantly and were a wicked people

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِى مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.' "
tr.pickthall: And when it was said: Lo! Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming, ye said: We know not what the Hour is. We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced.
tr.yusufali: "And when it was said that the promise of Allah was true, and that the Hour- there was no doubt about its (coming), ye used to say, 'We know not what is the hour: we only think it is an idea, and we have no firm assurance.'"
tr.khattab: And whenever it was said ˹to you˺, ‘Surely Allah’s promise ˹of judgment˺ is true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said ˹mockingly˺, ‘We do not know what the Hour is! We think it is no more than speculation, and we are not convinced ˹that it will ever come˺.’”

ayahs.ar: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

tr.sahih: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr.pickthall: And the evils of what they did will appear unto them, and that which they used to deride will befall them.
tr.yusufali: Then will appear to them the evil (fruits) of what they did, and they will be completely encircled by that which they used to mock at!
tr.khattab: And the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds will unfold before them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule

ayahs.ar: وَقِيلَ ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
tr.pickthall: And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you.
tr.yusufali: It will also be said: "This Day We will forget you as ye forgot the meeting of this Day of yours! and your abode is the Fire, and no helpers have ye!
tr.khattab: It will be said, “This Day We will neglect you as you neglected the meeting of this Day of yours! Your home will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers

ayahs.ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًۭا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

tr.sahih: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
tr.pickthall: This, forasmuch as ye made the revelations of Allah a jest, and the life of the world beguiled you. Therefor this day they come not forth from thence, nor can they make amends.
tr.yusufali: "This, because ye used to take the Signs of Allah in jest, and the life of the world deceived you:" (From) that Day, therefore, they shall not be taken out thence, nor shall they be received into Grace.
tr.khattab: This is because you made a mockery of Allah’s revelations, and were deluded by ˹your˺ worldly life.” So ˹from˺ that Day ˹on˺ they will not be taken out of the Fire, nor will they be allowed to appease ˹their Lord˺

ayahs.ar: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.yusufali: Then Praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth,- Lord and Cherisher of all the Worlds!
tr.khattab: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

tr.sahih: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr.pickthall: And unto Him (alone) belongeth Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.yusufali: To Him be glory throughout the heavens and the earth: and He is Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom!
tr.khattab: To Him belongs ˹all˺ Majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise

ayahs.ar: حمٓ

tr.sahih: Ha, Meem.
tr.pickthall: Ha. Mim.
tr.yusufali: Ha-Mim.
tr.khattab: Ḥâ-Mĩm

ayahs.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

tr.sahih: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr.pickthall: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.yusufali: The Revelation of the Book is from Allah the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.
tr.khattab: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise

ayahs.ar: مَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُوا۟ مُعْرِضُونَ

tr.sahih: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
tr.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.
tr.yusufali: We created not the heavens and the earth and all between them but for just ends, and for a Term Appointed: But those who reject Faith turn away from that whereof they are warned.
tr.khattab: We only created the heavens and the earth and everything in between for a purpose and an appointed term. Yet the disbelievers are turning away from what they have been warned about

ayahs.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌۭ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ۖ ٱئْتُونِى بِكِتَٰبٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ هَٰذَآ أَوْ أَثَٰرَةٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful.
tr.yusufali: Say: "Do ye see what it is ye invoke besides Allah? Show me what it is they have created on earth, or have they a share in the heavens bring me a book (revealed) before this, or any remnant of knowledge (ye may have), if ye are telling the truth!
tr.khattab: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Have you considered whatever ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created on earth! Or do they have a share in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens? Bring me a scripture ˹revealed˺ before this ˹Quran˺ or a shred of knowledge, if what you say is true.”

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَآئِهِمْ غَٰفِلُونَ

tr.sahih: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
tr.pickthall: And who is further astray than those who, instead of Allah, pray unto such as hear not their prayer until the Day of Resurrection, and are unconscious of their prayer,
tr.yusufali: And who is more astray than one who invokes besides Allah, such as will not answer him to the Day of Judgment, and who (in fact) are unconscious of their call (to them)?
tr.khattab: And who could be more astray than those who call upon others besides Allah—˹others˺ that cannot respond to them until the Day of Judgment, and are ˹even˺ unaware of their calls

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَعْدَآءًۭ وَكَانُوا۟ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَٰفِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
tr.pickthall: And when mankind are gathered (to the Judgment) will become enemies for them, and will become deniers of having been worshipped.
tr.yusufali: And when mankind are gathered together (at the Resurrection), they will be hostile to them and reject their worship (altogether)!
tr.khattab: And when ˹such˺ people will be gathered together, those ˹gods˺ will be their enemies and will disown their worship

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."
tr.pickthall: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say of the Truth when it reacheth them: This is mere magic.
tr.yusufali: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say, of the Truth when it comes to them: "This is evident sorcery!"
tr.khattab: Whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, the disbelievers say of the truth when it has come to them, “This is pure magic.”

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ ٱفْتَرَيْتُهُۥ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۖ كَفَىٰ بِهِۦ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tr.sahih: Or do they say, "He has invented it?" Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allah at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving the Merciful."
tr.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it? Say (O Muhammad): If I have invented it, still ye have no power to support me against Allah. He is Best Aware of what ye say among yourselves concerning it. He sufficeth for a witness between me and you. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
tr.yusufali: Or do they say, "He has forged it"? Say: "Had I forged it, then can ye obtain no single (blessing) for me from Allah. He knows best of that whereof ye talk (so glibly)! Enough is He for a witness between me and you! And he is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
tr.khattab: Or do they say, “He has fabricated this ˹Quran˺!”? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If I have done so, then there is nothing whatsoever you can do to save me from Allah. He knows best what ˹slurs˺ you indulge about it. Sufficient is He as a Witness between you and me. And He is the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدْرِى مَا يُفْعَلُ بِى وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
tr.pickthall: Say: I am no new thing among the messengers (of Allah), nor know I what will be done with me or with you. I do but follow that which is inspired in me, and I am but a plain warner.
tr.yusufali: Say: "I am no bringer of new-fangled doctrine among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I follow but that which is revealed to me by inspiration; I am but a Warner open and clear."
tr.khattab: Say, “I am not the first messenger ever sent, nor do I know what will happen to me or you. I only follow what is revealed to me. And I am only sent with a clear warning.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِۦ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِۦ فَـَٔامَنَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an was from Allah, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
tr.pickthall: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye disbelieve therein, and a witness of the Children of Israel hath already testified to the like thereof and hath believed, and ye are too proud (what plight is yours)? Lo! Allah guideth not wrong-doing folk.
tr.yusufali: Say: "See ye? If (this teaching) be from Allah, and ye reject it, and a witness from among the Children of Israel testifies to its similarity (with earlier scripture), and has believed while ye are arrogant, (how unjust ye are!) truly, Allah guides not a people unjust."
tr.khattab: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Consider if this ˹Quran˺ is ˹truly˺ from Allah and you deny it, and a witness from the Children of Israel attests to it and then believes, whereas you act arrogantly. Surely Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.”

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًۭا مَّا سَبَقُونَآ إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَٰذَآ إِفْكٌۭ قَدِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."
tr.pickthall: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe: If it had been (any) good, they would not have been before us in attaining it. And since they will not be guided by it, they say: This is an ancient lie;
tr.yusufali: The Unbelievers say of those who believe: "If (this Message) were a good thing, (such men) would not have gone to it first, before us!" And seeing that they guide not themselves thereby, they will say, "this is an (old,) falsehood!"
tr.khattab: The disbelievers say of the believers, “Had it been ˹something˺ good, they would not have beaten us to it.” Now since they reject its guidance, they will say, “˹This is˺ an ancient fabrication!”

ayahs.ar: وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًۭا وَرَحْمَةًۭ ۚ وَهَٰذَا كِتَٰبٌۭ مُّصَدِّقٌۭ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لِّيُنذِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.
tr.pickthall: When before it there was the Scripture of Moses, an example and a mercy; and this is a confirming Scripture in the Arabic language, that it may warn those who do wrong and bring good tidings for the righteous.
tr.yusufali: And before this, was the Book of Moses as a guide and a mercy: And this Book confirms (it) in the Arabic tongue; to admonish the unjust, and as Glad Tidings to those who do right.
tr.khattab: And before this ˹Quran˺ the Book of Moses was ˹revealed as˺ a guide and mercy. And this Book is a confirmation, in the Arabic tongue, to warn those who do wrong, and as good news to those who do good

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا ٱللَّهُ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and thereafter walk aright, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.
tr.yusufali: Verily those who say, "Our Lord is Allah," and remain firm (on that Path),- on them shall be no fear, nor shall they grieve.
tr.khattab: Surely those who say, “Our Lord is Allah,” and then remain steadfast—there will be no fear for them, nor will they grieve

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
tr.pickthall: Such are rightful owners of the Garden, immortal therein, as a reward for what they used to do.
tr.yusufali: Such shall be Companions of the Gardens, dwelling therein (for aye): a recompense for their (good) deeds.
tr.khattab: It is they who will be the residents of Paradise, staying there forever, as a reward for what they used to do

ayahs.ar: وَوَصَّيْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ إِحْسَٰنًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُۥ كُرْهًۭا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًۭا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُۥ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ ثَلَٰثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةًۭ قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِى فِى ذُرِّيَّتِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
tr.pickthall: And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee).
tr.yusufali: We have enjoined on man kindness to his parents: In pain did his mother bear him, and in pain did she give him birth. The carrying of the (child) to his weaning is (a period of) thirty months. At length, when he reaches the age of full strength and attains forty years, he says, "O my Lord! Grant me that I may be grateful for Thy favour which Thou has bestowed upon me, and upon both my parents, and that I may work righteousness such as Thou mayest approve; and be gracious to me in my issue. Truly have I turned to Thee and truly do I bow (to Thee) in Islam."
tr.khattab: We have commanded people to honour their parents. Their mothers bore them in hardship and delivered them in hardship. Their ˹period of˺ bearing and weaning is thirty months. In time, when the child reaches their prime at the age of forty, they pray, “My Lord! Inspire me to ˹always˺ be thankful for Your favours which You blessed me and my parents with, and to do good deeds that please You. And instil righteousness in my offspring. I truly repent to You, and I truly submit ˹to Your Will˺.”

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱلصِّدْقِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
