But Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing.
tr.pickthall: When those who disbelieve had set up in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance, then Allah sent down His peace of reassurance upon His messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of self-restraint, for they were worthy of it and meet for it. And Allah is Aware of all things.
tr.yusufali: While the Unbelievers got up in their hearts heat and cant - the heat and cant of ignorance,- Allah sent down His Tranquillity to his Messenger and to the Believers, and made them stick close to the command of self-restraint; and well were they entitled to it and worthy of it. And Allah has full knowledge of all things.
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when the disbelievers had filled their hearts with pride—the pride of ˹pre-Islamic˺ ignorance—then Allah sent down His serenity upon His Messenger and the believers, inspiring them to uphold the declaration of faith, for they were better entitled and more worthy of it. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things

ayahs.ar: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًا

tr.sahih: Certainly has Allah showed to His Messenger the vision in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Haram, if Allah wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
tr.pickthall: Allah hath fulfilled the vision for His messenger in very truth. Ye shall indeed enter the Inviolable Place of Worship, if Allah will, secure, (having your hair) shaven and cut, not fearing. But He knoweth that which ye know not, and hath given you a near victory beforehand.
tr.yusufali: Truly did Allah fulfil the vision for His Messenger: ye shall enter the Sacred Mosque, if Allah wills, with minds secure, heads shaved, hair cut short, and without fear. For He knew what ye knew not, and He granted, besides this, a speedy victory.
tr.khattab: Indeed, Allah will fulfil His Messenger’s vision in all truth: Allah willing, you will surely enter the Sacred Mosque, in security—˹some with˺ heads shaved and ˹others with˺ hair shortened—without fear. He knew what you did not know, so He first granted you the triumph at hand

ayahs.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا

tr.sahih: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.
tr.pickthall: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion. And Allah sufficeth as a Witness.
tr.yusufali: It is He Who has sent His Messenger with Guidance and the Religion of Truth, to proclaim it over all religion: and enough is Allah for a Witness.
tr.khattab: He is the One Who has sent His Messenger with ˹right˺ guidance and the religion of truth, making it prevail over all others. And sufficient is Allah as a Witness

ayahs.ar: مُّحَمَّدٌۭ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًۭا سُجَّدًۭا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا

tr.sahih: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allah and [His] pleasure. Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
tr.pickthall: Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. And those with him are hard against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. Thou (O Muhammad) seest them bowing and falling prostrate (in worship), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) acceptance. The mark of them is on their foreheads from the traces of prostration. Such is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel - like as sown corn that sendeth forth its shoot and strengtheneth it and riseth firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage the disbelievers with (the sight of) them. Allah hath promised, unto such of them as believe and do good works, forgiveness and immense reward.
tr.yusufali: Muhammad is the messenger of Allah; and those who are with him are strong against Unbelievers, (but) compassionate amongst each other. Thou wilt see them bow and prostrate themselves (in prayer), seeking Grace from Allah and (His) Good Pleasure. On their faces are their marks, (being) the traces of their prostration. This is their similitude in the Taurat; and their similitude in the Gospel is: like a seed which sends forth its blade, then makes it strong; it then becomes thick, and it stands on its own stem, (filling) the sowers with wonder and delight. As a result, it fills the Unbelievers with rage at them. Allah has promised those among them who believe and do righteous deeds forgiveness, and a great Reward.
tr.khattab: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah. And those with him are firm with the disbelievers and compassionate with one another. You see them bowing and prostrating ˹in prayer˺, seeking Allah’s bounty and pleasure. The sign ˹of brightness can be seen˺ on their faces from the trace of prostrating ˹in prayer˺. This is their description in the Torah. And their parable in the Gospel is that of a seed that sprouts its ˹tiny˺ branches, making it strong. Then it becomes thick, standing firmly on its stem, to the delight of the planters—in this way Allah makes the believers a source of dismay for the disbelievers. To those of them who believe and do good, Allah has promised forgiveness and a great reward

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
tr.pickthall: O ye who believe! Be not forward in the presence of Allah and His messenger, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.
tr.yusufali: O Ye who believe! Put not yourselves forward before Allah and His Messenger; but fear Allah: for Allah is He Who hears and knows all things.
tr.khattab: O believers! Do not proceed ˹in any matter˺ before ˹a decree from˺ Allah and His Messenger. And fear Allah. Surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

tr.sahih: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
tr.pickthall: O ye who believe! Lift not up your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout when speaking to him as ye shout one to another, lest your works be rendered vain while ye perceive not.
tr.yusufali: O ye who believe! Raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor speak aloud to him in talk, as ye may speak aloud to one another, lest your deeds become vain and ye perceive not.
tr.khattab: O believers! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor speak loudly to him as you do to one another, or your deeds will become void while you are unaware

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
tr.pickthall: Lo! they who subdue their voices in the presence of the messenger of Allah, those are they whose hearts Allah hath proven unto righteousness. Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward.
tr.yusufali: Those that lower their voices in the presence of Allah's Messenger,- their hearts has Allah tested for piety: for them is Forgiveness and a great Reward.
tr.khattab: Indeed, those who lower their voices in the presence of Allah’s Messenger are the ones whose hearts Allah has refined for righteousness. They will have forgiveness and a great reward

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muhammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who call thee from behind the private apartments, most of them have no sense.
tr.yusufali: Those who shout out to thee from without the inner apartments - most of them lack understanding.
tr.khattab: Indeed, most of those who call out to you ˹O Prophet˺ from outside ˹your˺ private quarters have no understanding ˹of manners˺

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًۭا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr.pickthall: And if they had had patience till thou camest forth unto them, it had been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: If only they had patience until thou couldst come out to them, it would be best for them: but Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: Had they been patient until you could come out to them, it would have certainly been better for them. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍۢ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ

tr.sahih: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
tr.pickthall: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.
tr.yusufali: O ye who believe! If a wicked person comes to you with any news, ascertain the truth, lest ye harm people unwittingly, and afterwards become full of repentance for what ye have done.
tr.khattab: O believers, if an evildoer brings you any news, verify ˹it˺ so you do not harm people unknowingly, becoming regretful for what you have done

ayahs.ar: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ

tr.sahih: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
tr.pickthall: And know that the messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in much of the government, ye would surely be in trouble; but Allah hath endeared the faith to you and hath beautified it in your hearts, and hath made disbelief and lewdness and rebellion hateful unto you. Such are they who are the rightly guided.
tr.yusufali: And know that among you is Allah's Messenger: were he, in many matters, to follow your (wishes), ye would certainly fall into misfortune: But Allah has endeared the Faith to you, and has made it beautiful in your hearts, and He has made hateful to you Unbelief, wickedness, and rebellion: such indeed are those who walk in righteousness;-
tr.khattab: And keep in mind that Allah’s Messenger is ˹still˺ in your midst. If he were to yield to you in many matters, you would surely suffer ˹the consequences˺. But Allah has endeared faith to you, making it appealing in your hearts. And He has made disbelief, rebelliousness, and disobedience detestable to you. Those are the ones rightly guided

ayahs.ar: فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: [It is] as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
tr.pickthall: (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise.
tr.yusufali: A Grace and Favour from Allah; and Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
tr.khattab: ˹This is˺ a bounty and a blessing from Allah. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise

ayahs.ar: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ

tr.sahih: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.
tr.pickthall: And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.
tr.yusufali: If two parties among the Believers fall into a quarrel, make ye peace between them: but if one of them transgresses beyond bounds against the other, then fight ye (all) against the one that transgresses until it complies with the command of Allah; but if it complies, then make peace between them with justice, and be fair: for Allah loves those who are fair (and just).
tr.khattab: And if two groups of believers fight each other, then make peace between them. But if one of them transgresses against the other, then fight against the transgressing group until they ˹are willing to˺ submit to the rule of Allah. If they do so, then make peace between both ˹groups˺ in all fairness and act justly. Surely Allah loves those who uphold justice

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌۭ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

tr.sahih: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
tr.pickthall: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.
tr.yusufali: The Believers are but a single Brotherhood: So make peace and reconciliation between your two (contending) brothers; and fear Allah, that ye may receive Mercy.
tr.khattab: The believers are but one brotherhood, so make peace between your brothers. And be mindful of Allah so you may be shown mercy

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌۭ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

tr.sahih: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
tr.pickthall: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.
tr.yusufali: O ye who believe! Let not some men among you laugh at others: It may be that the (latter) are better than the (former): Nor let some women laugh at others: It may be that the (latter are better than the (former): Nor defame nor be sarcastic to each other, nor call each other by (offensive) nicknames: Ill-seeming is a name connoting wickedness, (to be used of one) after he has believed: And those who do not desist are (indeed) doing wrong.
tr.khattab: O believers! Do not let some ˹men˺ ridicule others, they may be better than them, nor let ˹some˺ women ridicule other women, they may be better than them. Do not defame one another, nor call each other by offensive nicknames. How evil it is to act rebelliously after having faith! And whoever does not repent, it is they who are the ˹true˺ wrongdoers

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌۭ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًۭا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.
tr.pickthall: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: O ye who believe! Avoid suspicion as much (as possible): for suspicion in some cases is a sin: And spy not on each other behind their backs. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Nay, ye would abhor it... But fear Allah: For Allah is Oft-Returning, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: O believers! Avoid many suspicions, ˹for˺ indeed, some suspicions are sinful. And do not spy, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of their dead brother? You would despise that! And fear Allah. Surely Allah is ˹the˺ Accepter of Repentance, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍۢ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ شُعُوبًۭا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۭ

tr.sahih: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted.
tr.pickthall: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.
tr.yusufali: O mankind! We created you from a single (pair) of a male and a female, and made you into nations and tribes, that ye may know each other (not that ye may despise (each other). Verily the most honoured of you in the sight of Allah is (he who is) the most righteous of you. And Allah has full knowledge and is well acquainted (with all things).
tr.khattab: O humanity! Indeed, We created you from a male and a female, and made you into peoples and tribes so that you may ˹get to˺ know one another. Surely the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous among you. Allah is truly All-Knowing, All-Aware

ayahs.ar: ۞ قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ

tr.sahih: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."
tr.pickthall: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: The desert Arabs say, "We believe." Say, "Ye have no faith; but ye (only) say, 'We have submitted our wills to Allah,' For not yet has Faith entered your hearts. But if ye obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not belittle aught of your deeds: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
tr.khattab: ˹Some of˺ the nomadic Arabs say, “We believe.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You have not believed. But say, ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered your hearts. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger ˹wholeheartedly˺, He will not discount anything from ˹the reward of˺ your deeds. Allah is truly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ

tr.sahih: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allah. It is those who are the truthful.
tr.pickthall: The (true) believers are those only who believe in Allah and His messenger and afterward doubt not, but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Such are the sincere.
tr.yusufali: Only those are Believers who have believed in Allah and His Messenger, and have never since doubted, but have striven with their belongings and their persons in the Cause of Allah: Such are the sincere ones.
tr.khattab: The ˹true˺ believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger—never doubting—and strive with their wealth and their lives in the cause of Allah. They are the ones true in faith

ayahs.ar: قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Say, "Would you acquaint Allah with your religion while Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is Knowing of all things?"
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things?
tr.yusufali: Say: "What! Will ye instruct Allah about your religion? But Allah knows all that is in the heavens and on earth: He has full knowledge of all things.
tr.khattab: Say, “Do you inform Allah of your faith, when Allah ˹already˺ knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth? And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.”

ayahs.ar: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَٰمَكُم ۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islam. Say, "Do not consider your Islam a favor to me. Rather, Allah has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."
tr.pickthall: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.
tr.yusufali: They impress on thee as a favour that they have embraced Islam. Say, "Count not your Islam as a favour upon me: Nay, Allah has conferred a favour upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if ye be true and sincere.
tr.khattab: They regard their acceptance of Islam as a favour to you. Tell ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Do not regard your Islam as a favour to me. Rather, it is Allah Who has done you a favour by guiding you to the faith, if ˹indeed˺ you are faithful

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, Allah knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.
tr.pickthall: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
tr.yusufali: "Verily Allah knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth: and Allah Sees well all that ye do."
tr.khattab: Surely Allah knows the unseen of the heavens and earth. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.”

ayahs.ar: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ

tr.sahih: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...
tr.pickthall: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,
tr.yusufali: Qaf: By the Glorious Qur'an (Thou art Allah's Messenger).
tr.khattab: Qãf. By the glorious Quran

ayahs.ar: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

tr.sahih: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:
tr.yusufali: But they wonder that there has come to them a Warner from among themselves. So the Unbelievers say: "This is a wonderful thing!
tr.khattab: ˹All will be resurrected,˺ yet the deniers are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves ˹warning of resurrection˺. So the disbelievers say, “This is an astonishing thing

ayahs.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."
tr.pickthall: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!
tr.yusufali: "What! When we die and become dust, (shall we live again?) That is a (sort of) return far (from our understanding)."
tr.khattab: ˹Will we be returned to life,˺ when we are dead and reduced to dust? Such a return is impossible.”

ayahs.ar: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ

tr.sahih: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
tr.pickthall: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.
tr.yusufali: We already know how much of them the earth takes away: With Us is a record guarding (the full account).
tr.khattab: We certainly know what the earth consumes of them ˹after their death˺, and with us is a well-preserved Record

ayahs.ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ

tr.sahih: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.
tr.yusufali: But they deny the Truth when it comes to them: so they are in a confused state.
tr.khattab: In fact, they reject the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ

tr.sahih: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
tr.pickthall: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?
tr.yusufali: Do they not look at the sky above them?- How We have made it and adorned it, and there are no flaws in it?
tr.khattab: Have they not then looked at the sky above them: how We built it and adorned it ˹with stars˺, leaving it flawless

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ

tr.sahih: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
tr.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,
tr.yusufali: And the earth- We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and produced therein every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs)-
tr.khattab: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and produced in it every type of pleasant plant—

ayahs.ar: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ

tr.sahih: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].
tr.pickthall: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.
tr.yusufali: To be observed and commemorated by every devotee turning (to Allah).
tr.khattab: ˹all as˺ an insight and a reminder to every servant who turns ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ

tr.sahih: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
tr.pickthall: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,
tr.yusufali: And We send down from the sky rain charted with blessing, and We produce therewith gardens and Grain for harvests;
tr.khattab: And We send down blessed rain from the sky, bringing forth gardens and grains for harvest

ayahs.ar: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
tr.pickthall: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,
tr.yusufali: And tall (and stately) palm-trees, with shoots of fruit-stalks, piled one over another;-
tr.khattab: and towering palm trees ˹loaded˺ with clustered fruit

ayahs.ar: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ

tr.sahih: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
tr.pickthall: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.
tr.yusufali: As sustenance for (Allah's) Servants;- and We give (new) life therewith to land that is dead: Thus will be the Resurrection.
tr.khattab: ˹as˺ a provision for ˹Our˺ servants. And with this ˹rain˺ We revive a lifeless land. Similar is the emergence ˹from the graves˺

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

tr.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
tr.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,
tr.yusufali: Before them was denied (the Hereafter) by the People of Noah, the Companions of the Rass, the Thamud,
tr.khattab: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth,˺ as did the people of the Water-pit, Thamûd

ayahs.ar: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ

tr.sahih: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
tr.pickthall: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
tr.yusufali: The 'Ad, Pharaoh, the brethren of Lut,
tr.khattab: ’Ȃd, Pharaoh, the kinfolk of Lot

ayahs.ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

tr.sahih: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
tr.pickthall: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.
tr.yusufali: The Companions of the Wood, and the People of Tubba'; each one (of them) rejected the messengers, and My warning was duly fulfilled (in them).
tr.khattab: the residents of the Forest, and the people of Tubba’. Each rejected ˹their˺ messenger, so My warning was fulfilled

ayahs.ar: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ

tr.sahih: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
tr.pickthall: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
tr.yusufali: Were We then weary with the first Creation, that they should be in confused doubt about a new Creation?
tr.khattab: Were We incapable of creating ˹them˺ the first time? In fact, they are in doubt about ˹their˺ re-creation

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ

tr.sahih: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
tr.pickthall: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
tr.yusufali: It was We Who created man, and We know what dark suggestions his soul makes to him: for We are nearer to him than (his) jugular vein.
tr.khattab: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ created humankind and ˹fully˺ know what their souls whisper to them, and We are closer to them than ˹their˺ jugular vein

ayahs.ar: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
tr.pickthall: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,
tr.yusufali: Behold, two (guardian angels) appointed to learn (his doings) learn (and noted them), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
tr.khattab: As the two recording-angels—˹one˺ sitting to the right, and ˹the other to˺ the left—note ˹everything˺

ayahs.ar: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
tr.pickthall: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.
tr.yusufali: Not a word does he utter but there is a sentinel by him, ready (to note it).
tr.khattab: not a word does a person utter without having a ˹vigilant˺ observer ready ˹to write it down˺

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

tr.sahih: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
tr.pickthall: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.
tr.yusufali: And the stupor of death will bring Truth (before his eyes): "This was the thing which thou wast trying to escape!"
tr.khattab: ˹Ultimately,˺ with the throes of death will come the truth. This is what you were trying to escape

ayahs.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ

tr.sahih: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
tr.pickthall: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.
tr.yusufali: And the Trumpet shall be blown: that will be the Day whereof Warning (had been given).
tr.khattab: And the Trumpet will be blown. This is the Day ˹you were˺ warned of

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
tr.pickthall: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.
tr.yusufali: And there will come forth every soul: with each will be an (angel) to drive, and an (angel) to bear witness.
tr.khattab: Each soul will come forth with an angel to drive it and another to testify

ayahs.ar: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
tr.pickthall: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.
tr.yusufali: (It will be said:) "Thou wast heedless of this; now have We removed thy veil, and sharp is thy sight this Day!"
tr.khattab: ˹It will be said to the denier,˺ “You were totally heedless of this. Now We have lifted this veil of yours, so Today your sight is sharp!”

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ

tr.sahih: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
tr.pickthall: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).
tr.yusufali: And his Companion will say: "Here is (his Record) ready with me!"
tr.khattab: And one’s accompanying-angel will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”

ayahs.ar: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ

tr.sahih: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
tr.pickthall: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,
tr.yusufali: (The sentence will be:) "Throw, throw into Hell every contumacious Rejecter (of Allah)!-
tr.khattab: ˹It will be said to both angels,˺ “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever

ayahs.ar: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ

tr.sahih: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
tr.pickthall: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,
tr.yusufali: "Who forbade what was good, transgressed all bounds, cast doubts and suspicions;
tr.khattab: withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ

tr.sahih: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
tr.pickthall: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.
tr.yusufali: "Who set up another god beside Allah: Throw him into a severe penalty."
tr.khattab: who set up another god with Allah. So cast them into the severe punishment.”

ayahs.ar: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

tr.sahih: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
tr.pickthall: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
tr.yusufali: His Companion will say: "Our Lord! I did not make him transgress, but he was (himself) far astray."
tr.khattab: One’s ˹devilish˺ associate will say, “Our Lord! I did not make them transgress. Rather, they were far astray ˹on their own˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ

tr.sahih: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
tr.pickthall: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.
tr.yusufali: He will say: "Dispute not with each other in My Presence: I had already in advance sent you Warning.
tr.khattab: Allah will respond, “Do not dispute in My presence, since I had already given you a warning

ayahs.ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

tr.sahih: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
tr.pickthall: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.
tr.yusufali: "The Word changes not before Me, and I do not the least injustice to My Servants."
tr.khattab: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to ˹My˺ creation.”

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ

tr.sahih: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
tr.pickthall: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
tr.yusufali: One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
tr.khattab: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will ask Hell, “Are you full ˹yet˺?” And it will respond, “Are there any more?”

ayahs.ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ

tr.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
tr.pickthall: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.
tr.yusufali: And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
tr.khattab: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ

tr.sahih: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
tr.pickthall: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,
tr.yusufali: (A voice will say:) "This is what was promised for you,- for every one who turned (to Allah) in sincere repentance, who kept (His Law),
tr.khattab: ˹And it will be said to them,˺ “This is what you were promised, for whoever ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺ and kept up ˹His commandments˺—

ayahs.ar: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ

tr.sahih: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
tr.pickthall: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.
tr.yusufali: "Who feared (Allah) Most Gracious Unseen, and brought a heart turned in devotion (to Him):
tr.khattab: who were in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing ˹Him˺, and have come with a heart turning ˹only to Him˺

ayahs.ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ

tr.sahih: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
tr.pickthall: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
tr.yusufali: "Enter ye therein in Peace and Security; this is a Day of Eternal Life!"
tr.khattab: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternal life!”

ayahs.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
tr.pickthall: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.
tr.yusufali: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.
tr.khattab: There they will have whatever they desire, and with Us is ˹even˺ more

ayahs.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

tr.sahih: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
tr.pickthall: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?
tr.yusufali: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?
tr.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, who were far mightier than them. Then ˹when the torment came,˺ they ˹desperately˺ sought refuge in the land. ˹But˺ was there any escape

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
tr.pickthall: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.
tr.yusufali: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).
tr.khattab: Surely in this is a reminder for whoever has a ˹mindful˺ heart and lends an attentive ear

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
tr.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
tr.yusufali: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue

ayahs.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ

tr.sahih: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
tr.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
tr.yusufali: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
tr.khattab: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ

tr.sahih: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
tr.pickthall: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.
tr.yusufali: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.
tr.khattab: And glorify Him during part of the night and after the prayers

ayahs.ar: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ

tr.sahih: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
tr.pickthall: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
tr.yusufali: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-
tr.khattab: And listen! On the Day the caller will call out from a near place

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ

tr.sahih: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
tr.pickthall: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
tr.yusufali: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.
tr.khattab: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
tr.pickthall: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.
tr.yusufali: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-
tr.khattab: It is certainly We Who give life and cause death. And to Us is the final return

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ

tr.sahih: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
tr.pickthall: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).
tr.yusufali: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.
tr.khattab: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the earth will split open, letting them rush forth. That will be an easy gathering for Us

ayahs.ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

tr.sahih: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
tr.pickthall: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
tr.yusufali: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur'an such as fear My Warning!
tr.khattab: We know best what they say. And you ˹O Prophet˺ are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺. So remind with the Quran ˹only˺ those who fear My warning

ayahs.ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا

tr.sahih: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
tr.pickthall: By those that winnow with a winnowing
tr.yusufali: By the (Winds) that scatter broadcast;
tr.khattab: By the winds scattering ˹dust˺

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
tr.pickthall: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)
tr.yusufali: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;
tr.khattab: and ˹the clouds˺ loaded with rain

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And those [ships] sailing with ease
tr.pickthall: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)
tr.yusufali: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;
tr.khattab: and ˹the ships˺ gliding with ease

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا

tr.sahih: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
tr.pickthall: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,
tr.yusufali: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-
tr.khattab: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
tr.pickthall: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,
tr.yusufali: Verily that which ye are promised is true;
tr.khattab: Indeed, what you are promised is true

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ

tr.sahih: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
tr.pickthall: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.
tr.yusufali: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.
tr.khattab: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ

tr.sahih: By the heaven containing pathways,
tr.pickthall: By the heaven full of paths,
tr.yusufali: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,
tr.khattab: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
tr.pickthall: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).
tr.yusufali: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,
tr.khattab: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺

ayahs.ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ

tr.sahih: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
tr.pickthall: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.
tr.yusufali: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.
tr.khattab: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it

ayahs.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ

tr.sahih: Destroyed are the falsifiers
tr.pickthall: Accursed be the conjecturers
tr.yusufali: Woe to the falsehood-mongers,-
tr.khattab: Condemned are the liars—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ

tr.sahih: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
tr.pickthall: Who are careless in an abyss!
tr.yusufali: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:
tr.khattab: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless

ayahs.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
tr.pickthall: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?
tr.yusufali: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"
tr.khattab: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

tr.sahih: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
tr.pickthall: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
tr.yusufali: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

ayahs.ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

tr.sahih: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
tr.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
tr.yusufali: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
tr.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
tr.yusufali: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
tr.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs

ayahs.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
tr.yusufali: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
tr.khattab: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺

ayahs.ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

tr.sahih: They used to sleep but little of the night,
tr.pickthall: They used to sleep but little of the night,
tr.yusufali: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
tr.khattab: they used to sleep only little in the night

ayahs.ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
tr.pickthall: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
tr.yusufali: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
tr.khattab: and pray for forgiveness before dawn

ayahs.ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

tr.sahih: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
tr.pickthall: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
tr.yusufali: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
tr.khattab: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor

ayahs.ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
tr.pickthall: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
tr.yusufali: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
tr.khattab: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith

ayahs.ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
tr.pickthall: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
tr.yusufali: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
tr.khattab: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see

ayahs.ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
tr.pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
tr.yusufali: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
tr.khattab: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised

ayahs.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
tr.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
tr.yusufali: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
tr.khattab: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak

ayahs.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

tr.sahih: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
tr.pickthall: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
tr.yusufali: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
tr.khattab: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ

tr.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
tr.pickthall: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
tr.yusufali: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."
tr.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”

ayahs.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
tr.pickthall: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;
tr.yusufali: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,
tr.khattab: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

tr.sahih: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
tr.pickthall: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?
tr.yusufali: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"
tr.khattab: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”

ayahs.ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
tr.pickthall: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
tr.yusufali: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
tr.khattab: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him good news of a knowledgeable son

ayahs.ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
tr.pickthall: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
tr.yusufali: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"
tr.khattab: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
tr.pickthall: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
tr.yusufali: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."
tr.khattab: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”

ayahs.ar: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
tr.pickthall: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
tr.yusufali: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"
tr.khattab: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O messengers?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
tr.pickthall: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
tr.yusufali: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-
tr.khattab: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people

ayahs.ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: To send down upon them stones of clay,
tr.pickthall: That we may send upon them stones of clay,
tr.yusufali: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),
tr.khattab: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay

ayahs.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

tr.sahih: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
tr.pickthall: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
tr.yusufali: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."
tr.khattab: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

ayahs.ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
tr.pickthall: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.
tr.yusufali: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,
tr.khattab: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city

ayahs.ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
tr.pickthall: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).
tr.yusufali: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:
tr.khattab: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

tr.sahih: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
tr.pickthall: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.
tr.yusufali: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.
tr.khattab: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment

ayahs.ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
tr.pickthall: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
tr.yusufali: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.
tr.khattab: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ

tr.sahih: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
tr.pickthall: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
tr.yusufali: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"
tr.khattab: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
tr.pickthall: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
tr.yusufali: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
tr.khattab: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy

ayahs.ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ

tr.sahih: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
tr.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.
tr.yusufali: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:
tr.khattab: And in ˹the story of˺ ’Âd ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind

ayahs.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

tr.sahih: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
tr.pickthall: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
tr.yusufali: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
tr.khattab: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes

ayahs.ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
tr.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
tr.yusufali: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"
tr.khattab: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”

ayahs.ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

tr.sahih: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
tr.pickthall: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
tr.yusufali: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.
tr.khattab: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on

ayahs.ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
tr.pickthall: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
tr.yusufali: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
tr.khattab: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped

ayahs.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
tr.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.
tr.yusufali: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.
tr.khattab: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

tr.sahih: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
tr.pickthall: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
tr.yusufali: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of pace.
tr.khattab: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ

tr.sahih: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
tr.pickthall: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
tr.yusufali: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!
tr.khattab: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out

ayahs.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
tr.pickthall: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
tr.yusufali: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.
tr.khattab: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful

ayahs.ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
tr.pickthall: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
tr.yusufali: Hasten ye then (at once) to Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
tr.khattab: So ˹proclaim, O Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
tr.pickthall: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
tr.yusufali: And make not another an object of worship with Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
tr.khattab: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

tr.sahih: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
tr.pickthall: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
tr.yusufali: Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
tr.khattab: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”

ayahs.ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ

tr.sahih: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
tr.pickthall: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.
tr.yusufali: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
tr.khattab: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ

tr.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
tr.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,
tr.yusufali: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.
tr.khattab: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed

ayahs.ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
tr.pickthall: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
tr.yusufali: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
tr.khattab: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

tr.sahih: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
tr.pickthall: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
tr.yusufali: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.
tr.khattab: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me

ayahs.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

tr.sahih: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
tr.pickthall: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
tr.yusufali: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
tr.khattab: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
tr.pickthall: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
tr.yusufali: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
tr.khattab: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

tr.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
tr.pickthall: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
tr.yusufali: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
tr.khattab: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺

ayahs.ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
tr.pickthall: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
tr.yusufali: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
tr.khattab: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of

ayahs.ar: وَٱلطُّورِ

tr.sahih: By the mount
tr.pickthall: By the Mount,
tr.yusufali: By the Mount (of Revelation);
tr.khattab: By Mount Ṭûr

ayahs.ar: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ

tr.sahih: And [by] a Book inscribed
tr.pickthall: And a Scripture inscribed
tr.yusufali: By a Decree inscribed
tr.khattab: And by the Book written

ayahs.ar: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ

tr.sahih: In parchment spread open
tr.pickthall: On fine parchment unrolled,
tr.yusufali: In a Scroll unfolded;
tr.khattab: on open pages ˹for all to read˺

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the frequented House
tr.pickthall: And the House frequented,
tr.yusufali: By the much-frequented Fane;
tr.khattab: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the heaven raised high
tr.pickthall: And the roof exalted,
tr.yusufali: By the Canopy Raised High;
tr.khattab: And by the canopy raised ˹high˺

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
tr.pickthall: And the sea kept filled,
tr.yusufali: And by the Ocean filled with Swell;-
tr.khattab: And by the seas set on fire

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
tr.pickthall: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;
tr.yusufali: Verily, the Doom of thy Lord will indeed come to pass;-
tr.khattab: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—

ayahs.ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ

tr.sahih: Of it there is no preventer.
tr.pickthall: There is none that can ward it off.
tr.yusufali: There is none can avert it;-
tr.khattab: none will avert it—

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا

tr.sahih: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
tr.pickthall: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
tr.yusufali: On the Day when the firmament will be in dreadful commotion.
tr.khattab: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently

ayahs.ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
tr.pickthall: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,
tr.yusufali: And the mountains will fly hither and thither.
tr.khattab: and the mountains will be blown away entirely

ayahs.ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

tr.sahih: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
tr.pickthall: Then woe that day unto the deniers
tr.yusufali: Then woe that Day to those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood;-
tr.khattab: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ

tr.sahih: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
tr.pickthall: Who play in talk of grave matters;
tr.yusufali: That play (and paddle) in shallow trifles.
tr.khattab: those who amuse themselves with falsehood

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

tr.sahih: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
tr.pickthall: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell
tr.yusufali: That Day shall they be thrust down to the Fire of Hell, irresistibly.
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell

ayahs.ar: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

tr.sahih: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
tr.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.
tr.yusufali: "This:, it will be said, "Is the Fire,- which ye were wont to deny!
tr.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny

ayahs.ar: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
tr.pickthall: Is this magic, or do ye not see?
tr.yusufali: "Is this then a fake, or is it ye that do not see?
tr.khattab: Is this magic, or do you not see

ayahs.ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
tr.pickthall: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
tr.yusufali: "Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds."
tr.khattab: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,
tr.yusufali: As to the Righteous, they will be in Gardens, and in Happiness,-
tr.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss

ayahs.ar: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
tr.yusufali: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire.
tr.khattab: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire

ayahs.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
tr.pickthall: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,
tr.yusufali: (To them will be said:) "Eat and drink ye, with profit and health, because of your (good) deeds."
tr.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
tr.pickthall: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
