tr.yusufali: They will recline (with ease) on Thrones (of dignity) arranged in ranks; and We shall join them to Companions, with beautiful big and lustrous eyes.
tr.khattab: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
tr.pickthall: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.
tr.yusufali: And those who believe and whose families follow them in Faith,- to them shall We join their families: Nor shall We deprive them (of the fruit) of aught of their works: (Yet) is each individual in pledge for his deeds.
tr.khattab: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed

ayahs.ar: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

tr.sahih: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
tr.pickthall: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
tr.yusufali: And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire.
tr.khattab: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire

ayahs.ar: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
tr.pickthall: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
tr.yusufali: They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill.
tr.khattab: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ

tr.sahih: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
tr.pickthall: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
tr.yusufali: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
tr.khattab: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls

ayahs.ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

tr.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
tr.pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
tr.yusufali: They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry.
tr.khattab: They will turn to one another inquisitively

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ

tr.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].
tr.pickthall: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;
tr.yusufali: They will say: "Aforetime, we were not without fear for the sake of our people.
tr.khattab: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people

ayahs.ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ

tr.sahih: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
tr.pickthall: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.
tr.yusufali: "But Allah has been good to us, and has delivered us from the Penalty of the Scorching Wind.
tr.khattab: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
tr.pickthall: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.
tr.yusufali: "Truly, we did call unto Him from of old: truly it is He, the Beneficent, the Merciful!"
tr.khattab: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”

ayahs.ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

tr.sahih: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
tr.pickthall: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
tr.yusufali: Therefore proclaim thou the praises (of thy Lord): for by the Grace of thy Lord, thou art no (vulgar) soothsayer, nor art thou one possessed.
tr.khattab: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ

tr.sahih: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
tr.pickthall: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?
tr.yusufali: Or do they say:- "A Poet! we await for him some calamity (hatched) by Time!"
tr.khattab: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

tr.sahih: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.
tr.yusufali: Say thou: "Await ye!- I too will wait along with you!"
tr.khattab: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”

ayahs.ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
tr.pickthall: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?
tr.yusufali: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds?
tr.khattab: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
tr.pickthall: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!
tr.yusufali: Or do they say, "He fabricated the (Message)"? Nay, they have no faith!
tr.khattab: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith

ayahs.ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
tr.pickthall: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.
tr.yusufali: Let them then produce a recital like unto it,- If (it be) they speak the truth!
tr.khattab: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true

ayahs.ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
tr.pickthall: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?
tr.yusufali: Were they created of nothing, or were they themselves the creators?
tr.khattab: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators

ayahs.ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
tr.pickthall: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
tr.yusufali: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, they have no firm belief.
tr.khattab: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺

ayahs.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
tr.pickthall: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?
tr.yusufali: Or are the Treasures of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (of affairs)?
tr.khattab: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
tr.pickthall: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
tr.yusufali: Or have they a ladder, by which they can (climb up to heaven and) listen (to its secrets)? Then let (such a) listener of theirs produce a manifest proof.
tr.khattab: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ

tr.sahih: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
tr.pickthall: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?
tr.yusufali: Or has He only daughters and ye have sons?
tr.khattab: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons

ayahs.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
tr.pickthall: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?
tr.yusufali: Or is it that thou dost ask for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
tr.khattab: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt

ayahs.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
tr.pickthall: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?
tr.yusufali: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down?
tr.khattab: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
tr.pickthall: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!
tr.yusufali: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy Allah are themselves involved in a Plot!
tr.khattab: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
tr.pickthall: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!
tr.yusufali: Or have they a god other than Allah? Exalted is Allah far above the things they associate with Him!
tr.khattab: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ

tr.sahih: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
tr.pickthall: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
tr.yusufali: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
tr.khattab: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”

ayahs.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ

tr.sahih: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
tr.pickthall: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,
tr.yusufali: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror),-
tr.khattab: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
tr.pickthall: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
tr.yusufali: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them.
tr.khattab: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
tr.pickthall: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.
tr.yusufali: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.
tr.khattab: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know

ayahs.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

tr.sahih: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
tr.pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
tr.yusufali: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
tr.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ

tr.sahih: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
tr.pickthall: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.
tr.yusufali: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars!
tr.khattab: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars

ayahs.ar: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ

tr.sahih: By the star when it descends,
tr.pickthall: By the Star when it setteth,
tr.yusufali: By the Star when it goes down,-
tr.khattab: By the stars when they fade away

ayahs.ar: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ

tr.sahih: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
tr.pickthall: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;
tr.yusufali: Your Companion is neither astray nor being misled.
tr.khattab: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
tr.pickthall: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.
tr.yusufali: Nor does he say (aught) of (his own) Desire.
tr.khattab: Nor does he speak of his own whims

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ

tr.sahih: It is not but a revelation revealed,
tr.pickthall: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,
tr.yusufali: It is no less than inspiration sent down to him:
tr.khattab: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺

ayahs.ar: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ

tr.sahih: Taught to him by one intense in strength -
tr.pickthall: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,
tr.yusufali: He was taught by one Mighty in Power,
tr.khattab: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power

ayahs.ar: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ

tr.sahih: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
tr.pickthall: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view
tr.yusufali: Endued with Wisdom: for he appeared (in stately form);
tr.khattab: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

tr.sahih: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
tr.pickthall: When he was on the uppermost horizon.
tr.yusufali: While he was in the highest part of the horizon:
tr.khattab: while on the highest point above the horizon

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ

tr.sahih: Then he approached and descended
tr.pickthall: Then he drew nigh and came down
tr.yusufali: Then he approached and came closer,
tr.khattab: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close

ayahs.ar: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
tr.pickthall: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,
tr.yusufali: And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer;
tr.khattab: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less

ayahs.ar: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ

tr.sahih: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
tr.pickthall: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.
tr.yusufali: So did (Allah) convey the inspiration to His Servant- (conveyed) what He (meant) to convey.
tr.khattab: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺

ayahs.ar: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
tr.pickthall: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.
tr.yusufali: The (Prophet's) (mind and) heart in no way falsified that which he saw.
tr.khattab: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw

ayahs.ar: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ

tr.sahih: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
tr.pickthall: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?
tr.yusufali: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he saw?
tr.khattab: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: And he certainly saw him in another descent
tr.pickthall: And verily he saw him yet another time
tr.yusufali: For indeed he saw him at a second descent,
tr.khattab: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time

ayahs.ar: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ

tr.sahih: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
tr.pickthall: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,
tr.yusufali: Near the Lote-tree beyond which none may pass:
tr.khattab: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—

ayahs.ar: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -
tr.pickthall: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.
tr.yusufali: Near it is the Garden of Abode.
tr.khattab: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—

ayahs.ar: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ

tr.sahih: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
tr.pickthall: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,
tr.yusufali: Behold, the Lote-tree was shrouded (in mystery unspeakable!)
tr.khattab: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours

ayahs.ar: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ

tr.sahih: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
tr.pickthall: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.
tr.yusufali: (His) sight never swerved, nor did it go wrong!
tr.khattab: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
tr.pickthall: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.
tr.yusufali: For truly did he see, of the Signs of his Lord, the Greatest!
tr.khattab: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ

tr.sahih: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
tr.pickthall: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza
tr.yusufali: Have ye seen Lat. and 'Uzza,
tr.khattab: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lât and ’Uzza

ayahs.ar: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And Manat, the third - the other one?
tr.pickthall: And Manat, the third, the other?
tr.yusufali: And another, the third (goddess), Manat?
tr.khattab: and the third one, Manât, as well

ayahs.ar: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ

tr.sahih: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
tr.pickthall: Are yours the males and His the females?
tr.yusufali: What! for you the male sex, and for Him, the female?
tr.khattab: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters

ayahs.ar: تِلْكَ إِذًۭا قِسْمَةٌۭ ضِيزَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: That, then, is an unjust division.
tr.pickthall: That indeed were an unfair division!
tr.yusufali: Behold, such would be indeed a division most unfair!
tr.khattab: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
tr.pickthall: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
tr.yusufali: These are nothing but names which ye have devised,- ye and your fathers,- for which Allah has sent down no authority (whatever). They follow nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire!- Even though there has already come to them Guidance from their Lord!
tr.khattab: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ

tr.sahih: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
tr.pickthall: Or shall man have what he coveteth?
tr.yusufali: Nay, shall man have (just) anything he hankers after?
tr.khattab: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire

ayahs.ar: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ

tr.sahih: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
tr.pickthall: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.
tr.yusufali: But it is to Allah that the End and the Beginning (of all things) belong.
tr.khattab: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
tr.pickthall: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.
tr.yusufali: How many-so-ever be the angels in the heavens, their intercession will avail nothing except after Allah has given leave for whom He pleases and that he is acceptable to Him.
tr.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.
tr.yusufali: Those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.
tr.khattab: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا

tr.sahih: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
tr.pickthall: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.
tr.yusufali: But they have no knowledge therein. They follow nothing but conjecture; and conjecture avails nothing against Truth.
tr.khattab: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth

ayahs.ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

tr.sahih: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
tr.pickthall: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
tr.yusufali: Therefore shun those who turn away from Our Message and desire nothing but the life of this world.
tr.khattab: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

ayahs.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ

tr.sahih: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
tr.pickthall: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.
tr.yusufali: That is as far as knowledge will reach them. Verily thy Lord knoweth best those who stray from His Path, and He knoweth best those who receive guidance.
tr.khattab: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided

ayahs.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى

tr.sahih: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
tr.pickthall: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.
tr.yusufali: Yea, to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: so that He rewards those who do evil, according to their deeds, and He rewards those who do good, with what is best.
tr.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
tr.pickthall: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).
tr.yusufali: Those who avoid great sins and shameful deeds, only (falling into) small faults,- verily thy Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you well when He brings you out of the earth, And when ye are hidden in your mothers' wombs. Therefore justify not yourselves: He knows best who it is that guards against evil.
tr.khattab: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ

tr.sahih: Have you seen the one who turned away
tr.pickthall: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,
tr.yusufali: Seest thou one who turns back,
tr.khattab: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺

ayahs.ar: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًۭا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
tr.pickthall: And gave a little, then was grudging?
tr.yusufali: Gives a little, then hardens (his heart)?
tr.khattab: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped

ayahs.ar: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
tr.pickthall: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?
tr.yusufali: What! Has he knowledge of the Unseen so that he can see?
tr.khattab: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
tr.pickthall: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses
tr.yusufali: Nay, is he not acquainted with what is in the Books of Moses-
tr.khattab: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses

ayahs.ar: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
tr.pickthall: And Abraham who paid his debt:
tr.yusufali: And of Abraham who fulfilled his engagements?-
tr.khattab: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺

ayahs.ar: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
tr.pickthall: That no laden one shall bear another's load,
tr.yusufali: Namely, that no bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another;
tr.khattab: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another

ayahs.ar: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ

tr.sahih: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
tr.pickthall: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,
tr.yusufali: That man can have nothing but what he strives for;
tr.khattab: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ

tr.sahih: And that his effort is going to be seen -
tr.pickthall: And that his effort will be seen.
tr.yusufali: That (the fruit of) his striving will soon come in sight:
tr.khattab: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ

tr.sahih: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
tr.pickthall: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;
tr.yusufali: Then will he be rewarded with a reward complete;
tr.khattab: then they will be fully rewarded

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ

tr.sahih: And that to your Lord is the finality
tr.pickthall: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;
tr.yusufali: That to thy Lord is the final Goal;
tr.khattab: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ

tr.sahih: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
tr.pickthall: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,
tr.yusufali: That it is He Who granteth Laughter and Tears;
tr.khattab: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا

tr.sahih: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
tr.pickthall: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;
tr.yusufali: That it is He Who granteth Death and Life;
tr.khattab: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ

tr.sahih: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
tr.pickthall: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,
tr.yusufali: That He did create in pairs,- male and female,
tr.khattab: And He created the pairs—males and females—

ayahs.ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
tr.pickthall: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;
tr.yusufali: From a seed when lodged (in its place);
tr.khattab: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
tr.pickthall: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;
tr.yusufali: That He hath promised a Second Creation (Raising of the Dead);
tr.khattab: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
tr.pickthall: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;
tr.yusufali: That it is He Who giveth wealth and satisfaction;
tr.khattab: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
tr.pickthall: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;
tr.yusufali: That He is the Lord of Sirius (the Mighty Star);
tr.khattab: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ

tr.sahih: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
tr.pickthall: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,
tr.yusufali: And that it is He Who destroyed the (powerful) ancient 'Ad (people),
tr.khattab: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd

ayahs.ar: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ

tr.sahih: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
tr.pickthall: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;
tr.yusufali: And the Thamud nor gave them a lease of perpetual life.
tr.khattab: and ˹then˺ Thamûd, sparing no one

ayahs.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ

tr.sahih: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
tr.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;
tr.yusufali: And before them, the people of Noah, for that they were (all) most unjust and most insolent transgressors,
tr.khattab: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ

tr.sahih: And the overturned towns He hurled down
tr.pickthall: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed
tr.yusufali: And He destroyed the Overthrown Cities (of Sodom and Gomorrah).
tr.khattab: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down

ayahs.ar: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ

tr.sahih: And covered them by that which He covered.
tr.pickthall: So that there covered them that which did cover.
tr.yusufali: So that (ruins unknown) have covered them up.
tr.khattab: How overwhelming was what covered ˹them˺

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ

tr.sahih: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
tr.pickthall: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the gifts of thy Lord, (O man,) wilt thou dispute about?
tr.khattab: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.
tr.pickthall: This is a warner of the warners of old.
tr.yusufali: This is a Warner, of the (series of) Warners of old!
tr.khattab: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones

ayahs.ar: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْءَازِفَةُ

tr.sahih: The Approaching Day has approached.
tr.pickthall: The threatened Hour is nigh.
tr.yusufali: The (Judgment) ever approaching draws nigh:
tr.khattab: The approaching ˹Hour˺ has drawn near

ayahs.ar: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ

tr.sahih: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.
tr.pickthall: None beside Allah can disclose it.
tr.yusufali: No (soul) but Allah can lay it bare.
tr.khattab: None but Allah can disclose it

ayahs.ar: أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ

tr.sahih: Then at this statement do you wonder?
tr.pickthall: Marvel ye then at this statement,
tr.yusufali: Do ye then wonder at this recital?
tr.khattab: Do you find this revelation astonishing

ayahs.ar: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ

tr.sahih: And you laugh and do not weep
tr.pickthall: And laugh and not weep,
tr.yusufali: And will ye laugh and not weep,-
tr.khattab: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺

ayahs.ar: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ

tr.sahih: While you are proudly sporting?
tr.pickthall: While ye amuse yourselves?
tr.yusufali: Wasting your time in vanities?
tr.khattab: while persisting in heedlessness

ayahs.ar: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩

tr.sahih: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
tr.pickthall: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.
tr.yusufali: But fall ye down in prostration to Allah, and adore (Him)!
tr.khattab: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺

ayahs.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

tr.sahih: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
tr.pickthall: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
tr.yusufali: The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.
tr.khattab: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ

tr.sahih: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
tr.pickthall: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
tr.yusufali: But if they see a Sign, they turn away, and say, "This is (but) transient magic."
tr.khattab: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ

tr.sahih: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
tr.pickthall: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
tr.yusufali: They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.
tr.khattab: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

tr.sahih: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
tr.pickthall: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,
tr.yusufali: There have already come to them Recitals wherein there is (enough) to check (them),
tr.khattab: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent

ayahs.ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

tr.sahih: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
tr.pickthall: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.
tr.yusufali: Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.
tr.khattab: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ

tr.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
tr.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.
tr.yusufali: Therefore, (O Prophet,) turn away from them. The Day that the Caller will call (them) to a terrible affair,
tr.khattab: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying

ayahs.ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ

tr.sahih: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
tr.pickthall: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,
tr.yusufali: They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,
tr.khattab: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts

ayahs.ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ

tr.sahih: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
tr.pickthall: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
tr.yusufali: Hastening, with eyes transfixed, towards the Caller!- "Hard is this Day!", the Unbelievers will say.
tr.khattab: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”

ayahs.ar: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

tr.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
tr.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
tr.yusufali: Before them the People of Noah rejected (their messenger): they rejected Our servant, and said, "Here is one possessed!", and he was driven out.
tr.khattab: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated

ayahs.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ

tr.sahih: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
tr.pickthall: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
tr.yusufali: Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"
tr.khattab: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”

ayahs.ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ

tr.sahih: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
tr.pickthall: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water
tr.yusufali: So We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring forth.
tr.khattab: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain

ayahs.ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ

tr.sahih: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
tr.pickthall: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.
tr.yusufali: And We caused the earth to gush forth with springs, so the waters met (and rose) to the extent decreed.
tr.khattab: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set

ayahs.ar: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
tr.pickthall: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,
tr.yusufali: But We bore him on an (Ark) made of broad planks and caulked with palm-fibre:
tr.khattab: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails

ayahs.ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

tr.sahih: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
tr.pickthall: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.
tr.yusufali: She floats under our eyes (and care): a recompense to one who had been rejected (with scorn)!
tr.khattab: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.yusufali: And We have left this as a Sign (for all time): then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.khattab: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful

ayahs.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
tr.yusufali: But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning?
tr.khattab: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.yusufali: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.
tr.yusufali: The 'Ad (people) (too) rejected (Truth): then how terrible was My Penalty and My Warning?
tr.khattab: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
tr.pickthall: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,
tr.yusufali: For We sent against them a furious wind, on a Day of violent Disaster,
tr.khattab: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery

ayahs.ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ

tr.sahih: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
tr.pickthall: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.
tr.yusufali: Plucking out men as if they were roots of palm-trees torn up (from the ground).
tr.khattab: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees

ayahs.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
tr.yusufali: Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
tr.khattab: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.yusufali: But We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

tr.sahih: Thamud denied the warning
tr.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings
tr.yusufali: The Thamud (also) rejected (their) Warners.
tr.khattab: Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ

tr.sahih: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
tr.pickthall: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.
tr.yusufali: For they said: "What! a man! a Solitary one from among ourselves! shall we follow such a one? Truly should we then be straying in mind, and mad!
tr.khattab: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane

ayahs.ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ

tr.sahih: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
tr.pickthall: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
tr.yusufali: "Is it that the Message is sent to him, of all people amongst us? Nay, he is a liar, an insolent one!"
tr.khattab: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”

ayahs.ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

tr.sahih: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
tr.pickthall: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.
tr.yusufali: Ah! they will know on the morrow, which is the liar, the insolent one!
tr.khattab: ˹It was revealed to Ṣâliḥ,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;
tr.yusufali: For We will send the she-camel by way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Salih), and possess thyself in patience!
tr.khattab: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience

ayahs.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ

tr.sahih: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
tr.pickthall: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.
tr.yusufali: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them: Each one's right to drink being brought forward (by suitable turns).
tr.khattab: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”

ayahs.ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

tr.sahih: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
tr.pickthall: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).
tr.yusufali: But they called to their companion, and he took a sword in hand, and hamstrung (her).
tr.khattab: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺

ayahs.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
tr.yusufali: Ah! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
tr.khattab: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.
tr.yusufali: For We sent against them a single Mighty Blast, and they became like the dry stubble used by one who pens cattle.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.yusufali: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

tr.sahih: The people of Lot denied the warning.
tr.pickthall: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.
tr.yusufali: The people of Lut rejected (his) warning.
tr.khattab: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
tr.pickthall: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,
tr.yusufali: We sent against them a violent Tornado with showers of stones, (which destroyed them), except Lut's household: them We delivered by early Dawn,-
tr.khattab: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn

ayahs.ar: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

tr.sahih: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
tr.pickthall: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.
tr.yusufali: As a Grace from Us: thus do We reward those who give thanks.
tr.khattab: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

tr.sahih: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
tr.pickthall: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.
tr.yusufali: And (Lut) did warn them of Our Punishment, but they disputed about the Warning.
tr.khattab: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
tr.pickthall: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!
tr.yusufali: And they even sought to snatch away his guests from him, but We blinded their eyes. (They heard:) "Now taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
tr.khattab: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ

tr.sahih: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
tr.pickthall: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.
tr.yusufali: Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
tr.khattab: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment

ayahs.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: So taste My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!
tr.yusufali: "So taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
tr.khattab: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.yusufali: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

tr.sahih: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
tr.pickthall: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh
tr.yusufali: To the People of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, came Warners (from Allah).
tr.khattab: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

tr.sahih: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
tr.pickthall: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.
tr.yusufali: The (people) rejected all Our Signs; but We seized them with such Penalty (as comes) from One Exalted in Power, able to carry out His Will.
tr.khattab: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful

ayahs.ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

tr.sahih: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
tr.pickthall: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?
tr.yusufali: Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they? Or have ye an immunity in the Sacred Books?
tr.khattab: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books

ayahs.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ

tr.sahih: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
tr.pickthall: Or say they: We are a host victorious?
tr.yusufali: Or do they say: "We acting together can defend ourselves"?
tr.khattab: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”

ayahs.ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

tr.sahih: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
tr.pickthall: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.
tr.yusufali: Soon will their multitude be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
tr.khattab: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee

ayahs.ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

tr.sahih: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).
tr.yusufali: Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) is the time promised them (for their full recompense): And that Hour will be most grievous and most bitter.
tr.khattab: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
tr.pickthall: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.
tr.yusufali: Truly those in sin are the ones straying in mind, and mad.
tr.khattab: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

tr.sahih: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
tr.pickthall: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.
tr.yusufali: The Day they will be dragged through the Fire on their faces, (they will hear:) "Taste ye the touch of Hell!"
tr.khattab: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.
tr.yusufali: Verily, all things have We created in proportion and measure.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

tr.sahih: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
tr.pickthall: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.
tr.yusufali: And Our Command is but a single (Act),- like the twinkling of an eye.
tr.khattab: Our command is but a single word, done in the blink of an eye

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

tr.sahih: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.yusufali: And (oft) in the past, have We destroyed gangs like unto you: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.khattab: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

tr.sahih: And everything they did is in written records.
tr.pickthall: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,
tr.yusufali: All that they do is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds):
tr.khattab: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

tr.sahih: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
tr.pickthall: And every small and great thing is recorded.
tr.yusufali: Every matter, small and great, is on record.
tr.khattab: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
tr.pickthall: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,
tr.yusufali: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,
tr.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers

ayahs.ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

tr.sahih: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
tr.pickthall: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
tr.yusufali: In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.
tr.khattab: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign

ayahs.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ

tr.sahih: The Most Merciful
tr.pickthall: The Beneficent
tr.yusufali: (Allah) Most Gracious!
tr.khattab: The Most Compassionate

ayahs.ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ

tr.sahih: Taught the Qur'an,
tr.pickthall: Hath made known the Qur'an.
tr.yusufali: It is He Who has taught the Qur'an.
tr.khattab: taught the Quran

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ

tr.sahih: Created man,
tr.pickthall: He hath created man.
tr.yusufali: He has created man:
tr.khattab: created humanity

ayahs.ar: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ

tr.sahih: [And] taught him eloquence.
tr.pickthall: He hath taught him utterance.
tr.yusufali: He has taught him speech (and intelligence).
tr.khattab: ˹and˺ taught them speech

ayahs.ar: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ

tr.sahih: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
tr.pickthall: The sun and the moon are made punctual.
tr.yusufali: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed;
tr.khattab: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision

ayahs.ar: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ

tr.sahih: And the stars and trees prostrate.
tr.pickthall: The stars and the trees prostrate.
tr.yusufali: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) prostrate in adoration.
tr.khattab: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

tr.sahih: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
tr.pickthall: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
tr.yusufali: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice),
tr.khattab: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺

ayahs.ar: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ

tr.sahih: That you not transgress within the balance.
tr.pickthall: That ye exceed not the measure,
tr.yusufali: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance.
tr.khattab: so that you do not defraud the scales

ayahs.ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

tr.sahih: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
tr.pickthall: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
tr.yusufali: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.
tr.khattab: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ

tr.sahih: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
tr.pickthall: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,
tr.yusufali: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:
tr.khattab: He laid out the earth for all beings

ayahs.ar: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ

tr.sahih: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
tr.pickthall: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,
tr.yusufali: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates);
tr.khattab: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ

tr.sahih: And grain having husks and scented plants.
tr.pickthall: Husked grain and scented herb.
tr.yusufali: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.
tr.khattab: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ

tr.sahih: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
tr.pickthall: He created man of clay like the potter's,
tr.yusufali: He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery,
tr.khattab: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery

ayahs.ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ

tr.sahih: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
tr.pickthall: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.
tr.yusufali: And He created Jinns from fire free of smoke:
tr.khattab: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ

tr.sahih: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
tr.pickthall: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!
tr.yusufali: (He is) Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests:
tr.khattab: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ

tr.sahih: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
tr.pickthall: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.
tr.yusufali: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together:
tr.khattab: He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water

ayahs.ar: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ

tr.sahih: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
tr.pickthall: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).
tr.yusufali: Between them is a Barrier which they do not transgress:
tr.khattab: yet between them is a barrier they never cross

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ

tr.sahih: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
tr.pickthall: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.
tr.yusufali: Out of them come Pearls and Coral:
tr.khattab: Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ

tr.sahih: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
tr.pickthall: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.
tr.yusufali: And His are the Ships sailing smoothly through the seas, lofty as mountains:
tr.khattab: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ

tr.sahih: Everyone upon the earth will perish,
tr.pickthall: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;
tr.yusufali: All that is on earth will perish:
tr.khattab: Every being on earth is bound to perish

ayahs.ar: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

tr.sahih: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
tr.pickthall: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.
tr.yusufali: But will abide (for ever) the Face of thy Lord,- full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
tr.khattab: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ

tr.sahih: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
tr.pickthall: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
tr.yusufali: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)!
tr.khattab: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ

tr.sahih: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
tr.pickthall: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).
tr.yusufali: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds!
tr.khattab: We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ

tr.sahih: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
tr.pickthall: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
tr.yusufali: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass!
tr.khattab: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

tr.sahih: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
tr.pickthall: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.
tr.yusufali: On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain!) a flame of fire (to burn) and a smoke (to choke): no defence will ye have:
tr.khattab: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ

tr.sahih: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
tr.pickthall: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -
tr.yusufali: When the sky is rent asunder, and it becomes red like ointment:
tr.khattab: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

tr.sahih: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
tr.pickthall: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.
tr.yusufali: On that Day no question will be asked of man or Jinn as to his sin.
tr.khattab: On that Day there will be no need for any human or jinn to be asked about their sins

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ

tr.sahih: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
tr.pickthall: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.
tr.yusufali: (For) the sinners will be known by their marks: and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
tr.khattab: The wicked will be recognized by their appearance, then will be seized by ˹their˺ forelocks and feet

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

tr.sahih: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
tr.pickthall: This is hell which the guilty deny.
tr.yusufali: This is the Hell which the Sinners deny:
tr.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Hell which the wicked denied.”

ayahs.ar: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍۢ

tr.sahih: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
tr.pickthall: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water.
tr.yusufali: In its midst and in the midst of boiling hot water will they wander round!
tr.khattab: They will alternate between its flames and scalding water

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ

tr.sahih: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
tr.pickthall: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens.
tr.yusufali: But for such as fear the time when they will stand before (the Judgment Seat of) their Lord, there will be two Gardens-
tr.khattab: And whoever is in awe of standing before their Lord will have two Gardens

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍۢ

tr.sahih: Having [spreading] branches.
tr.pickthall: Of spreading branches.
tr.yusufali: Containing all kinds (of trees and delights);-
tr.khattab: ˹Both will be˺ with lush branches

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ

tr.sahih: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
tr.pickthall: Wherein are two fountains flowing.
tr.yusufali: In them (each) will be two Springs flowing (free);
tr.khattab: In each ˹Garden˺ will be two flowing springs

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍۢ زَوْجَانِ

tr.sahih: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
tr.pickthall: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs.
tr.yusufali: In them will be Fruits of every kind, two and two.
tr.khattab: In each will be two types of every fruit

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
