tr.sahih: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
tr.pickthall: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.
tr.yusufali: They will recline on Carpets, whose inner linings will be of rich brocade: the Fruit of the Gardens will be near (and easy of reach).
tr.khattab: Those ˹believers˺ will recline on furnishings lined with rich brocade. And the fruit of both Gardens will hang within reach

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

tr.sahih: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -
tr.pickthall: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them.
tr.yusufali: In them will be (Maidens), chaste, restraining their glances, whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
tr.khattab: In both ˹Gardens˺ will be maidens of modest gaze, who no human or jinn has ever touched before

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ

tr.sahih: As if they were rubies and coral.
tr.pickthall: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone.
tr.yusufali: Like unto Rubies and coral.
tr.khattab: Those ˹maidens˺ will be ˹as elegant˺ as rubies and coral

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ

tr.sahih: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
tr.pickthall: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?
tr.yusufali: Is there any Reward for Good - other than Good?
tr.khattab: Is there any reward for goodness except goodness

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ

tr.sahih: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
tr.pickthall: And beside them are two other gardens,
tr.yusufali: And besides these two, there are two other Gardens,-
tr.khattab: And below these two ˹Gardens˺ will be two others

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ

tr.sahih: Dark green [in color].
tr.pickthall: Dark green with foliage.
tr.yusufali: Dark-green in colour (from plentiful watering).
tr.khattab: Both will be dark green

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ

tr.sahih: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
tr.pickthall: Wherein are two abundant springs.
tr.yusufali: In them (each) will be two Springs pouring forth water in continuous abundance:
tr.khattab: In each will be two gushing springs

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَنَخْلٌۭ وَرُمَّانٌۭ

tr.sahih: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
tr.pickthall: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.
tr.yusufali: In them will be Fruits, and dates and pomegranates:
tr.khattab: In both will be fruit, palm trees, and pomegranates

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌۭ

tr.sahih: In them are good and beautiful women -
tr.pickthall: Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful -
tr.yusufali: In them will be fair (Companions), good, beautiful;-
tr.khattab: In all Gardens will be noble, pleasant mates

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: حُورٌۭ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌۭ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ

tr.sahih: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
tr.pickthall: Fair ones, close-guarded in pavilions -
tr.yusufali: Companions restrained (as to their glances), in (goodly) pavilions;-
tr.khattab: ˹They will be˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

tr.sahih: Untouched before them by man or jinni -
tr.pickthall: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them -
tr.yusufali: Whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
tr.khattab: No human or jinn has ever touched these ˹maidens˺ before

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ

tr.sahih: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
tr.pickthall: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets.
tr.yusufali: Reclining on green Cushions and rich Carpets of beauty.
tr.khattab: All ˹believers˺ will be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets

ayahs.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

tr.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
tr.pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.yusufali: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.khattab: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

ayahs.ar: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

tr.sahih: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
tr.pickthall: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!
tr.yusufali: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
tr.khattab: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour

ayahs.ar: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ

tr.sahih: When the Occurrence occurs,
tr.pickthall: When the event befalleth -
tr.yusufali: When the Event inevitable cometh to pass,
tr.khattab: When the Inevitable Event takes place

ayahs.ar: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ

tr.sahih: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
tr.pickthall: There is no denying that it will befall -
tr.yusufali: Then will no (soul) entertain falsehood concerning its coming.
tr.khattab: then no one can deny it has come

ayahs.ar: خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ

tr.sahih: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
tr.pickthall: Abasing (some), exalting (others);
tr.yusufali: (Many) will it bring low; (many) will it exalt;
tr.khattab: It will debase ˹some˺ and elevate ˹others˺

ayahs.ar: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّۭا

tr.sahih: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
tr.pickthall: When the earth is shaken with a shock
tr.yusufali: When the earth shall be shaken to its depths,
tr.khattab: When the earth will be violently shaken

ayahs.ar: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّۭا

tr.sahih: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
tr.pickthall: And the hills are ground to powder
tr.yusufali: And the mountains shall be crumbled to atoms,
tr.khattab: and the mountains will be crushed to pieces

ayahs.ar: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءًۭ مُّنۢبَثًّۭا

tr.sahih: And become dust dispersing.
tr.pickthall: So that they become a scattered dust,
tr.yusufali: Becoming dust scattered abroad,
tr.khattab: becoming scattered ˹particles of˺ dust

ayahs.ar: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ثَلَٰثَةًۭ

tr.sahih: And you become [of] three kinds:
tr.pickthall: And ye will be three kinds:
tr.yusufali: And ye shall be sorted out into three classes.
tr.khattab: you will ˹all˺ be ˹divided into˺ three groups

ayahs.ar: فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ

tr.sahih: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
tr.pickthall: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
tr.yusufali: Then (there will be) the Companions of the Right Hand;- What will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
tr.khattab: the people of the right, how ˹blessed˺ will they be

ayahs.ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

tr.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
tr.pickthall: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?
tr.yusufali: And the Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
tr.khattab: the people of the left, how ˹miserable˺ will they be

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ

tr.sahih: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
tr.pickthall: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:
tr.yusufali: And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).
tr.khattab: and the foremost ˹in faith˺ will be the foremost ˹in Paradise˺

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

tr.sahih: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
tr.pickthall: Those are they who will be brought nigh
tr.yusufali: These will be those Nearest to Allah:
tr.khattab: They are the ones nearest ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

tr.sahih: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
tr.pickthall: In gardens of delight;
tr.yusufali: In Gardens of Bliss:
tr.khattab: in the Gardens of Bliss

ayahs.ar: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: A [large] company of the former peoples
tr.pickthall: A multitude of those of old
tr.yusufali: A number of people from those of old,
tr.khattab: ˹They will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations

ayahs.ar: وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And a few of the later peoples,
tr.pickthall: And a few of those of later time.
tr.yusufali: And a few from those of later times.
tr.khattab: and a few from later generations

ayahs.ar: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّوْضُونَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: On thrones woven [with ornament],
tr.pickthall: On lined couches,
tr.yusufali: (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
tr.khattab: ˹All will be˺ on jewelled thrones

ayahs.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ

tr.sahih: Reclining on them, facing each other.
tr.pickthall: Reclining therein face to face.
tr.yusufali: Reclining on them, facing each other.
tr.khattab: reclining face to face

ayahs.ar: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ

tr.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
tr.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths
tr.yusufali: Round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness),
tr.khattab: They will be waited on by eternal youths

ayahs.ar: بِأَكْوَابٍۢ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
tr.pickthall: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
tr.yusufali: With goblets, (shining) beakers, and cups (filled) out of clear-flowing fountains:
tr.khattab: with cups, pitchers, and a drink ˹of pure wine˺ from a flowing stream

ayahs.ar: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ

tr.sahih: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
tr.pickthall: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,
tr.yusufali: No after-ache will they receive therefrom, nor will they suffer intoxication:
tr.khattab: that will cause them neither headache nor intoxication

ayahs.ar: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: And fruit of what they select
tr.pickthall: And fruit that they prefer
tr.yusufali: And with fruits, any that they may select:
tr.khattab: ˹They will also be served˺ any fruit they choose

ayahs.ar: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

tr.sahih: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
tr.pickthall: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
tr.yusufali: And the flesh of fowls, any that they may desire.
tr.khattab: and meat from any bird they desire

ayahs.ar: وَحُورٌ عِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
tr.pickthall: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,
tr.yusufali: And (there will be) Companions with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes,-
tr.khattab: And ˹they will have˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes

ayahs.ar: كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ

tr.sahih: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
tr.pickthall: Like unto hidden pearls,
tr.yusufali: Like unto Pearls well-guarded.
tr.khattab: like pristine pearls

ayahs.ar: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

tr.sahih: As reward for what they used to do.
tr.pickthall: Reward for what they used to do.
tr.yusufali: A Reward for the deeds of their past (life).
tr.khattab: ˹all˺ as a reward for what they used to do

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا

tr.sahih: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
tr.pickthall: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
tr.yusufali: Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
tr.khattab: There they will never hear any idle or sinful talk—

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا قِيلًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا

tr.sahih: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."
tr.pickthall: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
tr.yusufali: Only the saying, "Peace! Peace".
tr.khattab: only good and virtuous speech

ayahs.ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
tr.pickthall: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
tr.yusufali: The Companions of the Right Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
tr.khattab: And the people of the right—how ˹blessed˺ will they be

ayahs.ar: فِى سِدْرٍۢ مَّخْضُودٍۢ

tr.sahih: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
tr.pickthall: Among thornless lote-trees
tr.yusufali: (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
tr.khattab: ˹They will be˺ amid thornless lote trees

ayahs.ar: وَطَلْحٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ

tr.sahih: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
tr.pickthall: And clustered plantains,
tr.yusufali: Among Talh trees with flowers (or fruits) piled one above another,-
tr.khattab: clusters of bananas

ayahs.ar: وَظِلٍّۢ مَّمْدُودٍۢ

tr.sahih: And shade extended
tr.pickthall: And spreading shade,
tr.yusufali: In shade long-extended,
tr.khattab: extended shade

ayahs.ar: وَمَآءٍۢ مَّسْكُوبٍۢ

tr.sahih: And water poured out
tr.pickthall: And water gushing,
tr.yusufali: By water flowing constantly,
tr.khattab: flowing water

ayahs.ar: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
tr.pickthall: And fruit in plenty
tr.yusufali: And fruit in abundance.
tr.khattab: abundant fruit—

ayahs.ar: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍۢ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
tr.pickthall: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,
tr.yusufali: Whose season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden,
tr.khattab: never out of season nor forbidden—

ayahs.ar: وَفُرُشٍۢ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ

tr.sahih: And [upon] beds raised high.
tr.pickthall: And raised couches;
tr.yusufali: And on Thrones (of Dignity), raised high.
tr.khattab: and elevated furnishings

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءًۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
tr.yusufali: We have created (their Companions) of special creation.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We will have perfectly created their mates

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا

tr.sahih: And made them virgins,
tr.pickthall: And made them virgins,
tr.yusufali: And made them virgin - pure (and undefiled), -
tr.khattab: making them virgins

ayahs.ar: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًۭا

tr.sahih: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
tr.pickthall: Lovers, friends,
tr.yusufali: Beloved (by nature), equal in age,-
tr.khattab: loving and of equal age

ayahs.ar: لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: For the companions of the right [who are]
tr.pickthall: For those on the right hand;
tr.yusufali: For the Companions of the Right Hand.
tr.khattab: for the people of the right

ayahs.ar: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: A company of the former peoples
tr.pickthall: A multitude of those of old
tr.yusufali: A (goodly) number from those of old,
tr.khattab: ˹who will be˺ a multitude from earlier generations

ayahs.ar: وَثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And a company of the later peoples.
tr.pickthall: And a multitude of those of later time.
tr.yusufali: And a (goodly) number from those of later times.
tr.khattab: and a multitude from later generations

ayahs.ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ

tr.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
tr.pickthall: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?
tr.yusufali: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
tr.khattab: And the people of the left—how ˹miserable˺ will they be

ayahs.ar: فِى سَمُومٍۢ وَحَمِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
tr.pickthall: In scorching wind and scalding water
tr.yusufali: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,
tr.khattab: ˹They will be˺ in scorching heat and boiling water

ayahs.ar: وَظِلٍّۢ مِّن يَحْمُومٍۢ

tr.sahih: And a shade of black smoke,
tr.pickthall: And shadow of black smoke,
tr.yusufali: And in the shades of Black Smoke:
tr.khattab: in the shade of black smoke

ayahs.ar: لَّا بَارِدٍۢ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Neither cool nor beneficial.
tr.pickthall: Neither cool nor refreshing.
tr.yusufali: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:
tr.khattab: neither cool nor refreshing

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
tr.pickthall: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
tr.yusufali: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
tr.khattab: Indeed, before this ˹torment˺ they were spoiled by luxury

ayahs.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: And they used to persist in the great violation,
tr.pickthall: And used to persist in the awful sin.
tr.yusufali: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!
tr.khattab: and persisted in the worst of sin

ayahs.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

tr.sahih: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
tr.pickthall: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
tr.yusufali: And they used to say, "What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised up again?-
tr.khattab: They used to ask ˹mockingly˺, “When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected

ayahs.ar: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

tr.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
tr.pickthall: And also our forefathers?
tr.yusufali: "(We) and our fathers of old?"
tr.khattab: And our forefathers as well?”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْءَاخِرِينَ

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
tr.yusufali: Say: "Yea, those of old and those of later times,
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Most certainly, earlier and later generations

ayahs.ar: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ

tr.sahih: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
tr.pickthall: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
tr.yusufali: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
tr.khattab: will surely be gathered ˹together˺ for the appointed Day

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ

tr.sahih: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
tr.pickthall: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,
tr.yusufali: "Then will ye truly,- O ye that go wrong, and treat (Truth) as Falsehood!-
tr.khattab: Then you, O misguided deniers

ayahs.ar: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍۢ مِّن زَقُّومٍۢ

tr.sahih: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
tr.pickthall: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
tr.yusufali: "Ye will surely taste of the Tree of Zaqqum.
tr.khattab: will certainly eat from ˹the fruit of˺ the trees of Zaqqûm

ayahs.ar: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ

tr.sahih: And filling with it your bellies
tr.pickthall: And will fill your bellies therewith;
tr.yusufali: "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
tr.khattab: filling up ˹your˺ bellies with it

ayahs.ar: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

tr.sahih: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
tr.pickthall: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,
tr.yusufali: "And drink Boiling Water on top of it:
tr.khattab: Then on top of that you will drink boiling water—

ayahs.ar: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ

tr.sahih: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
tr.pickthall: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
tr.yusufali: "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
tr.khattab: and you will drink ˹it˺ like thirsty camels do.”

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
tr.pickthall: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
tr.yusufali: Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
tr.khattab: This will be their accommodation on the Day of Judgment

ayahs.ar: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ

tr.sahih: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
tr.pickthall: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
tr.yusufali: It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?
tr.khattab: It is We Who created you. Will you not then believe ˹in resurrection˺

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ

tr.sahih: Have you seen that which you emit?
tr.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye emit?
tr.yusufali: Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-
tr.khattab: Have you considered what you ejaculate

ayahs.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
tr.pickthall: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
tr.yusufali: Is it ye who create it, or are We the Creators?
tr.khattab: Is it you who create ˹a child out of˺ it, or is it We Who do so

ayahs.ar: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

tr.sahih: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
tr.pickthall: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,
tr.yusufali: We have decreed Death to be your common lot, and We are not to be frustrated
tr.khattab: We have ordained death for ˹all of˺ you, and We cannot be prevented

ayahs.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
tr.pickthall: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.
tr.yusufali: from changing your Forms and creating you (again) in (forms) that ye know not.
tr.khattab: from transforming and recreating you in forms unknown to you

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
tr.pickthall: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?
tr.yusufali: And ye certainly know already the first form of creation: why then do ye not celebrate His praises?
tr.khattab: You already know how you were first created. Will you not then be mindful

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ

tr.sahih: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
tr.pickthall: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?
tr.yusufali: See ye the seed that ye sow in the ground?
tr.khattab: Have you considered what you sow

ayahs.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ

tr.sahih: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
tr.pickthall: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?
tr.yusufali: Is it ye that cause it to grow, or are We the Cause?
tr.khattab: Is it you who cause it to grow, or is it We Who do so

ayahs.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًۭا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

tr.sahih: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
tr.pickthall: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
tr.yusufali: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry powder, and ye would be left in wonderment,
tr.khattab: If We willed, We could simply reduce this ˹harvest˺ to chaff, leaving you to lament

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ

tr.sahih: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
tr.pickthall: Lo! we are laden with debt!
tr.yusufali: (Saying), "We are indeed left with debts (for nothing):
tr.khattab: “We have truly suffered a ˹great˺ loss

ayahs.ar: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

tr.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."
tr.pickthall: Nay, but we are deprived!
tr.yusufali: "Indeed are we shut out (of the fruits of our labour)"
tr.khattab: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ

tr.sahih: And have you seen the water that you drink?
tr.pickthall: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?
tr.yusufali: See ye the water which ye drink?
tr.khattab: Have you considered the water you drink

ayahs.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ

tr.sahih: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
tr.pickthall: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?
tr.yusufali: Do ye bring it down (in rain) from the cloud or do We?
tr.khattab: Is it you who bring it down from the clouds, or is it We Who do so

ayahs.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًۭا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ

tr.sahih: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
tr.pickthall: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?
tr.yusufali: Were it Our Will, We could make it salt (and unpalatable): then why do ye not give thanks?
tr.khattab: If We willed, We could make it salty. Will you not then give thanks

ayahs.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ

tr.sahih: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
tr.pickthall: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;
tr.yusufali: See ye the Fire which ye kindle?
tr.khattab: Have you considered the fire you kindle

ayahs.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ

tr.sahih: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
tr.pickthall: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?
tr.yusufali: Is it ye who grow the tree which feeds the fire, or do We grow it?
tr.khattab: Is it you who produce its trees, or is it We Who do so

ayahs.ar: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَٰهَا تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَمَتَٰعًۭا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ

tr.sahih: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
tr.pickthall: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
tr.yusufali: We have made it a memorial (of Our handiwork), and an article of comfort and convenience for the denizens of deserts.
tr.khattab: We have made it ˹as˺ a reminder ˹of the Hellfire˺ and a provision for the travellers

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
tr.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
tr.yusufali: Then celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme!
tr.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest

ayahs.ar: ۞ فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ

tr.sahih: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
tr.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -
tr.yusufali: Furthermore I call to witness the setting of the Stars,-
tr.khattab: So I do swear by the positions of the stars—

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌۭ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ

tr.sahih: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
tr.pickthall: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -
tr.yusufali: And that is indeed a mighty adjuration if ye but knew,-
tr.khattab: and this, if only you knew, is indeed a great oath—

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an
tr.pickthall: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an
tr.yusufali: That this is indeed a qur'an Most Honourable,
tr.khattab: that this is truly a noble Quran

ayahs.ar: فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مَّكْنُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: In a Register well-protected;
tr.pickthall: In a Book kept hidden
tr.yusufali: In Book well-guarded,
tr.khattab: in a well-preserved Record

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: None touch it except the purified.
tr.pickthall: Which none toucheth save the purified,
tr.yusufali: Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
tr.khattab: touched by none except the purified ˹angels˺

ayahs.ar: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.yusufali: A Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ

tr.sahih: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
tr.pickthall: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,
tr.yusufali: Is it such a Message that ye would hold in light esteem?
tr.khattab: How can you then take this message lightly

ayahs.ar: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ

tr.sahih: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
tr.pickthall: And make denial thereof your livelihood?
tr.yusufali: And have ye made it your livelihood that ye should declare it false?
tr.khattab: and repay ˹Allah for˺ your provisions with denial

ayahs.ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ

tr.sahih: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
tr.pickthall: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
tr.yusufali: Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
tr.khattab: Why then ˹are you helpless˺ when the soul ˹of a dying person˺ reaches ˹their˺ throat

ayahs.ar: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍۢ تَنظُرُونَ

tr.sahih: And you are at that time looking on -
tr.pickthall: And ye are at that moment looking
tr.yusufali: And ye the while (sit) looking on,-
tr.khattab: while you are looking on

ayahs.ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
tr.pickthall: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
tr.yusufali: But We are nearer to him than ye, and yet see not,-
tr.khattab: And We are nearer to such a person than you, but you cannot see

ayahs.ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ

tr.sahih: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
tr.pickthall: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),
tr.yusufali: Then why do ye not,- If you are exempt from (future) account,-
tr.khattab: Now, if you are not subject to Our Will ˹as you claim˺

ayahs.ar: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
tr.pickthall: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?
tr.yusufali: Call back the soul, if ye are true (in the claim of independence)?
tr.khattab: bring that soul back, if what you say is true

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

tr.sahih: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah,
tr.pickthall: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,
tr.yusufali: Thus, then, if he be of those Nearest to Allah,
tr.khattab: So, if the deceased is one of those brought near ˹to Us˺

ayahs.ar: فَرَوْحٌۭ وَرَيْحَانٌۭ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
tr.pickthall: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
tr.yusufali: (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
tr.khattab: then ˹such a person will have˺ serenity, fragrance, and a Garden of Bliss

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: And if he was of the companions of the right,
tr.pickthall: And if he is of those on the right hand,
tr.yusufali: And if he be of the Companions of the Right Hand,
tr.khattab: And if the deceased is one of the people of the right

ayahs.ar: فَسَلَٰمٌۭ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
tr.pickthall: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
tr.yusufali: (For him is the salutation), "Peace be unto thee", from the Companions of the Right Hand.
tr.khattab: then ˹they will be told,˺ “Greetings to you from the people of the right.”

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

tr.sahih: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
tr.pickthall: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,
tr.yusufali: And if he be of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, who go wrong,
tr.khattab: But if such person is one of the misguided deniers

ayahs.ar: فَنُزُلٌۭ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
tr.pickthall: Then the welcome will be boiling water
tr.yusufali: For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.
tr.khattab: then their accommodation will be boiling water ˹to drink˺

ayahs.ar: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And burning in Hellfire
tr.pickthall: And roasting at hell-fire.
tr.yusufali: And burning in Hell-Fire.
tr.khattab: and burning in Hellfire

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
tr.pickthall: Lo! this is certain truth.
tr.yusufali: Verily, this is the Very Truth and Certainly.
tr.khattab: Indeed, this is the absolute truth

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
tr.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
tr.yusufali: So celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme.
tr.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest

ayahs.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

tr.sahih: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr.pickthall: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.yusufali: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth,- let it declare the Praises and Glory of Allah: for He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr.khattab: Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah, for He is the Almighty, All-Wise

ayahs.ar: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ

tr.sahih: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
tr.pickthall: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.
tr.yusufali: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: It is He Who gives Life and Death; and He has Power over all things.
tr.khattab: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He gives life and causes death. And He is Most Capable of everything

ayahs.ar: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

tr.sahih: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
tr.pickthall: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.
tr.yusufali: He is the First and the Last, the Evident and the Immanent: and He has full knowledge of all things.
tr.khattab: He is the First and the Last, the Most High and Most Near, and He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things

ayahs.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ

tr.sahih: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
tr.pickthall: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
tr.yusufali: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in Six Days, and is moreover firmly established on the Throne (of Authority). He knows what enters within the earth and what comes forth out of it, what comes down from heaven and what mounts up to it. And He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah sees well all that ye do.
tr.khattab: He is the One Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. He knows whatever goes into the earth and whatever comes out of it, and whatever descends from the sky and whatever ascends into it. And He is with you wherever you are. For Allah is All-Seeing of what you do

ayahs.ar: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ

tr.sahih: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned [all] matters.
tr.pickthall: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back.
tr.yusufali: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: and all affairs are referred back to Allah.
tr.khattab: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And to Allah all matters are returned

ayahs.ar: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

tr.sahih: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and he is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr.pickthall: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts.
tr.yusufali: He merges Night into Day, and He merges Day into Night; and He has full knowledge of the secrets of (all) hearts.
tr.khattab: He merges the night into day and the day into night. And He knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart

ayahs.ar: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ

tr.sahih: Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.
tr.pickthall: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward.
tr.yusufali: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend (in charity) out of the (substance) whereof He has made you heirs. For, those of you who believe and spend (in charity),- for them is a great Reward.
tr.khattab: Believe in Allah and His Messenger, and donate from what He has entrusted you with. So those of you who believe and donate will have a mighty reward

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?
tr.pickthall: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers?
tr.yusufali: What cause have ye why ye should not believe in Allah?- and the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord, and has indeed taken your Covenant, if ye are men of Faith.
tr.khattab: Why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger is inviting you to have faith in your Lord, although He has already taken your covenant, if you will ever believe

ayahs.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muhammad] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful.
tr.pickthall: He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: He is the One Who sends to His Servant Manifest Signs, that He may lead you from the depths of Darkness into the Light and verily Allah is to you most kind and Merciful.
tr.khattab: He is the One Who sends down clear revelations to His servant to bring you out of darkness and into light. For indeed Allah is Ever Gracious and Most Merciful to you

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّۭا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

tr.sahih: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allah has promised the best [reward]. And Allah, with what you do, is Acquainted.
tr.pickthall: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.
tr.yusufali: And what cause have ye why ye should not spend in the cause of Allah?- For to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. Not equal among you are those who spent (freely) and fought, before the Victory, (with those who did so later). Those are higher in rank than those who spent (freely) and fought afterwards. But to all has Allah promised a goodly (reward). And Allah is well acquainted with all that ye do.
tr.khattab: And why should you not spend in the cause of Allah, while Allah is the ˹sole˺ inheritor of the heavens and the earth? Those of you who donated and fought before the victory ˹over Mecca˺ are unparalleled. They are far greater in rank than those who donated and fought afterwards. Yet Allah has promised each a fine reward. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do

ayahs.ar: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
tr.pickthall: Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward?
tr.yusufali: Who is he that will Loan to Allah a beautiful loan? for (Allah) will increase it manifold to his credit, and he will have (besides) a liberal Reward.
tr.khattab: Who is it that will lend to Allah a good loan which Allah will multiply ˹many times over˺ for them, and they will have an honourable reward

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

tr.sahih: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
tr.pickthall: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph.
tr.yusufali: One Day shalt thou see the believing men and the believing women- how their Light runs forward before them and by their right hands: (their greeting will be): "Good News for you this Day! Gardens beneath which flow rivers! to dwell therein for aye! This is indeed the highest Achievement!"
tr.khattab: On that Day you will see believing men and women with their light shining ahead of them and on their right. ˹They will be told,˺ “Today you have good news of Gardens, under which rivers flow, ˹for you˺ to stay in forever. This is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph.”

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًۭا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍۢ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ

tr.sahih: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
tr.pickthall: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.
tr.yusufali: One Day will the Hypocrites- men and women - say to the Believers: "Wait for us! Let us borrow (a Light) from your Light!" It will be said: "Turn ye back to your rear! then seek a Light (where ye can)!" So a wall will be put up betwixt them, with a gate therein. Within it will be Mercy throughout, and without it, all alongside, will be (Wrath and) Punishment!
tr.khattab: On that Day hypocrite men and women will beg the believers, “Wait for us so that we may have some of your light.” It will be said ˹mockingly˺, “Go back ˹to the world˺ and seek a light ˹there˺!” Then a ˹separating˺ wall with a gate will be erected between them. On the near side will be grace and on the far side will be torment

ayahs.ar: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ

tr.sahih: The hypocrites will call to the believers, "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah.
tr.pickthall: They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah;
tr.yusufali: (Those without) will call out, "Were we not with you?" (The others) will reply, "True! but ye led yourselves into temptation; ye looked forward (to our ruin); ye doubted (Allah's Promise); and (your false) desires deceived you; until there issued the Command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you in respect of Allah.
tr.khattab: The tormented will cry out to those graced, “Were we not with you?” They will reply, “Yes ˹you were˺. But you chose to be tempted ˹by hypocrisy˺, ˹eagerly˺ awaited ˹our demise˺, doubted ˹the truth˺, and were deluded by false hopes until Allah’s decree ˹of your death˺ came to pass. And ˹so˺ the Chief Deceiver deceived you about Allah

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌۭ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

tr.sahih: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination.
tr.pickthall: So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end.
tr.yusufali: "This Day shall no ransom be accepted of you, nor of those who rejected Allah." Your abode is the Fire: that is the proper place to claim you: and an evil refuge it is!"
tr.khattab: So Today no ransom will be accepted from you ˹hypocrites˺, nor from the disbelievers. Your home is the Fire—it is the ˹only˺ fitting place for you. What an evil destination!”

ayahs.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
tr.pickthall: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers.
tr.yusufali: Has not the Time arrived for the Believers that their hearts in all humility should engage in the remembrance of Allah and of the Truth which has been revealed (to them), and that they should not become like those to whom was given Revelation aforetime, but long ages passed over them and their hearts grew hard? For many among them are rebellious transgressors.
tr.khattab: Has the time not yet come for believers’ hearts to be humbled at the remembrance of Allah and what has been revealed of the truth, and not be like those given the Scripture before—˹those˺ who were spoiled for so long that their hearts became hardened. And many of them are ˹still˺ rebellious

ayahs.ar: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

tr.sahih: Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.
tr.pickthall: Know that Allah quickeneth the earth after its death. We have made clear Our revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.
tr.yusufali: Know ye (all) that Allah giveth life to the earth after its death! already have We shown the Signs plainly to you, that ye may learn wisdom.
tr.khattab: Know that Allah revives the earth after its death. We have certainly made the signs clear for you so perhaps you will understand

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who give alms, both men and women, and lend unto Allah a goodly loan, it will be doubled for them, and theirs will be a rich reward.
tr.yusufali: For those who give in Charity, men and women, and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan, it shall be increased manifold (to their credit), and they shall have (besides) a liberal reward.
tr.khattab: Indeed, those men and women who give in charity and lend to Allah a good loan will have it multiplied for them, and they will have an honourable reward

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.
tr.yusufali: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers- they are the Sincere (lovers of Truth), and the witnesses (who testify), in the eyes of their Lord: They shall have their Reward and their Light. But those who reject Allah and deny Our Signs,- they are the Companions of Hell-Fire.
tr.khattab: ˹As for˺ those who believe in Allah and His messengers, it is they who are ˹truly˺ the people of truth. And the martyrs, with their Lord, will have their reward and their light. But ˹as for˺ those who disbelieve and reject Our signs, it is they who will be the residents of the Hellfire

ayahs.ar: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ وَزِينَةٌۭ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰمًۭا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌۭ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ

tr.sahih: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
tr.pickthall: Know that the life of the world is only play, and idle talk, and pageantry, and boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children; as the likeness of vegetation after rain, whereof the growth is pleasing to the husbandman, but afterward it drieth up and thou seest it turning yellow, then it becometh straw. And in the Hereafter there is grievous punishment, and (also) forgiveness from Allah and His good pleasure, whereas the life of the world is but matter of illusion.
tr.yusufali: Know ye (all), that the life of this world is but play and amusement, pomp and mutual boasting and multiplying, (in rivalry) among yourselves, riches and children. Here is a similitude: How rain and the growth which it brings forth, delight (the hearts of) the tillers; soon it withers; thou wilt see it grow yellow; then it becomes dry and crumbles away. But in the Hereafter is a Penalty severe (for the devotees of wrong). And Forgiveness from Allah and (His) Good Pleasure (for the devotees of Allah). And what is the life of this world, but goods and chattels of deception?
tr.khattab: Know that this worldly life is no more than play, amusement, luxury, mutual boasting, and competition in wealth and children. This is like rain that causes plants to grow, to the delight of the planters. But later the plants dry up and you see them wither, then they are reduced to chaff. And in the Hereafter there will be either severe punishment or forgiveness and pleasure of Allah, whereas the life of this world is no more than the delusion of enjoyment

ayahs.ar: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
tr.pickthall: Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.
tr.yusufali: Be ye foremost (in seeking) Forgiveness from your Lord, and a Garden (of Bliss), the width whereof is as the width of heaven and earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers: that is the Grace of Allah, which He bestows on whom he pleases: and Allah is the Lord of Grace abounding.
tr.khattab: ˹So˺ compete with one another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Paradise as vast as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. This is the favour of Allah. He grants it to whoever He wills. And Allah is the Lord of infinite bounty

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

tr.sahih: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah, is easy -
tr.pickthall: Naught of disaster befalleth in the earth or in yourselves but it is in a Book before we bring it into being - Lo! that is easy for Allah -
tr.yusufali: No misfortune can happen on earth or in your souls but is recorded in a decree before We bring it into existence: That is truly easy for Allah:
tr.khattab: No calamity ˹or blessing˺ occurs on earth or in yourselves without being ˹written˺ in a Record before We bring it into being. This is certainly easy for Allah

ayahs.ar: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍۢ فَخُورٍ

tr.sahih: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -
tr.pickthall: That ye grieve not for the sake of that which hath escaped you, nor yet exult because of that which hath been given. Allah loveth not all prideful boasters,
tr.yusufali: In order that ye may not despair over matters that pass you by, nor exult over favours bestowed upon you. For Allah loveth not any vainglorious boaster,-
tr.khattab: ˹We let you know this˺ so that you neither grieve over what you have missed nor boast over what He has granted you. For Allah does not like whoever is arrogant, boastful—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبُخْلِ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

tr.sahih: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
tr.pickthall: Who hoard and who enjoin upon the people avarice. And whosoever turneth away, still Allah is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.
tr.yusufali: Such persons as are covetous and commend covetousness to men. And if any turn back (from Allah's Way), verily Allah is Free of all Needs, Worthy of all Praise.
tr.khattab: those who are stingy and promote stinginess among people. And whoever turns away ˹should know that˺ Allah ˹alone˺ is truly the Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌۭ

tr.sahih: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allah may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
tr.pickthall: We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
tr.yusufali: We sent aforetime our messengers with Clear Signs and sent down with them the Book and the Balance (of Right and Wrong), that men may stand forth in justice; and We sent down Iron, in which is (material for) mighty war, as well as many benefits for mankind, that Allah may test who it is that will help, Unseen, Him and His messengers: For Allah is Full of Strength, Exalted in Might (and able to enforce His Will).
tr.khattab: Indeed, We sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and with them We sent down the Scripture and the balance ˹of justice˺ so that people may administer justice. And We sent down iron with its great might, benefits for humanity, and means for Allah to prove who ˹is willing to˺ stand up for Him and His messengers without seeing Him. Surely Allah is All-Powerful, Almighty

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًۭا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَٰبَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍۢ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

tr.sahih: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
tr.pickthall: And We verily sent Noah and Abraham and placed the prophethood and the scripture among their seed, and among them there is he who goeth right, but many of them are evil-livers.
tr.yusufali: And We sent Noah and Abraham, and established in their line Prophethood and Revelation: and some of them were on right guidance. But many of them became rebellious transgressors.
tr.khattab: And indeed, We sent Noah and Abraham and reserved prophethood and revelation for their descendants. Some of them are ˹rightly˺ guided, while most are rebellious

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةًۭ وَرَحْمَةًۭ وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ٱبْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا ۖ فَـَٔاتَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Then We sent following their footsteps Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allah. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
tr.pickthall: Then We caused Our messengers to follow in their footsteps; and We caused Jesus, son of Mary, to follow, and gave him the Gospel, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. But monasticism they invented - We ordained it not for them - only seeking Allah's pleasure, and they observed it not with right observance. So We give those of them who believe their reward, but many of them are evil-livers.
tr.yusufali: Then, in their wake, We followed them up with (others of) Our messengers: We sent after them Jesus the son of Mary, and bestowed on him the Gospel; and We ordained in the hearts of those who followed him Compassion and Mercy. But the Monasticism which they invented for themselves, We did not prescribe for them: (We commanded) only the seeking for the Good Pleasure of Allah; but that they did not foster as they should have done. Yet We bestowed, on those among them who believed, their (due) reward, but many of them are rebellious transgressors.
tr.khattab: Then in the footsteps of these ˹prophets˺, We sent Our messengers, and ˹after them˺ We sent Jesus, son of Mary, and granted him the Gospel, and instilled compassion and mercy into the hearts of his followers. As for monasticism, they made it up—We never ordained it for them—only seeking to please Allah, yet they did not ˹even˺ observe it strictly. So We rewarded those of them who were faithful. But most of them are rebellious

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًۭا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: O you who have believed, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr.pickthall: O ye who believe! Be mindful of your duty to Allah and put faith in His messenger. He will give you twofold of His mercy and will appoint for you a light wherein ye shall walk, and will forgive you. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful;
tr.yusufali: O ye that believe! Fear Allah, and believe in His Messenger, and He will bestow on you a double portion of His Mercy: He will provide for you a Light by which ye shall walk (straight in your path), and He will forgive you (your past): for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: O people of faith! Fear Allah and believe in His Messenger. ˹And˺ He will grant you a double share of His mercy, provide you with a light to walk in ˹on Judgment Day˺, and forgive you. For Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ مِّن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allah and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
tr.pickthall: That the People of the Scripture may know that they control naught of the bounty of Allah, but that the bounty is in Allah's hand to give to whom He will. And Allah is of Infinite Bounty.
tr.yusufali: That the People of the Book may know that they have no power whatever over the Grace of Allah, that (His) Grace is (entirely) in His Hand, to bestow it on whomsoever He wills. For Allah is the Lord of Grace abounding.
tr.khattab: ˹This is so˺ that the People of the Book ˹who deny the Prophet˺ may know that they do not have any control over Allah’s grace, and that all grace is in Allah’s Hands. He grants it to whoever He wills. For Allah is the Lord of infinite bounty

ayahs.ar: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ

tr.sahih: Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you, [O Muhammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah. And Allah hears your dialogue; indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.
tr.pickthall: Allah hath heard the saying of her that disputeth with thee (Muhammad) concerning her husband, and complaineth unto Allah. And Allah heareth your colloquy. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.
tr.yusufali: Allah has indeed heard (and accepted) the statement of the woman who pleads with thee concerning her husband and carries her complaint (in prayer) to Allah: and Allah (always) hears the arguments between both sides among you: for Allah hears and sees (all things).
tr.khattab: Indeed, Allah has heard the argument of the woman who pleaded with you ˹O Prophet˺ concerning her husband, and appealed to Allah. Allah has heard your exchange. Surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمْ ۖ إِنْ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًۭا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌۭ

tr.sahih: Those who pronounce thihar among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.
tr.pickthall: Such of you as put away your wives (by saying they are as their mothers) - They are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave them birth - they indeed utter an ill word and a lie. And lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: If any men among you divorce their wives by Zihar (calling them mothers), they cannot be their mothers: None can be their mothers except those who gave them birth. And in fact they use words (both) iniquitous and false: but truly Allah is one that blots out (sins), and forgives (again and again).
tr.khattab: Those of you who ˹sinfully˺ divorce their wives by comparing them to their mothers ˹should know that˺ their wives are in no way their mothers. None can be their mothers except those who gave birth to them. What they say is certainly detestable and false. Yet Allah is truly Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا۟ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ

tr.sahih: And those who pronounce thihar from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
tr.pickthall: Those who put away their wives (by saying they are as their mothers) and afterward would go back on that which they have said, (the penalty) in that case (is) the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. Unto this ye are exhorted; and Allah is Informed of what ye do.
tr.yusufali: But those who divorce their wives by Zihar, then wish to go back on the words they uttered,- (It is ordained that such a one) should free a slave before they touch each other: Thus are ye admonished to perform: and Allah is well-acquainted with (all) that ye do.
tr.khattab: Those who divorce their wives in this manner, then ˹wish to˺ retract what they said, must free a slave before they touch each other. This ˹penalty˺ is meant to deter you. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do

ayahs.ar: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

tr.sahih: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allah and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allah. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
tr.pickthall: And he who findeth not (the wherewithal), let him fast for two successive months before they touch one another; and for him who is unable to do so (the penance is) the feeding of sixty needy ones. This, that ye may put trust in Allah and His messenger. Such are the limits (imposed by Allah); and for disbelievers is a painful doom.
tr.yusufali: And if any has not (the wherewithal), he should fast for two months consecutively before they touch each other. But if any is unable to do so, he should feed sixty indigent ones, this, that ye may show your faith in Allah and His Messenger. Those are limits (set by) Allah. For those who reject (Him), there is a grievous Penalty.
tr.khattab: But if the husband cannot afford this, let him then fast two consecutive months before the couple touch each other. But if he is unable ˹to fast˺, then let him feed sixty poor people. This is to re-affirm your faith in Allah and His Messenger. These are the limits set by Allah. And the disbelievers will suffer a painful punishment

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُوا۟ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَلِلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who oppose Allah and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who oppose Allah and His messenger will be abased even as those before them were abased; and We have sent down clear tokens, and for disbelievers is a shameful doom
tr.yusufali: Those who resist Allah and His Messenger will be humbled to dust, as were those before them: for We have already sent down Clear Signs. And the Unbelievers (will have) a humiliating Penalty,-
tr.khattab: Indeed, those who defy Allah and His Messenger will be debased, just like those before them. We have certainly sent down clear revelations. And the disbelievers will suffer a humiliating punishment

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًۭا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ أَحْصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ

tr.sahih: On the Day when Allah will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allah had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allah is, over all things, Witness.
tr.pickthall: On the day when Allah will raise them all together and inform them of what they did. Allah hath kept account of it while they forgot it. And Allah is Witness over all things.
tr.yusufali: On the Day that Allah will raise them all up (again) and show them the Truth (and meaning) of their conduct. Allah has reckoned its (value), though they may have forgotten it, for Allah is Witness to all things.
tr.khattab: On the Day Allah resurrects them all together, He will then inform them of what they have done. Allah has kept account of it all, while they have forgotten it. For Allah is a Witness over all things

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَآ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ ۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

tr.sahih: Have you not considered that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, of all things, Knowing.
tr.pickthall: Hast thou not seen that Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth? There is no secret conference of three but He is their fourth, nor of five but He is their sixth, nor of less than that or more but He is with them wheresoever they may be; and afterward, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things.
tr.yusufali: Seest thou not that Allah doth know (all) that is in the heavens and on earth? There is not a secret consultation between three, but He makes the fourth among them, - Nor between five but He makes the sixth,- nor between fewer nor more, but He is in their midst, wheresoever they be: In the end will He tell them the truth of their conduct, on the Day of Judgment. For Allah has full knowledge of all things.
tr.khattab: Do you not see that Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth? If three converse privately, He is their fourth. If five, He is their sixth. Whether fewer or more, He is with them wherever they may be. Then, on the Day of Judgment, He will inform them of what they have done. Surely Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نُهُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَٰجَوْنَ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَآءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا ٱللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ ۚ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

tr.sahih: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation, then they return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allah does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allah not punish us for what we say?"
