tr.pickthall: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),
tr.yusufali: Nun. By the Pen and the (Record) which (men) write,-
tr.khattab: Nũn. By the pen and what everyone writes

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
tr.pickthall: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.
tr.yusufali: Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed.
tr.khattab: By the grace of your Lord, you ˹O Prophet˺ are not insane

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.
tr.yusufali: Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing:
tr.khattab: You will certainly have a never-ending reward

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
tr.pickthall: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.
tr.yusufali: And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character.
tr.khattab: And you are truly ˹a man˺ of outstanding character

ayahs.ar: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: So you will see and they will see
tr.pickthall: And thou wilt see and they will see
tr.yusufali: Soon wilt thou see, and they will see,
tr.khattab: Soon you and the pagans will see

ayahs.ar: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ

tr.sahih: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
tr.pickthall: Which of you is the demented.
tr.yusufali: Which of you is afflicted with madness.
tr.khattab: which of you is mad

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.
tr.yusufali: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which (among men) hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive (true) Guidance.
tr.khattab: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

tr.sahih: Then do not obey the deniers.
tr.pickthall: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters
tr.yusufali: So hearken not to those who deny (the Truth).
tr.khattab: So do not give in to the deniers

ayahs.ar: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ

tr.sahih: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
tr.pickthall: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.
tr.yusufali: Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant.
tr.khattab: They wish you would compromise so they would yield ˹to you˺

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍۢ مَّهِينٍ

tr.sahih: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
tr.pickthall: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,
tr.yusufali: Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths,
tr.khattab: And do not obey the despicable, vain oath-taker

ayahs.ar: هَمَّازٍۢ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
tr.pickthall: Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders,
tr.yusufali: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,
tr.khattab: slanderer, gossip-monger

ayahs.ar: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

tr.sahih: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
tr.pickthall: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor
tr.yusufali: (Habitually) hindering (all) good, transgressing beyond bounds, deep in sin,
tr.khattab: withholder of good, transgressor, evildoer

ayahs.ar: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
tr.pickthall: Greedy therewithal, intrusive.
tr.yusufali: Violent (and cruel),- with all that, base-born,-
tr.khattab: brute, and—on top of all that—an illegitimate child

ayahs.ar: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ

tr.sahih: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
tr.pickthall: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children
tr.yusufali: Because he possesses wealth and (numerous) sons.
tr.khattab: Now, ˹simply˺ because he has been blessed with ˹abundant˺ wealth and children

ayahs.ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

tr.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
tr.pickthall: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.
tr.yusufali: When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, "Tales of the ancients", he cries!
tr.khattab: whenever Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”

ayahs.ar: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ

tr.sahih: We will brand him upon the snout.
tr.pickthall: We shall brand him on the nose.
tr.yusufali: Soon shall We brand (the beast) on the snout!
tr.khattab: We will soon mark his snout

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,
tr.yusufali: Verily We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they resolved to gather the fruits of the (garden) in the morning.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have tested those ˹Meccans˺ as We tested the owners of the garden—when they swore they would surely harvest ˹all˺ its fruit in the early morning

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ

tr.sahih: Without making exception.
tr.pickthall: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);
tr.yusufali: But made no reservation, ("If it be Allah's Will").
tr.khattab: leaving no thought for Allah’s Will

ayahs.ar: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ

tr.sahih: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
tr.pickthall: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
tr.yusufali: Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep.
tr.khattab: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept

ayahs.ar: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ

tr.sahih: And it became as though reaped.
tr.pickthall: And in the morning it was as if plucked.
tr.yusufali: So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered).
tr.khattab: so it was reduced to ashes

ayahs.ar: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ

tr.sahih: And they called one another at morning,
tr.pickthall: And they cried out one unto another in the morning,
tr.yusufali: As the morning broke, they called out, one to another,-
tr.khattab: Then by daybreak they called out to each other

ayahs.ar: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
tr.pickthall: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).
tr.yusufali: "Go ye to your tilth (betimes) in the morning, if ye would gather the fruits."
tr.khattab: ˹saying,˺ “Go early to your harvest, if you want to pick ˹all˺ the fruit.”

ayahs.ar: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ

tr.sahih: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
tr.pickthall: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:
tr.yusufali: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones, (saying)-
tr.khattab: So they went off, whispering to one another

ayahs.ar: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ

tr.sahih: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
tr.pickthall: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.
tr.yusufali: "Let not a single indigent person break in upon you into the (garden) this day."
tr.khattab: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”

ayahs.ar: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍۢ قَٰدِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
tr.pickthall: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.
tr.yusufali: And they opened the morning, strong in an (unjust) resolve.
tr.khattab: And they proceeded early, totally fixated on their purpose

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ

tr.sahih: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
tr.pickthall: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!
tr.yusufali: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "We have surely lost our way:
tr.khattab: But when they saw it ˹devastated˺, they cried, “We must have lost ˹our˺ way

ayahs.ar: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

tr.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."
tr.pickthall: Nay, but we are desolate!
tr.yusufali: "Indeed we are shut out (of the fruits of our labour)!"
tr.khattab: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ

tr.sahih: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?' "
tr.pickthall: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?
tr.yusufali: Said one of them, more just (than the rest): "Did I not say to you, 'Why not glorify (Allah)?'"
tr.khattab: The most sensible of them said, “Did I not urge you to say, ‘Allah willing.’?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
tr.pickthall: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.
tr.yusufali: They said: "Glory to our Lord! Verily we have been doing wrong!"
tr.khattab: They replied, “Glory be to our Lord! We have truly been wrongdoers.”

ayahs.ar: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
tr.pickthall: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.
tr.yusufali: Then they turned, one against another, in reproach.
tr.khattab: Then they turned on each other, throwing blame

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
tr.pickthall: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.
tr.yusufali: They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed!
tr.khattab: They said, “Woe to us! We have certainly been transgressors

ayahs.ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ

tr.sahih: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
tr.pickthall: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.
tr.yusufali: "It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this: for we do turn to Him (in repentance)!"
tr.khattab: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
tr.pickthall: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.
tr.yusufali: Such is the Punishment (in this life); but greater is the Punishment in the Hereafter,- if only they knew!
tr.khattab: That is the ˹way of Our˺ punishment ˹in this world˺. But the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly far worse, if only they knew

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
tr.pickthall: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.
tr.yusufali: Verily, for the Righteous, are Gardens of Delight, in the Presence of their Lord.
tr.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord

ayahs.ar: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
tr.pickthall: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?
tr.yusufali: Shall We then treat the People of Faith like the People of Sin?
tr.khattab: Should We then treat those who have submitted like the wicked

ayahs.ar: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

tr.sahih: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
tr.pickthall: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!
tr.yusufali: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
tr.khattab: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَٰبٌۭ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
tr.pickthall: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn
tr.yusufali: Or have ye a book through which ye learn-
tr.khattab: Or do you have a scripture, in which you read

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
tr.pickthall: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?
tr.yusufali: That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose?
tr.khattab: that you will have whatever you choose

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
tr.pickthall: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?
tr.yusufali: Or have ye Covenants with Us to oath, reaching to the Day of Judgment, (providing) that ye shall have whatever ye shall demand?
tr.khattab: Or do you have oaths binding on Us until the Day of Judgment that you will have whatever you decide

ayahs.ar: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ

tr.sahih: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
tr.pickthall: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!
tr.yusufali: Ask thou of them, which of them will stand surety for that!
tr.khattab: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ which of them can guarantee all that

ayahs.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ

tr.sahih: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
tr.pickthall: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful
tr.yusufali: Or have they some "Partners" (in Allahhead)? Then let them produce their "partners", if they are truthful!
tr.khattab: Or do they have associate-gods ˹supporting this claim˺? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods, if what they say is true

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,
tr.pickthall: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,
tr.yusufali: The Day that the shin shall be laid bare, and they shall be summoned to bow in adoration, but they shall not be able,-
tr.khattab: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Shin ˹of Allah˺ will be bared, and the wicked will be asked to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so

ayahs.ar: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ

tr.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
tr.pickthall: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.
tr.yusufali: Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused).
tr.khattab: with eyes downcast, totally covered with disgrace. For they were ˹always˺ called to prostrate ˹in the world˺ when they were fully capable ˹but they chose not to˺

ayahs.ar: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
tr.pickthall: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.
tr.yusufali: Then leave Me alone with such as reject this Message: by degrees shall We punish them from directions they perceive not.
tr.khattab: So leave to Me ˹O Prophet˺ those who reject this message. We will gradually draw them to destruction in ways they cannot comprehend

ayahs.ar: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ

tr.sahih: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
tr.pickthall: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.
tr.yusufali: A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan.
tr.khattab: I ˹only˺ delay their end for a while, but My planning is flawless

ayahs.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ

tr.sahih: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
tr.pickthall: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?
tr.yusufali: Or is it that thou dost ask them for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
tr.khattab: Or are you asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt

ayahs.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

tr.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
tr.pickthall: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?
tr.yusufali: Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down?
tr.khattab: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺

ayahs.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ

tr.sahih: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.
tr.pickthall: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.
tr.yusufali: So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony.
tr.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not be like ˹Jonah,˺ the Man of the Whale, who cried out ˹to Allah˺, in total distress

ayahs.ar: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ

tr.sahih: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
tr.pickthall: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.
tr.yusufali: Had not Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been cast off on the naked shore, in disgrace.
tr.khattab: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy

ayahs.ar: فَٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ

tr.sahih: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
tr.pickthall: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.
tr.yusufali: Thus did his Lord choose him and make him of the Company of the Righteous.
tr.khattab: Then his Lord chose him, making him one of the righteous

ayahs.ar: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ

tr.sahih: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
tr.pickthall: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;
tr.yusufali: And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed!"
tr.khattab: The disbelievers would almost cut you down with their eyes when they hear ˹you recite˺ the Reminder, and say, “He is certainly a madman.”

ayahs.ar: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
tr.pickthall: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.
tr.yusufali: But it is nothing less than a Message to all the worlds.
tr.khattab: But it is simply a reminder to the whole world

ayahs.ar: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ

tr.sahih: The Inevitable Reality -
tr.pickthall: The Reality!
tr.yusufali: The Sure Reality!
tr.khattab: The Inevitable Hour

ayahs.ar: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ

tr.sahih: What is the Inevitable Reality?
tr.pickthall: What is the Reality?
tr.yusufali: What is the Sure Reality?
tr.khattab: What is the Inevitable Hour

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
tr.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!
tr.yusufali: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?
tr.khattab: And what will make you realize what the Inevitable Hour is

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ

tr.sahih: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
tr.pickthall: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.
tr.yusufali: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!
tr.khattab: ˹Both˺ Thamûd and ’Ȃd denied the Striking Disaster

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ

tr.sahih: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
tr.pickthall: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.
tr.yusufali: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!
tr.khattab: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by an overwhelming blast

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
tr.pickthall: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,
tr.yusufali: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;
tr.khattab: And as for ’Ȃd, they were destroyed by a furious, bitter wind

ayahs.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
tr.pickthall: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
tr.yusufali: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!
tr.khattab: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees

ayahs.ar: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: Then do you see of them any remains?
tr.pickthall: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?
tr.yusufali: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?
tr.khattab: Do you see any of them left alive

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ

tr.sahih: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
tr.pickthall: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,
tr.yusufali: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.
tr.khattab: Also, Pharaoh and those before him, and ˹the people of˺ the overturned cities ˹of Lot˺ indulged in sin

ayahs.ar: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً

tr.sahih: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
tr.pickthall: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.
tr.yusufali: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.
tr.khattab: each disobeying their Lord’s messenger, so He seized them with a crushing grip

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
tr.pickthall: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship
tr.yusufali: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),
tr.khattab: Indeed, when the floodwater had overflowed, We carried you in the floating Ark ˹with Noah˺

ayahs.ar: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
tr.pickthall: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.
tr.yusufali: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.
tr.khattab: so that We may make this a reminder to you, and that attentive ears may grasp it

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
tr.pickthall: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast
tr.yusufali: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,
tr.khattab: At last, when the Trumpet will be blown with one blast

ayahs.ar: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ

tr.sahih: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
tr.pickthall: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,
tr.yusufali: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-
tr.khattab: and the earth and mountains will be lifted up and crushed with one blow

ayahs.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ

tr.sahih: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
tr.pickthall: Then, on that day will the Event befall.
tr.yusufali: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.
tr.khattab: on that Day the Inevitable Event will have come to pass

ayahs.ar: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاهِيَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
tr.pickthall: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.
tr.yusufali: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,
tr.khattab: The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
tr.pickthall: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.
tr.yusufali: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.
tr.khattab: with the angels on its sides. On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
tr.pickthall: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.
tr.yusufali: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.
tr.khattab: You will then be presented ˹before Him for judgment˺, and none of your secrets will stay hidden

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ

tr.sahih: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
tr.pickthall: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
tr.yusufali: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!
tr.khattab: As for those given their records in their right hand, they will cry ˹happily˺, “Here ˹everyone˺! Read my record

ayahs.ar: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ

tr.sahih: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
tr.pickthall: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.
tr.yusufali: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"
tr.khattab: I surely knew I would face my reckoning.”

ayahs.ar: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: So he will be in a pleasant life -
tr.pickthall: Then he will be in blissful state
tr.yusufali: And he will be in a life of Bliss,
tr.khattab: They will be in a life of bliss

ayahs.ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: In an elevated garden,
tr.pickthall: In a high garden
tr.yusufali: In a Garden on high,
tr.khattab: in an elevated Garden

ayahs.ar: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
tr.pickthall: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.
tr.yusufali: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.
tr.khattab: whose fruit will hang within reach

ayahs.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ

tr.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
tr.pickthall: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.
tr.yusufali: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"
tr.khattab: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ

tr.sahih: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
tr.pickthall: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
tr.yusufali: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!
tr.khattab: And as for those given their record in their left hand, they will cry ˹bitterly˺, “I wish I had not been given my record

ayahs.ar: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ

tr.sahih: And had not known what is my account.
tr.pickthall: And knew not what my reckoning!
tr.yusufali: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!
tr.khattab: nor known anything of my reckoning

ayahs.ar: يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ

tr.sahih: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
tr.pickthall: Oh, would that it had been death!
tr.yusufali: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!
tr.khattab: I wish death was the end

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ

tr.sahih: My wealth has not availed me.
tr.pickthall: My wealth hath not availed me,
tr.yusufali: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!
tr.khattab: My wealth has not benefited me

ayahs.ar: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَٰنِيَهْ

tr.sahih: Gone from me is my authority."
tr.pickthall: My power hath gone from me.
tr.yusufali: "My power has perished from me!"...
tr.khattab: My authority has been stripped from me.”

ayahs.ar: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ

tr.sahih: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
tr.pickthall: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him
tr.yusufali: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,
tr.khattab: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ

tr.sahih: Then into Hellfire drive him.
tr.pickthall: And then expose him to hell-fire
tr.yusufali: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.
tr.khattab: then burn them in Hell

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ

tr.sahih: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
tr.pickthall: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.
tr.yusufali: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!
tr.khattab: then tie them up with chains seventy arms long

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
tr.pickthall: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,
tr.yusufali: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.
tr.khattab: For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

tr.sahih: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
tr.pickthall: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.
tr.yusufali: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!
tr.khattab: nor encouraged the feeding of the poor

ayahs.ar: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
tr.pickthall: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,
tr.yusufali: "So no friend hath he here this Day.
tr.khattab: So this Day they will have no close friend here

ayahs.ar: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
tr.pickthall: Nor any food save filth
tr.yusufali: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,
tr.khattab: nor any food except ˹oozing˺ pus

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَٰطِـُٔونَ

tr.sahih: None will eat it except the sinners.
tr.pickthall: Which none but sinners eat.
tr.yusufali: "Which none do eat but those in sin."
tr.khattab: which none will eat except the evildoers.”

ayahs.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: So I swear by what you see
tr.pickthall: But nay! I swear by all that ye see
tr.yusufali: So I do call to witness what ye see,
tr.khattab: Now, I do swear by whatever you see

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And what you do not see
tr.pickthall: And all that ye see not
tr.yusufali: And what ye see not,
tr.khattab: and whatever you cannot see

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
tr.pickthall: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.
tr.yusufali: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;
tr.khattab: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the recitation of a noble Messenger

ayahs.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
tr.pickthall: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!
tr.yusufali: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!
tr.khattab: It is not the prose of a poet ˹as you claim˺, ˹yet˺ you hardly have any faith

ayahs.ar: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
tr.pickthall: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!
tr.yusufali: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.
tr.khattab: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful

ayahs.ar: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.yusufali: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ

tr.sahih: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
tr.pickthall: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,
tr.yusufali: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,
tr.khattab: Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name

ayahs.ar: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: We would have seized him by the right hand;
tr.pickthall: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
tr.yusufali: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,
tr.khattab: We would have certainly seized him by his right hand

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ

tr.sahih: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
tr.pickthall: And then severed his life-artery,
tr.yusufali: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:
tr.khattab: then severed his aorta

ayahs.ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ

tr.sahih: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
tr.pickthall: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.
tr.yusufali: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).
tr.khattab: and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).
tr.yusufali: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.
tr.khattab: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
tr.pickthall: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).
tr.yusufali: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).
tr.khattab: And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.
tr.yusufali: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.
tr.khattab: and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ

tr.sahih: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
tr.pickthall: And lo! it is absolute truth.
tr.yusufali: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.
tr.khattab: And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

tr.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
tr.pickthall: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
tr.yusufali: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.
tr.khattab: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest

ayahs.ar: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ

tr.sahih: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
tr.pickthall: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall
tr.yusufali: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-
tr.khattab: A challenger has demanded a punishment bound to come

ayahs.ar: لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌۭ

tr.sahih: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
tr.pickthall: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,
tr.yusufali: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-
tr.khattab: for the disbelievers—to be averted by none—

ayahs.ar: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ

tr.sahih: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent.
tr.pickthall: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways
tr.yusufali: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
tr.khattab: from Allah, Lord of pathways of ˹heavenly˺ ascent

ayahs.ar: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
tr.pickthall: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.
tr.yusufali: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:
tr.khattab: ˹through which˺ the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit will ascend to Him on a Day fifty thousand years in length

ayahs.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًۭا جَمِيلًا

tr.sahih: So be patient with gracious patience.
tr.pickthall: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.
tr.yusufali: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).
tr.khattab: So endure ˹this denial, O Prophet,˺ with beautiful patience

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
tr.pickthall: Lo! they behold it afar off
tr.yusufali: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):
tr.khattab: They truly see this ˹Day˺ as impossible

ayahs.ar: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًۭا

tr.sahih: But We see it [as] near.
tr.pickthall: While we behold it nigh:
tr.yusufali: But We see it (quite) near.
tr.khattab: but We see it as inevitable

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ

tr.sahih: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
tr.pickthall: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,
tr.yusufali: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,
tr.khattab: On that Day the sky will be like molten brass

ayahs.ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ

tr.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool,
tr.pickthall: And the hills become as flakes of wool,
tr.yusufali: And the mountains will be like wool,
tr.khattab: and the mountains like ˹tufts of˺ wool

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًۭا

tr.sahih: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
tr.pickthall: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend
tr.yusufali: And no friend will ask after a friend,
tr.khattab: And no close friend will ask ˹about˺ their friends

ayahs.ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ

tr.sahih: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
tr.pickthall: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children
tr.yusufali: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,
tr.khattab: ˹although˺ they will be made to see each other. The wicked will wish to ransom themselves from the punishment of that Day by their children

ayahs.ar: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ

tr.sahih: And his wife and his brother
tr.pickthall: And his spouse and his brother
tr.yusufali: His wife and his brother,
tr.khattab: their spouses, their siblings

ayahs.ar: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ

tr.sahih: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
tr.pickthall: And his kin that harboured him
tr.yusufali: His kindred who sheltered him,
tr.khattab: their clan that sheltered them

ayahs.ar: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ

tr.sahih: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
tr.pickthall: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.
tr.yusufali: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:
tr.khattab: and everyone on earth altogether, just to save themselves

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ

tr.sahih: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
tr.pickthall: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell
tr.yusufali: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-
tr.khattab: But no! There will certainly be a raging Flame

ayahs.ar: نَزَّاعَةًۭ لِّلشَّوَىٰ

tr.sahih: A remover of exteriors.
tr.pickthall: Eager to roast;
tr.yusufali: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-
tr.khattab: ripping off scalps

ayahs.ar: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

tr.sahih: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
tr.pickthall: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),
tr.yusufali: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).
tr.khattab: It will summon whoever turned their backs ˹on Allah˺ and turned away ˹from the truth˺

ayahs.ar: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
tr.pickthall: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.
tr.yusufali: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!
tr.khattab: and gathered and hoarded ˹wealth˺

ayahs.ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
tr.pickthall: Lo! man was created anxious,
tr.yusufali: Truly man was created very impatient;-
tr.khattab: Indeed, humankind was created impatient

ayahs.ar: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًۭا

tr.sahih: When evil touches him, impatient,
tr.pickthall: Fretful when evil befalleth him
tr.yusufali: Fretful when evil touches him;
tr.khattab: distressed when touched with evil

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا

tr.sahih: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
tr.pickthall: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;
tr.yusufali: And niggardly when good reaches him;-
tr.khattab: and withholding when touched with good—

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ

tr.sahih: Except the observers of prayer -
tr.pickthall: Save worshippers.
tr.yusufali: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-
tr.khattab: except those who pray

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ

tr.sahih: Those who are constant in their prayer
tr.pickthall: Who are constant at their worship
tr.yusufali: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;
tr.khattab: consistently performing their prayers

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

tr.sahih: And those within whose wealth is a known right
tr.pickthall: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged
tr.yusufali: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
tr.khattab: and who give the rightful share of their wealth

ayahs.ar: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

tr.sahih: For the petitioner and the deprived -
tr.pickthall: For the beggar and the destitute;
tr.yusufali: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);
tr.khattab: to the beggar and the poor

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
tr.pickthall: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,
tr.yusufali: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;
tr.khattab: and who ˹firmly˺ believe in the Day of Judgment

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

tr.sahih: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
tr.pickthall: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -
tr.yusufali: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-
tr.khattab: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord—

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
tr.pickthall: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -
tr.yusufali: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
tr.khattab: ˹knowing that˺ none should feel secure from their Lord’s punishment—

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ

tr.sahih: And those who guard their private parts
tr.pickthall: And those who preserve their chastity
tr.yusufali: And those who guard their chastity,
tr.khattab: and those who guard their chastity

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

tr.sahih: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
tr.pickthall: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;
tr.yusufali: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,
tr.khattab: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame

ayahs.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ

tr.sahih: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
tr.pickthall: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;
tr.yusufali: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-
tr.khattab: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ

tr.sahih: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
tr.pickthall: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,
tr.yusufali: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;
tr.khattab: ˹The faithful are˺ also those who are true to their trusts and covenants

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ

tr.sahih: And those who are in their testimonies upright
tr.pickthall: And those who stand by their testimony
tr.yusufali: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;
tr.khattab: and who are honest in their testimony

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

tr.sahih: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
tr.pickthall: And those who are attentive at their worship.
tr.yusufali: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-
tr.khattab: and who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ مُّكْرَمُونَ

tr.sahih: They will be in gardens, honored.
tr.pickthall: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.
tr.yusufali: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).
tr.khattab: These will be in Gardens, held in honour

ayahs.ar: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ

tr.sahih: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],
tr.pickthall: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,
tr.yusufali: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-
tr.khattab: So what is the matter with the disbelievers that they rush ˹head-long˺ towards you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.ar: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ

tr.sahih: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
tr.pickthall: On the right and on the left, in groups?
tr.yusufali: From the right and from the left, in crowds?
tr.khattab: from the right and the left, in groups ˹to mock you˺

ayahs.ar: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
tr.pickthall: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
tr.yusufali: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
tr.khattab: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
tr.pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.
tr.yusufali: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!
tr.khattab: But no! Indeed, they ˹already˺ know what We created them from

ayahs.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ

tr.sahih: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
tr.pickthall: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able
tr.yusufali: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-
tr.khattab: So, I do swear by the Lord of ˹all˺ the points of sunrise and sunset that We are truly capable

ayahs.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

tr.sahih: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
tr.pickthall: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.
tr.yusufali: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).
tr.khattab: of replacing them with ˹others˺ better than them, and We cannot be prevented ˹from doing so˺

ayahs.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
tr.pickthall: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,
tr.yusufali: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-
tr.khattab: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been threatened with—

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ

tr.sahih: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
tr.pickthall: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,
tr.yusufali: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-
tr.khattab: the Day they will come forth from the graves swiftly, as if racing to an idol ˹for a blessing˺

ayahs.ar: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
tr.pickthall: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.
tr.yusufali: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
tr.khattab: with eyes downcast, utterly covered with disgrace. That is the Day they have ˹always˺ been warned of

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
tr.pickthall: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.
tr.yusufali: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."
tr.khattab: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
tr.pickthall: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you
tr.yusufali: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:
tr.khattab: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning

ayahs.ar: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

tr.sahih: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
tr.pickthall: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,
tr.yusufali: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:
tr.khattab: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me

ayahs.ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
tr.pickthall: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.
tr.yusufali: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."
tr.khattab: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا

tr.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
tr.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
tr.yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:
tr.khattab: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night

ayahs.ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا

tr.sahih: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
tr.pickthall: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;
tr.yusufali: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).
tr.khattab: but my calls only made them run farther away

ayahs.ar: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا

tr.sahih: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
tr.pickthall: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.
tr.yusufali: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.
tr.khattab: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا

tr.sahih: Then I invited them publicly.
tr.pickthall: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,
tr.yusufali: "So I have called to them aloud;
tr.khattab: Then I certainly called them openly

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا

tr.sahih: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
tr.pickthall: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.
tr.yusufali: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,
tr.khattab: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately

ayahs.ar: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا

tr.sahih: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
tr.pickthall: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
tr.yusufali: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
tr.khattab: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving

ayahs.ar: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا

tr.sahih: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
tr.pickthall: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
tr.yusufali: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;
tr.khattab: He will shower you with abundant rain

ayahs.ar: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا

tr.sahih: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
tr.pickthall: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
tr.yusufali: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).
tr.khattab: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers

ayahs.ar: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا

tr.sahih: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
tr.pickthall: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity
tr.yusufali: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-
tr.khattab: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah

ayahs.ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا

tr.sahih: While He has created you in stages?
tr.pickthall: When He created you by (divers) stages?
tr.yusufali: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?
tr.khattab: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا

tr.sahih: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
tr.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
tr.yusufali: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,
tr.khattab: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا

tr.sahih: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
tr.pickthall: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
tr.yusufali: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?
tr.khattab: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp

ayahs.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا

tr.sahih: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
tr.pickthall: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,
tr.yusufali: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),
tr.khattab: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا

tr.sahih: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
tr.pickthall: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.
tr.yusufali: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?
tr.khattab: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺

ayahs.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا

tr.sahih: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
tr.pickthall: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you
tr.yusufali: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),
tr.khattab: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you

ayahs.ar: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا

tr.sahih: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
tr.pickthall: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.
tr.yusufali: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"
tr.khattab: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”

ayahs.ar: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا

tr.sahih: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
tr.pickthall: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
tr.yusufali: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.
tr.khattab: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss

ayahs.ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا

tr.sahih: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
tr.pickthall: And they have plotted a mighty plot,
tr.yusufali: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.
tr.khattab: and who have devised a tremendous plot

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
tr.pickthall: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
tr.yusufali: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-
tr.khattab: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’

ayahs.ar: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا

tr.sahih: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
tr.pickthall: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.
tr.yusufali: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)."
tr.khattab: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”

ayahs.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا

tr.sahih: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
tr.pickthall: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.
tr.yusufali: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them.
tr.khattab: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

tr.sahih: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
tr.pickthall: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
tr.yusufali: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!
tr.khattab: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
tr.pickthall: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.
tr.yusufali: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.
tr.khattab: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers

ayahs.ar: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا

tr.sahih: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
tr.pickthall: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
tr.yusufali: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"
tr.khattab: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,
tr.yusufali: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital!
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation

ayahs.ar: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا

tr.sahih: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
tr.pickthall: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.
tr.yusufali: 'It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord.
tr.khattab: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
tr.pickthall: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,
tr.yusufali: 'And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son.
tr.khattab: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا

tr.sahih: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
tr.pickthall: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.
tr.yusufali: 'There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against Allah;
tr.khattab: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا

tr.sahih: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
tr.pickthall: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -
tr.yusufali: 'But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against Allah.
tr.khattab: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا

tr.sahih: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
tr.pickthall: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);
tr.yusufali: 'True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly.
tr.khattab: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
tr.pickthall: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -
tr.yusufali: 'And they (came to) think as ye thought, that Allah would not raise up any one (to Judgment).
tr.khattab: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا

tr.sahih: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
tr.pickthall: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.
tr.yusufali: 'And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
tr.khattab: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
tr.pickthall: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
tr.yusufali: 'We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
tr.khattab: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
tr.pickthall: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.
tr.yusufali: 'And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct.
tr.khattab: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
tr.pickthall: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.
tr.yusufali: 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths.
tr.khattab: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا

tr.sahih: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
tr.pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
tr.yusufali: 'But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
tr.khattab: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا

tr.sahih: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
tr.pickthall: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.
tr.yusufali: 'And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice.
tr.khattab: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
tr.pickthall: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.
tr.yusufali: 'Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:
tr.khattab: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا

tr.sahih: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
tr.pickthall: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.
tr.yusufali: 'But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire'-
tr.khattab: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”

ayahs.ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا

tr.sahih: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
tr.pickthall: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance
tr.yusufali: (And Allah's Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance.
tr.khattab: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—

ayahs.ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا

tr.sahih: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
tr.pickthall: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
tr.yusufali: "That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty.
tr.khattab: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
tr.pickthall: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.
tr.yusufali: "And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah;
tr.khattab: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا

tr.sahih: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
tr.pickthall: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.
tr.yusufali: "Yet when the Devotee of Allah stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd."
tr.khattab: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا

tr.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
tr.pickthall: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.
tr.yusufali: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)."
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا

tr.sahih: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
tr.pickthall: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.
tr.yusufali: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct."
tr.khattab: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا

tr.sahih: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
tr.pickthall: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him
tr.yusufali: Say: "No one can deliver me from Allah (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him,
tr.khattab: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا

tr.sahih: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
