tr.pickthall: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.
tr.yusufali: "Unless I proclaim what I receive from Allah and His Messages: for any that disobey Allah and His Messenger,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever."
tr.khattab: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا

tr.sahih: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
tr.pickthall: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.
tr.yusufali: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.
tr.khattab: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower

ayahs.ar: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا

tr.sahih: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
tr.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.
tr.yusufali: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
tr.khattab: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it

ayahs.ar: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا

tr.sahih: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
tr.pickthall: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,
tr.yusufali: "He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries,-
tr.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا

tr.sahih: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
tr.pickthall: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him
tr.yusufali: "Except a messenger whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him,
tr.khattab: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them

ayahs.ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا

tr.sahih: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
tr.pickthall: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
tr.yusufali: "That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing."
tr.khattab: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ

tr.sahih: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
tr.pickthall: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!
tr.yusufali: O thou folded in garments!
tr.khattab: O you wrapped ˹in your clothes˺

ayahs.ar: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
tr.pickthall: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -
tr.yusufali: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night,-
tr.khattab: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—

ayahs.ar: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا

tr.sahih: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
tr.pickthall: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof
tr.yusufali: Half of it,- or a little less,
tr.khattab: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less

ayahs.ar: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا

tr.sahih: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
tr.pickthall: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,
tr.yusufali: Or a little more; and recite the Qur'an in slow, measured rhythmic tones.
tr.khattab: or a little more—and recite the Quran ˹properly˺ in a measured way

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
tr.pickthall: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.
tr.yusufali: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message.
tr.khattab: ˹For˺ We will soon send upon you a weighty revelation

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
tr.pickthall: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.
tr.yusufali: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).
tr.khattab: Indeed, worship in the night is more impactful and suitable for recitation

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.
tr.yusufali: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
tr.khattab: For during the day you are over-occupied ˹with worldly duties˺

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
tr.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
tr.yusufali: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
tr.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly

ayahs.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
tr.pickthall: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -
tr.yusufali: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.
tr.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs

ayahs.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
tr.pickthall: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.
tr.yusufali: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).
tr.khattab: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say, and depart from them courteously

ayahs.ar: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا

tr.sahih: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
tr.pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
tr.yusufali: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
tr.khattab: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
tr.pickthall: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,
tr.yusufali: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),
tr.khattab: ˹For˺ We certainly have shackles, a ˹raging˺ Fire

ayahs.ar: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا

tr.sahih: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
tr.pickthall: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom
tr.yusufali: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.
tr.khattab: choking food, and a painful punishment ˹in store for them˺

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا

tr.sahih: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
tr.pickthall: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.
tr.yusufali: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
tr.khattab: on the Day the earth and mountains will shake ˹violently˺, and mountains will be ˹reduced to˺ dunes of shifting sand

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.
tr.yusufali: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh

ayahs.ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
tr.pickthall: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.
tr.yusufali: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.
tr.khattab: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a stern grip

ayahs.ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا

tr.sahih: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
tr.pickthall: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,
tr.yusufali: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-
tr.khattab: If you ˹pagans˺ persist in disbelief, then how will you guard yourselves against ˹the horrors of˺ a Day which will turn children’s hair grey

ayahs.ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا

tr.sahih: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
tr.pickthall: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.
tr.yusufali: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.
tr.khattab: It will ˹even˺ cause the sky to split apart. His promise ˹of judgment˺ must be fulfilled

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
tr.pickthall: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.
tr.yusufali: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!
tr.khattab: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord

ayahs.ar: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.yusufali: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.khattab: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. So recite ˹in prayer˺ whatever you can from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, some will be travelling throughout the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and some fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite whatever you can from it. And ˹continue to˺ perform ˹regular˺ prayers, pay alms-tax, and lend to Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah far better and more rewarding. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ

tr.sahih: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
tr.pickthall: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,
tr.yusufali: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!
tr.khattab: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺

ayahs.ar: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ

tr.sahih: Arise and warn
tr.pickthall: Arise and warn!
tr.yusufali: Arise and deliver thy warning!
tr.khattab: Arise and warn ˹all˺

ayahs.ar: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ

tr.sahih: And your Lord glorify
tr.pickthall: Thy Lord magnify,
tr.yusufali: And thy Lord do thou magnify!
tr.khattab: Revere your Lord ˹alone˺

ayahs.ar: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ

tr.sahih: And your clothing purify
tr.pickthall: Thy raiment purify,
tr.yusufali: And thy garments keep free from stain!
tr.khattab: Purify your garments

ayahs.ar: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ

tr.sahih: And uncleanliness avoid
tr.pickthall: Pollution shun!
tr.yusufali: And all abomination shun!
tr.khattab: ˹Continue to˺ shun idols

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ

tr.sahih: And do not confer favor to acquire more
tr.pickthall: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!
tr.yusufali: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!
tr.khattab: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺

ayahs.ar: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ

tr.sahih: But for your Lord be patient.
tr.pickthall: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!
tr.yusufali: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!
tr.khattab: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ

tr.sahih: And when the trumpet is blown,
tr.pickthall: For when the trumpet shall sound,
tr.yusufali: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
tr.khattab: ˹For˺ when the Trumpet will be sounded

ayahs.ar: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ

tr.sahih: That Day will be a difficult day
tr.pickthall: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,
tr.yusufali: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-
tr.khattab: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—

ayahs.ar: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ

tr.sahih: For the disbelievers - not easy.
tr.pickthall: Not of ease, for disbelievers.
tr.yusufali: Far from easy for those without Faith.
tr.khattab: far from easy for the disbelievers

ayahs.ar: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا

tr.sahih: Leave Me with the one I created alone
tr.pickthall: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,
tr.yusufali: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-
tr.khattab: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا

tr.sahih: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
tr.pickthall: And then bestowed upon him ample means,
tr.yusufali: To whom I granted resources in abundance,
tr.khattab: and granted him abundant wealth

ayahs.ar: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا

tr.sahih: And children present [with him]
tr.pickthall: And sons abiding in his presence
tr.yusufali: And sons to be by his side!-
tr.khattab: and children always by his side

ayahs.ar: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا

tr.sahih: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
tr.pickthall: And made (life) smooth for him.
tr.yusufali: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
tr.khattab: and made life very easy for him

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ

tr.sahih: Then he desires that I should add more.
tr.pickthall: Yet he desireth that I should give more.
tr.yusufali: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-
tr.khattab: Yet he is hungry for more

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا

tr.sahih: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
tr.pickthall: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.
tr.yusufali: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
tr.khattab: But no! ˹For˺ he has been truly stubborn with Our revelations

ayahs.ar: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا

tr.sahih: I will cover him with arduous torment.
tr.pickthall: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.
tr.yusufali: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!
tr.khattab: I will make his fate unbearable

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
tr.pickthall: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -
tr.yusufali: For he thought and he plotted;-
tr.khattab: for he contemplated and determined ˹a degrading label for the Quran˺

ayahs.ar: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

tr.sahih: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
tr.pickthall: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!
tr.yusufali: And woe to him! How he plotted!-
tr.khattab: May he be condemned! How evil was what he determined

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

tr.sahih: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
tr.pickthall: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -
tr.yusufali: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-
tr.khattab: May he be condemned even more! How evil was what he determined

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ

tr.sahih: Then he considered [again];
tr.pickthall: Then looked he,
tr.yusufali: Then he looked round;
tr.khattab: Then he re-contemplated ˹in frustration˺

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ

tr.sahih: Then he frowned and scowled;
tr.pickthall: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.
tr.yusufali: Then he frowned and he scowled;
tr.khattab: then frowned and scowled

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ

tr.sahih: Then he turned back and was arrogant
tr.pickthall: Then turned he away in pride
tr.yusufali: Then he turned back and was haughty;
tr.khattab: then turned his back ˹on the truth˺ and acted arrogantly

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ

tr.sahih: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
tr.pickthall: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;
tr.yusufali: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;
tr.khattab: saying, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but magic from the ancients

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ

tr.sahih: This is not but the word of a human being."
tr.pickthall: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.
tr.yusufali: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"
tr.khattab: This is no more than the word of a man.”

ayahs.ar: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ

tr.sahih: I will drive him into Saqar.
tr.pickthall: Him shall I fling unto the burning.
tr.yusufali: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!
tr.khattab: Soon I will burn him in Hell

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
tr.pickthall: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
tr.khattab: And what will make you realize what Hell is

ayahs.ar: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ

tr.sahih: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
tr.pickthall: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught
tr.yusufali: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-
tr.khattab: It does not let anyone live or die

ayahs.ar: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ

tr.sahih: Blackening the skins.
tr.pickthall: It shrivelleth the man.
tr.yusufali: Darkening and changing the colour of man!
tr.khattab: scorching the skin

ayahs.ar: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ

tr.sahih: Over it are nineteen [angels].
tr.pickthall: Above it are nineteen.
tr.yusufali: Over it are Nineteen.
tr.khattab: It is overseen by nineteen ˹keepers˺

ayahs.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

tr.sahih: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
tr.pickthall: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
tr.yusufali: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.
tr.khattab: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ

tr.sahih: No! By the moon
tr.pickthall: Nay, by the Moon
tr.yusufali: Nay, verily: By the Moon,
tr.khattab: But no! By the moon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ

tr.sahih: And [by] the night when it departs
tr.pickthall: And the night when it withdraweth
tr.yusufali: And by the Night as it retreateth,
tr.khattab: and the night as it retreats

ayahs.ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ

tr.sahih: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
tr.pickthall: And the dawn when it shineth forth,
tr.yusufali: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
tr.khattab: and the day as it breaks

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
tr.pickthall: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)
tr.yusufali: This is but one of the mighty (portents),
tr.khattab: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—

ayahs.ar: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ

tr.sahih: As a warning to humanity -
tr.pickthall: As a warning unto men,
tr.yusufali: A warning to mankind,-
tr.khattab: a warning to humankind

ayahs.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ

tr.sahih: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
tr.pickthall: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.
tr.yusufali: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-
tr.khattab: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind

ayahs.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ

tr.sahih: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
tr.pickthall: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;
tr.yusufali: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.
tr.khattab: Every soul will be detained for what it has done

ayahs.ar: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ

tr.sahih: Except the companions of the right,
tr.pickthall: Save those who will stand on the right hand.
tr.yusufali: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.
tr.khattab: except the people of the right

ayahs.ar: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
tr.pickthall: In gardens they will ask one another
tr.yusufali: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,
tr.khattab: who will be in Gardens, asking one another

ayahs.ar: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: About the criminals,
tr.pickthall: Concerning the guilty:
tr.yusufali: And (ask) of the Sinners:
tr.khattab: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺

ayahs.ar: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ

tr.sahih: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
tr.pickthall: What hath brought you to this burning?
tr.yusufali: "What led you into Hell Fire?"
tr.khattab: “What has landed you in Hell?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ

tr.sahih: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
tr.pickthall: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed
tr.yusufali: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;
tr.khattab: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed

ayahs.ar: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ

tr.sahih: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
tr.pickthall: Nor did we feed the wretched.
tr.yusufali: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;
tr.khattab: nor did we feed the poor

ayahs.ar: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ

tr.sahih: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
tr.pickthall: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,
tr.yusufali: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;
tr.khattab: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others

ayahs.ar: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
tr.pickthall: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
tr.yusufali: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
tr.khattab: and deny the Day of Judgment

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ

tr.sahih: Until there came to us the certainty."
tr.pickthall: Till the Inevitable came unto us.
tr.yusufali: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."
tr.khattab: until the inevitable came to us.”

ayahs.ar: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ

tr.sahih: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
tr.pickthall: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.
tr.yusufali: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
tr.khattab: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them

ayahs.ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ

tr.sahih: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
tr.pickthall: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,
tr.yusufali: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-
tr.khattab: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder

ayahs.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: As if they were alarmed donkeys
tr.pickthall: As they were frightened asses
tr.yusufali: As if they were affrighted asses,
tr.khattab: as if they were spooked zebras

ayahs.ar: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ

tr.sahih: Fleeing from a lion?
tr.pickthall: Fleeing from a lion?
tr.yusufali: Fleeing from a lion!
tr.khattab: fleeing from a lion

ayahs.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ

tr.sahih: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).
tr.yusufali: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!
tr.khattab: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ

tr.sahih: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
tr.pickthall: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.
tr.yusufali: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,
tr.khattab: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
tr.pickthall: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.
tr.yusufali: Nay, this surely is an admonition:
tr.khattab: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder

ayahs.ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Then whoever wills will remember it.
tr.pickthall: So whosoever will may heed.
tr.yusufali: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!
tr.khattab: So let whoever wills be mindful of it

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ

tr.sahih: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
tr.pickthall: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.
tr.yusufali: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
tr.khattab: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive

ayahs.ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ

tr.sahih: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
tr.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
tr.yusufali: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;
tr.khattab: I do swear by the Day of Judgment

ayahs.ar: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ

tr.sahih: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
tr.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).
tr.yusufali: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).
tr.khattab: And I do swear by the self-reproaching soul

ayahs.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
tr.pickthall: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?
tr.yusufali: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?
tr.khattab: Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones

ayahs.ar: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
tr.pickthall: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!
tr.yusufali: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.
tr.khattab: Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips

ayahs.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ

tr.sahih: But man desires to continue in sin.
tr.pickthall: But man would fain deny what is before him.
tr.yusufali: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.
tr.khattab: Still people want to deny what is yet to come

ayahs.ar: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ

tr.sahih: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
tr.pickthall: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
tr.yusufali: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
tr.khattab: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ

tr.sahih: So when vision is dazzled
tr.pickthall: But when sight is confounded
tr.yusufali: At length, when the sight is dazed,
tr.khattab: But when the sight is stunned

ayahs.ar: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ

tr.sahih: And the moon darkens
tr.pickthall: And the moon is eclipsed
tr.yusufali: And the moon is buried in darkness.
tr.khattab: and the moon is dimmed

ayahs.ar: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ

tr.sahih: And the sun and the moon are joined,
tr.pickthall: And sun and moon are united,
tr.yusufali: And the sun and moon are joined together,-
tr.khattab: and the sun and the moon are brought together

ayahs.ar: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ

tr.sahih: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
tr.pickthall: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
tr.yusufali: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"
tr.khattab: on that Day one will cry, “Where is the escape?”

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ

tr.sahih: No! There is no refuge.
tr.pickthall: Alas! No refuge!
tr.yusufali: By no means! No place of safety!
tr.khattab: But no! There will be no refuge

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ

tr.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
tr.pickthall: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.
tr.yusufali: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.
tr.khattab: On that Day all will end up before your Lord

ayahs.ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ

tr.sahih: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
tr.pickthall: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.
tr.yusufali: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.
tr.khattab: All will then be informed of what they have sent forth and left behind

ayahs.ar: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
tr.pickthall: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
tr.yusufali: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,
tr.khattab: In fact, people will testify against their own souls

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Even if he presents his excuses.
tr.pickthall: Although he tender his excuses.
tr.yusufali: Even though he were to put up his excuses.
tr.khattab: despite the excuses they come up with

ayahs.ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ

tr.sahih: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
tr.pickthall: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.
tr.yusufali: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.
tr.khattab: Do not rush your tongue trying to memorize ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
tr.pickthall: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.
tr.yusufali: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:
tr.khattab: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ

tr.sahih: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
tr.pickthall: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;
tr.yusufali: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):
tr.khattab: So once We have recited a revelation ˹through Gabriel˺, follow its recitation ˹closely˺

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
tr.pickthall: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.
tr.yusufali: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):
tr.khattab: Then it is surely upon Us to make it clear ˹to you˺

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ

tr.sahih: No! But you love the immediate
tr.pickthall: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
tr.yusufali: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,
tr.khattab: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world

ayahs.ar: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ

tr.sahih: And leave the Hereafter.
tr.pickthall: And neglect the Hereafter.
tr.yusufali: And leave alone the Hereafter.
tr.khattab: and neglect the Hereafter

ayahs.ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ

tr.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
tr.pickthall: That day will faces be resplendent,
tr.yusufali: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-
tr.khattab: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Looking at their Lord.
tr.pickthall: Looking toward their Lord;
tr.yusufali: Looking towards their Lord;
tr.khattab: looking at their Lord

ayahs.ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
tr.pickthall: And that day will other faces be despondent,
tr.yusufali: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,
tr.khattab: And ˹other˺ faces will be gloomy

ayahs.ar: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
tr.pickthall: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.
tr.yusufali: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;
tr.khattab: anticipating something devastating to befall them

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ

tr.sahih: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
tr.pickthall: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
tr.yusufali: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),
tr.khattab: But no! ˹Beware of the day˺ when the soul reaches the collar bone ˹as it leaves˺

ayahs.ar: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ

tr.sahih: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
tr.pickthall: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?
tr.yusufali: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"
tr.khattab: and it will be said, “Is there any healer ˹who can save this life˺?”

ayahs.ar: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ

tr.sahih: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
tr.pickthall: And he knoweth that it is the parting;
tr.yusufali: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;
tr.khattab: And the dying person realizes it is ˹their˺ time to depart

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ

tr.sahih: And the leg is wound about the leg,
tr.pickthall: And agony is heaped on agony;
tr.yusufali: And one leg will be joined with another:
tr.khattab: and ˹then˺ their feet are tied together ˹in a shroud˺

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ

tr.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
tr.pickthall: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.
tr.yusufali: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!
tr.khattab: On that day they will be driven to your Lord ˹alone˺

ayahs.ar: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ

tr.sahih: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
tr.pickthall: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.
tr.yusufali: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-
tr.khattab: This denier neither believed nor prayed

ayahs.ar: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

tr.sahih: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
tr.pickthall: But he denied and flouted.
tr.yusufali: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!
tr.khattab: but persisted in denial and turned away

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
tr.pickthall: Then went he to his folk with glee.
tr.yusufali: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!
tr.khattab: then went to their own people, walking boastfully

ayahs.ar: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ

tr.sahih: Woe to you, and woe!
tr.pickthall: Nearer unto thee and nearer,
tr.yusufali: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
tr.khattab: Woe to you, and more woe

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Then woe to you, and woe!
tr.pickthall: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).
tr.yusufali: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
tr.khattab: Again, woe to you, and even more woe

ayahs.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى

tr.sahih: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
tr.pickthall: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?
tr.yusufali: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?
tr.khattab: Do people think they will be left without purpose

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
tr.pickthall: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?
tr.yusufali: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?
tr.khattab: Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

tr.sahih: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
tr.pickthall: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
tr.yusufali: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.
tr.khattab: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
tr.pickthall: And made of him a pair, the male and female.
tr.yusufali: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.
tr.khattab: producing from it both sexes, male and female

ayahs.ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ

tr.sahih: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
tr.pickthall: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?
tr.yusufali: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
tr.khattab: Is such ˹a Creator˺ unable to bring the dead back to life

ayahs.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا

tr.sahih: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
tr.pickthall: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
tr.yusufali: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?
tr.khattab: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
tr.yusufali: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
tr.khattab: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
tr.yusufali: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).
tr.khattab: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.
tr.yusufali: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
tr.pickthall: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,
tr.yusufali: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-
tr.khattab: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—

ayahs.ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
tr.pickthall: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,
tr.yusufali: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.
tr.khattab: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will

ayahs.ar: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
tr.pickthall: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
tr.yusufali: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.
tr.khattab: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror

ayahs.ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا

tr.sahih: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
tr.pickthall: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,
tr.yusufali: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-
tr.khattab: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا

tr.sahih: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
tr.pickthall: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
tr.yusufali: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.
tr.khattab: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
tr.pickthall: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
tr.yusufali: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."
tr.khattab: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”

ayahs.ar: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا

tr.sahih: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
tr.pickthall: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
tr.yusufali: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.
tr.khattab: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy

ayahs.ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
tr.pickthall: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;
tr.yusufali: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.
tr.khattab: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk

ayahs.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
tr.pickthall: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
tr.yusufali: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.
tr.khattab: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold

ayahs.ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
tr.pickthall: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.
tr.yusufali: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.
tr.khattab: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach

ayahs.ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠

tr.sahih: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
tr.pickthall: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
tr.yusufali: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-
tr.khattab: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—

ayahs.ar: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
tr.pickthall: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).
tr.yusufali: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
tr.khattab: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired

ayahs.ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

tr.sahih: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
tr.pickthall: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
tr.yusufali: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-
tr.khattab: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger

ayahs.ar: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
tr.pickthall: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
tr.yusufali: A fountain there, called Salsabil.
tr.khattab: from a spring there, called Salsabîl

ayahs.ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا

tr.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
tr.pickthall: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
tr.yusufali: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.
tr.khattab: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا

tr.sahih: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
tr.pickthall: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
tr.yusufali: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.
tr.khattab: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom

ayahs.ar: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا

tr.sahih: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
tr.pickthall: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.
tr.yusufali: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.
tr.khattab: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا

tr.sahih: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
tr.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
tr.yusufali: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."
tr.khattab: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;
tr.yusufali: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.
tr.khattab: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages

ayahs.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا

tr.sahih: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
tr.pickthall: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.
tr.yusufali: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.
tr.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them

ayahs.ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
tr.pickthall: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
tr.yusufali: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,
tr.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا

tr.sahih: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
tr.pickthall: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.
tr.yusufali: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.
tr.khattab: and prostrate before Him during part of the night, and glorify Him long at night

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
tr.pickthall: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
tr.yusufali: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.
tr.khattab: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them

ayahs.ar: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا

tr.sahih: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
tr.pickthall: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
tr.yusufali: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.
tr.khattab: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
tr.pickthall: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
tr.yusufali: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.
tr.khattab: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord
