tr.yusufali: And made your sleep for rest,
tr.khattab: and made your sleep for rest

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا

tr.sahih: And made the night as clothing
tr.pickthall: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
tr.yusufali: And made the night as a covering,
tr.khattab: and made the night as a cover

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا

tr.sahih: And made the day for livelihood
tr.pickthall: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
tr.yusufali: And made the day as a means of subsistence?
tr.khattab: and made the day for livelihood

ayahs.ar: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا

tr.sahih: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
tr.pickthall: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
tr.yusufali: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,
tr.khattab: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا

tr.sahih: And made [therein] a burning lamp
tr.pickthall: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
tr.yusufali: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?
tr.khattab: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp

ayahs.ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا

tr.sahih: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
tr.pickthall: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
tr.yusufali: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,
tr.khattab: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water

ayahs.ar: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا

tr.sahih: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
tr.pickthall: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
tr.yusufali: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,
tr.khattab: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants

ayahs.ar: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا

tr.sahih: And gardens of entwined growth.
tr.pickthall: And gardens of thick foliage.
tr.yusufali: And gardens of luxurious growth?
tr.khattab: and dense orchards

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
tr.pickthall: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
tr.yusufali: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,
tr.khattab: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا

tr.sahih: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
tr.pickthall: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
tr.yusufali: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;
tr.khattab: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds

ayahs.ar: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا

tr.sahih: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
tr.pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
tr.yusufali: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
tr.khattab: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates

ayahs.ar: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا

tr.sahih: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
tr.pickthall: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
tr.yusufali: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.
tr.khattab: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
tr.pickthall: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,
tr.yusufali: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,
tr.khattab: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush

ayahs.ar: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا

tr.sahih: For the transgressors, a place of return,
tr.pickthall: A home for the rebellious.
tr.yusufali: For the transgressors a place of destination:
tr.khattab: as a home for the transgressors

ayahs.ar: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا

tr.sahih: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
tr.pickthall: They will abide therein for ages.
tr.yusufali: They will dwell therein for ages.
tr.khattab: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا

tr.sahih: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
tr.pickthall: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
tr.yusufali: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,
tr.khattab: There they will not taste any coolness or drink

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا

tr.sahih: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
tr.pickthall: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
tr.yusufali: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,
tr.khattab: except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—

ayahs.ar: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا

tr.sahih: An appropriate recompense.
tr.pickthall: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).
tr.yusufali: A fitting recompense (for them).
tr.khattab: a fitting reward

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
tr.pickthall: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
tr.yusufali: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
tr.khattab: For they never expected any reckoning

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا

tr.sahih: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
tr.pickthall: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
tr.yusufali: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.
tr.khattab: and totally rejected Our signs

ayahs.ar: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا

tr.sahih: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
tr.pickthall: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
tr.yusufali: And all things have We preserved on record.
tr.khattab: And We have everything recorded precisely

ayahs.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا

tr.sahih: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
tr.pickthall: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
tr.yusufali: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
tr.khattab: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
tr.pickthall: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
tr.yusufali: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;
tr.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—

ayahs.ar: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا

tr.sahih: Gardens and grapevines
tr.pickthall: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,
tr.yusufali: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;
tr.khattab: Gardens, vineyards

ayahs.ar: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا

tr.sahih: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
tr.pickthall: And voluptuous women of equal age;
tr.yusufali: And voluptuous women of equal age;
tr.khattab: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age

ayahs.ar: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا

tr.sahih: And a full cup.
tr.pickthall: And a full cup.
tr.yusufali: And a cup full (to the brim).
tr.khattab: and full cups ˹of pure wine˺

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا

tr.sahih: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
tr.pickthall: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
tr.yusufali: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-
tr.khattab: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—

ayahs.ar: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا

tr.sahih: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
tr.pickthall: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
tr.yusufali: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,
tr.khattab: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord

ayahs.ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا

tr.sahih: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
tr.pickthall: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
tr.yusufali: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.
tr.khattab: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا

tr.sahih: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
tr.pickthall: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
tr.yusufali: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.
tr.khattab: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true

ayahs.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا

tr.sahih: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
tr.pickthall: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
tr.yusufali: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
tr.khattab: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
tr.pickthall: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
tr.yusufali: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (metre) dust!"
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”

ayahs.ar: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا

tr.sahih: By those [angels] who extract with violence
tr.pickthall: By those who drag forth to destruction,
tr.yusufali: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
tr.khattab: By those ˹angels˺ stripping out ˹evil souls˺ harshly

ayahs.ar: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا

tr.sahih: And [by] those who remove with ease
tr.pickthall: By the meteors rushing,
tr.yusufali: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);
tr.khattab: and those pulling out ˹good souls˺ gently

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا

tr.sahih: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
tr.pickthall: By the lone stars floating,
tr.yusufali: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
tr.khattab: and those gliding ˹through heavens˺ swiftly

ayahs.ar: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا

tr.sahih: And those who race each other in a race
tr.pickthall: By the angels hastening,
tr.yusufali: Then press forward as in a race,
tr.khattab: and those taking the lead vigorously

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا

tr.sahih: And those who arrange [each] matter,
tr.pickthall: And those who govern the event,
tr.yusufali: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),
tr.khattab: and those conducting affairs ˹obediently˺

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ

tr.sahih: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
tr.pickthall: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
tr.yusufali: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
tr.khattab: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass

ayahs.ar: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ

tr.sahih: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
tr.pickthall: And the second followeth it,
tr.yusufali: Followed by oft-repeated (commotions):
tr.khattab: followed by a second Blast

ayahs.ar: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ

tr.sahih: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
tr.pickthall: On that day hearts beat painfully
tr.yusufali: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
tr.khattab: ˹The deniers’˺ hearts on that Day will be trembling ˹in horror˺

ayahs.ar: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Their eyes humbled.
tr.pickthall: While eyes are downcast
tr.yusufali: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.
tr.khattab: with their eyes downcast

ayahs.ar: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ

tr.sahih: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
tr.pickthall: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
tr.yusufali: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?
tr.khattab: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state

ayahs.ar: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ

tr.sahih: Even if we should be decayed bones?
tr.pickthall: Even after we are crumbled bones?
tr.yusufali: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"
tr.khattab: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
tr.pickthall: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
tr.yusufali: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
tr.khattab: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
tr.pickthall: Surely it will need but one shout,
tr.yusufali: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
tr.khattab: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ

tr.sahih: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
tr.pickthall: And lo! they will be awakened.
tr.yusufali: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).
tr.khattab: and at once they will be above ground

ayahs.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
tr.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?
tr.yusufali: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
tr.khattab: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

tr.sahih: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
tr.pickthall: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,
tr.yusufali: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-
tr.khattab: His Lord called him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa

ayahs.ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ

tr.sahih: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
tr.pickthall: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -
tr.yusufali: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:
tr.khattab: ˹commanding,˺ “Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺

ayahs.ar: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

tr.sahih: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
tr.pickthall: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
tr.yusufali: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-
tr.khattab: And say, ‘Would you ˹be willing to˺ purify yourself

ayahs.ar: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ

tr.sahih: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
tr.pickthall: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).
tr.yusufali: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"
tr.khattab: and let me guide you to your Lord so that you will be in awe ˹of Him˺?’”

ayahs.ar: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: And he showed him the greatest sign,
tr.pickthall: And he showed him the tremendous token.
tr.yusufali: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
tr.khattab: Then Moses showed him the great sign

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ

tr.sahih: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
tr.pickthall: But he denied and disobeyed,
tr.yusufali: But (Pharaoh) rejected it and disobeyed (guidance);
tr.khattab: but he denied and disobeyed ˹Allah˺

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ

tr.sahih: Then he turned his back, striving.
tr.pickthall: Then turned he away in haste,
tr.yusufali: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
tr.khattab: then turned his back, striving ˹against the truth˺

ayahs.ar: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ

tr.sahih: And he gathered [his people] and called out
tr.pickthall: Then gathered he and summoned
tr.yusufali: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
tr.khattab: Then he summoned ˹his people˺ and called out

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

tr.sahih: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
tr.pickthall: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
tr.yusufali: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
tr.khattab: saying, “I am your lord, the most high!”

ayahs.ar: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
tr.pickthall: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
tr.yusufali: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.
tr.khattab: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].
tr.pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.
tr.yusufali: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).
tr.khattab: Surely in this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of ˹Allah˺

ayahs.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
tr.pickthall: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
tr.yusufali: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:
tr.khattab: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it

ayahs.ar: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا

tr.sahih: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
tr.pickthall: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;
tr.yusufali: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.
tr.khattab: raising it high and forming it flawlessly

ayahs.ar: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
tr.pickthall: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
tr.yusufali: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).
tr.khattab: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ

tr.sahih: And after that He spread the earth.
tr.pickthall: And after that He spread the earth,
tr.yusufali: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);
tr.khattab: As for the earth, He spread it out as well

ayahs.ar: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
tr.pickthall: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
tr.yusufali: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;
tr.khattab: bringing forth its water and pastures

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And the mountains He set firmly
tr.pickthall: And He made fast the hills,
tr.yusufali: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
tr.khattab: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—

ayahs.ar: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ

tr.sahih: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
tr.pickthall: A provision for you and for your cattle.
tr.yusufali: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
tr.khattab: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
tr.pickthall: But when the great disaster cometh,
tr.yusufali: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-
tr.khattab: But, when the Supreme Disaster comes to pass—

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ

tr.sahih: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
tr.pickthall: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
tr.yusufali: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,
tr.khattab: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving

ayahs.ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ

tr.sahih: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
tr.pickthall: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
tr.yusufali: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-
tr.khattab: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ

tr.sahih: So as for he who transgressed
tr.pickthall: Then, as for him who rebelled
tr.yusufali: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,
tr.khattab: then as for those who transgressed

ayahs.ar: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

tr.sahih: And preferred the life of the world,
tr.pickthall: And chose the life of the world,
tr.yusufali: And had preferred the life of this world,
tr.khattab: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ

tr.sahih: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
tr.pickthall: Lo! hell will be his home.
tr.yusufali: The Abode will be Hell-Fire;
tr.khattab: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ

tr.sahih: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
tr.pickthall: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
tr.yusufali: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
tr.khattab: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ

tr.sahih: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
tr.pickthall: Lo! the Garden will be his home.
tr.yusufali: Their abode will be the Garden.
tr.khattab: Paradise will certainly be ˹their˺ home

ayahs.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
tr.pickthall: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?
tr.yusufali: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?
tr.khattab: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding the Hour, “When will it be?”

ayahs.ar: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ

tr.sahih: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
tr.pickthall: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
tr.yusufali: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
tr.khattab: But it is not for you to tell its time

ayahs.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ

tr.sahih: To your Lord is its finality.
tr.pickthall: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
tr.yusufali: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
tr.khattab: That knowledge rests with your Lord ˹alone˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
tr.pickthall: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
tr.yusufali: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
tr.khattab: Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it

ayahs.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
tr.pickthall: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
tr.yusufali: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
tr.khattab: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning

ayahs.ar: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

tr.sahih: The Prophet frowned and turned away
tr.pickthall: He frowned and turned away
tr.yusufali: (The Prophet) frowned and turned away,
tr.khattab: He frowned and turned ˹his attention˺ away

ayahs.ar: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ

tr.sahih: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
tr.pickthall: Because the blind man came unto him.
tr.yusufali: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).
tr.khattab: ˹simply˺ because the blind man came to him ˹interrupting˺

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ

tr.sahih: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
tr.pickthall: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
tr.yusufali: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
tr.khattab: You never know ˹O Prophet˺, perhaps he may be purified

ayahs.ar: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
tr.pickthall: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
tr.yusufali: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?
tr.khattab: or he may be mindful, benefitting from the reminder

ayahs.ar: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: As for he who thinks himself without need,
tr.pickthall: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
tr.yusufali: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,
tr.khattab: As for the one who was indifferent

ayahs.ar: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ

tr.sahih: To him you give attention.
tr.pickthall: Unto him thou payest regard.
tr.yusufali: To him dost thou attend;
tr.khattab: you gave him your ˹undivided˺ attention

ayahs.ar: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ

tr.sahih: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
tr.pickthall: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
tr.yusufali: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).
tr.khattab: even though you are not to blame if he would not be purified

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ

tr.sahih: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
tr.pickthall: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
tr.yusufali: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,
tr.khattab: But as for the one who came to you, eager ˹to learn˺

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ

tr.sahih: While he fears [Allah],
tr.pickthall: And hath fear,
tr.yusufali: And with fear (in his heart),
tr.khattab: being in awe ˹of Allah˺

ayahs.ar: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ

tr.sahih: From him you are distracted.
tr.pickthall: From him thou art distracted.
tr.yusufali: Of him wast thou unmindful.
tr.khattab: you were inattentive to him

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
tr.pickthall: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
tr.yusufali: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
tr.khattab: But no! This ˹revelation˺ is truly a reminder

ayahs.ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: So whoever wills may remember it.
tr.pickthall: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
tr.yusufali: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.
tr.khattab: So let whoever wills be mindful of it

ayahs.ar: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
tr.pickthall: On honoured leaves
tr.yusufali: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,
tr.khattab: It is ˹written˺ on pages held in honour—

ayahs.ar: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ

tr.sahih: Exalted and purified,
tr.pickthall: Exalted, purified,
tr.yusufali: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,
tr.khattab: highly esteemed, purified—

ayahs.ar: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
tr.pickthall: (Set down) by scribes
tr.yusufali: (Written) by the hands of scribes-
tr.khattab: by the hands of angel-scribes

ayahs.ar: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: Noble and dutiful.
tr.pickthall: Noble and righteous.
tr.yusufali: Honourable and Pious and Just.
tr.khattab: honourable and virtuous

ayahs.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
tr.pickthall: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!
tr.yusufali: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;
tr.khattab: Condemned are ˹disbelieving˺ humans! How ungrateful they are ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ

tr.sahih: From what substance did He create him?
tr.pickthall: From what thing doth He create him?
tr.yusufali: From what stuff hath He created him?
tr.khattab: From what substance did He create them

ayahs.ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
tr.pickthall: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
tr.yusufali: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
tr.khattab: He created them from a sperm-drop, and ordained their development

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Then He eased the way for him;
tr.pickthall: Then maketh the way easy for him,
tr.yusufali: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;
tr.khattab: Then He makes the way easy for them

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
tr.pickthall: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
tr.yusufali: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;
tr.khattab: then causes them to die and be buried

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
tr.pickthall: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
tr.yusufali: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).
tr.khattab: Then when He wills, He will resurrect them

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
tr.yusufali: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.
tr.khattab: But no! They have failed to comply with what He ordered

ayahs.ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ

tr.sahih: Then let mankind look at his food -
tr.pickthall: Let man consider his food:
tr.yusufali: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
tr.khattab: Let people then consider their food

ayahs.ar: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا

tr.sahih: How We poured down water in torrents,
tr.pickthall: How We pour water in showers
tr.yusufali: For that We pour forth water in abundance,
tr.khattab: how We pour down rain in abundance

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا

tr.sahih: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
tr.pickthall: Then split the earth in clefts
tr.yusufali: And We split the earth in fragments,
tr.khattab: and meticulously split the earth open ˹for sprouts˺

ayahs.ar: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا

tr.sahih: And caused to grow within it grain
tr.pickthall: And cause the grain to grow therein
tr.yusufali: And produce therein corn,
tr.khattab: causing grain to grow in it

ayahs.ar: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا

tr.sahih: And grapes and herbage
tr.pickthall: And grapes and green fodder
tr.yusufali: And Grapes and nutritious plants,
tr.khattab: as well as grapes and greens

ayahs.ar: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا

tr.sahih: And olive and palm trees
tr.pickthall: And olive-trees and palm-trees
tr.yusufali: And Olives and Dates,
tr.khattab: and olives and palm trees

ayahs.ar: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا

tr.sahih: And gardens of dense shrubbery
tr.pickthall: And garden-closes of thick foliage
tr.yusufali: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
tr.khattab: and dense orchards

ayahs.ar: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا

tr.sahih: And fruit and grass -
tr.pickthall: And fruits and grasses:
tr.yusufali: And fruits and fodder,-
tr.khattab: and fruit and fodder—

ayahs.ar: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ

tr.sahih: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
tr.pickthall: Provision for you and your cattle.
tr.yusufali: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
tr.khattab: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ

tr.sahih: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
tr.pickthall: But when the Shout cometh
tr.yusufali: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-
tr.khattab: Then, when the Deafening Blast comes to pass—

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ

tr.sahih: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
tr.pickthall: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
tr.yusufali: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
tr.khattab: on that Day every person will flee from their own siblings

ayahs.ar: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ

tr.sahih: And his mother and his father
tr.pickthall: And his mother and his father
tr.yusufali: And from his mother and his father,
tr.khattab: and ˹even˺ their mother and father

ayahs.ar: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ

tr.sahih: And his wife and his children,
tr.pickthall: And his wife and his children,
tr.yusufali: And from his wife and his children.
tr.khattab: and ˹even˺ their spouse and children

ayahs.ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ

tr.sahih: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
tr.pickthall: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
tr.yusufali: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.
tr.khattab: For then everyone will have enough concern of their own

ayahs.ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
tr.pickthall: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
tr.yusufali: Some faces that Day will be beaming,
tr.khattab: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright

ayahs.ar: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
tr.pickthall: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;
tr.yusufali: Laughing, rejoicing.
tr.khattab: laughing and rejoicing

ayahs.ar: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
tr.pickthall: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
tr.yusufali: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
tr.khattab: while ˹other˺ faces will be dusty

ayahs.ar: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ

tr.sahih: Blackness will cover them.
tr.pickthall: Veiled in darkness,
tr.yusufali: Blackness will cover them:
tr.khattab: cast in gloom—

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ

tr.sahih: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
tr.pickthall: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
tr.yusufali: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
tr.khattab: those are the disbelievers, the ˹wicked˺ sinners

ayahs.ar: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ

tr.sahih: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
tr.pickthall: When the sun is overthrown,
tr.yusufali: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;
tr.khattab: When the sun is put out

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ

tr.sahih: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
tr.pickthall: And when the stars fall,
tr.yusufali: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;
tr.khattab: and when the stars fall down

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ

tr.sahih: And when the mountains are removed
tr.pickthall: And when the hills are moved,
tr.yusufali: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);
tr.khattab: and when the mountains are blown away

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ

tr.sahih: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
tr.pickthall: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
tr.yusufali: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;
tr.khattab: and when pregnant camels are left untended

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ

tr.sahih: And when the wild beasts are gathered
tr.pickthall: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
tr.yusufali: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);
tr.khattab: and when wild beasts are gathered together

tr.pickthall: And when the seas rise,
tr.yusufali: When the oceans boil over with a swell;
tr.khattab: and when the seas are set on fire

tr.pickthall: And when souls are reunited,

tr.khattab: and when the souls ˹and their bodies˺ are paired ˹once more˺

tr.pickthall: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
tr.yusufali: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -

tr.sahih: For what sin she was killed
tr.pickthall: For what sin she was slain,
tr.yusufali: For what crime she was killed;
tr.khattab: for what crime they were put to death

tr.sahih: And when the pages are made public
tr.pickthall: And when the pages are laid open,
tr.yusufali: When the scrolls are laid open;
tr.khattab: and when the records ˹of deeds˺ are laid open

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ

tr.sahih: And when the sky is stripped away
tr.pickthall: And when the sky is torn away,
tr.yusufali: When the world on High is unveiled;
tr.khattab: and when the sky is stripped away

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ

tr.sahih: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
tr.pickthall: And when hell is lighted,
tr.yusufali: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
tr.khattab: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ

tr.sahih: And when Paradise is brought near,
tr.pickthall: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
tr.yusufali: And when the Garden is brought near;-
tr.khattab: and when Paradise is brought near—

tr.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
tr.pickthall: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
tr.yusufali: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
tr.khattab: ˹on that Day˺ each soul will know what ˹deeds˺ it has brought along

tr.sahih: So I swear by the retreating stars -
tr.pickthall: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
tr.yusufali: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,
tr.khattab: I do swear by the receding stars

ayahs.ar: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ

tr.sahih: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
tr.pickthall: The stars which rise and set,
tr.yusufali: Go straight, or hide;
tr.khattab: which travel and hide

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ

tr.sahih: And by the night as it closes in
tr.pickthall: And the close of night,
tr.yusufali: And the Night as it dissipates;
tr.khattab: and the night as it falls

ayahs.ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ

tr.sahih: And by the dawn when it breathes
tr.pickthall: And the breath of morning
tr.yusufali: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
tr.khattab: and the day as it breaks

tr.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
tr.pickthall: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
tr.yusufali: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,
tr.khattab: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the Word of ˹Allah delivered by Gabriel,˺ a noble messenger-angel

ayahs.ar: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
tr.pickthall: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
tr.yusufali: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
tr.khattab: full of power, held in honour by the Lord of the Throne

ayahs.ar: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
tr.pickthall: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;
tr.yusufali: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.
tr.khattab: obeyed there ˹in heaven˺, and trustworthy

ayahs.ar: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
tr.pickthall: And your comrade is not mad.
tr.yusufali: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;
tr.khattab: And your fellow man is not insane

tr.sahih: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
tr.pickthall: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
tr.yusufali: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.
tr.khattab: And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon

ayahs.ar: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ

tr.sahih: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
tr.pickthall: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
tr.yusufali: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.
tr.khattab: and he does not withhold ˹what is revealed to him of˺ the unseen

ayahs.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
tr.pickthall: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
tr.yusufali: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.
tr.khattab: And this ˹Quran˺ is not the word of an outcast devil

ayahs.ar: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ

tr.sahih: So where are you going?
tr.pickthall: Whither then go ye?
tr.yusufali: When whither go ye?
tr.khattab: So what ˹other˺ path would you take

ayahs.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
tr.pickthall: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
tr.yusufali: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:
tr.khattab: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—

ayahs.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ

tr.sahih: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
tr.pickthall: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
tr.yusufali: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
tr.khattab: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
tr.pickthall: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
tr.yusufali: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
tr.khattab: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺, except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ

tr.sahih: When the sky breaks apart
tr.pickthall: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
tr.yusufali: When the Sky is cleft asunder;
tr.khattab: When the sky splits open

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ

tr.sahih: And when the stars fall, scattering,
tr.pickthall: When the planets are dispersed,
tr.yusufali: When the Stars are scattered;
tr.khattab: and when the stars fall away

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ

tr.sahih: And when the seas are erupted
tr.pickthall: When the seas are poured forth,
tr.yusufali: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;
tr.khattab: and when the seas burst forth

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ

tr.sahih: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
tr.pickthall: And the sepulchres are overturned,
tr.yusufali: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-
tr.khattab: and when the graves spill out

ayahs.ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ

tr.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
tr.pickthall: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
tr.yusufali: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
tr.khattab: ˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ

tr.sahih: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
tr.pickthall: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
tr.yusufali: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-
tr.khattab: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ

tr.sahih: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
tr.pickthall: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
tr.yusufali: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;
tr.khattab: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design

ayahs.ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ

tr.sahih: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
tr.pickthall: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
tr.yusufali: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.
tr.khattab: moulding you in whatever form He willed

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: No! But you deny the Recompense.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
tr.yusufali: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!
tr.khattab: But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ

tr.sahih: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
tr.pickthall: Lo! there are above you guardians,
tr.yusufali: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-
tr.khattab: while you are certainly observed by vigilant

ayahs.ar: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ

tr.sahih: Noble and recording;
tr.pickthall: Generous and recording,
tr.yusufali: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):
tr.khattab: honourable angels, recording ˹everything˺

ayahs.ar: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

tr.sahih: They know whatever you do.
tr.pickthall: Who know (all) that ye do.
tr.yusufali: They know (and understand) all that ye do.
tr.khattab: They know whatever you do

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
tr.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
tr.yusufali: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;
tr.khattab: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
tr.yusufali: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,
tr.khattab: and the wicked will be in Hell

tr.pickthall: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
tr.yusufali: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,
tr.khattab: burning in it on Judgment Day

tr.sahih: And never therefrom will they be absent.
tr.pickthall: And will not be absent thence.
tr.yusufali: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
tr.khattab: and they will have no escape from it

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
tr.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
tr.khattab: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
tr.pickthall: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
tr.yusufali: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
tr.khattab: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ

tr.sahih: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
tr.pickthall: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
tr.yusufali: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺

ayahs.ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ

tr.sahih: Woe to those who give less [than due],
tr.pickthall: Woe unto the defrauders:
tr.yusufali: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
tr.khattab: Woe to the defrauders

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

tr.sahih: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
tr.pickthall: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
tr.yusufali: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
tr.khattab: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people

tr.pickthall: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.
tr.yusufali: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
tr.khattab: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers

ayahs.ar: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ

tr.sahih: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
tr.pickthall: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
tr.yusufali: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
tr.khattab: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected

ayahs.ar: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: For a tremendous Day -
tr.pickthall: Unto an Awful Day,
tr.yusufali: On a Mighty Day,
tr.khattab: for a tremendous Day—

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

tr.sahih: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
tr.pickthall: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
tr.yusufali: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
tr.khattab: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ

tr.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -
tr.yusufali: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
tr.khattab: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjîn ˹in the depths of Hell˺—

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
tr.pickthall: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
tr.khattab: and what will make you realize what Sijjîn is?—

ayahs.ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ

tr.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
tr.pickthall: A written record.
tr.yusufali: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed.
tr.khattab: a fate ˹already˺ sealed

ayahs.ar: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

tr.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
tr.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.yusufali: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
tr.khattab: Woe on that Day to the deniers—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
tr.pickthall: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
tr.yusufali: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
tr.khattab: those who deny Judgment Day

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
tr.pickthall: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
tr.yusufali: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
tr.khattab: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor

tr.pickthall: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
tr.yusufali: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
tr.khattab: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

tr.sahih: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.
tr.yusufali: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
tr.khattab: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ

tr.sahih: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
tr.yusufali: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
tr.khattab: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

tr.sahih: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
tr.yusufali: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
tr.khattab: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ

tr.sahih: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
tr.pickthall: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
tr.yusufali: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
tr.khattab: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ

tr.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -
tr.yusufali: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.
tr.khattab: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
tr.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
tr.khattab: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—

ayahs.ar: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ

tr.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
tr.pickthall: A written record,
tr.yusufali: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed,
tr.khattab: a fate ˹already˺ sealed

ayahs.ar: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

tr.sahih: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
tr.pickthall: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).
tr.yusufali: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).
tr.khattab: witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
tr.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
tr.yusufali: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
tr.khattab: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss

ayahs.ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

tr.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.
tr.pickthall: On couches, gazing,
tr.yusufali: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
tr.khattab: ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around

ayahs.ar: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

tr.sahih: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
tr.pickthall: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
tr.yusufali: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
tr.khattab: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight

ayahs.ar: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ

tr.sahih: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
tr.pickthall: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,
tr.yusufali: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
tr.khattab: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine

ayahs.ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ

tr.sahih: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
tr.pickthall: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -
tr.yusufali: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
tr.khattab: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺

ayahs.ar: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ

tr.sahih: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
tr.pickthall: And mixed with water of Tasnim,
tr.yusufali: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
tr.khattab: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnîm—

ayahs.ar: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ

tr.sahih: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.
tr.pickthall: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.
tr.yusufali: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.
tr.khattab: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
tr.pickthall: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
tr.yusufali: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
tr.khattab: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ

tr.sahih: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
tr.pickthall: And wink one to another when they passed them;
tr.yusufali: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
tr.khattab: wink to one another whenever they passed by

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ

tr.sahih: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
tr.pickthall: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;
tr.yusufali: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
tr.khattab: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ

tr.sahih: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
tr.pickthall: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
tr.yusufali: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
tr.khattab: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ

tr.sahih: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
tr.pickthall: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
tr.yusufali: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
tr.khattab: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ

tr.sahih: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
tr.pickthall: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
tr.yusufali: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
tr.khattab: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers

ayahs.ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

tr.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.
tr.pickthall: On high couches, gazing.
tr.yusufali: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
tr.khattab: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on

ayahs.ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ

tr.sahih: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
tr.pickthall: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?
tr.yusufali: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
tr.khattab: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”

ayahs.ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ

tr.sahih: When the sky has split [open]
tr.pickthall: When the heaven is split asunder
tr.yusufali: When the sky is rent asunder,
tr.khattab: When the sky bursts open

ayahs.ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ

tr.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
tr.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
tr.yusufali: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
tr.khattab: obeying its Lord as it must

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ

tr.sahih: And when the earth has been extended
tr.pickthall: And when the earth is spread out
tr.yusufali: And when the earth is flattened out,
tr.khattab: and when the earth is flattened out

ayahs.ar: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ

tr.sahih: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
tr.pickthall: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
tr.yusufali: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,
tr.khattab: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty

ayahs.ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ

tr.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
tr.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear!
tr.yusufali: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).
tr.khattab: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ

tr.sahih: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
tr.pickthall: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
tr.yusufali: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.
tr.khattab: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ

tr.sahih: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
tr.pickthall: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
tr.yusufali: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,
tr.khattab: As for those who are given their record in their right hand

ayahs.ar: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: He will be judged with an easy account
tr.pickthall: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
tr.yusufali: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,
tr.khattab: they will have an easy reckoning

ayahs.ar: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا

tr.sahih: And return to his people in happiness.
tr.pickthall: And will return unto his folk in joy.
tr.yusufali: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
tr.khattab: and will return to their people joyfully

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ

tr.sahih: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
tr.pickthall: But whoso is given his account behind his back,
tr.yusufali: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-
tr.khattab: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs

ayahs.ar: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا

tr.sahih: He will cry out for destruction
tr.pickthall: He surely will invoke destruction
tr.yusufali: Soon will he cry for perdition,
tr.khattab: they will cry for ˹instant˺ destruction

ayahs.ar: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا

tr.sahih: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
tr.pickthall: And be thrown to scorching fire.
tr.yusufali: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.
tr.khattab: and will burn in the blazing Fire

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا

tr.sahih: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
tr.pickthall: He verily lived joyous with his folk,
tr.yusufali: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!
tr.khattab: For they used to be prideful among their people

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].
tr.pickthall: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).
tr.yusufali: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!
tr.khattab: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا

tr.sahih: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
tr.yusufali: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
tr.khattab: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them

ayahs.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ

tr.sahih: So I swear by the twilight glow
tr.pickthall: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
tr.yusufali: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;
tr.khattab: So, I do swear by the twilight

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ

tr.sahih: And [by] the night and what it envelops
tr.pickthall: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,
tr.yusufali: The Night and its Homing;
tr.khattab: And by the night and whatever it envelops

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ

tr.sahih: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
tr.pickthall: And by the moon when she is at the full,
tr.yusufali: And the Moon in her fullness:
tr.khattab: And by the moon when it waxes full

ayahs.ar: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ

tr.sahih: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
tr.pickthall: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
tr.yusufali: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.
tr.khattab: You will certainly pass from one state to another

ayahs.ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

tr.sahih: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
tr.pickthall: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
tr.yusufali: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-
tr.khattab: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩

tr.sahih: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
tr.pickthall: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?
tr.yusufali: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
tr.khattab: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺

ayahs.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ

tr.sahih: But those who have disbelieved deny,
tr.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;
tr.yusufali: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).
tr.khattab: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial

ayahs.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ

tr.sahih: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
tr.pickthall: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
tr.yusufali: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
tr.khattab: But Allah knows best whatever they hide

ayahs.ar: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

tr.sahih: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
tr.pickthall: So give them tidings of a painful doom,
tr.yusufali: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,
tr.khattab: So give them good news of a painful punishment

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ

tr.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
tr.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
tr.yusufali: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
tr.khattab: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ

tr.sahih: By the sky containing great stars
tr.pickthall: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
tr.yusufali: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;
tr.khattab: By the sky full of constellations

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the promised Day
tr.pickthall: And by the Promised Day.
tr.yusufali: By the promised Day (of Judgment);
tr.khattab: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺

ayahs.ar: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ

tr.sahih: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
tr.pickthall: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,
tr.yusufali: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-
tr.khattab: and the witness and what is witnessed

ayahs.ar: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ

tr.sahih: Cursed were the companions of the trench
tr.pickthall: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
tr.yusufali: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),
tr.khattab: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—

ayahs.ar: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ

tr.sahih: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
tr.pickthall: Of the fuel-fed fire,
tr.yusufali: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel:
tr.khattab: the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—

ayahs.ar: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ

tr.sahih: When they were sitting near it
tr.pickthall: When they sat by it,
tr.yusufali: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),
tr.khattab: when they sat around it

ayahs.ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ

tr.sahih: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
tr.pickthall: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.
tr.yusufali: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.
tr.khattab: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ

tr.sahih: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
tr.pickthall: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,
tr.yusufali: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-
tr.khattab: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ

tr.sahih: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
tr.pickthall: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
tr.yusufali: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.
tr.khattab: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
tr.pickthall: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
tr.yusufali: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
tr.khattab: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.
tr.yusufali: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),
tr.khattab: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
tr.pickthall: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
tr.yusufali: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
tr.khattab: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
tr.pickthall: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,
tr.yusufali: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).
tr.khattab: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ

tr.sahih: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
tr.pickthall: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
tr.yusufali: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
tr.khattab: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—

ayahs.ar: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ

tr.sahih: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
tr.pickthall: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
tr.yusufali: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
tr.khattab: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious

ayahs.ar: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ

tr.sahih: Effecter of what He intends.
tr.pickthall: Doer of what He will.
tr.yusufali: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.
tr.khattab: Doer of whatever He wills

ayahs.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ

tr.sahih: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
tr.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
tr.yusufali: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-
tr.khattab: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—

ayahs.ar: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ

tr.sahih: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
tr.pickthall: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?
tr.yusufali: Of Pharaoh and the Thamud?
tr.khattab: ˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd

ayahs.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ

tr.sahih: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
tr.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
tr.yusufali: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!
tr.khattab: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial

ayahs.ar: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ

tr.sahih: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
tr.pickthall: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.
tr.yusufali: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!
tr.khattab: But Allah encompasses them from all sides

ayahs.ar: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: But this is an honored Qur'an
tr.pickthall: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.
tr.yusufali: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,
tr.khattab: In fact, this is a glorious Quran

ayahs.ar: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ

tr.sahih: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
tr.pickthall: On a guarded tablet.
tr.yusufali: (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved!
tr.khattab: ˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ

tr.sahih: By the sky and the night comer -
tr.pickthall: By the heaven and the Morning Star
tr.yusufali: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-
tr.khattab: By the heaven and the nightly star

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
tr.pickthall: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
tr.khattab: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is

ayahs.ar: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ

tr.sahih: It is the piercing star -
tr.pickthall: - The piercing Star!
tr.yusufali: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness

ayahs.ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ

tr.sahih: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
tr.pickthall: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
tr.yusufali: There is no soul but has a protector over it.
tr.khattab: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺

ayahs.ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ

tr.sahih: So let man observe from what he was created.
tr.pickthall: So let man consider from what he is created.
tr.yusufali: Now let man but think from what he is created!
tr.khattab: Let people then consider what they were created from

ayahs.ar: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ

tr.sahih: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
tr.pickthall: He is created from a gushing fluid
tr.yusufali: He is created from a drop emitted-
tr.khattab: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid

ayahs.ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ

tr.sahih: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
tr.pickthall: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
tr.yusufali: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
tr.khattab: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
tr.pickthall: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
tr.yusufali: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!
tr.khattab: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ

tr.sahih: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
tr.pickthall: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
tr.yusufali: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,
tr.khattab: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed

ayahs.ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ

tr.sahih: Then man will have no power or any helper.
tr.pickthall: Then will he have no might nor any helper.
tr.yusufali: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.
tr.khattab: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ

tr.sahih: By the sky which returns [rain]
tr.pickthall: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
tr.yusufali: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),
tr.khattab: By the sky with its recurring cycles

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
tr.pickthall: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
tr.yusufali: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-
tr.khattab: and the earth with its sprouting plants

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
tr.pickthall: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,
tr.yusufali: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):
tr.khattab: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word

ayahs.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ

tr.sahih: And it is not amusement.
tr.pickthall: It is no pleasantry.
tr.yusufali: It is not a thing for amusement.
tr.khattab: and is not to be taken lightly

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
tr.pickthall: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
tr.yusufali: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,
tr.khattab: They are certainly devising ˹evil˺ plans

ayahs.ar: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا

tr.sahih: But I am planning a plan.
tr.pickthall: And I plot a plot (against them).
tr.yusufali: And I am planning a scheme.
tr.khattab: but I too am planning

ayahs.ar: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا

tr.sahih: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
tr.pickthall: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
tr.yusufali: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
tr.khattab: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while

ayahs.ar: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى

tr.sahih: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
tr.pickthall: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
tr.yusufali: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,
tr.khattab: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

tr.sahih: Who created and proportioned
tr.pickthall: Who createth, then disposeth;
tr.yusufali: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;
tr.khattab: Who created and ˹perfectly˺ fashioned ˹all˺

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ

tr.sahih: And who destined and [then] guided
tr.pickthall: Who measureth, then guideth;
tr.yusufali: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;
tr.khattab: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ

tr.sahih: And who brings out the pasture
tr.pickthall: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,
tr.yusufali: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,
tr.khattab: and Who brings forth ˹green˺ pasture

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ

tr.sahih: And [then] makes it black stubble.
tr.pickthall: Then turneth it to russet stubble.
