tr.yusufali: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
tr.khattab: then reduces it to withered chaff

ayahs.ar: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
tr.pickthall: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
tr.yusufali: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,
tr.khattab: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ

tr.sahih: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
tr.pickthall: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
tr.yusufali: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.
tr.khattab: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden

ayahs.ar: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: And We will ease you toward ease.
tr.pickthall: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
tr.yusufali: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).
tr.khattab: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease

ayahs.ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
tr.pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
tr.yusufali: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
tr.khattab: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺

ayahs.ar: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ

tr.sahih: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
tr.pickthall: He will heed who feareth,
tr.yusufali: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):
tr.khattab: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺

ayahs.ar: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى

tr.sahih: But the wretched one will avoid it -
tr.pickthall: But the most hapless will flout it,
tr.yusufali: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
tr.khattab: But it will be shunned by the most wretched

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
tr.pickthall: He who will be flung to the great Fire
tr.yusufali: Who will enter the Great Fire,
tr.khattab: who will burn in the greatest Fire

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

tr.sahih: Neither dying therein nor living.
tr.pickthall: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
tr.yusufali: In which they will then neither die nor live.
tr.khattab: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die

ayahs.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

tr.sahih: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
tr.pickthall: He is successful who groweth,
tr.yusufali: But those will prosper who purify themselves,
tr.khattab: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves

ayahs.ar: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ

tr.sahih: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
tr.pickthall: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
tr.yusufali: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.
tr.khattab: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray

ayahs.ar: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

tr.sahih: But you prefer the worldly life,
tr.pickthall: But ye prefer the life of the world
tr.yusufali: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;
tr.khattab: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
tr.pickthall: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
tr.yusufali: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
tr.khattab: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

tr.sahih: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
tr.pickthall: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
tr.yusufali: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-
tr.khattab: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—

ayahs.ar: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ

tr.sahih: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
tr.pickthall: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
tr.yusufali: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
tr.khattab: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses

ayahs.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ

tr.sahih: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
tr.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?
tr.yusufali: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?
tr.khattab: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ

tr.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
tr.pickthall: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,
tr.yusufali: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,
tr.khattab: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast

ayahs.ar: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Working [hard] and exhausted.
tr.pickthall: Toiling, weary,
tr.yusufali: Labouring (hard), weary,-
tr.khattab: ˹totally˺ overburdened, exhausted

ayahs.ar: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ

tr.sahih: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
tr.pickthall: Scorched by burning fire,
tr.yusufali: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-
tr.khattab: burning in a scorching Fire

ayahs.ar: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
tr.pickthall: Drinking from a boiling spring,
tr.yusufali: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,
tr.khattab: left to drink from a scalding spring

ayahs.ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ

tr.sahih: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
tr.pickthall: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
tr.yusufali: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'
tr.khattab: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub

ayahs.ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ

tr.sahih: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
tr.pickthall: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
tr.yusufali: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
tr.khattab: neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger

ayahs.ar: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
tr.pickthall: In that day other faces will be calm,
tr.yusufali: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
tr.khattab: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss

ayahs.ar: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: With their effort [they are] satisfied
tr.pickthall: Glad for their effort past,
tr.yusufali: Pleased with their striving,-
tr.khattab: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving

ayahs.ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: In an elevated garden,
tr.pickthall: In a high Garden
tr.yusufali: In a Garden on high,
tr.khattab: in an elevated Garden

ayahs.ar: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ

tr.sahih: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
tr.pickthall: Where they hear no idle speech,
tr.yusufali: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:
tr.khattab: where no idle talk will be heard

ayahs.ar: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Within it is a flowing spring.
tr.pickthall: Wherein is a gushing spring,
tr.yusufali: Therein will be a bubbling spring:
tr.khattab: In it will be a running spring

ayahs.ar: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Within it are couches raised high
tr.pickthall: Wherein are couches raised
tr.yusufali: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,
tr.khattab: along with thrones raised high

ayahs.ar: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: And cups put in place
tr.pickthall: And goblets set at hand
tr.yusufali: Goblets placed (ready),
tr.khattab: and cups set at hand

ayahs.ar: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: And cushions lined up
tr.pickthall: And cushions ranged
tr.yusufali: And cushions set in rows,
tr.khattab: and ˹fine˺ cushions lined up

ayahs.ar: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ

tr.sahih: And carpets spread around.
tr.pickthall: And silken carpets spread.
tr.yusufali: And rich carpets (all) spread out.
tr.khattab: and ˹splendid˺ carpets spread out

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

tr.sahih: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
tr.pickthall: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?
tr.yusufali: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-
tr.khattab: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created

ayahs.ar: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ

tr.sahih: And at the sky - how it is raised?
tr.pickthall: And the heaven, how it is raised?
tr.yusufali: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-
tr.khattab: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ

tr.sahih: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
tr.pickthall: And the hills, how they are set up?
tr.yusufali: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-
tr.khattab: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up

ayahs.ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ

tr.sahih: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
tr.pickthall: And the earth, how it is spread?
tr.yusufali: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?
tr.khattab: and the earth—how it was levelled out

ayahs.ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ

tr.sahih: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
tr.pickthall: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
tr.yusufali: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.
tr.khattab: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind

ayahs.ar: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ

tr.sahih: You are not over them a controller.
tr.pickthall: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
tr.yusufali: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.
tr.khattab: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ

tr.sahih: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
tr.pickthall: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,
tr.yusufali: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-
tr.khattab: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief

ayahs.ar: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ

tr.sahih: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
tr.pickthall: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.
tr.yusufali: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,
tr.khattab: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ

tr.sahih: Indeed, to Us is their return.
tr.pickthall: Lo! unto Us is their return
tr.yusufali: For to Us will be their return;
tr.khattab: Surely to Us is their return

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم

tr.sahih: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
tr.pickthall: And Ours their reckoning.
tr.yusufali: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
tr.khattab: then surely with Us is their reckoning

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْفَجْرِ

tr.sahih: By the dawn
tr.pickthall: By the Dawn
tr.yusufali: By the break of Day
tr.khattab: By the dawn

ayahs.ar: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ

tr.sahih: And [by] ten nights
tr.pickthall: And ten nights,
tr.yusufali: By the Nights twice five;
tr.khattab: and the ten nights

ayahs.ar: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
tr.pickthall: And the Even and the Odd,
tr.yusufali: By the even and odd (contrasted);
tr.khattab: and the even and the odd

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ

tr.sahih: And [by] the night when it passes,
tr.pickthall: And the night when it departeth,
tr.yusufali: And by the Night when it passeth away;-
tr.khattab: and the night when it passes

ayahs.ar: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ

tr.sahih: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
tr.pickthall: There surely is an oath for thinking man.
tr.yusufali: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?
tr.khattab: Is all this ˹not˺ a sufficient oath for those who have sense

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

tr.sahih: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
tr.pickthall: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,
tr.yusufali: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people),-
tr.khattab: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with ’Ȃd—

ayahs.ar: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ

tr.sahih: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
tr.pickthall: With many-columned Iram,
tr.yusufali: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,
tr.khattab: ˹the people˺ of Iram—with ˹their˺ great stature

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ

tr.sahih: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
tr.pickthall: The like of which was not created in the lands;
tr.yusufali: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?
tr.khattab: unmatched in any other land

ayahs.ar: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ

tr.sahih: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
tr.pickthall: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;
tr.yusufali: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-
tr.khattab: and Thamûd who carved ˹their homes into˺ the rocks in the ˹Stone˺ Valley

ayahs.ar: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ

tr.sahih: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
tr.pickthall: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,
tr.yusufali: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?
tr.khattab: and the Pharaoh of mighty structures

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ

tr.sahih: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
tr.pickthall: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
tr.yusufali: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
tr.khattab: They all transgressed throughout the land

ayahs.ar: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ

tr.sahih: And increased therein the corruption.
tr.pickthall: And multiplied iniquity therein?
tr.yusufali: And heaped therein mischief (on mischief).
tr.khattab: spreading much corruption there

ayahs.ar: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ

tr.sahih: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
tr.pickthall: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
tr.yusufali: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
tr.khattab: So your Lord unleashed on them a scourge of punishment

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
tr.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
tr.yusufali: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
tr.khattab: ˹For˺ your Lord is truly vigilant

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ

tr.sahih: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
tr.pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
tr.yusufali: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
tr.khattab: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ

tr.sahih: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
tr.pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
tr.yusufali: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
tr.khattab: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

tr.sahih: No! But you do not honor the orphan
tr.pickthall: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
tr.yusufali: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!
tr.khattab: Absolutely not! In fact, you are not ˹even˺ gracious to the orphan

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

tr.sahih: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
tr.pickthall: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.
tr.yusufali: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-
tr.khattab: nor do you urge one another to feed the poor

ayahs.ar: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا

tr.sahih: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
tr.pickthall: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.
tr.yusufali: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,
tr.khattab: And you devour ˹others’˺ inheritance greedily

ayahs.ar: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا

tr.sahih: And you love wealth with immense love.
tr.pickthall: And love wealth with abounding love.
tr.yusufali: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!
tr.khattab: and love wealth fervently

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا

tr.sahih: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
tr.pickthall: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,
tr.yusufali: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,
tr.khattab: Enough! When the earth is entirely crushed over and over

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا

tr.sahih: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
tr.pickthall: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
tr.yusufali: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,
tr.khattab: and your Lord comes ˹to judge˺ with angels, rank upon rank

ayahs.ar: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
tr.pickthall: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
tr.yusufali: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
tr.khattab: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then

ayahs.ar: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى

tr.sahih: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
tr.pickthall: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!
tr.yusufali: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"
tr.khattab: They will cry, “I wish I had sent forth ˹something good˺ for my ˹true˺ life.”

ayahs.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ

tr.sahih: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
tr.pickthall: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!
tr.yusufali: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,
tr.khattab: On that Day He will punish ˹them˺ severely, like no other

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ

tr.sahih: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
tr.pickthall: None bindeth as He then will bind.
tr.yusufali: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.
tr.khattab: and bind ˹them˺ tightly, like no other

ayahs.ar: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ

tr.sahih: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
tr.pickthall: But ah! thou soul at peace!
tr.yusufali: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!
tr.khattab: ˹Allah will say to the righteous,˺ “O tranquil soul

ayahs.ar: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ

tr.sahih: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
tr.pickthall: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
tr.yusufali: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
tr.khattab: Return to your Lord, well pleased ˹with Him˺ and well pleasing ˹to Him˺

ayahs.ar: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى

tr.sahih: And enter among My [righteous] servants
tr.pickthall: Enter thou among My bondmen!
tr.yusufali: "Enter thou, then, among My devotees!
tr.khattab: So join My servants

ayahs.ar: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى

tr.sahih: And enter My Paradise."
tr.pickthall: Enter thou My Garden!
tr.yusufali: "Yea, enter thou My Heaven!
tr.khattab: and enter My Paradise.”

ayahs.ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

tr.sahih: I swear by this city, Makkah -
tr.pickthall: Nay, I swear by this city -
tr.yusufali: I do call to witness this City;-
tr.khattab: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—

ayahs.ar: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

tr.sahih: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
tr.pickthall: And thou art an indweller of this city -
tr.yusufali: And thou art a freeman of this City;-
tr.khattab: even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—

ayahs.ar: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ

tr.sahih: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
tr.pickthall: And the begetter and that which he begat,
tr.yusufali: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-
tr.khattab: and by every parent and ˹their˺ child

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ

tr.sahih: We have certainly created man into hardship.
tr.pickthall: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
tr.yusufali: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle

ayahs.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ

tr.sahih: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
tr.pickthall: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?
tr.yusufali: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
tr.khattab: Do they think that no one has power over them

ayahs.ar: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا

tr.sahih: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
tr.pickthall: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
tr.yusufali: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!
tr.khattab: boasting, “I have wasted enormous wealth!”

ayahs.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

tr.sahih: Does he think that no one has seen him?
tr.pickthall: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
tr.yusufali: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
tr.khattab: Do they think that no one sees them

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ

tr.sahih: Have We not made for him two eyes?
tr.pickthall: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
tr.yusufali: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-
tr.khattab: Have We not given them two eyes

ayahs.ar: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ

tr.sahih: And a tongue and two lips?
tr.pickthall: And a tongue and two lips,
tr.yusufali: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-
tr.khattab: a tongue, and two lips

ayahs.ar: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ

tr.sahih: And have shown him the two ways?
tr.pickthall: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?
tr.yusufali: And shown him the two highways?
tr.khattab: and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺

ayahs.ar: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ

tr.sahih: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
tr.pickthall: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -
tr.yusufali: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.
tr.khattab: If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
tr.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
tr.khattab: And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is

ayahs.ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ

tr.sahih: It is the freeing of a slave
tr.pickthall: (It is) to free a slave,
tr.yusufali: (It is:) freeing the bondman;
tr.khattab: It is to free a slave

ayahs.ar: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
tr.pickthall: And to feed in the day of hunger.
tr.yusufali: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
tr.khattab: or to give food in times of famine

ayahs.ar: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ

tr.sahih: An orphan of near relationship
tr.pickthall: An orphan near of kin,
tr.yusufali: To the orphan with claims of relationship,
tr.khattab: to an orphaned relative

ayahs.ar: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: Or a needy person in misery
tr.pickthall: Or some poor wretch in misery,
tr.yusufali: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.
tr.khattab: or to a poor person in distress

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ

tr.sahih: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
tr.pickthall: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
tr.yusufali: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.
tr.khattab: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion

ayahs.ar: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ

tr.sahih: Those are the companions of the right.
tr.pickthall: Their place will be on the right hand.
tr.yusufali: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.
tr.khattab: These are the people of the right

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

tr.sahih: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
tr.pickthall: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
tr.yusufali: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
tr.khattab: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left

ayahs.ar: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ

tr.sahih: Over them will be fire closed in.
tr.pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them.
tr.yusufali: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
tr.khattab: The Fire will be sealed over them

ayahs.ar: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: By the sun and its brightness
tr.pickthall: By the sun and his brightness,
tr.yusufali: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;
tr.khattab: By the sun and its brightness

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And [by] the moon when it follows it
tr.pickthall: And the moon when she followeth him,
tr.yusufali: By the Moon as she follows him;
tr.khattab: and the moon as it follows it

ayahs.ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And [by] the day when it displays it
tr.pickthall: And the day when it revealeth him,
tr.yusufali: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;
tr.khattab: and the day as it unveils it

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers it
tr.pickthall: And the night when it enshroudeth him,
tr.yusufali: By the Night as it conceals it;
tr.khattab: and the night as it conceals it

ayahs.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
tr.pickthall: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
tr.yusufali: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;
tr.khattab: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
tr.pickthall: And the earth and Him Who spread it,
tr.yusufali: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:
tr.khattab: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it

ayahs.ar: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
tr.pickthall: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
tr.yusufali: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;
tr.khattab: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it

ayahs.ar: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
tr.pickthall: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
tr.yusufali: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
tr.khattab: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it

ayahs.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا

tr.sahih: He has succeeded who purifies it,
tr.pickthall: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
tr.yusufali: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
tr.khattab: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul

ayahs.ar: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا

tr.sahih: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
tr.pickthall: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
tr.yusufali: And he fails that corrupts it!
tr.khattab: and doomed is the one who corrupts it

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ

tr.sahih: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
tr.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,
tr.yusufali: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,
tr.khattab: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance

ayahs.ar: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا

tr.sahih: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
tr.pickthall: When the basest of them broke forth
tr.yusufali: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
tr.khattab: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺

ayahs.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا

tr.sahih: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
tr.pickthall: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
tr.yusufali: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
tr.khattab: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

tr.sahih: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
tr.pickthall: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
tr.yusufali: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!
tr.khattab: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا

tr.sahih: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
tr.pickthall: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).
tr.yusufali: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.
tr.khattab: He has no fear of consequences

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ

tr.sahih: By the night when it covers
tr.pickthall: By the night enshrouding
tr.yusufali: By the Night as it conceals (the light);
tr.khattab: By the night when it covers

ayahs.ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ

tr.sahih: And [by] the day when it appears
tr.pickthall: And the day resplendent
tr.yusufali: By the Day as it appears in glory;
tr.khattab: and the day when it shines

ayahs.ar: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And [by] He who created the male and female,
tr.pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female,
tr.yusufali: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-
tr.khattab: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ

tr.sahih: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
tr.pickthall: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).
tr.yusufali: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.
tr.khattab: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ

tr.sahih: As for he who gives and fears Allah
tr.pickthall: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
tr.yusufali: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),
tr.khattab: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺

ayahs.ar: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: And believes in the best [reward],
tr.pickthall: And believeth in goodness;
tr.yusufali: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-
tr.khattab: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward

ayahs.ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: We will ease him toward ease.
tr.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
tr.yusufali: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.
tr.khattab: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
tr.pickthall: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
tr.yusufali: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,
tr.khattab: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: And denies the best [reward],
tr.pickthall: And disbelieveth in goodness;
tr.yusufali: And gives the lie to the best,-
tr.khattab: and ˹staunchly˺ denies the finest reward

ayahs.ar: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ

tr.sahih: We will ease him toward difficulty.
tr.pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
tr.yusufali: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
tr.khattab: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
tr.pickthall: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
tr.yusufali: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).
tr.khattab: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ

tr.sahih: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
tr.pickthall: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
tr.yusufali: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
tr.khattab: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ

tr.sahih: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
tr.pickthall: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
tr.yusufali: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.
tr.khattab: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next

ayahs.ar: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ

tr.sahih: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
tr.pickthall: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
tr.yusufali: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;
tr.khattab: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire

ayahs.ar: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى

tr.sahih: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
tr.pickthall: Which only the most wretched must endure,
tr.yusufali: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
tr.khattab: in which none will burn except the most wretched—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

tr.sahih: Who had denied and turned away.
tr.pickthall: He who denieth and turneth away.
tr.yusufali: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.
tr.khattab: who deny and turn away

ayahs.ar: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى

tr.sahih: But the righteous one will avoid it -
tr.pickthall: Far removed from it will be the righteous
tr.yusufali: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-
tr.khattab: But the righteous will be spared from it—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ

tr.sahih: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
tr.pickthall: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
tr.yusufali: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
tr.khattab: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
tr.pickthall: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
tr.yusufali: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
tr.khattab: not in return for someone’s favours

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

tr.sahih: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
tr.pickthall: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
tr.yusufali: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
tr.khattab: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High

ayahs.ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ

tr.sahih: And he is going to be satisfied.
tr.pickthall: He verily will be content.
tr.yusufali: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
tr.khattab: They will certainly be pleased

ayahs.ar: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ

tr.sahih: By the morning brightness
tr.pickthall: By the morning hours
tr.yusufali: By the Glorious Morning Light,
tr.khattab: By the morning sunlight

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ

tr.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
tr.pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest,
tr.yusufali: And by the Night when it is still,-
tr.khattab: and the night when it falls still

ayahs.ar: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

tr.sahih: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
tr.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
tr.yusufali: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
tr.khattab: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺

ayahs.ar: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

tr.sahih: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
tr.pickthall: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
tr.yusufali: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
tr.khattab: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one

ayahs.ar: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
tr.pickthall: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
tr.yusufali: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
tr.khattab: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ

tr.sahih: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
tr.pickthall: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
tr.yusufali: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
tr.khattab: Did He not find you as an orphan then sheltered you

ayahs.ar: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ

tr.sahih: And He found you lost and guided [you],
tr.pickthall: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
tr.yusufali: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
tr.khattab: Did He not find you unguided then guided you

ayahs.ar: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ

tr.sahih: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
tr.pickthall: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
tr.yusufali: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
tr.khattab: And did He not find you needy then satisfied your needs

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ

tr.sahih: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
tr.pickthall: Therefor the orphan oppress not,
tr.yusufali: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
tr.khattab: So do not oppress the orphan

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ

tr.sahih: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
tr.pickthall: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
tr.yusufali: Nor repulse the petitioner (unheard);
tr.khattab: nor repulse the beggar

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ

tr.sahih: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
tr.pickthall: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
tr.yusufali: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
tr.khattab: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ

tr.sahih: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
tr.pickthall: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
tr.yusufali: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
tr.khattab: Have We not uplifted your heart for you ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.ar: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ

tr.sahih: And We removed from you your burden
tr.pickthall: And eased thee of the burden
tr.yusufali: And removed from thee thy burden
tr.khattab: relieved you of the burden

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ

tr.sahih: Which had weighed upon your back
tr.pickthall: Which weighed down thy back;
tr.yusufali: The which did gall thy back?-
tr.khattab: which weighed so heavily on your back

ayahs.ar: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ

tr.sahih: And raised high for you your repute.
tr.pickthall: And exalted thy fame?
tr.yusufali: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?
tr.khattab: and elevated your renown for you

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

tr.sahih: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
tr.pickthall: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,
tr.yusufali: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
tr.khattab: So, surely with hardship comes ease

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا

tr.sahih: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
tr.pickthall: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;
tr.yusufali: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
tr.khattab: Surely with ˹that˺ hardship comes ˹more˺ ease

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ

tr.sahih: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
tr.pickthall: So when thou art relieved, still toil
tr.yusufali: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
tr.khattab: So once you have fulfilled ˹your duty˺, strive ˹in devotion˺

ayahs.ar: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب

tr.sahih: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
tr.pickthall: And strive to please thy Lord.
tr.yusufali: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
tr.khattab: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope

ayahs.ar: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ

tr.sahih: By the fig and the olive
tr.pickthall: By the fig and the olive,
tr.yusufali: By the Fig and the Olive,
tr.khattab: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺

ayahs.ar: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ

tr.sahih: And [by] Mount Sinai
tr.pickthall: By Mount Sinai,
tr.yusufali: And the Mount of Sinai,
tr.khattab: and Mount Sinai

ayahs.ar: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ

tr.sahih: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],
tr.pickthall: And by this land made safe;
tr.yusufali: And this City of security,-
tr.khattab: and this secure city ˹of Mecca˺

ayahs.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ

tr.sahih: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
tr.pickthall: Surely We created man of the best stature
tr.yusufali: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,
tr.khattab: Indeed, We created humans in the best form

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ

tr.sahih: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
tr.pickthall: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,
tr.yusufali: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-
tr.khattab: But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ

tr.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
tr.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.
tr.yusufali: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.
tr.khattab: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward

ayahs.ar: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
tr.pickthall: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?
tr.yusufali: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?
tr.khattab: Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment

ayahs.ar: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ

tr.sahih: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
tr.pickthall: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?
tr.yusufali: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?
tr.khattab: Is Allah not the most just of all judges

ayahs.ar: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ

tr.sahih: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
tr.pickthall: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
tr.yusufali: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-
tr.khattab: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ

tr.sahih: Created man from a clinging substance.
tr.pickthall: Createth man from a clot.
tr.yusufali: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:
tr.khattab: created humans from a clinging clot

ayahs.ar: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ

tr.sahih: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
tr.pickthall: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
tr.yusufali: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-
tr.khattab: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ

tr.sahih: Who taught by the pen -
tr.pickthall: Who teacheth by the pen,
tr.yusufali: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-
tr.khattab: Who taught by the pen—

ayahs.ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ

tr.sahih: Taught man that which he knew not.
tr.pickthall: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
tr.yusufali: Taught man that which he knew not.
tr.khattab: taught humanity what they knew not

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
tr.pickthall: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
tr.yusufali: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,
tr.khattab: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds

ayahs.ar: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
tr.pickthall: That he thinketh himself independent!
tr.yusufali: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.
tr.khattab: once they think they are self-sufficient

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
tr.pickthall: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
tr.yusufali: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).
tr.khattab: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺

ayahs.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ

tr.sahih: Have you seen the one who forbids
tr.pickthall: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
tr.yusufali: Seest thou one who forbids-
tr.khattab: Have you seen the man who prevents

ayahs.ar: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ

tr.sahih: A servant when he prays?
tr.pickthall: A slave when he prayeth?
tr.yusufali: A votary when he (turns) to pray?
tr.khattab: a servant ˹of Ours˺ from praying

ayahs.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
tr.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
tr.yusufali: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-
tr.khattab: What if this ˹servant˺ is ˹rightly˺ guided

ayahs.ar: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Or enjoins righteousness?
tr.pickthall: Or enjoineth piety?
tr.yusufali: Or enjoins Righteousness?
tr.khattab: or encourages righteousness

ayahs.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

tr.sahih: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
tr.pickthall: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?
tr.yusufali: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?
tr.khattab: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ

tr.sahih: Does he not know that Allah sees?
tr.pickthall: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?
tr.yusufali: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?
tr.khattab: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

tr.sahih: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
tr.pickthall: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -
tr.yusufali: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-
tr.khattab: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—

ayahs.ar: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: A lying, sinning forelock.
tr.pickthall: The lying, sinful forelock -
tr.yusufali: A lying, sinful forelock!
tr.khattab: a lying, sinful forelock

ayahs.ar: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Then let him call his associates;
tr.pickthall: Then let him call upon his henchmen!
tr.yusufali: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):
tr.khattab: So let him call his associates

ayahs.ar: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ

tr.sahih: We will call the angels of Hell.
tr.pickthall: We will call the guards of hell.
tr.yusufali: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!
tr.khattab: We will call the wardens of Hell

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩

tr.sahih: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
tr.pickthall: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
tr.yusufali: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!
tr.khattab: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.
tr.yusufali: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:
tr.khattab: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
tr.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?
tr.khattab: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is

ayahs.ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ

tr.sahih: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
tr.pickthall: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
tr.yusufali: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
tr.khattab: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months

ayahs.ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ

tr.sahih: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
tr.pickthall: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
tr.yusufali: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:
tr.khattab: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter

ayahs.ar: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ

tr.sahih: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
tr.pickthall: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
tr.yusufali: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!
tr.khattab: It is all peace until the break of dawn

ayahs.ar: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

tr.sahih: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
tr.pickthall: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,
tr.yusufali: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, were not going to depart (from their ways) until there should come to them Clear Evidence,-
tr.khattab: The disbelievers from the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist ˹from disbelief˺ until the clear proof came to them

ayahs.ar: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ

tr.sahih: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures
tr.pickthall: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages
tr.yusufali: An messenger from Allah, rehearsing scriptures kept pure and holy:
tr.khattab: a messenger from Allah, reciting scrolls of ˹utmost˺ purity

ayahs.ar: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Within which are correct writings.
tr.pickthall: Containing correct scriptures.
tr.yusufali: Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight.
tr.khattab: containing upright commandments

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

tr.sahih: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
tr.pickthall: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.
tr.yusufali: Nor did the People of the Book make schisms, until after there came to them Clear Evidence.
tr.khattab: It was not until this clear proof came to the People of the Book that they became divided ˹about his prophethood˺—

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ

tr.sahih: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
tr.pickthall: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.
tr.yusufali: And they have been commanded no more than this: To worship Allah, offering Him sincere devotion, being true (in faith); to establish regular prayer; and to practise regular charity; and that is the Religion Right and Straight.
tr.khattab: even though they were only commanded to worship Allah ˹alone˺ with sincere devotion to Him in all uprightness, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. That is the upright Way

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.
tr.yusufali: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, will be in Hell-Fire, to dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures.
tr.khattab: Indeed, those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there forever. They are the worst of ˹all˺ beings

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
tr.pickthall: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.
tr.yusufali: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds,- they are the best of creatures.
tr.khattab: Indeed, those who believe and do good—they are the best of ˹all˺ beings

ayahs.ar: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ

tr.sahih: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
tr.pickthall: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
tr.yusufali: Their reward is with Allah: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which rivers flow; they will dwell therein for ever; Allah well pleased with them, and they with Him: all this for such as fear their Lord and Cherisher.
tr.khattab: Their reward with their Lord will be Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is ˹only˺ for those in awe of their Lord

ayahs.ar: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا

tr.sahih: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
tr.pickthall: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
tr.yusufali: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
tr.khattab: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking

ayahs.ar: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا

tr.sahih: And the earth discharges its burdens
tr.pickthall: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
tr.yusufali: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
tr.khattab: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا

tr.sahih: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
tr.pickthall: And man saith: What aileth her?
tr.yusufali: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-
tr.khattab: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا

tr.sahih: That Day, it will report its news
tr.pickthall: That day she will relate her chronicles,
tr.yusufali: On that Day will she declare her tidings:
tr.khattab: on that Day the earth will recount everything

ayahs.ar: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا

tr.sahih: Because your Lord has commanded it.
tr.pickthall: Because thy Lord inspireth her.
tr.yusufali: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.
tr.khattab: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

tr.sahih: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
tr.pickthall: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
tr.yusufali: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
tr.khattab: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds

ayahs.ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
tr.pickthall: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
tr.yusufali: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!
tr.khattab: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ

tr.sahih: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
tr.pickthall: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.
tr.yusufali: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.
tr.khattab: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا

tr.sahih: By the racers, panting,
tr.pickthall: By the snorting courses,
tr.yusufali: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
tr.khattab: ’ By the galloping, panting horses

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا

tr.sahih: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
tr.pickthall: Striking sparks of fire
tr.yusufali: And strike sparks of fire,
tr.khattab: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺

ayahs.ar: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا

tr.sahih: And the chargers at dawn,
tr.pickthall: And scouring to the raid at dawn,
tr.yusufali: And push home the charge in the morning,
tr.khattab: launching raids at dawn

ayahs.ar: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا

tr.sahih: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
tr.pickthall: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
tr.yusufali: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
tr.khattab: stirring up ˹clouds of˺ dust

ayahs.ar: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا

tr.sahih: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
tr.pickthall: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
tr.yusufali: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
tr.khattab: and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
tr.pickthall: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
tr.yusufali: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
tr.khattab: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ

tr.sahih: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
tr.pickthall: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
tr.yusufali: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
tr.khattab: and they certainly attest to this—

ayahs.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

tr.sahih: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
tr.pickthall: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
tr.yusufali: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
tr.khattab: and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains

ayahs.ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

tr.sahih: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
tr.pickthall: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
tr.yusufali: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
tr.khattab: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out

ayahs.ar: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ

tr.sahih: And that within the breasts is obtained,
tr.pickthall: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
tr.yusufali: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
tr.khattab: and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ

tr.sahih: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
tr.pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
tr.yusufali: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
tr.khattab: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day

ayahs.ar: ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

tr.sahih: The Striking Calamity -
tr.pickthall: The Calamity!
tr.yusufali: The (Day) of Noise and Clamour:
tr.khattab: The Striking Disaster

ayahs.ar: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

tr.sahih: What is the Striking Calamity?
tr.pickthall: What is the Calamity?
tr.yusufali: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?
tr.khattab: What is the Striking Disaster

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
tr.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?
tr.khattab: And what will make you realize what the Striking Disaster is

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ

tr.sahih: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
tr.pickthall: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
tr.yusufali: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths

ayahs.ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ

tr.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
tr.pickthall: And the mountains will become as carded wool.
tr.yusufali: And the mountains will be like carded wool.
tr.khattab: and the mountains will be like carded wool

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

tr.sahih: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
tr.pickthall: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),
tr.yusufali: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,
tr.khattab: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺

ayahs.ar: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ

tr.sahih: He will be in a pleasant life.
tr.pickthall: He will live a pleasant life.
tr.yusufali: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.
tr.khattab: they will be in a life of bliss

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

tr.sahih: But as for one whose scales are light,
tr.pickthall: But as for him whose scales are light,
tr.yusufali: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-
tr.khattab: And as for those whose scale is light

ayahs.ar: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: His refuge will be an abyss.
tr.pickthall: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,
tr.yusufali: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.
tr.khattab: their home will be the abyss

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what that is?
tr.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee what this is?
tr.khattab: And what will make you realize what that is

ayahs.ar: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ

tr.sahih: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
tr.pickthall: Raging Fire.
tr.yusufali: (It is) a Fire Blazing fiercely!
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ a scorching Fire

ayahs.ar: أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

tr.sahih: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
tr.pickthall: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
tr.yusufali: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),
tr.khattab: Competition for more ˹gains˺ diverts you ˹from Allah˺

ayahs.ar: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ

tr.sahih: Until you visit the graveyards.
tr.pickthall: Until ye come to the graves.
tr.yusufali: Until ye visit the graves.
tr.khattab: until you end up in ˹your˺ graves

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: No! You are going to know.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
tr.yusufali: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
tr.khattab: But no! You will soon come to know

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

tr.sahih: Then no! You are going to know.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but ye will come to know!
tr.yusufali: Again, ye soon shall know!
tr.khattab: Again, no! You will soon come to know

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

tr.sahih: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
tr.pickthall: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
tr.yusufali: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
tr.khattab: Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺

ayahs.ar: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ

tr.sahih: You will surely see the Hellfire.
tr.pickthall: For ye will behold hell-fire.
tr.yusufali: Ye shall certainly see Hell-Fire!
tr.khattab: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

tr.sahih: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
tr.pickthall: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
tr.yusufali: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
tr.khattab: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

tr.sahih: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
tr.pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
tr.yusufali: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
tr.khattab: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures

ayahs.ar: وَٱلْعَصْرِ

tr.sahih: By time,
tr.pickthall: By the declining day,
tr.yusufali: By (the Token of) Time (through the ages),
tr.khattab: By the ˹passage of˺ time

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
tr.pickthall: Lo! man is a state of loss,
tr.yusufali: Verily Man is in loss,
tr.khattab: Surely humanity is in ˹grave˺ loss

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ

tr.sahih: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
tr.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.
tr.yusufali: Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.
tr.khattab: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance

ayahs.ar: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ

tr.sahih: Woe to every scorner and mocker
tr.pickthall: Woe unto every slandering traducer,
tr.yusufali: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,
tr.khattab: Woe to every backbiter, slanderer

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ

tr.sahih: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
tr.pickthall: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.
tr.yusufali: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,
tr.khattab: who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺

ayahs.ar: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ

tr.sahih: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
tr.pickthall: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
tr.yusufali: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!
tr.khattab: thinking that their wealth will make them immortal

ayahs.ar: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ

tr.sahih: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
tr.yusufali: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,
tr.khattab: Not at all! Such a person will certainly be tossed into the Crusher

ayahs.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ

tr.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
tr.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
tr.yusufali: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
tr.khattab: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is

ayahs.ar: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ

tr.sahih: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
tr.pickthall: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,
tr.yusufali: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),
tr.khattab: ˹It is˺ Allah’s kindled Fire

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ

tr.sahih: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
tr.pickthall: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).
tr.yusufali: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:
tr.khattab: which rages over the hearts

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ

tr.sahih: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is closed in on them
tr.yusufali: It shall be made into a vault over them,
tr.khattab: It will be sealed over them

ayahs.ar: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ

tr.sahih: In extended columns.
tr.pickthall: In outstretched columns.
tr.yusufali: In columns outstretched.
tr.khattab: ˹tightly secured˺ with long braces

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

tr.sahih: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
tr.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
tr.yusufali: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?
tr.khattab: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant

ayahs.ar: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ

tr.sahih: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
tr.pickthall: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
tr.yusufali: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?
tr.khattab: Did He not frustrate their scheme

ayahs.ar: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

tr.sahih: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
tr.pickthall: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,
tr.yusufali: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,
tr.khattab: For He sent against them flocks of birds

ayahs.ar: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ

tr.sahih: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
tr.pickthall: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
tr.yusufali: Striking them with stones of baked clay.
tr.khattab: that pelted them with stones of baked clay

ayahs.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ

tr.sahih: And He made them like eaten straw.
tr.pickthall: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?
tr.yusufali: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
tr.khattab: leaving them like chewed up straw

ayahs.ar: لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

tr.sahih: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
tr.pickthall: For the taming of Qureysh.
tr.yusufali: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,
tr.khattab: ˹At least˺ for ˹the favour of˺ making Quraysh habitually secure—

ayahs.ar: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ

tr.sahih: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
tr.pickthall: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
tr.yusufali: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-
tr.khattab: secure in their trading caravan ˹to Yemen˺ in the winter and ˹Syria˺ in the summer—

ayahs.ar: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ

tr.sahih: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
tr.pickthall: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
tr.yusufali: Let them adore the Lord of this House,
tr.khattab: let them worship the Lord of this ˹Sacred˺ House

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

tr.sahih: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
tr.pickthall: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
tr.yusufali: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).
tr.khattab: Who has fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear

ayahs.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
tr.pickthall: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?
tr.yusufali: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?
tr.khattab: Have you seen the one who denies the ˹final˺ Judgment

ayahs.ar: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

tr.sahih: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
tr.pickthall: That is he who repelleth the orphan,
tr.yusufali: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),
tr.khattab: That is the one who repulses the orphan

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

tr.sahih: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
tr.pickthall: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.
tr.yusufali: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.
tr.khattab: and does not encourage the feeding of the poor

ayahs.ar: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

tr.sahih: So woe to those who pray
tr.pickthall: Ah, woe unto worshippers
tr.yusufali: So woe to the worshippers
tr.khattab: So woe to those ˹hypocrites˺ who pray

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

tr.sahih: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
tr.pickthall: Who are heedless of their prayer;
tr.yusufali: Who are neglectful of their prayers,
tr.khattab: yet are unmindful of their prayers

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ

tr.sahih: Those who make show [of their deeds]
tr.pickthall: Who would be seen (at worship)
tr.yusufali: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),
tr.khattab: those who ˹only˺ show off

ayahs.ar: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ

tr.sahih: And withhold [simple] assistance.
tr.pickthall: Yet refuse small kindnesses!
tr.yusufali: But refuse (to supply) (even) neighbourly needs.
tr.khattab: and refuse to give ˹even the simplest˺ aid

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
tr.yusufali: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
tr.khattab: Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness

ayahs.ar: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ

tr.sahih: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
tr.pickthall: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
tr.yusufali: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.
tr.khattab: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
tr.pickthall: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.
tr.yusufali: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).
tr.khattab: Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺

ayahs.ar: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

tr.sahih: Say, "O disbelievers,
tr.pickthall: Say: O disbelievers!
tr.yusufali: Say: O ye that reject Faith!
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O you disbelievers

ayahs.ar: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

tr.sahih: I do not worship what you worship.
tr.pickthall: I worship not that which ye worship;
tr.yusufali: I worship not that which ye worship,
tr.khattab: I do not worship what you worship

ayahs.ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

tr.sahih: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
tr.pickthall: Nor worship ye that which I worship.
tr.yusufali: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
tr.khattab: nor do you worship what I worship

ayahs.ar: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

tr.sahih: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
tr.pickthall: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.
tr.yusufali: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,
tr.khattab: I will never worship what you worship

ayahs.ar: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

tr.sahih: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
tr.pickthall: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
tr.yusufali: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
tr.khattab: nor will you ever worship what I worship

ayahs.ar: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ

tr.sahih: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
tr.pickthall: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.
tr.yusufali: To you be your Way, and to me mine.
tr.khattab: You have your way, and I have my Way.”

ayahs.ar: إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ

tr.sahih: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
tr.pickthall: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh
tr.yusufali: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory,
tr.khattab: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺

ayahs.ar: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا

tr.sahih: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
tr.pickthall: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
tr.yusufali: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds,
tr.khattab: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds

ayahs.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا

tr.sahih: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
tr.pickthall: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
tr.yusufali: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).
tr.khattab: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance

ayahs.ar: تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ

tr.sahih: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
tr.pickthall: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.
tr.yusufali: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!
tr.khattab: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

tr.sahih: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
tr.pickthall: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
tr.yusufali: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!
tr.khattab: Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him

ayahs.ar: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ

tr.sahih: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
tr.pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
tr.yusufali: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
tr.khattab: He will burn in a flaming Fire

ayahs.ar: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ

tr.sahih: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
tr.pickthall: And his wife, the wood-carrier,
