tr.yusufali: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
tr.khattab: and ˹so will˺ his wife, the carrier of ˹thorny˺ kindling

ayahs.ar: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ

tr.sahih: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
tr.pickthall: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
tr.yusufali: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!
tr.khattab: around her neck will be a rope of palm-fibre

ayahs.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

tr.sahih: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,
tr.pickthall: Say: He is Allah, the One!
tr.yusufali: Say: He is Allah, the One and Only;
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is Allah—One ˹and Indivisible˺

ayahs.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ

tr.sahih: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.
tr.pickthall: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!
tr.yusufali: Allah, the Eternal, Absolute;
tr.khattab: Allah—the Sustainer ˹needed by all˺

ayahs.ar: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

tr.sahih: He neither begets nor is born,
tr.pickthall: He begetteth not nor was begotten.
tr.yusufali: He begetteth not, nor is He begotten;
tr.khattab: He has never had offspring, nor was He born

ayahs.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ

tr.sahih: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
tr.pickthall: And there is none comparable unto Him.
tr.yusufali: And there is none like unto Him.
tr.khattab: And there is none comparable to Him.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

tr.sahih: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
tr.pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak
tr.yusufali: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak

ayahs.ar: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

tr.sahih: From the evil of that which He created
tr.pickthall: From the evil of that which He created;
tr.yusufali: From the mischief of created things;
tr.khattab: from the evil of whatever He has created

ayahs.ar: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

tr.sahih: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
tr.pickthall: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,
tr.yusufali: From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads;
tr.khattab: and from the evil of the night when it grows dark

ayahs.ar: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ

tr.sahih: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
tr.pickthall: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,
tr.yusufali: From the mischief of those who practise secret arts;
tr.khattab: and from the evil of those ˹witches casting spells by˺ blowing onto knots

ayahs.ar: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

tr.sahih: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
tr.pickthall: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.
tr.yusufali: And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy.
tr.khattab: and from the evil of an envier when they envy.”

ayahs.ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

tr.sahih: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
tr.pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
tr.yusufali: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind,
tr.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind

ayahs.ar: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ

tr.sahih: The Sovereign of mankind.
tr.pickthall: The King of mankind,
tr.yusufali: The King (or Ruler) of Mankind,
tr.khattab: the Master of humankind

ayahs.ar: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ

tr.sahih: The God of mankind,
tr.pickthall: The god of mankind,
tr.yusufali: The god (or judge) of Mankind,-
tr.khattab: the God of humankind

ayahs.ar: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ

tr.sahih: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
tr.pickthall: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,
tr.yusufali: From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper),-
tr.khattab: from the evil of the lurking whisperer—

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ

tr.sahih: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
tr.pickthall: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,
tr.yusufali: (The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind,-
tr.khattab: who whispers into the hearts of humankind—

ayahs.ar: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ

tr.sahih: From among the jinn and mankind."
tr.pickthall: Of the jinn and of mankind.
tr.yusufali: Among Jinns and among men.
tr.khattab: from among jinn and humankind.”
